title: Sequential diagnosis with language models
summary_zh: 研究语言模型在连续诊断中的应用。开发交互式基准和AI系统模拟医生诊断过程。系统在临床病例中达到83.2%的准确率。
summary_en: This study explores the application of language models in sequential diagnosis. An interactive benchmark and an AI system simulating physician diagnosis processes are developed. The system achieves an 83.2% accuracy rate in clinical cases.
insights: 创新点：语言模型在连续诊断中的有效性
方法亮点：交互式基准和AI系统的开发
关键发现：系统在临床病例中表现优于普通医生
insights_en: Novelty: Effectiveness of language models in sequential diagnosis
Method highlight: Development of interactive benchmark and AI system
Key finding: System outperforms generalist physicians in clinical cases
abstract: We explored the capabilities of frontier language models in sequential diagnosis, a diagnostic paradigm that captures the iterative nature of clinical reasoning. Given a brief clinical presentation, clinicians selectively acquired information to reach a diagnosis, enabling assessment of diagnostic accuracy and workup cost. We developed an interactive benchmark and an artificial intelligence (AI) system that simulates a panel of physicians, continually revising the differential diagnosis and selecting cost-effective tests. Using this benchmark, the system achieved 83.2% accuracy on New England Journal of Medicine clinicopathological conference cases and 80.3% on MIMIC-IV-ED emergency department admissions, outperforming generalist physicians (36.1 and 46.8%, respectively). Although these findings were obtained in a controlled benchmark setting, they highlight the promise of language models for supporting more accurate, lower-cost diagnoses.

title: Tangermeme: a toolkit for understanding cis-regulatory logic using deep learning models
summary_zh: Tangermeme工具包用于从深度学习模型中提取可解释的顺式调控模式。
summary_en: The Tangermeme toolkit is used to extract interpretable cis-regulatory patterns from deep learning models.
insights: 创新点：Tangermeme优化基因组深度学习应用
方法亮点：提取模型学习到的顺式调控模式
关键发现：Tangermeme促进生物发现
insights_en: Novelty: Tangermeme optimizes applications of genomic deep learning
Method highlight: Extracts cis-regulatory patterns learned by models
Key finding: Tangermeme promotes biological discovery
abstract: Abstract Deep learning models have achieved state-of-the-art performance at predicting diverse genomic modalities, yet their promise for biological discovery lies in how they are used after demonstrating their predictive performance. Here we describe the functionality of tangermeme, a highly optimized toolkit for ‘everything-but-the-model’ when it comes to genomic deep learning, and demonstrate how tangermeme can be used to distill the learned cis- regulatory patterns from models into human-interpretable insights.

title: Comparative analysis of mitochondrial proteomes across the tree of life
summary_zh: 本文比较分析了生命树中不同生物的线粒体蛋白质组。方法上，通过实验定义的线粒体蛋白质组进行对比。实验表明，发现保守的蛋白质家族，并预测线粒体蛋白质。
summary_en: This paper compares mitochondrial proteomes across different organisms in the tree of life. Using experimentally defined mitoproteomes, it identifies conserved protein families and predicts mitoproteomes.
insights: 创新点：发现生命树中保守的蛋白质家族
方法亮点：利用实验定义的线粒体蛋白质组
关键发现：预测线粒体蛋白质的进化轨迹
insights_en: Novelty: Identifies conserved protein families in the tree of life
Method highlight: Utilizes experimentally defined mitoproteomes
Key finding: Predicts evolutionary trajectories of mitoproteomes
abstract: Mitochondria arose from the endosymbiosis of a bacterium with an archaea-related host cell about 2 billion years ago. To understand their origins and evolution, we compared experimentally defined mitoproteomes from the MitoCarta Tree of Life project. Across eight organisms, we identified 8,619 distinct mitochondrial proteins within 3,199 families, of which 43% lack Pfam domains. We report 33 protein families conserved in eukaryotic pathogens yet absent in humans, representing promising candidate targets for protozoan infectious diseases. Leveraging our experimentally defined mitoproteomes, we retrained a classifier based on a protein language model to predict mitoproteomes of ∼200 eukaryotes. From this expanded set, we detail the evolutionary trajectories of mitochondria, ranging from clade-specific gene family expansions to extreme mitoproteome reductions seemingly en route to complete organelle loss. Finally, we reconstruct the last eukaryotic common ancestor (LECA) mitoproteome, revealing that LECA possessed a complex mitochondrion capable of both aerobic and anaerobic metabolism.

title: Mitochondrial proteome of Acanthamoeba delineates aerobic and anaerobic pathways dynamically regulated by oxygen
summary_zh: 本文描述了阿米巴原虫的线粒体蛋白质组，揭示了氧气调节的代谢途径。方法上，整合多种技术生成蛋白质组。实验表明，发现独特的蛋白质和复杂体。
summary_en: This paper describes the mitochondrial proteome of Acanthamoeba, delineating aerobic and anaerobic pathways dynamically regulated by oxygen. Using multiple techniques, it generates a proteome and identifies unique proteins and complexes.
insights: 创新点：揭示氧气调节的代谢途径
方法亮点：整合多种技术生成蛋白质组
关键发现：发现独特的蛋白质和复杂体
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals metabolic pathways dynamically regulated by oxygen
Method highlight: Integrates multiple techniques to generate the proteome
Key finding: Identifies unique proteins and complexes
abstract: Acanthamoeba castellanii causes infectious blindness and resides in a key evolutionary outgroup to humans and fungi. Its divergent mitochondria are of outstanding interest due to their predicted aerobic and anaerobic functions with potential for drug targeting. However, a detailed delineation of its bioenergetic machinery, its activities, and their regulation remains lacking. Here, we integrate mitochondrial immunoprecipitation, density gradient purification, mass spectrometry, protein correlation profiling, and microscopy to generate a high-confidence inventory of the Acanthamoeba mitoproteome. The resulting AcMitoCarta contains 1,122 proteins, including 381 lacking readily identifiable homologs in human and yeast mitochondria. Complexome analysis highlights 20 macromolecular assemblies. Complementary proteomic and transcriptomic profiling reveals extensive rewiring of the organelle's bioenergetic machinery by oxygen, including induction of an anaerobic pyruvate:ferredoxin oxidoreductase-to-hydrogenase pathway under anoxia. We experimentally demonstrate that Acanthamoeba can produce H 2 gas under anoxic conditions via a mitochondria-localized, oxygen-labile hydrogenase. AcMitoCarta establishes a framework for dissecting the interplay between aerobic and anaerobic energy metabolism.

title: Two D-loop resolution systems enable natural genetic transformation in bacteria
summary_zh: 本研究发现，细菌中的两种D环解旋系统负责自然遗传转化。其中，YraN与ComM解旋酶相互作用，而CoiA是解旋酶，负责解旋转化D环。
summary_en: This study finds that two D-loop resolution systems enable natural genetic transformation in bacteria, with YraN interacting with the ComM helicase and CoiA being a resolvase responsible for resolving the transformation D-loop.
insights: 创新点：揭示了细菌自然遗传转化的D环解旋系统
方法亮点：确定了YraN和CoiA在D环解旋中的作用
关键发现：YraN和CoiA分别与ComM和转化D环相互作用
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the D-loop resolution systems for natural genetic transformation in bacteria
Method highlight: Identified the roles of YraN and CoiA in D-loop resolution
Key finding: YraN interacts with ComM and CoiA resolves the transformation D-loop
abstract: Natural transformation is a widespread mechanism driving genetic exchanges in bacteria. It proceeds from the capture of extracellular DNA released by other cells. Internalized in linear single strands, this exogenous DNA is ultimately integrated into the genome by homologous recombination. It is unknown how the RecA-directed D-loop intermediate of this dedicated recombination pathway is processed. We report that resolution of the transformation D-loop depends on two endonucleases of opposing phylogenetic distribution in bacteria. One is YraN, which has coevolved and interacts with the ComM helicase, known to extend DNA recombination at the transformation D-loop. The other is CoiA, which is restricted to the Bacillota. CoiA is shown to be a resolvase of the transformation D-loop, extended by the RadA helicase in these species. We demonstrate that both YraN and CoiA act synergistically with their cognate helicases. These findings reveal that bacteria have evolved two helicase/nuclease pairs for the maturation and recombination extension of the transformation D-loop. The wide distribution of this dual system indicates that recombination of exogenous DNA by natural transformation is an ancestral and pervasive feature of bacteria.

title: Tipping point forecasting in nonstationary dynamics on function spaces
summary_zh: 本文研究非平稳动力系统中的转折点预测。采用循环神经网络操作符（RNO）学习函数空间之间的映射。通过监测物理约束的偏差来预测转折点。
summary_en: This paper studies the forecasting of tipping points in nonstationary dynamical systems. It employs a recurrent neural operator (RNO) to learn mappings between function spaces and predicts tipping points by monitoring deviations from physical constraints.
insights: 创新点：提出基于RNO的转折点预测方法
方法亮点：采用符合预测框架监测物理约束
关键发现：预测方法在非平稳动力系统中有效
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes a tipping point prediction method based on RNO
Method highlight: Uses a conformal prediction framework to monitor physical constraints
Key finding: The prediction method is effective in nonstationary dynamical systems
abstract: Tipping points are abrupt, drastic, and often irreversible changes in the evolution of nonstationary and chaotic dynamical systems. For instance, increased greenhouse gas concentrations are predicted to lead to drastic decreases in low cloud cover, referred to as a climatological tipping point. In this paper, we learn the evolution of such nonstationary dynamical systems using a recurrent neural operator (RNO), which learns mappings between function spaces. After training RNO on only the pre-tipping dynamics, we employ it to detect future tipping points using an uncertainty-based approach. In particular, we propose a conformal prediction framework to forecast tipping points by monitoring deviations from physics constraints (such as conserved quantities and partial differential equations), enabling forecasting of these abrupt changes along with a rigorous measure of uncertainty. We illustrate our proposed methodology on nonstationary ordinary and partial differential equations, such as the Lorenz-63 and Kuramoto–Sivashinsky equations. We also apply our methods to forecast a climate tipping point in stratocumulus cloud cover and airfoil wake and stall transitions using only limited knowledge of the governing equations. For the latter, we show that our proposed method zero-shot generalizes to forecasting multiple future tipping points under varying Reynolds numbers. In our experiments, we demonstrate that even partial or approximate physics constraints can be used to accurately forecast future tipping points.

title: PanRes: A database of latent and acquired antimicrobial resistance allowing 3D-based protein homology search
summary_zh: 本文开发了一个整合抗微生物耐药性决定因子的数据库PanRes。通过结构相似性聚类蛋白质，并构建HMM进行远程同源搜索。
summary_en: This paper develops a database called PanRes, integrating determinants of antimicrobial resistance. It clusters proteins by structural similarity and builds Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) for remote homology search.
insights: 创新点：整合抗微生物耐药性决定因子
方法亮点：基于结构相似性聚类蛋白质
关键发现：HMMs在远程同源搜索中有效
insights_en: Novelty: Integrates determinants of antimicrobial resistance
Method highlight: Clusters proteins based on structural similarity
Key finding: HMMs are effective in remote homology search
abstract: Abstract Motivation Antimicrobial resistance databases are central to genomic surveillance, but resistance determinants remain distributed across resources with different scopes, structures, and annotations. Results We developed PanRes, a curated resistance database of 11 717 genes integrating acquired and latent determinants of antibiotic, biocide, and metal resistance within a unified ontology. We predicted representative protein structures and clustered them by structural similarity, grouping proteins into 505 high-confidence structurally conserved clusters coherent despite sequence divergence. Their structure-guided alignments were used to build Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) for remote homology search. In seven wastewater metagenomes from five European cities, PanRes 3D-based HMMs expanded detection beyond what was possible with BLAST, with 35.3% of retained hits identified only by the HMMs and generally showing greater divergence from known proteins. For beta-lactamases, several proteins retained beta-lactamase-like folds and catalytic geometry despite weak sequence similarity. Availability and implementation PanRes is available through an interactive web platform (https://panres.rambio.dk/), a structure-informed resource for exploring the whole resistome. The database, HMM profiles, and ontology are available at Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.22876216). Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: A high-confidence plant mitochondrial proteome via protein correlation profiling
summary_zh: 本文通过蛋白质相关性分析定义了植物线粒体蛋白质组。方法上，结合多种技术提高灵敏度。实验表明，获得高置信度的蛋白质组。
summary_en: This paper defines a plant mitochondrial proteome via protein correlation profiling. Using a combination of techniques, it achieves high sensitivity and specificity in the proteome.
insights: 创新点：通过蛋白质相关性分析定义植物线粒体蛋白质组
方法亮点：结合多种技术提高灵敏度
关键发现：获得高置信度的蛋白质组
insights_en: Novelty: Defines plant mitochondrial proteome via protein correlation profiling
Method highlight: Combines multiple techniques to enhance sensitivity
Key finding: Achieves a high-confidence proteome
abstract: Plant mitochondria share many features with animal mitochondria but also possess unique traits, including presence of both circular and linear mitochondrial DNA, RNA editing, a branched electron transport chain, and metabolic pathways supporting photosynthesis. An accurate mitochondrial proteome is crucial for studying these conserved and lineage-specific functions. Here, we introduce a novel approach to defining plant mitoproteomes that combines serial mitochondrial enrichment, mass spectrometry, and protein correlation profiling. This approach allows us to experimentally define a mitochondrial protein inventory of 1,462 proteins with high sensitivity and specificity. Integration of our experimental inventory with literature and microscopy validation yields the Arabidopsis thaliana MitoCarta (AtMitoCarta) atlas of 1,609 mitochondrial proteins, including 236 newly defined proteins and 147 proteins of unknown functions. A comparative analysis across eukaryotic organisms reveals that 15% of mitochondrial protein families are plant specific, including expanded pentatricopeptide repeat proteins. The AtMitoCarta inventory and the experimental workflow applicable to wild-type plants will enable comparative studies of plant mitochondria.

title: Acanthamoeba ATP synthase structure reveals the TCA cycle is tethered to OXPHOS
summary_zh: 研究揭示阿米巴ATP合酶结构，揭示TCA循环与氧化磷酸化紧密相连。通过冷冻电镜和质谱蛋白质组学解析其结构。发现阿米巴特异亚基和延伸稳定了分子机器。
summary_en: This study reveals the structure of Acanthamoeba ATP synthase, showing the TCA cycle is tightly connected to OXPHOS. Cryo-electron microscopy and mass spectrometry proteomics were used to resolve its structure. Acanthamoeba-specific subunits and extensions were found to stabilize the molecular machine.
insights: 创新点：揭示了TCA循环与氧化磷酸化的直接联系
方法亮点：结合冷冻电镜和质谱蛋白质组学解析结构
关键发现：阿米巴特异亚基和延伸稳定了分子机器
insights_en: Novelty: Direct connection between the TCA cycle and OXPHOS is revealed
Method highlight: Structures are resolved using cryo-electron microscopy and mass spectrometry proteomics
Key finding: Acanthamoeba-specific subunits and extensions stabilize the molecular machine
abstract: Oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS) is a key metabolic process that couples redox energy to ATP production. While some core OXPHOS complex subunits are found across all domains of life, many have diverged or expanded across evolution—as seen in the protozoan pathogen Acanthamoeba castellanii . By integrating cryo-electron microscopy of unenriched mitochondrial lysate with mass spectrometry proteomics, we resolved the structures of endogenous mitochondrial ATP synthase (complex V), Hsp60, and respiratory complex III from Acanthamoeba . We capture Acanthamoeba ATP synthase in an IF1-inhibited state and reveal how Acanthamoeba -specific subunits and extensions stabilize the molecular machine, which includes a β subunit extension that interfaces with the peripheral stalk. Additionally, we characterize an active malate dehydrogenase (MDH) dimer structurally integrated within the ATP synthase peripheral stalk, thus revealing a direct protein tether between OXPHOS and the tricarboxylic acid cycle. Together, these findings provide structural insight into lineage-specific adaptations in Acanthamoeba that may tune protozoan metabolism.

title: The digital determinants of health: a new era for global public health
The public health challenges of children's and adolescents’ digital media use: applying the digital determinants of health as an interpretive framework
Advancing mathematics research with AI-driven formal proof search
summary_zh: 本文利用大型语言模型生成形式化证明，解决数学难题。通过构建人工智能代理进行形式化证明搜索，成功解决多个开放性问题，并在多个数学领域得到应用。
summary_en: This paper utilizes large language models to generate formal proofs for solving mathematical problems. By building an AI agent for formal proof search, it successfully resolves several open problems and is applied in various mathematical fields.
insights: 创新点：利用LLM生成形式化证明
方法亮点：构建AI代理进行形式化证明搜索
关键发现：解决多个开放性问题
insights_en: Novelty: Using LLMs to generate formal proofs
Method highlight: Building an AI agent for formal proof search
Key finding: Resolving multiple open problems
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly excel at mathematics tasks, but their unreliability limits their utility in mathematics research. A mitigation is to use LLMs to generate formal proofs in languages such as Lean, in which the compiler verifies every proof step. We present the first demonstration of this method’s value in solving open problems at scale. We built an artificial intelligence agent for formal proof search that autonomously resolved nine of 353 open Erdős problems, proved 44/492 On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences conjectures, and is being deployed in combinatorics, optimization, graph theory, algebraic geometry, and quantum optics research. Even a basic agent alternating LLM-based generation with Lean-based verification replicated the Erdős successes. These findings demonstrate the power of formal proof search as an enabler of autonomous mathematical discovery.

title: A DNA Typewriter records the cell lineage history of a mouse, from zygote to late organogenesis
summary_zh: 应用DNA打字机技术记录小鼠发育过程中的细胞谱系。构建了从受精卵到晚期器官发生的细胞谱系树。发现细胞类型耦合随时间变化。
summary_en: Applied DNA Typewriter technology to record the cell lineage of a mouse during development. Constructed a cell lineage tree from zygote to late organogenesis. Found that cell type couplings change over time.
insights: 创新点：开发DNA打字机技术记录细胞谱系。
方法亮点：时间校准的细胞谱系分析。
关键发现：细胞类型耦合随时间变化。
insights_en: Novelty: Developed DNA Typewriter technology for cell lineage recording.
Method highlight: Time-calibrated cell lineage analysis.
Key finding: Cell type couplings change over time.
abstract: Mammalian biology unfolds over time, within tissues and organs opaque to our eyes and instruments. We applied DNA Typewriter, a sequential molecular recorder, to record the cell lineage of a mouse over nearly two weeks of development. From one embryo, we reconstruct a time-calibrated, parsimony-supported, zygote-rooted phylogeny of 1.28 million transcriptionally profiled cells. A burst of editing unequivocally marks the daughters of the first cleavage, which serve as inline replicates. We quantify clonal dominance arising during gastrulation. Tree siblings share cell type far above chance; heterotypic siblings mark terminal differentiations. Temporal sweeps of clade co-occurrence recover a dated hierarchy of cell-type couplings; imputed labels for internal nodes recapitulate known state paths. A lineage-anchored ontogeny of mammalian development, long out of reach, is coming into view.

title: The conformation-selective PI3Kδ inhibitor roginolisib in patients with advanced or metastatic cancer, including metastatic uveal melanoma: first-in-human clinical trial
summary_zh: 研究PI3Kδ抑制剂roginolisib对晚期或转移性癌症的治疗效果。方法为首次人体剂量研究。结果显示，roginolisib在转移性黑色素瘤患者中表现出良好的生存期。
summary_en: This study investigates the efficacy of the PI3Kδ inhibitor roginolisib in advanced or metastatic cancer patients, including those with metastatic uveal melanoma. The method is a first-in-human dose study, showing promising overall survival in mUM patients.
insights: 创新点：首次人体剂量研究评估roginolisib的疗效
方法亮点：使用非ATP竞争性抑制剂锁定PI3Kδ
关键发现：roginolisib在转移性黑色素瘤患者中表现出良好的生存期
insights_en: Novelty: First-in-human dose study to assess roginolisib's efficacy
Method highlight: Utilizing a non-ATP competitive inhibitor to lock PI3Kδ
Key finding: roginolisib shows promising overall survival in mUM patients
abstract: Abstract Phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase delta (PI3Kδ) promotes tumour cell growth directly or indirectly by activating immune-suppressive cells. Roginolisib is a selective, non-ATP competitive inhibitor, which locks PI3Kδ into an inactive state. In a First-in-Human dose study, continuous daily dosing of roginolisib was investigated in patients with solid and haematologic malignancies. In Part A, 24 patients received escalating doses of roginolisib. In Part B, 20 mostly pre-treated metastatic uveal melanoma (mUM) patients received a dose associated with continuous PI3Kδ inhibition of > 90%. No Dose Limiting Toxicity or drug related toxicities requiring dose modifications were observed (≥ Grade 3 toxicities: 3/44; 6.8%). In mUM, median Overall Survival (mOS) was 20.8 months. mOS in mUM patients with Stable Disease was 28.5 months, and in patients with Progressive Disease was 12.3 months. Roginolisib treatment was associated with reducing T regulatory cell abundance, increasing activated CD8 + T cells and soluble plasma IL-15.

title: PI3Kδ is selectively inhibited by roginolisib by stabilizing the C-terminal helix kα12
summary_zh: 研究roginolisib通过稳定C端螺旋kα12选择性抑制PI3Kδ的机制。方法结合X射线晶体学、分子动力学模拟和氢氘交换质谱。结果显示，roginolisib通过锁定酶的失活构象来抑制PI3Kδ。
summary_en: This study investigates the mechanism by which roginolisib selectively inhibits PI3Kδ by stabilizing the C-terminal helix kα12. Methods include X-ray crystallography, molecular dynamics simulations, and hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry. Results show that roginolisib inhibits PI3Kδ by locking the enzyme in an inactive conformation.
insights: 创新点：揭示roginolisib抑制PI3Kδ的新机制
方法亮点：结合多种技术手段研究抑制机制
关键发现：roginolisib通过稳定C端螺旋抑制PI3Kδ
insights_en: Novelty: Unveils a new mechanism for roginolisib's inhibition of PI3Kδ
Method highlight: Combining multiple techniques to study the inhibitory mechanism
Key finding: roginolisib inhibits PI3Kδ by stabilizing the C-terminal helix
abstract: Phosphoinositide 3-kinases (PI3Ks) are major regulators of cell growth, proliferation and signalling, constituting key therapeutic targets in cancer, inflammation, and other diseases. Individual class I PI3K isoforms control key cellular functions, imposing the need to generate isoform-specific inhibition for therapeutic intervention. Roginolisib is a selective PI3Kδ inhibitor that shows promise for the treatment of cancer. Using a combination of X-ray crystallography, molecular dynamics simulations, and hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry, we describe the mechanism driving roginolisib's potent and isoform-selective inhibition of PI3Kδ. Roginolisib uniquely stabilises the catalytic C-terminal helix kα12, locking the enzyme in an inactive conformation. This binding mode also results in more sustained inhibition of phosphatidylinositol 3,4,5-trisphosphate formation in tumour samples of CLL patients. Inhibition of PI3Ks by stabilization of helix kα12 into an inactive conformation has not, to the best of our knowledge, been described before and may provide the basis for novel, more selective and effective pharmacological strategies.

title: De novo design of cysteine proteases
Governing the digital determinants of health for children and young people: a global public health imperative
Localization Lens for Improving Medical Vision-Language Models
summary_zh: 本文提出一种定位增强方法，用于提升医学视觉语言模型。方法包括数据、架构和定位的改进。实验表明，该方法有效提升了模型性能。
summary_en: This paper proposes a localization-aware enhancement method for improving Medical Vision-Language Models. The method includes improvements in data, architecture, and alignment. Experiments show that this method effectively enhances model performance.
insights: 创新点：引入定位增强提升医学模型性能
方法亮点：多层面改进模型架构
关键发现：定位增强显著提升模型效果
insights_en: Novelty: Introduces localization enhancement to improve medical model performance
Method highlight: Multi-level improvements in model architecture
Key finding: Localization enhancement significantly improves model effectiveness
abstract: Medical Vision-Language Models (Med-VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in clinical tasks. However, they often struggle to understand anatomical structures and spatial positioning, which are crucial for medical reasoning. To address this, we propose a localization-aware enhancement to the Med-VLM pipeline, introducing improvements at three levels: data,architecture, and alignment. First, we introduce localization lens, a set of expert-validated representations that provide richer anatomical and positional context. However, as these representations increase input complexity, we integrate pixel shuffle within the model architecture to filter and refine representations, enhancing spatial information processing while preserving anatomical continuity. Lastly, to effectively align the localization lens representations with textual features, we incorporate decoupled contrastive loss (DCL) alongside the standard loss function. This ensures better feature discrimination and robustness, particularly in data limited medical settings. Through extensive evaluations on medical visual question answering (Med-VQA) datasets, we show that our methodology improves localization-driven performance across different Med-VLM architectures. Our analysis of localization-based questions further reveals that improvements in anatomy and spatial reasoning directly enhance the overall accuracy of Med-VQA upto 6.2%. The proposed approach is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing Med-VLM pipelines. The dataset, code, and trained models will be made publicly available at https://github.com/CVLABLUMS/localizationlens.

title: The Wnt co-receptor Arrow-LRP5/6 is required for planar cell polarity establishment in Drosophila
summary_zh: 研究揭示Wnt/PCP信号通路中Arr-LRP5/6的必要性，其在果蝇中调控细胞极性。
summary_en: This study reveals the necessity of Arr-LRP5/6 in the Wnt/PCP signaling pathway for regulating cell polarity in Drosophila.
insights: 创新点：首次证明Arr-LRP5/6在Wnt/PCP信号通路中的关键作用。
方法亮点：利用果蝇模型研究Arr-LRP5/6的功能。
关键发现：Arr-LRP5/6缺失导致细胞极性协调丧失。
insights_en: Novelty: First demonstration of the critical role of Arr-LRP5/6 in the Wnt/PCP signaling pathway.
Method highlight: Use of Drosophila model to study the function of Arr-LRP5/6.
Key finding: Loss of Arr-LRP5/6 leads to the loss of cell polarity coordination.
abstract: Wnt-signaling, via β−catenin or the planar cell polarity (PCP) branch, is crucial for development, tissue homeostasis, and linked to many diseases. LRP5/6, arrow/arr in Drosophila, is the obligate co-receptor in Wnt/β−catenin signaling, with ligand binding to a Frizzled (Fz) family member and LRP5/6. Current models for Wnt/PCP signaling omit Arr-LRP5/6 and PCP is presumed functioning without these co-receptors. Here we show that arr-LRP5/6 is fully required in Wnt/PCP signaling. In Drosophila, loss of arr results in aberrant PCP mediated cellular orientation and loss of polarity coordination in wings, comparable to core PCP factors mutations, with defects manifest as loss of asymmetric PCP factor localization and reduced levels of Dishevelled (Dsh) with centrally forming wing hairs. In the eye, arr mutant tissue displays phenotypes with defects in chirality and photoreceptors R3 and R4 cell fates. Functional interactions indicate that Fz can recruit Arr, and Arr potentiates Fz-Dsh PCP signaling in all tissues tested. Furthermore, arr-LRP5/6 sensitizes the ligand pair Wg, Wnt4 with the receptor fz, and the core PCP factors fmi and Vang/stbm to cause PCP defects in heterozygous conditions. Our data support a core PCP function of Arr-LRP5/6, promoting Wnt/Fz-Dsh PCP-complex activity. The LRP5/6 Wnt co-receptor was thought to be specific to Wnt/β-catenin signaling. Our work in Drosophila shows that it is equally critical in Wnt/planar cell polarity signaling, also promoting activity of the common downstream effector Dishevelled.

title: METANet: a supervised ensemble learning framework for reconstructing direct and functional tissue-specific transcription factor networks
summary_zh: 提出METANet框架，用于重建直接和功能组织特异性转录因子网络。该框架结合TF基序、顺式调控元件活性和表达特征，预测TF结合。
summary_en: Introduces the METANet framework for reconstructing direct and functional tissue-specific transcription factor networks. The framework combines TF motifs, cis-regulatory element activity, and linear and non-linear expression-derived features to predict TF binding.
insights: 创新点：结合多种数据类型预测TF结合
方法亮点：集成TF基序和表达特征
关键发现：预测TF的直接结合位点
insights_en: Novelty: Combination of multiple data types for TF binding prediction
Method highlight: Integration of TF motifs and expression features
Key finding: Prediction of direct TF binding sites
abstract: MOTIVATION: Reconstructing tissue-specific transcription factor (TF) networks remains challenging. TF -motif-based methods often lack functional validation, while expression-based methods struggle to distinguish direct binding from indirect regulation. Integration of diverse data types is necessary to accurately prioritize likely functional targets directly bound by TFs across human tissues. RESULTS: We introduce METANet (Motif Expression TF Association Networks), a supervised ensemble learning framework that combines TF motifs, cis-regulatory element activity, and linear and non-linear expression-derived features to predict TF binding. Applied to 36 human tissues, predicted METANet maps significantly outperform established methods in identifying direct, likely functional targets of TFs validated by ChIP-seq and gene ontology. Furthermore, METANet maps capture tissue-specific regulation comparable to existing methods, allowing the identification of reproducible gene-trait associations. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: All code and network maps are freely available at Zenodo https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20614479. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Antisense oligonucleotides targeting transcription termination windows disrupt mRNA 3’ end processing and decrease gene expression
summary_zh: 研究识别转录终止窗口为ASOs新靶点。ASOs作用于下游RNA降低mRNA水平。终止窗口是ASO的真正靶点。
summary_en: This study identifies transcription termination windows as novel targets for ASOs. ASOs act on downstream RNA to reduce mRNA levels. Termination windows are genuine ASO targets.
insights: 创新点：识别转录终止窗口为ASOs新靶点
方法亮点：ASOs作用于下游RNA降低mRNA水平
关键发现：终止窗口是ASO的真正靶点
insights_en: Novelty: Identifying transcription termination windows as novel targets for ASOs
Method highlight: ASOs acting on downstream RNA to reduce mRNA levels
Key finding: Termination windows are genuine ASO targets
abstract: Antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) are short, synthetic nucleic acids that bind to complementary RNA sequences and alter gene expression, making them versatile therapeutic agents. Here, we identify transcription termination windows of protein-coding genes as previously unrecognised targets for ASOs. We show that ASOs can act on nascent RNA synthesised downstream of the annotated genes, leading to a pronounced decrease in the corresponding mRNA levels. These downstream of gene ASOs (DG-ASOs) induce RNase H1-dependent cleavage, impairing mRNA 3’ end processing, directing the unprocessed mRNAs for exosome-dependent degradation and creating early entry points in the nascent RNA for the XRN2 exonuclease termination factor. Altogether, we show that termination windows are genuine ASO targets which can be exploited to suppress gene expression. Importantly, we also reveal an underappreciated source of off-target effects which may arise from ASOs binding downstream of genes. Our findings indicate the necessity to expand ASO design and off-target assessment guidelines to include termination window sequences, thereby improving therapeutic efficacy and safety. Antisense oligonucleotides are powerful tools for modulating gene expression. Here, the authors show that targeting transcription termination windows downstream of polyadenylation sites disrupts RNA processing to reduce expression levels, expanding targetable space and highlighting off-target risks.

title: A cryptic binding pocket regulates the metal-dependent activity of Cas9
summary_zh: 本研究揭示了Cas9的催化活性受金属离子调节，通过形成二价金属结合口袋（DBP）在HNH-RuvC界面激活催化HHN结构域。突变靶向DBP会破坏HHN激活并损害核酸酶的耦合催化活性。
summary_en: This study reveals that the catalytic activity of Cas9 is regulated by metal ions, which activate the catalytic HNH domain through the formation of a divalent metal-binding pocket (DBP) at the HNH-RuvC interface. Mutations targeting the DBP disrupt HNH activation and impair the coupled catalytic activity of both nucleases.
insights: 创新点：揭示了Cas9金属依赖性活性的调控机制。
方法亮点：采用分子模拟和NMR技术。
关键发现：DBP在Cas9活性中起关键作用。
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the regulatory mechanism of Cas9's metal-dependent activity.
Method highlight: Utilizes molecular simulations and NMR techniques.
Key finding: The DBP plays a critical role in Cas9 activity.
abstract: Abstract Cas9 is a metal-dependent nuclease used for genome editing across diverse cells and organisms exhibiting distinct ionic environments, yet how metal ions regulate its catalytic function, and consequently its editing efficiency remains unclear. Here, molecular simulations, Markov state models, and mixed quantum–classical approaches reveal that divalent metals promote activation of the catalytic HNH domain through formation of a divalent metal-binding pocket (DBP) at the HNH–RuvC interface. This cryptic pocket emerges dynamically during HNH activation and is supported by NMR measurements revealing metal-dependent structural perturbations within the HNH–L2 region. Mutations targeting the DBP disrupt HNH activation and impair the coupled catalytic activity of both nucleases, identifying the pocket as a key regulator of Cas9’s metal-dependent activity. Together with quantum–classical simulations revealing distinct catalytic behaviours among divalent metals, these findings uncover an ion-dependent regulatory mechanism in Cas9 with insights for genome editing across diverse biological environments.

title: Global origins of tuna and billfish fisheries reveal the transition from coastal access to oceanic exploitation
summary_zh: 研究揭示金枪鱼和剑鱼渔业起源于海洋生态系统，最早捕捞记录分别约4.4万和1万年以前，早期渔业多集中在沿海地区。
summary_en: Research reveals the origins of tuna and billfish fisheries in ocean ecosystems, with the earliest fishing records around 44,000 and 10,000 years ago, predominantly in coastal areas.
insights: 创新点：首次明确金枪鱼和剑鱼渔业的历史起源。
方法亮点：结合考古学和生态学方法研究渔业演变。
关键发现：早期渔业集中在沿海地区，逐渐转向海洋捕捞。
insights_en: Novelty: First-time clarification of the historical origins of tuna and billfish fisheries.
Method highlight: Combining archaeological and ecological methods to study the evolution of fisheries.
Key finding: Early fisheries were concentrated in coastal areas, gradually shifting to oceanic fishing.
abstract: Ocean ecosystems have played a crucial role in people’s lives around the world for millennia. However, questions persist about when, why, and how people first began removing biomass from offshore habitats and established fisheries in distant, oceanic environments. We explore the antiquity and evolution of tuna (Thunnini) and billfish (Istiophoridae/Xiphiidae) fisheries, two groups of fishes that occur around the world, are economically significant, and are ecologically important open ocean apex predators. The earliest archaeological evidence of fishing for tuna occurs ~44,000 years ago and billfish at ~10,000 years ago, with early fisheries for some tuna species appearing around the world by 3,000 to 1,000 years ago. Most early fisheries are in areas where tunas and billfishes could be accessed relatively close to shore (e.g., submarine canyons) and/or where these fishes may come inshore seasonally or during warm ocean events. Early tuna and billfish fisheries were often linked to ceremony/ritual, alongside advances in maritime technologies. With few exceptions, sustained and intensive commercial exploitation of pelagic predators in offshore and oceanic habitats is a late development in the human past, occurring primarily during the last 200 y. Our findings document a long-term continuum of human interactions with global marine ecosystems spanning thousands of years, including significant differences between the timing and pathways by which people became dominant ecological drivers in nearshore compared to offshore/oceanic ecosystems.

title: Loss of the tumor suppressor p53 generates a signaling gradient that drives epithelial clonal expansion
summary_zh: 研究显示p53肿瘤抑制因子缺失会导致信号梯度形成，驱动上皮细胞克隆扩张。p53通过限制祖细胞自我更新来抑制克隆扩张。
summary_en: This study shows that the loss of the tumor suppressor p53 generates a signaling gradient that drives epithelial clonal expansion. p53 suppresses clonal expansion by limiting progenitor self-renewal.
insights: 创新点：p53缺失导致信号梯度形成驱动克隆扩张
方法亮点：整合染色质免疫沉淀测序和转录分析
关键发现：p53通过限制祖细胞自我更新抑制克隆扩张
insights_en: Novelty: Loss of p53 generates a signaling gradient that drives clonal expansion
Method highlight: Integrating chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing and transcriptional analyses
Key finding: p53 suppresses clonal expansion by limiting progenitor self-renewal
abstract: Although tumor protein p53 ( TP53 ) mutations are among the most common lesions in epithelial cancers, how p53 loss drives unrestrained clonal expansion remains unclear. Working with mouse epidermis, we found that p53 suppresses clonal expansion by limiting progenitor self-renewal. Integrating chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing, transcriptional analyses, and genetic screens, we identified a p53-dependent network controlling progenitor renewal and differentiation, in which secreted frizzled-related protein 1 ( Sfrp1 ), low-density lipoprotein receptor–related protein 1 ( Lrp1 ), and ubiquitin-specific peptidase 22 ( Usp22 ) were direct targets of p53 and the most genetically upstream components. Their suppression after p53 loss generated a radial gradient of Wnt activity across mutant clones. Genetic manipulation showed that a Wnt activity gradient, rather than uniform elevation, was associated with sustained clonal expansion. These findings identify spatial organization as a determinant of clonal behavior and a mechanism by which TP53 inactivation drives tissue colonization.

title: Mitochondrial carrier SLC25A34 links clock, diet, and temperature control of adipocyte lipid cycling
summary_zh: 研究揭示了SLC25A34如何将时钟、饮食和环境温度与脂肪细胞脂质循环联系起来。SLC25A34在脂质循环中起关键作用。
summary_en: This study reveals how SLC25A34 links clock, diet, and environmental temperature to adipocyte lipid cycling. SLC25A34 plays a critical role in lipid cycling.
insights: 创新点：SLC25A34连接时钟、饮食和温度与脂质循环
方法亮点：研究脂质循环中的SLC25A34作用
关键发现：SLC25A34在脂质循环中的关键作用
insights_en: Novelty: SLC25A34 links clock, diet, and temperature to lipid cycling
Method highlight: Investigating the role of SLC25A34 in lipid cycling
Key finding: SLC25A34's critical role in lipid cycling
abstract: Adipocyte lipid metabolism is coordinated by circadian rhythms, diet, and environmental temperature, but how these diverse signals are molecularly integrated remains unknown. We showed that these cues converge on the orphan mitochondrial transporter SLC25A34 to orchestrate lipid cycling. During the sleep phase, the adipocyte clock suppresses Slc25a34 expression through the REV-ERB transcriptional repressors. Entering the active phase, consuming lipid-rich diets, or exposure to cold abolishes REV-ERB repression, and lipolytic signals stimulate Slc25a34 transcription through the peroxisome proliferator–activated receptors. SLC25A34 is proposed to import oxaloacetate into mitochondria, dually supporting the tricarboxylic acid cycle and cytosolic acetyl–coenzyme A (acetyl-CoA) production. Elevated cytosolic acetyl-CoA then fuels the synthesis of lipids and promotes the transcription of genes enhancing mitochondrial oxidation. Thus, SLC25A34 confers circadian, dietary, and temperature control of adipocyte lipid metabolism.

title: Recurrent hypermotif regulatory circuits in developmental programs
summary_zh: 本文提出一种框架，解析发育基因调控网络的基本电路，并研究其整合到更高阶超基序电路中。实验表明，不同发育基因在网络基序中具有不同角色。
summary_en: This paper introduces a framework to dissect the building-block circuits of developmental gene regulatory networks and explore their integration into higher-order hypermotif circuits. Experiments show that different developmental genes play distinct roles within network motifs.
insights: 创新点：提出解析发育基因调控网络框架
方法亮点：利用单细胞RNA测序数据
关键发现：发育基因在网络基序中角色多样
insights_en: Novelty: Introduces a framework for dissecting developmental gene regulatory networks
Method highlight: Utilizes single-cell RNA-sequencing data
Key finding: Developmental genes have diverse roles within network motifs
abstract: During development, cells self-organize into complex spatial and temporal patterns driven by regulatory circuits of transcription factors and morphogen signaling. However, the principles that govern these regulatory interactions remain poorly understood. Here, we introduce a framework to dissect the building-block circuits of developmental gene regulatory networks and explore their integration into higher-order hypermotif circuits. Using single-cell RNA-sequencing data spanning human intestinal development, we identify five recurrent network motifs, including feedforward and feedback loops, and investigate their roles in the regulation of gene expression. Our analysis reveals distinct categories of developmental genes based on their roles within network motifs, highlighting major transitions in regulatory architecture across developmental stages. Furthermore, we model the emergent dynamical properties of hypermotif circuits, including their potential roles in regulating morphogen signaling. This study uncovers a common theme in regulatory circuits of developmental programs, emphasizing how the combinatorial wiring of regulatory motifs enables robust and diverse tissue formation.

title: The lack of characterization of inferential operators leaves the robustness of global insect richness estimates undetermined
A spatiotemporal lifecycle atlas decodes spatial coordination in rice
Quantitative Chest CT–derived Fibrosis and Vascular Remodeling and Acute Exacerbation Risk in Mild Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis
summary_zh: CT扫描纤维化和血管重塑与轻度IPF的急性加重风险相关。静脉和动脉重塑介导纤维化效应，血管指标对风险分层有价值。
summary_en: Quantitative CT-derived fibrosis and vascular remodeling are associated with acute exacerbation risk in mild idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. Venous and arterial remodeling mediates fibrosis effects, and vascular metrics are valuable for risk stratification.
insights: 创新点：发现CT扫描纤维化和血管重塑与急性加重风险相关
方法亮点：采用定量CT扫描分析纤维化和血管重塑
关键发现：血管指标对风险分层有价值
insights_en: Novelty: Finding that CT-derived fibrosis and vascular remodeling are associated with acute exacerbation risk
Method highlight: Using quantitative CT scan to analyze fibrosis and vascular remodeling
Key finding: Vascular metrics are valuable for risk stratification
abstract: In mild idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, quantitative CT–derived fibrosis burden and vascular remodeling were associated with acute exacerbation risk, with venous and arterial remodeling mediating fibrosis effects, supporting the value of vascular metrics for risk stratification.

title: Hypertension Management and Control in Cienfuegos, Cuba
summary_zh: 论文评估了古巴Cienfuegos地区高血压的患病率和控制情况。方法上比较了2023年和2011年的调查结果。
summary_en: The paper assesses hypertension prevalence and control in Cienfuegos, Cuba. The method compares survey results from 2023 and 2011.
insights: 评估古巴Cienfuegos地区高血压患病率和控制情况
比较2023年和2011年的调查结果
高血压管理控制研究
insights_en: Assessment of hypertension prevalence and control in Cienfuegos, Cuba
Comparison of survey results from 2023 and 2011
Hypertension management and control study
abstract: This population-based cross-sectional survey assesses hypertension prevalence and indicators of management and control in 2023 and compares these findings with a similar population-based survey conducted in 2011.

title: Benchmarking imputation methods on real-world clinical time series with simulated spatio-temporal missingness
summary_zh: 论文评估了在具有模拟时空缺失的实时临床数据集上的插补方法。方法上引入了时空自编码器。结果显示STAE优于简单方法。
summary_en: The paper evaluates imputation methods on real-world clinical time series with simulated spatio-temporal missingness. The method introduces spatio-temporal autoencoders. The results show STAE outperforms simpler methods.
insights: 评估具有模拟时空缺失的实时临床数据集上的插补方法
引入时空自编码器
STAE优于简单方法
insights_en: Evaluation of imputation methods on real-world clinical time series with simulated spatio-temporal missingness
Introduction of spatio-temporal autoencoders
STAE outperforms simpler methods
abstract: Previous studies evaluating imputation methods on clinical time series do not jointly account for spatial (e.g., across features) and temporal (across time) structures in missingness. We present a simulation model that induces realistic spatio-temporal missingness in three real-world clinical datasets by sampling from Markov chains. A variety of imputation methods including last observation carried forward (LOCF), linear interpolation, and spatio-temporal autoencoder (STAE) are applied to fill these missingness patterns. Finally, we evaluate the influence of time series imputations on a downstream prediction task. Here we show that deep STAEs outperform simpler baseline methods when missingness patterns lack spatio-temporal structure. In contrast, linear interpolations perform best on spatio-temporal patterns, contributing to sufficient downstream performances. This study demonstrates that simple linear imputations attain robust performances for clinical real-world data with spatio-temporal missingness. We provide an open benchmark to evaluate the effect of missingness on clinical studies and prediction tasks.

title: The human gut microbiome primes fever after vaccination
summary_zh: 研究分析疫苗接种后发热风险与肠道菌群、体温和血清标志物的相关性。发现低度肠道炎症、鞭毛菌增加与发热风险相关。肠道菌群可引发人体肠道类器官和免疫小鼠的炎症反应。
summary_en: The study analyzes the correlation between fever risk after vaccination and gut microbiome, body temperature, and serological markers. It finds that low-grade intestinal inflammation and increased abundance of flagellated bacteria are associated with fever risk. The gut microbiome can trigger inflammation in human intestinal organoids and immune mice.
insights: 创新点：发现肠道菌群与疫苗接种后发热风险相关。
方法亮点：采用纵向研究方法，结合多参数分析。
关键发现：肠道菌群可调节疫苗反应。
insights_en: Novelty: Identified the association between gut microbiome and fever risk after vaccination.
Method highlight: Employed longitudinal research methods with multi-parametric analysis.
Key finding: Gut microbiome modulates vaccine reactions.
abstract: Fever is a common adverse reaction to vaccination, contributing to vaccine hesitancy and reduced uptake. To understand variation in fever risk, we longitudinally profiled fecal microbiota, oral temperature, and serological markers in 171 healthy adults receiving Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 mRNA vaccines. Fever risk correlated with low-grade intestinal inflammation, increased abundance of flagellated Lachnospiraceae bacteria, and increased flagellin expression prevaccine. Microbiomes from fever-high donors triggered stronger inflammation in human intestinal organoids and drove flagellin-dependent vaccine reactions in gnotobiotic mice. Moreover, microbiome flagellin phenotypes and murine vaccine reactions were modifiable by diet. Consistent with this, human fever risk was associated with self-reported diet and metabolic markers. These findings identify the gut microbiome as a driver of vaccine-induced fever, suggesting that microbiome-targeting strategies could modulate immune tone and improve vaccine side effects.

title: A fast radio burst at redshift 2, three billion years after the Big Bang
summary_zh: 报告了红移2的快速射电暴观测，对应大爆炸后30亿年。发现该射电暴发生时宇宙处于星形成高峰期。射电暴的散射发射表明存在未被当前调查发现的快速射电暴。
summary_en: Reports observations of a fast radio burst at redshift 2, corresponding to 3 billion years after the Big Bang. Finds that the burst occurred during the peak of cosmic star formation. The scattered burst emission suggests the existence of undetected fast radio bursts.
insights: 创新点：首次观测到红移2的快速射电暴。
方法亮点：结合射电和近红外观测。
关键发现：揭示宇宙早期星形成信息。
insights_en: Novelty: First detection of a fast radio burst at redshift 2.
Method highlight: Combined radio and near-infrared observations.
Key finding: Reveals early cosmic star formation information.
abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio transients from extragalactic sources. Their frequency and polarization properties are affected by plasma and magnetic fields along the line of sight to Earth. We report radio observations of FRB 20240304B and near-infrared follow-up to identify its host galaxy. The host is a low-mass, clumpy, star-forming galaxy at redshift 2.148 ± 0.0013, corresponding to 3 billion years after the Big Bang. This FRB occurred during the peak of cosmic star formation and probes ionized gas over approximately 80% of cosmic history. The highly scattered burst emission implies that there is a population of FRBs that are undetected by current surveys.

title: Insights from more than a year of ongoing episodic lava fountaining at Kīlauea
summary_zh: 研究记录了基拉韦厄火山一年多的间歇性喷泉活动。发现喷泉与山顶膨胀存在系统相关性，可进行前所未有的定量预测。
summary_en: The study records over a year of ongoing episodic lava fountaining at Kīlauea. Finds systematic correlations between fountaining and summit inflation, enabling unprecedented quantitative forecasts.
insights: 创新点：长期监测间歇性喷泉活动。
方法亮点：多参数记录喷泉活动。
关键发现：揭示喷泉与山顶膨胀的关系。
insights_en: Novelty: Long-term monitoring of episodic lava fountaining.
Method highlight: Multi-parametric recording of fountaining activities.
Key finding: Reveals the relationship between fountaining and summit inflation.
abstract: Episodic lava fountaining is rare globally, with only three occurrences from Kīlauea (Hawaii) since 1823. Beginning in December 2024, an eruption within the summit crater, Halemaʻumaʻu, has produced 54 fountaining episodes to date, each lasting typically for hours and separated by days to weeks. Although multiple mechanisms have been proposed, fundamental questions remain about how magma reservoir pressure, conduit permeability, and volatile exsolution control fountaining onset. We present a multiparameter record of episodic fountaining at Kīlauea using modern geochemical, geophysical, and geologic monitoring. These observations revealed systematic correlations between fountaining and summit inflation, enabling unprecedented quantitative forecasts. This eruption will provide new constraints on the timing, evolution, and processes driving episodic fountaining globally, and highlights Kīlauea’s role as a natural laboratory for studying volcanic processes.

title: Epigenetic aging and transposon dysregulation reflect size-related lifespan compression in dogs
summary_zh: 研究通过狗的甲基化组数据，发现体型和性别影响寿命。大型和雄性狗表现出加速的分子衰老。性别相关的甲基化变化集中在X染色体上，而体型相关的甲基化在转座元件中尤为明显。
summary_en: The study, using dog methylome data, found that size and sex affect lifespan. Larger and male dogs exhibit accelerated molecular aging. Sex-dependent methylation changes are concentrated on the X chromosome, while size-associated methylation is especially pronounced at transposable elements (TEs).
insights: 创新点：利用狗的甲基化组数据研究寿命。
方法亮点：开发新的表观遗传时钟。
关键发现：体型和性别影响分子衰老。
insights_en: Novelty: Studied lifespan using dog methylome data.
Method highlight: Developed a new epigenetic clock.
Key finding: Size and sex affect molecular aging.
abstract: The extraordinary lifespan variation in domestic dogs provides a natural experiment for testing how intrinsic rates of biological aging shape lifespan. Using 1640 methylomes from 894 dogs, we developed an epigenetic clock that predicted mortality and demonstrated that epigenetic aging is fastest early in life. At orthologs of human age-associated genes, dogs exhibited concordant age effects on promoter methylation, highlighting conserved remodeling of immune pathways. We found that larger and male dogs, which are shorter lived, exhibit accelerated molecular aging. Distinct epigenetic architectures mediated these effects: Sex-dependent methylation changes were concentrated on the X chromosome, whereas size-associated methylation was especially pronounced at transposable elements (TEs). These findings show that epigenetics reflects lifespan differences in dogs and identifies TEs as potential mediators of size-associated lifespan.

title: The genetic basis for the production of toxic quinolizidine alkaloids in lupins
summary_zh: 研究揭示了羽扇豆中产生有毒喹诺里西定生物碱的遗传基础。发现主要乳胶蛋白样蛋白在途径中起重要作用，并成功培育了低生物碱羽扇豆品种。
summary_en: The study reveals the genetic basis for the production of toxic quinolizidine alkaloids in lupins. Finds that major latex protein-like proteins play a prominent role in the pathway and successfully bred low alkaloid lupin varieties.
insights: 创新点：揭示了羽扇豆生物碱合成的遗传基础。
方法亮点：采用途径重建和突变分析。
关键发现：成功培育低生物碱品种。
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed the genetic basis for alkaloid biosynthesis in lupins.
Method highlight: Employed pathway reconstruction and mutant analysis.
Key finding: Successfully bred low alkaloid varieties.
abstract: Lupins ( Lupinus spp.) are promising protein crops that accumulate bitter and toxic quinolizidine alkaloids (QAs). The effective removal of QAs through new breeding technologies is hampered by a poor understanding of their biosynthesis. In this study, we used pathway reconstruction and mutant analysis to elucidate the full QA pathway in L. angustifolius [narrow-leafed lupin (NLL)] comprising 15 enzymatic steps. Major latex protein–like proteins play a prominent role in the pathway by accelerating spontaneous chemical equilibria, and an oxidoreductase-like protein ensures stereoselectivity. We also engineered a new low-alkaloid NLL line and identified the causal mutation in an existing low-alkaloid line of L. albus. Our work reveals the genetic and biochemical basis of toxic QA production and streamlines the de novo domestication of wild lupins and other QA-containing legumes.

title: Brain weight across the adult lifespan in great apes
summary_zh: 本文研究大猩猩成年期脑重变化。发现脑重在成年期没有显著变化，表明人类脑重减少可能是特定于人类谱系的。
summary_en: This paper studies brain weight changes across the adult lifespan in great apes. It is found that brain weight does not show significant change throughout adulthood, suggesting that the reduction in human brain weight may be specific to the human lineage.
insights: 创新点：发现大猩猩脑重无显著变化
方法亮点：研究大猩猩脑重变化
关键发现：人类脑重减少可能特定于人类谱系
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of no significant change in great ape brain weight
Method highlight: Studying brain weight changes in great apes
Key finding: Human brain weight reduction may be specific to the human lineage
abstract: Reduction in brain weight is a hallmark feature of human aging, which is exacerbated in pathologies, such as Alzheimer’s disease and other dementias. However, it remains unclear whether a decrease in brain weight with age reflects a vulnerability unique to the human lineage or represents a consequence of an extension of aging processes shared with other primates. To address this question, we examined age-related changes in brain weight across our closest living relatives, the great apes (chimpanzees, bonobos, gorillas, and orangutans). The sample spanned the full adult age range in each species and included individuals reaching ages comparable to those at which age-related brain changes become apparent in humans. Across species, brain weight did not show significant change throughout adulthood and into advanced age. The observed pattern held even when body weight was included in the analysis in a subsample of chimpanzees. Overall, these results indicate that marked brain weight loss is not a general feature of great ape aging and instead appears largely specific to humans, with implications for understanding susceptibility to late-life brain pathology.

title: Ecology must shape AI before AI reshapes ecology
A-to-I RNA editing–mediated stop codon read-through in Fusarium graminearum is not generally adaptive
GTP orchestrates CTP synthase via an allosteric effector–cycling mechanism
summary_zh: GTP通过别构效应器-循环机制调控CTP合酶，实现CTP的合成。
summary_en: GTP orchestrates CTP synthase via an allosteric effector-cycling mechanism to enable CTP synthesis.
insights: 创新点：GTP调控CTP合酶的新机制
方法亮点：结合冷冻电镜结构和生化分析
关键发现：GTP循环机制在CTP合成中的作用
insights_en: Novelty: A novel mechanism of GTP regulating CTP synthase
Method highlight: Integration of cryo-EM structures and biochemical analysis
Key finding: Role of the GTP cycling mechanism in CTP synthesis
abstract: Cytidine triphosphate (CTP), a fundamental building block of RNA, plays vital roles in diverse biological processes. CTP synthase (CTPS) is the only known enzyme for de novo synthesis of CTP. Efficient CTPS catalysis requires guanosine triphosphate (GTP) in a dose-dependent, nonconsumptive manner; however, the precise mechanism by which GTP drives CTP formation remains unclear. Here, we integrate a series of cryo-EM structures of Drosophila melanogaster CTPS captured from actively catalyzing samples with biochemical and mutagenesis analyses, yielding 34 distinct CTPS states at resolutions up to 2.0 Å. We find that GTP binds to and dissociates from CTPS once per catalytic cycle, thereby enabling the production of a single CTP molecule. Initial GTP engagement requires formation of 4-phosphoryl-UTP in the AL domain, whereas full stabilization of GTP binding is promoted by occupancy of the GAT active site. Together, these two checkpoints couple GTP recruitment and stabilization to catalytic progress in the two domains, enabling the coordinated synthesis of one CTP molecule per GTP binding–dissociation cycle. Moreover, the GTP-recognition site is highly conserved across the three domains of life. These findings establish a comprehensive mechanistic framework for efficient CTPS catalysis and define “effector-cycling”—in which GTP undergoes obligatory binding and dissociation during each catalytic cycle to regulate an intermediate step in a multistep catalytic process—as a distinct mode of allosteric regulation.

title: Maternal ranging strategies facilitate offspring social play at energetic cost in the most solitary ape
summary_zh: 研究调查了孤居猿类母亲如何通过调整活动范围促进后代社交玩耍，发现邻近母亲间空间重叠度高，但代价是能量消耗。
summary_en: The study investigates how solitary ape mothers facilitate offspring social play by adjusting ranging behavior, finding high spatial overlap among neighboring mothers at the cost of energetic expenditure.
insights: 创新点：首次发现孤居猿类母亲通过调整活动范围促进后代社交玩耍
方法亮点：长期行为和运动数据支持分析
关键发现：邻近母亲间空间重叠度高，但代价是能量消耗
insights_en: Novelty: First discovery of solitary ape mothers facilitating offspring social play through ranging adjustments
Method highlight: Long-term behavioral and movement data support analysis
Key finding: High spatial overlap among neighboring mothers at the cost of energetic expenditure
abstract: In most vertebrates, social play among peers is considered essential for behavioral development. Yet in solitary species bearing single offspring, opportunities for social play are inherently scarce. Whether mothers of such species actively facilitate play opportunities for their offspring, and at what cost, remains unknown. We used 15 y of behavioral and movement data (∼32,600 observation hours) from 31 wild Bornean orangutan ( Pongo pygmaeus wurmbii ) mother-offspring pairs to test whether mothers adjust ranging behavior to increase their offspring’s access to play with neighboring peers. Neighboring mothers with similarly aged offspring showed disproportionately high annual overlap in space use, independent of their relatedness or fruit availability. Correspondingly, peer play between neighboring offspring was more frequent when they were closer in age. Mothers also incurred energetic costs; on days their offspring played with peers, mothers traveled farther and spent less time feeding. Travel distances were also elevated on the days before and after play, with mothers orienting movement toward play partners’ core areas before play and back toward their own core areas after play. This suggests these encounters are planned and actively pursued over multiple days rather than arising by chance. These findings reveal that orangutan mothers incorporate their infants’ social needs into daily ranging decisions, at a cost to their own energy budgets. This points toward an underappreciated form of maternal investment and illustrates how the social requirements of development can be met even near the solitary extreme of animal social organization.

title: Myeloid cell reprogramming drives enhanced defense against Streptococcus pneumoniae lung infection following exposure to commensal Prevotella
summary_zh: 接触共生菌普雷沃菌后，巨噬细胞重编程增强对肺炎链球菌的防御。研究通过单细胞RNA测序揭示了这一过程。
summary_en: Exposure to the commensal bacterium Prevotella drives myeloid cell reprogramming to enhance defense against Streptococcus pneumoniae lung infection. The study reveals this process through single-cell RNA sequencing.
insights: 创新点：发现普雷沃菌影响巨噬细胞重编程的新机制
方法亮点：利用单细胞RNA测序研究免疫反应
关键发现：巨噬细胞重编程增强对肺炎链球菌的防御
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of a new mechanism by which Prevotella affects myeloid cell reprogramming
Method highlight: Using single-cell RNA sequencing to study immune responses
Key finding: Myeloid cell reprogramming enhances defense against Streptococcus pneumoniae
abstract: Clinical data link the prevalent respiratory tract anaerobe Prevotella with reduced pneumonia mortality, but the mechanisms directing Prevotella regulation of lung immune homeostasis are unclear. Here, single-cell RNA sequencing was employed to define the transcriptional immune signatures underlying improved clearance of Streptococcus pneumoniae following lung exposure to Prevotella melaninogenica . Overall, we observed a substantial shift in myeloid cell transcriptional programming from interferon-dominant to a more antibacterial profile in S. pneumoniae –infected mice after pre-exposure to P. melaninogenica , correlating with increased macrophage and neutrophil phagocytosis of S. pneumoniae and improved pathogen clearance. In neutrophils, tumor necrosis factor (TNF) signaling through TNFR2 was essential for increased antimicrobial function. Moreover, improved defense required CCR2-dependent monocyte-derived macrophages, with selective enrichment of more a mature Cxcl3+ population which was distinct from the hallmark S. pneumoniae –associated C1qa+ population enriched in the absence of effective clearance. Together, these findings inform the myeloid cell transcriptional changes associated with natural infection resistance mediated by pulmonary microbial exposures.

title: Large language models unlock the ecology of species interactions
summary_zh: 利用大型语言模型从公民科学平台中提取生物相互作用数据，研究物种相互作用。
summary_en: Large language models are used to extract species interaction data from citizen science platforms to study species interactions.
insights: 创新点：利用LLM从非结构化数据中提取生物相互作用。
方法亮点：开发LLM工作流程从多语言评论中收集数据。
关键发现：LLM在识别生物相互作用方面有效。
insights_en: Novelty: Using LLM to extract biological interactions from unstructured data.
Method highlight: Developed an LLM workflow to collect data from multilingual comments.
Key finding: LLM is effective in identifying biological interactions.
abstract: Species interactions shape population dynamics, geographic distributions, evolutionary trajectories, and responses to environmental change. Yet data on these interactions remain scarce across broad spatial, temporal, and taxonomic scales because they are difficult to collect in the field. One promising source of interaction data is citizen science platforms, which contain billions of biodiversity observations, often accompanied by unstructured text comments that may document interactions among organisms. Advances in large language models (LLMs) make it increasingly feasible to identify, extract, and categorize biotic interactions from these unstructured data at scale. Here, we present an LLM workflow that collects species interaction observations from multilingual citizen science comments. Using two case studies—bird–bird and plant–pollinator interactions—we show that LLMs can rapidly extract interaction types and participating species with high accuracy. These data can greatly expand the spatial, temporal, and taxonomic coverage and resolution of species interactions data, enable new tests of long-standing ecological questions, and improve our ability to track ecological changes. With appropriate validation, expert review, and attention to data privacy for both users and sensitive species, this approach opens new opportunities to characterize, forecast, and conserve biodiversity under global change.

title: Embryonic origin of cancer in newborn twins
summary_zh: 通过全基因组测序研究同卵双胞胎癌症，揭示肿瘤起源于一个双胞胎，并通过胎盘传播到另一个。
summary_en: Whole genome sequencing of monozygotic twins with identical cancers reveals that the tumor originates from one twin and spreads to the other through the placenta.
insights: 创新点：同卵双胞胎癌症起源研究
方法亮点：全基因组测序
关键发现：肿瘤单源传播
insights_en: Novelty: Study on the origin of cancer in monozygotic twins
Method highlight: Whole genome sequencing
Key finding: Single-source spread of the tumor
abstract: Abstract Studying monozygotic twins who present with identical cancers informs on the developmental origins of childhood tumours. Here, we perform whole genome sequencing on multiple tumour, normal, and placental samples to reconstruct the phylogeny of a soft tissue cancer that spread in utero between monozygotic twins. We demonstrate the origin of the tumour from one twin and time its diversification and transplacental spread to the other twin, showing that the spread occurred only once. This generalisable and scalable approach additionally allows us to dissect the earliest stages of twinning, revealing unexpected asymmetrical contributions of embryonic lineages to the placenta and each twin and challenging the classical model of twinning.

title: A co-evolved peptide-GPCR system senses host entry to drive fungal infection
summary_zh: 本文揭示真菌Ustilago maydis通过GPCR感知宿主进入，驱动感染。方法上，研究真菌分泌蛋白Pit2与宿主细胞相互作用。实验表明，Pit2被宿主细胞切割，释放肽配体激活下游信号。
summary_en: This paper reveals that the fungus Ustilago maydis senses host entry through a GPCR system to drive infection. The method involves studying the interaction between the fungal secreted protein Pit2 and host cells. Experiments show that Pit2 is cleaved by host cells, releasing a peptide ligand that activates downstream signaling.
insights: 创新点：真菌GPCR系统感知宿主进入
方法亮点：研究真菌分泌蛋白与宿主细胞相互作用
关键发现：Pit2被切割释放肽配体
insights_en: Novelty: Fungal GPCR system senses host entry
Method highlight: Studying the interaction between fungal secreted protein and host cells
Key finding: Pit2 is cleaved to release a peptide ligand
abstract: A successful infection requires pathogens to recognize the specific host environment in order to reprogram their physiology accordingly. One major way in which eukaryotic cells sense their surroundings is via G-Protein Coupled Receptors (GPCRs), which share a seven-transmembrane architecture and G-protein-mediated downstream signaling. While mammalian GPCRs are well-characterized and represent important drug targets, their fungal counterparts remain poorly understood. Here we uncover a GPCR-based mechanism that allows the corn pathogen Ustilago maydis to sense whether it has entered plant tissue. During infection, the fungus secretes the protein Pit2, which is cleaved by host apoplastic cysteine proteases, releasing a peptide ligand 'hidden' within the protein core. This ligand activates the fungal GPCR Gpe1, thus promoting fungal proliferation after initial host penetration. We elucidate the crystal structure of Pit2 and model the complex formed by Gpe1 and the Pit2-derived peptide. Structure-guided mutational analysis supports that disrupting this interaction reduces fungal virulence. The Gpe1/Pit2 system is conserved in related fungal species, with co-evolutionary signatures apparently preserving receptor-ligand specificity. Furthermore, this system shows mechanistic similarities to mammalian receptors, suggesting an evolutionary link between fungal and mammalian GPCRs.

title: Cycles upon cycles—Temperature scaling of medaka development
summary_zh: 研究探讨昼夜温度循环对斑马鱼胚胎轴伸长和节段化的影响。采用奇异值分解方法识别节段时钟振荡的动态模式。发现两种主要动态模式对温度敏感性相反。
summary_en: This study investigates the impact of diurnal temperature cycles on medaka embryonic axis elongation and segmentation. An unbiased dimensional reduction approach based on Singular Value Decomposition is used to identify the dynamic modes of segmentation clock oscillations. Two major dynamic modes with opposite temperature sensitivities are revealed.
insights: 创新点：采用奇异值分解识别节段时钟振荡的动态模式
方法亮点：基于奇异值分解的无偏维数约简方法
关键发现：两种动态模式对温度敏感性相反
insights_en: Novelty: Identifying dynamic modes of segmentation clock oscillations using Singular Value Decomposition
Method highlight: An unbiased dimensional reduction method based on Singular Value Decomposition
Key finding: Two dynamic modes with opposite temperature sensitivities
abstract: How organisms develop in dynamic environmental conditions is a fundamental question. We asked how day-night temperature cycles impact embryonic axis elongation and segmentation, itself a cyclic process linked to the segmentation clock, using the Japanese rice fish medaka. We developed an unbiased dimensional reduction approach, based on Singular Value Decomposition, to reliably identify the dynamic modes of segmentation clock oscillations across all temperature conditions. We reveal that the two major dynamic modes show opposite temperature sensitivities: While the temporal oscillation (mode 1) varies strongly with temperature, the spatial phase gradient (mode 2) appears largely temperature invariant. In addition, we found developmental parameters with intermediate, subscaled temperature responses, such as axis elongation. We used theoretical modeling to understand how dynamic modes emerge from the underlying local oscillation dynamics and axis elongation. We then exposed embryos to circadian and ultradian temperature cycles to reveal dynamic response patterns of oscillations and axis elongation, and found how these responses are integrated into morphological features. Combined, our theoretical–experimental results support a model in which the dynamic integration of temporal (i.e. segmentation clock related) and spatial (i.e. axis elongation) processes, in particular their subscaled temperature response patterns, quantitatively compensate each other to yield a robust, temperature-invariant axis patterning outcome.

title: Extensive glacier loss in the coterminous United States
summary_zh: 研究显示美国大陆冰川自20世纪中叶以来面积和体积减少三分之一，揭示冰川退缩模式。
summary_en: This study shows that glaciers in the contiguous United States have lost one-third of their area and volume since the mid-20th century, revealing the pattern of glacial retreat.
insights: 创新点：评估美国大陆冰川的退缩情况
方法亮点：综合分析冰川面积和体积变化
关键发现：冰川退缩受局部地形影响
insights_en: Novelty: Assessing the retreat of glaciers in the contiguous United States
Method highlight: Comprehensive analysis of glacial area and volume changes
Key finding: Glacial retreat is influenced by local topography
abstract: Glaciers populate the mountain ranges of the western conterminous United States and despite their importance to alpine hydrology, their area and volume change have never been comprehensively evaluated. Our study shows that since the mid-twentieth century about one-quarter of the glaciers have disappeared and the overall area and volume are reduced by one-third. The pattern of glacier shrinkage suggests most glaciers in the conterminous United States are largely maintained by local topographic influences due to their small size. These results improve our understanding of evolving high alpine hydrology and importance to ecosystem processes.

title: Artificial intelligence-enabled clinical phenotyping of human brown fat
summary_zh: 本文利用大数据和人工智能系统性地定义了棕色脂肪在患者队列中的临床影响。研究发现棕色脂肪与心血管和心理健康疾病风险降低相关。
summary_en: This paper leverages big data and artificial intelligence to systematically define the clinical impact of brown adipose tissue in a patient cohort. The study reveals that brown adipose tissue is associated with reduced risk of cardiovascular and psychiatric diseases.
insights: 创新点：人工智能辅助棕色脂肪临床表型分析
方法亮点：大数据分析患者队列
关键发现：棕色脂肪与疾病风险降低相关
insights_en: Novelty: AI-assisted clinical phenotyping of human brown fat
Method highlight: Big data analysis of patient cohorts
Key finding: Brown adipose tissue is associated with reduced disease risk
abstract: Adipose tissue has a central role in systemic energy balance and the pathogenesis of obesity and its sequelae1,2. In contrast to white adipose tissue, brown adipose tissue (BAT) uses energy to produce heat3. Detectable BAT in humans is associated with decreased prevalence of cardiometabolic diseases4. However, the complete spectrum of health conditions associated with BAT remains unknown, and high-throughput methods to quantify BAT activity in humans are lacking5,6. Here we leveraged big data and artificial intelligence to systematically define the clinical impact of BAT in a cohort of 101,243 patients from a large cancer centre. Our unbiased analyses revealed that, across all diagnoses, cardiovascular and psychiatric diseases were less prevalent in people with BAT. Using a machine learning approach, we semi-automatically quantified BAT activity in approximately 8,700 patients and demonstrated that higher BAT activity, especially in the axillary depot, is associated with lower odds of cardiometabolic diseases and healthier white fat distribution. People with BAT also exhibited more favourable glycaemic parameters, lipid profiles, inflammatory markers and echocardiographic indices. Analysis of medication usage demonstrated that angiotensin receptor blocker use was positively associated with BAT presence. As proof of concept, we showed that the angiotensin receptor blocker losartan increased brown adipocyte activity and whole-body energy expenditure. Altogether, our studies harnessing artificial intelligence and big data identify new clinical phenotypes linked to BAT and serve as a platform for drug repurposing to activate this tissue in humans. Artificial intelligence-enabled quantification and analyses of brown adipose tissue (BAT) activity uncover links between BAT and a healthier metabolic profile along with lower rates of psychiatric disease, and can identify pharmacologic agents that could be repurposed to activate this tissue in humans.

title: A pair of chitosan receptors confer broad-spectrum fungal resistance
summary_zh: 发现OsFID1和OsFID2受体，介导壳聚糖感知和免疫激活。OsFID1-OsFID2复合体赋予植物广谱抗真菌性。
summary_en: OsFID1 and OsFID2 receptors were identified to mediate chitosan sensing and immune activation. The OsFID1-OsFID2 complex confers broad-spectrum fungal resistance to plants.
insights: 创新点：发现OsFID1和OsFID2受体介导壳聚糖感知。
方法亮点：通过基因表达分析鉴定受体。
关键发现：受体复合体赋予植物抗真菌性。
insights_en: Novelty: OsFID1 and OsFID2 receptors mediate chitosan perception.
Method highlight: Identified receptors through gene expression analysis.
Key finding: The receptor complex confers fungal resistance to plants.
abstract: Chitosan, a major fungal cell wall component, activates plant immunity, yet the underlying perception mechanism remains unknown. In this study, we identified OsFID1, an apoplast-localized DUF26 domain protein, as a chitosan-binding receptor essential for chitosan-triggered immunity. OsFID1 forms a receptor complex with OsFID2, a plasma membrane–localized DUF26 receptor-like kinase, to mediate chitosan sensing and immune activation, requiring OsFID2 phosphorylation for function. The OsFID1-OsFID2 complex confers broad-spectrum resistance to fungal pathogens. OsFID1 homologs are conserved in land plants, which show chitosan-binding activity in both monocots and dicots. Ectopic expression of OsFID1 in wheat and maize enhanced fungal resistance without growth penalty. These findings uncover a conserved receptor complex for direct chitosan sensing, advancing our understanding of plant-fungus interactions and providing a potential strategy for engineering durable fungal resistance crops.

title: Structural basis for size-selective perception of chitin in plants
summary_zh: 研究植物识别几丁质机制。揭示CHITIN PERCEPTION受体类特征结构域。发现CERK类低亲和力受体。
summary_en: This study investigates the mechanism of plant chitin perception. It reveals a hallmark bridge domain of the CHITIN PERCEPTION receptor class and identifies the CERK class as a low-affinity receptor.
insights: 创新点：揭示CHITIN PERCEPTION受体类特征结构域。
方法亮点：结合结构分析和生物化学研究。
关键发现：CERK类低亲和力受体参与几丁质感知。
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the hallmark bridge domain of the CHITIN PERCEPTION receptor class.
Method highlight: Combining structural analysis and biochemical studies.
Key finding: The CERK class of low-affinity receptors is involved in chitin perception.
abstract: Plants detect microbes through pattern recognition receptors that perceive conserved microbial surface motifs known as microbe-associated molecular patterns (MAMPs). Lysin motif (LysM) receptors recognize and mediate downstream responses to chitinous MAMPs. In this study, we elucidated the mechanism for the specific recognition of long-chain chitin oligomers and identified a hallmark bridge domain characteristic of the CHITIN PERCEPTION (CHIP) receptor class. Structural analysis of receptor-ligand complexes, biochemistry, and in planta functional studies of inhibitory nanobodies revealed the mechanism of size-selective, high-affinity chitin perception in Lotus japonicus and Medicago truncatula . Additionally, we identified the CHITIN ELICITOR RECEPTOR KINASE (CERK) class as low-affinity, yet essential, co-receptors and propose a mechanistic model for a ligand-induced core signaling heterocomplex. Our findings establish the structural and mechanistic basis of differential chitin perception and receptor complex assembly in chitin-elicited plant immune signaling.

title: Modular van der Waals MOSFETs through layer-by-layer chalcogen substitutions
summary_zh: 通过层状硫族元素取代制备模块化范德华MOSFET。实现不同电子相的垂直和横向集成。
summary_en: Modular van der Waals MOSFETs are created through layer-by-layer chalcogen substitution, achieving vertical and lateral integration of distinct electronic phases.
insights: 创新点：层状硫族元素取代制备模块化MOSFET。
方法亮点：精确控制电子相的集成。
关键发现：实现不同电子相的集成。
insights_en: Novelty: Layer-by-layer chalcogen substitution for creating modular MOSFETs.
Method highlight: Precise control of electronic phase integration.
Key finding: Integration of distinct electronic phases achieved.
abstract: In two-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs), the local electrostatic field of the chalcogen p -orbitals dictates the crystal field splitting of the transition metal d -orbitals, stabilizing diverse electronic states from semiconducting and semimetallic to exotic topological phases. On-demand substitution of the lattice chalcogens is therefore an efficient route to tuning TMDC electronic phases.
