Here, we custom-molded van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures by layer-by-layer vapor-phase chalcogen substitution starting from p -type WSe 2 multilayers into which we locally inscribed insulating WO x , n -type WS 2 , and semimetallic WTe 2 . This spatially precise conversion seamlessly integrated distinct electronic phases, both vertically and laterally, into modular vdW semiconductor heterostructures that are otherwise inaccessible. As a demonstration, we integrated WO x /WSe 2 local gate stacks to build ultrascaled metal oxide–semiconductor field effect transistors (MOSFETs), achieving an unprecedented subthreshold swing at subnanometer equivalent oxide thickness.

title: Airflows redefine the cost of aerial transport in the wild
summary_zh: 研究野生动物飞行能量消耗。结果显示飞行成本低于游泳，接近跑步成本。
summary_en: This study investigates the energy cost of animal flight in the wild. The results suggest that flying is cheaper than swimming but nearly as costly as running.
insights: 创新点：分析野生动物飞行能量消耗。
方法亮点：利用高分辨率运动数据。
关键发现：飞行成本低于游泳。
insights_en: Novelty: Analyzing the energy cost of animal flight in the wild.
Method highlight: Using high-resolution movement data.
Key finding: Flying is cheaper than swimming.
abstract: Fuel economy matters to both animals and machines, as the cost of transport can determine where, when, and how far locomotion is possible. However, established estimates of these values for animal flight come from laboratories and treat the atmosphere as constant, even though free-flying animals routinely extract energy from atmospheric flows. Using high-resolution movement data, we estimate the cost of transport for 50 bird and bat species flying in the wild. Our results revise the classic ranking of locomotion costs, suggesting that flying can be cheaper than swimming though almost as costly as running, depending on interactions between physical environment, morphology, and behavior. Linking transport costs to atmospheric conditions provides a mechanistic basis for predicting how changing windscapes will reshape the energetics, movements, and distributions of flying animals.

title: Human–artificial intelligence collaboration for comanaging epilepsy in real time
Disentangling biases in responding from substantive effects in computational psychiatry
The basins of attraction of soft-sphere packings are not fractal
summary_zh: 研究显示软球堆积的吸引域并非分形，揭示了标准数值方法在解析能量景观结构时的局限性。
summary_en: Research shows that the basins of attraction of soft-sphere packings are not fractal, revealing the limitations of standard numerical methods in resolving the true structure of energy landscapes.
insights: 创新点：发现软球堆积的吸引域非分形结构。
方法亮点：采用C语言变量系数常微分方程求解器。
关键发现：标准数值方法在解析能量景观结构时存在局限性。
insights_en: Novelty: Found that the basins of attraction of soft-sphere packings are not fractal in structure.
Method highlight: Using a C-language variable-coefficient ordinary differential equation solver.
Key finding: Standard numerical methods have limitations in resolving the true structure of energy landscapes.
abstract: The energy landscape picture is a central tool to study many-body systems. In particular, the energy landscapes of glass-forming liquids, jammed packings, constraint satisfaction problems, or neural networks contain a plethora of minima corresponding to competing states. Due to their complexity, these landscapes resist analytical treatment and must be studied numerically. We focus on jammed soft spheres, a paradigmatic model of glasses and granulars, to expose the limitations of standard numerical methods in resolving the true structure of energy landscapes. We show that the C-language Variable-coefficients ordinary differential equation solver is the one with the best time-for-error trade-off for this problem, outperforming commonly used steepest-descent solvers by several orders of magnitude. Using this numerical approach, we provide unequivocal evidence that optimizers widely used in computational studies destroy all semblance of the true landscape geometry, even in moderately low dimensions. Employing a range of geometric indicators, both low- and high-dimensional, we show that earlier claims on the fractality of basins of attraction of minima originated from the use of inadequate mapping strategies. In reality, the basins of attraction of soft-sphere packings are smooth structures with well-defined length scales, a result that likely extends to a much broader family of problems.

title: CMGL: Confidence-guided Multi-omics Graph Learning for Cancer Subtype Classification
summary_zh: 提出CMGL方法，通过融合多组学数据，提高癌症亚型分类的预测可靠性。
summary_en: This study proposes the CMGL method, fusing multi-omics data to improve predictive reliability in cancer subtype classification.
insights: 创新点：置信度引导，多组学图学习
方法亮点：融合不同模态数据，提高分类可靠性
关键发现：癌症亚型分类
insights_en: Novelty: Confidence-guided, multi-omics graph learning
Method highlight: Fusing different modalities, improving classification reliability
Key finding: Cancer subtype classification
abstract: MOTIVATION: Multi-omics integration can improve cancer subtyping, but modality informativeness and noise vary across cancer types and patients. Most graph methods for multi-omics data learn modality contributions within the downstream classification objective, leaving predictive reliability for each patient implicit. As a result, uninformative modalities can weaken the fused representation, while unreliable omics can introduce noisy patient relationships into graph propagation. To address these two problems, we propose CMGL, which produces a separate reliability estimate before fusion and uses consensus patient neighborhoods for graph classification.

title: Infant hippocampal and amygdala volume in an observational follow-up from a randomized clinical trial for maternal prenatal depression
summary_zh: 研究观察母亲孕期抑郁症对婴儿海马体和杏仁核体积的影响。结果显示，接受心理治疗的婴儿海马体体积较小。
summary_en: This study observes the impact of prenatal maternal depression on infant hippocampal and amygdala volumes. Results show that infants of mothers receiving psychotherapy have smaller right hippocampal volumes.
insights: 创新点：观察孕期抑郁症对婴儿大脑的影响
方法亮点：随机临床试验的观察性后续研究
关键发现：心理治疗影响海马体体积
insights_en: Novelty: Observing the impact of prenatal depression on infant brain development
Method highlight: Observational follow-up from a randomized clinical trial
Key finding: Psychotherapy affects hippocampal volume
abstract: Prenatal maternal depression may have intergenerational effects on offspring brain development, with potential socioemotional consequences. This observational follow-up study examines brain development and subsequent negative emotionality among 109 infants born to mothers participating in a randomized clinical trial (NCT03011801). In the prior trial, brief interpersonal psychotherapy significantly reduced prenatal depression symptoms and disorder as the published primary and secondary endpoints. Exploratory infant outcomes include hippocampal and amygdala volumes at 6 weeks and negative emotionality at 6 months. Here we show that infants of mothers randomized to interpersonal psychotherapy during pregnancy have lower right hippocampal volume than infants of mothers in the enhanced usual care group (p = .002, d = 0.62). No statistically significant group differences are observed in left hippocampal or amygdala volume. Smaller hippocampal volume predicts subsequent lower negative emotionality (r = 0.19, p = 0.045). In this study, a maternal prenatal depression intervention is associated with differences in infant brain development with implications for their subsequent emotional health.

title: Scientists disrupt less but more persistently with career aging
summary_zh: 研究发现，科学家在职业生涯中产生颠覆性工作的概率降低，但影响更持久。
summary_en: The study finds that scientists produce less disruptive work over their careers but have more persistent impacts.
insights: 颠覆性工作概率下降
持久颠覆性影响增加
职业生涯影响分析
insights_en: Decreased probability of disruptive work
Increased persistent disruptive impact
Career impact analysis
abstract: Disruption describes the extent to which a scientific work overturns the prior knowledge on which it builds and leads to a new line of research. A scientist’s tendency to produce disruptive work has been found recently to decline over the career. However, the disruption index captures only how strongly a paper overturns prior work and ignores whether that disruption is later accepted or overturned by subsequent research. The persistent disruption (PD) framework adds this second perspective, identifying work that disrupts prior research and is then consolidated rather than displaced by later work. We examine how PD evolves over the career and find the opposite pattern: The probability of producing a persistent disruptive paper increases with career age. Senior scientists disrupt prior work less often compared to young, but once they do, the disruption tends to persist rather than being quickly superseded. Our results suggest that this reversal feature is due to the experience and we corroborate it across several dimensions of recognition. We also show that, at a fixed level of disruptiveness, the more senior the scientist is, it attracts more citations, social-media attention, and research grants. Nobel laureates also show delayed persistent disruptions. They exhibit high disruptive ability early in their careers, yet their prize-winning work appears years later. This lag further indicates that experience is needed to turn disruptive ability into the field’s most celebrated contributions.

title: Resolving short-term meteorological variability amplifies projected glacier loss and sea-level rise
summary_zh: 本文研究冰川融化与海平面上升的预测。开发每日分辨率冰川模型，对比月度模型。结果显示，每日模型更精确，预测损失增加25%。
summary_en: This paper studies the prediction of glacier melting and sea-level rise. A daily-resolution glacier model is developed and compared with the monthly model. Results show that the daily model is more accurate and predicts an increased loss by 25%.
insights: 创新点：每日分辨率模型提高预测精度
方法亮点：考虑短期气象变化对冰川的影响
关键发现：短期气象变化导致冰川损失预测增加
insights_en: Novelty: Daily-resolution model improves prediction accuracy
Method highlight: Consideration of short-term meteorological changes on glacier impact
Key finding: Short-term meteorological changes lead to increased glacier loss predictions
abstract: Global glacier models typically rely on temperature-index mass balance calculations forced with aggregated meteorological data, limiting their ability to resolve short-term variability. Here, we develop a daily-resolution version of the Global Glacier Evolution Model (GloGEM), which we apply globally and compare against the monthly configuration. Our results show that the daily model more closely reproduces mass balance observations and provides a more detailed representation of glacier runoff. Accounting for short-term meteorological variability leads to systematically greater projected mass loss, with up to 25% greater loss in Svalbard. These differences arise from extreme melt days, precipitation-phase transitions, and surface-type feedbacks not fully represented at monthly resolution. Globally, the daily model yields ice volume losses of 26 ± 10% under low-emission and 47 ± 17% under high-emission scenarios over 2025-2100 (ensemble mean ± 1 StD), resulting in an additional 5-10% mass loss (20-33 mm of global mean sea-level rise) relative to the monthly implementation. Resolving high-frequency forcing, or accounting for its effects through parameterisations, is therefore essential for robust glacier projections, while its omission may systematically underestimate future glacier loss.

title: Multimodal substrate recruitment enables CTLHMKLN1 E3 ligase to target acetylated N-, C-, and internal degrons
summary_zh: 本文研究CTLHMKLN1 E3连接酶的底物识别机制。通过重构和结构分析，揭示MKLN1如何通过多价接触识别底物。
summary_en: This paper studies the substrate recognition mechanism of the CTLHMKLN1 E3 ligase. Through reconstruction and structural analysis, it reveals how MKLN1 recognizes substrates through multivalent contacts.
insights: 创新点：揭示MKLN1的多模态底物识别机制
方法亮点：利用冷冻电镜技术解析结构
关键发现：MKLN1通过多价接触识别底物
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the multimodal substrate recognition mechanism of MKLN1
Method highlight: Utilizing cryo-EM technology to analyze structures
Key finding: MKLN1 recognizes substrates through multivalent contacts
abstract: Abstract The GID/CTLH family of E3 ubiquitin ligases employs several substrate receptor subunits that recruit distinct degrons, but the substrate recognition mechanisms of the CTLH MKLN1 assembly have largely remained elusive. Here, we reconstitute CTLH MKLN1 -dependent ubiquitylation of three biochemically distinct substrates – MKLN1 itself, ZMYND19, and FAM72A-recruited UNG2, and determine cryo-EM structures of each substrate bound to MKLN1. The structures reveal how MKLN1’s discoidin and Kelch β-propeller domains engage substrates through multivalent contacts. MKLN1 recruits itself through discoidin-Kelch interactions between MKLN1 dimers, forming an assembly that competes with other substrates. ZMYND19 and FAM72A each bind to MKLN1 through loops engaging the discoidin trench domain while their C-terminal Arg residues engage the MKLN1 Kelch central channel, identifying MKLN1 as an Arg/C-degron receptor. The acetylated N-terminus of UNG2 is positioned within a Y-shaped tunnel of FAM72A, defining an adaptor-mediated Ac/N-degron recognition mechanism. Thus, our data reveal how combinatorial deployment of MKLN1 discoidin and Kelch domains enable a single receptor subunit to recognize a diverse substrate repertoire, adding to a complex picture of degron recognition across the GID/CTLH family.

title: Social History
Global, regional and national burden of pertussis in 1990–2023: a Global Burden of Disease study
summary_zh: 研究全球百日咳负担，分析1990-2023年204个国家数据。结果显示死亡率下降61.2%，发病率下降41.6%。2020-2023年疫情后发病率与死亡率反弹。
summary_en: This study assesses the global burden of pertussis, analyzing data from 204 countries from 1990 to 2023. Results show a 61.2% decrease in mortality and a 41.6% decrease in incidence. Between 2020 and 2023, there was a rebound in incidence and mortality after the pandemic.
insights: 创新点：全球百日咳负担评估模型
方法亮点：长期趋势分析
关键发现：疫情后负担反弹
insights_en: Novelty: Global pertussis burden assessment model
Method highlight: Long-term trend analysis
Key finding: Burden rebound after the pandemic
abstract: Despite long-standing immunization programs, pertussis remains a major cause of vaccine-preventable mortality, particularly among infants. Here we present a primary assessment of global pertussis incidence, mortality and disability-adjusted life years across 204 countries and territories from 1990 to 2023. We show that despite short-term pandemic-period fluctuations, the dominant global pattern from 1990 to 2023 was long-term decline: age-standardized mortality decreased by 61.2% and age-standardized incidence by 41.6%. Relative to the anomalously low pandemic-period estimates, incidence and mortality rebounded by 102.6% (95% uncertainty interval, 77.0–128.2%) and 66.1% (95% uncertainty interval, 2.4–174.5%), respectively, between 2020 and 2023. In 2023 alone, we estimated 18.9 million cases and 115,000 deaths attributable to pertussis. This burden remains profoundly inequitable and inversely correlated with the sociodemographic index; sub-Saharan Africa now accounts for roughly 65% of global deaths, with the highest population-adjusted risk concentrated among infants younger than 6 months. Our findings highlight a modeled geographic concentration of pertussis mortality and support strengthening timely infant vaccination, maternal immunization where recommended and feasible and robust surveillance in highly susceptible regions. Updates to the Global Burden of Disease study showed that while global trends in pertussis (whooping cough) declined from 1990 to 2023, the rebound in incidence and mortality since 2020, particularly in high-income regions, reflects stalled vaccination progress worldwide.

title: Global and regional burden of measles and vaccine coverage among children under 5 years, 1990−2023: a Global Burden of Disease Study
Ultrarapid decision-making in an avian brain
summary_zh: 研究鸟类感知决策，发现乌鸦决策速度极快，平均235毫秒作出选择，准确率未受影响。
summary_en: This study investigates avian perceptual decision-making, revealing crows make rapid decisions with high accuracy in a visual motion task, averaging 235 milliseconds to report choices.
insights: 创新点：鸟类决策速度快于哺乳动物
方法亮点：使用经典视觉运动辨别任务
关键发现：乌鸦决策速度与准确性并存
insights_en: Novelty: Bird decision-making is faster than mammals
Method highlight: Classic visual motion discrimination task used
Key finding: Speed and accuracy coexist in crows' decision-making
abstract: Perceptual decision-making is well studied in mammals, but its operation in other vertebrates remains unclear. We show that carrion crows ( Corvus corone ) make deliberate decisions in a classic visual motion discrimination task with unprecedented speed, reporting choices in approximately 235 milliseconds on average, which is roughly twice as fast as has been observed in monkeys or humans and without sacrificing accuracy. Recordings from the pallial endbrain reveal that direction-selective neurons encode the upcoming choice as early as about 70 milliseconds after stimulus onset and about 170 milliseconds before the response, with ramping activity scaling with sensory evidence and converging at response onset. These findings highlight the extraordinary efficiency of avian decision-making circuitry, possibly shaped by evolutionary pressures for rapid visuomotor control.

title: BAK and BAX form a multiprotein complex to drive mtDNA efflux and caspase-independent cell death
summary_zh: 研究BAX和BAK蛋白复合体在细胞死亡中的作用，发现其可驱动mtDNA外排，引发细胞凋亡。
summary_en: This study investigates the role of the BAX-BAK protein complex in cell death, finding it drives mtDNA efflux and induces apoptosis.
insights: 创新点：BAX-BAK复合体参与mtDNA外排
方法亮点：纯化多蛋白复合体
关键发现：VDAC1/2和prohibitins参与细胞死亡
insights_en: Novelty: BAX-BAK complex involved in mtDNA efflux
Method highlight: Purification of macromolecular complex
Key finding: VDAC1/2 and prohibitins in cell death
abstract: The apoptotic regulators BAX and BAK, once activated, form homo-oligomers to trigger mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP), activating the apoptosome and caspases. Activation of BAX-BAK without apoptosome activation triggers sustained efflux of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) and caspase-independent cell death. However, the molecular basis of mtDNA efflux remains unclear. We purified a macromolecular complex comprising BAK, BAX, activator BH3-only molecules, voltage-dependent anion channels 1 and 2 (VDAC1 and VDAC2), and prohibitins that released mtDNA from mitoplasts. BAX-BAK activation resulted in VDAC closure, mitochondrial calcium influx, and mtDNA efflux. Loss of VDAC1, VDAC2, or prohibitins prevented BAX-BAK activation–induced mtDNA efflux and caspase-independent cell death without affecting MOMP or mitochondrial inner membrane herniation. These findings support differential regulation of cytochrome c and mtDNA efflux by distinct BAX-BAK complexes.

title: Late Holocene reexpansion of the Laurentide Ice Sheet
summary_zh: 研究劳伦蒂德冰盖的晚全新世再扩张，发现其于约3.6千年后达到最小冰期，随后再扩张，标志着新冰期的开始。
summary_en: This study examines the late Holocene reexpansion of the Laurentide Ice Sheet, revealing it reached its minimum interglacial dimensions around 3.6 thousand years ago before reexpanding, marking the start of the next glaciation.
insights: 创新点：劳伦蒂德冰盖晚全新世再扩张
方法亮点：使用Barnes冰盖作为研究对象
关键发现：人类活动导致冰盖退缩
insights_en: Novelty: Late Holocene reexpansion of the Laurentide Ice Sheet
Method highlight: Using Barnes Ice Cap as the research object
Key finding: Human activity leads to ice sheet recession
abstract: During interglaciations, the Laurentide Ice Sheet (LIS), which is the largest of the Pleistocene ice sheets, retreats to Arctic Canada, where it achieves a minimum configuration. The reexpansion of the LIS following this minimum marks the start of the next glaciation. Here, we show that the last remaining remnant of the most recent LIS, Barnes Ice Cap (Baffin Island, Canada), achieved its minimum interglacial dimensions after ~3.6 thousand years ago, before reexpanding ~2000 years ago, marking the onset of the next glaciation. The new LIS reached maximum dimensions in ~1960 CE, after which anthropogenic summer warming resulted in a negative mass balance, ice margin recession, and the termination of the next glaciation. The demise of the next glaciation, despite the ongoing decline in summer insolation, illustrates the influence of anomalous greenhouse gas forcing on climate.

title: Wireless electrocatalytic closed-loop system for drug-free management of diabesity
summary_zh: 研究无药治疗糖尿病和肥胖的方法，开发了一种无线供电的电催化闭环系统，有效调节血糖。
summary_en: This study investigates a drug-free method for managing diabesity, developing a wireless-powered electrocatalytic closed-loop system that effectively regulates blood glucose.
insights: 创新点：无线供电电催化闭环系统
方法亮点：使用铂装饰金纳米簇
关键发现：改善血糖稳态
insights_en: Novelty: Wireless-powered electrocatalytic closed-loop system
Method highlight: Use of platinum-decorated gold nanoclusters
Key finding: Improved glucose homeostasis
abstract: Lifestyle-related type 2 diabetes and associated obesity (diabesity) affect >2.5 billion people worldwide and impose nearly $3 trillion in annual health care costs. We developed an implantable, wirelessly powered electrocatalytic closed-loop health optimization (ECHO) device containing platinum-decorated gold nanoclusters embedded in graphite felt that enabled selective, electrically tunable oxidation of blood glucose to renally cleared gluconate. In type 2 diabetic mice, wireless, low-power activation (0.75 volts, 10 milliamperes) restored glucose homeostasis within 1 hour, shifted metabolism from glucose to lipid utilization, reduced body weight and triglycerides, and increased circulating free fatty acids and ketone bodies without detectable hypoglycemia or adverse physiological, inflammatory, or behavioral effects during 6 weeks of treatment. Coupling this ECHO device to a commercial continuous glucose monitoring system enabled autonomous, smartphone-controlled, drug-free closed-loop management of experimental diabesity.

title: Glioma margins gain a third dimension before surgery ends
Taking the heat: Breaking the temperature limits of eukaryotic life
Decoding mitochondrial proteomes of diverse eukaryotes
summary_zh: 研究不同真核生物的线粒体蛋白质组。通过实验和计算方法构建了高精度的线粒体蛋白质组。
summary_en: Studies the mitochondrial proteomes of diverse eukaryotes. Develops high-accuracy mitochondrial proteomes through experimental and computational methods.
insights: 创新点：构建跨真核生物的线粒体蛋白质组图谱
方法亮点：结合实验和计算方法
关键发现：揭示线粒体蛋白质组的多样性
insights_en: Novelty: Construction of a mitochondrial proteome map across eukaryotes
Method highlight: Combination of experimental and computational methods
Key finding: Revealing the diversity of mitochondrial proteomes
abstract: Our textbook view of mitochondria, which has been shaped by studies in animals and yeast, fails to do justice to the organelle's broader eukaryotic diversity. While most mitochondria retain a tiny genome, the overwhelming majority of their proteins are nuclear-encoded and vary extensively across lineages. To map this diversity, the MitoCarta Tree of Life Consortium developed experimental and computational workflows to generate high-accuracy mitochondrial proteomes across diverse eukaryotes—helping to lay a foundation for comparative mitochondrial biology with broad implications for physiology, evolution, and disease.

title: Mitochondria before we knew them
Genome mining of the tumor microbiome reveals biosynthetic diversity and potential pathology-modulating metabolites
summary_zh: 研究肿瘤微生物组的基因组挖掘。识别出与肿瘤病理相关的生物合成基因簇。
summary_en: Studies genome mining of the tumor microbiome. Identifies biosynthetic gene clusters relevant to tumor pathology.
insights: 创新点：挖掘肿瘤微生物组的生物合成潜力
方法亮点：利用微生物组组装基因组
关键发现：发现与肿瘤病理相关的代谢物
insights_en: Novelty: Mining the biosynthetic potential of the tumor microbiome
Method highlight: Utilizing microbial metagenome-assembled genomes
Key finding: Discovery of metabolites relevant to tumor pathology
abstract: Human tumor-associated microbes – the tumor microbiome – have demonstrated an increasingly important role in human health due to their relevance to cancer progression and treatment response. While the metabolism at the host-microbiota interface, such as in the human gut, has been extensively investigated in recent years, the specialized metabolites from the tumor microbiome remain uncharted territory. To address this knowledge gap, we report a survey of the biosynthetic potential of the human tumor microbiome. Utilizing high-quality microbial metagenome-assembled genomes from 3,526 human tumor tissue samples, we identify 528 biosynthetic gene clusters with the potential to encode specialized metabolites relevant to tumor pathology. We reveal that the tumor microbiome encodes known and unknown metabolites spanning multiple biosynthetic classes. From this diverse biosynthetic landscape, we express a conserved family of biosynthetic genes from the genus Fusobacterium, which has a well-established role in cancer, and discover distinct families of long-chain fatty acyl amides. We subsequently find that one of these fatty acyl amides, oleoyl γ-aminobutyric acid, has immunomodulatory and G-protein-coupled receptor partial agonist activities, potentially supporting the influence of Fusobacterium in tumor pathology. The findings of our investigation lay a foundation for further research into the roles of tumor microbe-derived metabolites in cancer. Here, Pulliam and colleagues characterize the metabolites encoded by tumor-inhabiting microbes and their potential role in cancer pathology.

title: Evaluating generative models for structure-based drug discovery from de novo design to lead optimization
Prognostic Value of Cardiac MRI–derived Diastolic Function for Adverse Cardiovascular Outcomes: Insights from UK Biobank | Tweetorial
Times are changing but order matters: transferable prediction of small-molecule liquid chromatography retention times
summary_zh: 提出两步法预测小分子液相色谱保留时间，考虑色谱条件。
summary_en: A two-step method for predicting small-molecule liquid chromatography retention times is proposed, considering chromatographic conditions.
insights: 创新点：保留顺序对预测至关重要
方法亮点：两步法提高预测准确性
关键发现：色谱条件影响保留时间预测
insights_en: Novelty: Retention order is crucial for prediction
Method highlight: Two-step method improves prediction accuracy
Key finding: Chromatographic conditions affect retention time prediction
abstract: Abstract Liquid chromatography is a predominant technology for the separation of small molecules. Hundreds of retention time prediction models have been published over the past decades, yet truly transferable prediction (requiring no training data from the target chromatographic system) remains an open challenge. Unfortunately, retention times may change massively, even for nominally identical chromatographic conditions. Retention order is considerably more conserved; but even retention order may change if chromatographic conditions vary. Here we present 2-step, a two-step method for the prediction of retention times in reversed-phase chromatography. In the first step, a machine-learning model predicts a retention order index, taking into account chromatographic conditions. In the second step, we map predicted indices to absolute retention times. Disentangling these two tasks finally enables transferable retention time prediction across chromatographic conditions and compound classes, without requiring any target-system training data. Our 2-step method outperforms existing methods that were trained on the target dataset. Finally, we systematically study what chromatographic conditions result in notable changes of retention order.

Effects of semaglutide on kidney disease in type 2 diabetes: a randomized placebo-controlled trial
summary_zh: 研究semaglutide对2型糖尿病肾病的影响，通过磁共振成像和活检分析。
summary_en: The effects of semaglutide on kidney disease in type 2 diabetes are investigated through kidney MRI and biopsy analysis.
insights: 创新点：semaglutide保护肾脏功能
方法亮点：综合磁共振成像和活检数据
关键发现：semaglutide改善肾功能
insights_en: Novelty: Semaglutide preserves kidney function
Method highlight: Integrated kidney MRI and biopsy data
Key finding: Semaglutide improves kidney function
abstract: The GLP-1 receptor agonist semaglutide preserves kidney function in people with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease, but the underlying mechanisms are unclear. Here we report a 52-week randomized trial of subcutaneous semaglutide 1 mg once weekly versus placebo (n = 106 (n = 25 women, n = 81 men)) in participants with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease. To identify kidney-specific mechanisms of action for semaglutide, we performed integrated multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging of the kidney and biopsy for histology (n = 33), alongside single-nucleus (n = 22) and spatial transcriptomics (n = 13) on paired samples with before- and after-treatment measurements. Coprimary magnetic resonance imaging outcomes (oxygenation by R2*, global perfusion and tissue inflammation by T1 mapping) were not significantly altered by semaglutide versus placebo treatment. Secondary outcomes revealed that semaglutide treatment, as compared to placebo, was associated with a significantly reduced renal artery resistive index and stabilization of the apparent diffusion coefficient, indicating prevention of fibrosis progression. Moreover, secondary transcriptomic outcomes revealed pronounced effects of semaglutide on glomerular endothelial cells, consistent with the results of spatial analyses indicating reduced numbers of immune cells in the proximity of these endothelial cells. The results from this trial indicate that mechanisms of kidney protection by semaglutide may include reduced vascular resistance, prevention of fibrosis and improved underlying molecular programs promoting endothelial cell health. ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT04865770 . A randomized trial in individuals with type 2 diabetes probed the kidney-protective mechanisms of semaglutide using a range of techniques, including histology, multiparametric MRI and transcriptomics.

title: Five-year survival with neoadjuvant therapy in melanoma: updated pooled analysis from the International Neoadjuvant Melanoma Consortium (INMC)
summary_zh: 分析新辅助治疗在黑色素瘤中的5年生存率，比较不同治疗方案。
summary_en: Five-year survival with neoadjuvant therapy in melanoma is analyzed, comparing different treatment regimens.
insights: 创新点：新辅助治疗提高生存率
方法亮点：多中心数据综合分析
关键发现：不同治疗方案影响生存率
insights_en: Novelty: Neoadjuvant therapy improves survival rates
Method highlight: Multi-center data pooled analysis
Key finding: Different treatment regimens affect survival rates
abstract: Abstract Neoadjuvant immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) are standard of care for resectable stage IIIB–D melanoma, but knowledge gaps remain regarding optimal treatment type, long-term survival, postsurgical management and clinical, histopathological or molecular subgroups. We analyzed 1,038 patients treated with neoadjuvant ICIs ( n = 735), BRAF and MEK inhibitors (BRAF/MEKis; n = 119) or ICI plus any targeted therapy (ICI + TT; n = 184) from 26 international sites in both trial (755, 72.7%) and nontrial (283, 27.3%) settings. ICI regimens included anti-programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1) alone (PD-1 alone; n = 242) and anti-PD-1 plus other immuno-oncology agent(s) (PD-1 + IO; n = 489). Outcomes included major pathological response (MPR), recurrence-free survival (RFS) and overall survival (OS). An MPR was achieved in 57.8% of patients with ICIs, 51.4% with BRAF/MEKis and 44.6% with ICI + TT. PD-1 + IO elicited higher MPR rates than PD-1 alone (61.4% versus 49.5%). The 5-year RFS rate was 61.0% with PD-1 alone, 73.9% with PD-1 + IO, 37.4% with BRAF/MEKis and 76.4% with ICI + TT; the 5-year OS rates were 83.3%, 87.5%, 69.8% and 83.9%, respectively. ICI-treated patients with MPR had 5-year OS rates of 98.8% with PD-1 alone and 97.9% with PD-1 + IO and gained no benefit from continuing ICIs into the adjuvant setting. Neoadjuvant ICIs were active in BRAF -mutant melanoma (MPR, 46.3%), acral melanoma (38.1%), in-transit metastases (66.7%) and oligometastases (41.2%), although subgroup sizes and relative effectiveness varied. Survival outcomes were excellent with neoadjuvant ICIs, particularly in patients achieving MPR, but poor with BRAF/MEKis and mixed with ICI + TT. Predictive biomarker-driven trials, effective adjuvant strategies and subgroup-specific research are needed for nonresponders.

title: Stationary entanglement of a levitated oscillator with an optical field
summary_zh: 实现宏观物体运动与光场的稳定纠缠，为量子物理和量子技术提供基础。
summary_en: Stationary entanglement between macroscopic object motion and an optical field is achieved, providing a foundation for quantum physics and quantum technologies.
insights: 创新点：室温下实现纠缠
方法亮点：光学腔内实现纠缠
关键发现：非经典关联分布
insights_en: Novelty: Entanglement achieved at room temperature
Method highlight: Entanglement realized within an optical cavity
Key finding: Nonclassical correlations distributed
abstract: Stationary entanglement between the motion of macroscopic objects and light is a long-standing goal of quantum optomechanics, with implications for both fundamental tests of quantum physics and emerging quantum technologies. We report the generation of quantum entanglement between the center-of-mass motion of a nanosphere levitated in an optical tweezer inside an optical cavity and the electromagnetic field. Using heterodyne detection, we reconstructed the full set of optomechanical correlations and observed a violation of separability bounds between the mechanical motion and a propagating optical mode, demonstrating the distribution of nonclassical correlations beyond the interaction region. The entanglement was generated at room temperature and remained robust over a broad range of parameters. Our results establish levitated optomechanical systems as a platform for continuous-variable quantum communication and for tests of macroscopic quantum physics.

title: Dynamic multimodal cation-carbon interaction for efficient adiponitrile electrosynthesis
summary_zh: 开发动态多模态阳离子-碳相互作用策略，提高己内酰胺电合成效率。
summary_en: A dynamic multimodal cation-carbon interaction strategy is developed to enhance adiponitrile electrosynthesis efficiency.
insights: 创新点：使用环保碳电极
方法亮点：多模态非共价相互作用
关键发现：提高选择性和降低过电位
insights_en: Novelty: Environmentally friendly carbon electrodes used
Method highlight: Multimodal noncovalent interactions
Key finding: Improved selectivity and reduced overpotentials
abstract: Adiponitrile electrosynthesis from acrylonitrile hydrodimerization is critical for the nylon industry. However, the key step of single-electron acrylonitrile reduction demands toxic heavy-metal electrodes and leads to low energy efficiency. We developed a dynamic multimodal cation-electrode interaction strategy to enable efficient synthesis with environmentally friendly carbon electrodes. Optimal benzyltrihexylammonium cations create a water-depleted interface in aqueous electrolytes by squeezing the electric double layer through multimodal noncovalent interactions between the benzyl moieties of the cations and carbon electrodes. This strategy achieves selectivity comparable to the standard lead-based system but at substantially lower overpotentials, as demonstrated from the laboratory scale to a 159–square centimeter electrolyzer. This work underscores the importance of tailoring cation-centered microenvironments for sustainable, industrial organic electrosynthesis in more conductive aqueous systems.

title: Quadrupolar sea level fluctuations reveal episodes of rapid polar wander
summary_zh: 通过大陆洪水重建，识别快速极移事件，揭示地球历史。
summary_en: Quadrupolar sea level fluctuations reveal episodes of rapid polar wander, shedding light on Earth's history.
insights: 创新点：利用四极海平面波动
方法亮点：大陆洪水重建分析
关键发现：地球历史中的快速极移

Method highlight: Continental flooding reconstruction analysis
Key finding: Rapid polar wander in Earth's history
abstract: True polar wander (TPW) is presently occurring at a rate of ~10 centimeters per year, exceeding the mean rate of differential plate motion. Whether this rate is transient and negligible on geological timescales or whether Earth has experienced rapid TPW lasting millions of years is unclear. Paleomagnetic evidence has been used to propose fast episodes of TPW, but limitations of the paleomagnetic record have precluded definitive results. Rapid TPW will induce global sea level fluctuations associated with relative changes in centrifugal potential, offering an independent test. We evaluated this prediction using continental flooding reconstructions and identified multiple robust quadrupolar patterns since 320 million years ago, confirming that protracted rapid TPW has occurred on Earth and that couplings among Earth’s rotational dynamics, mantle processes, and surface environments can be strongly episodic.

insights: 创新点：活聚合合成超分子聚合物

Method highlight: Precise control of charge segment length

abstract: Supramolecular polymers with precise micrometer-scale segments of opposite charge are challenging to synthesize as discrete assemblies in water. These systems could be used to pattern charged surfaces, interact with the membranes of cells, or form hierarchical structures. We report a living polymerization of fibrillar peptide assemblies with a central positively charged segment flanked by negative ones that can have a collective molar mass on the order of billions of daltons. The self-capping supramolecular polymerization required an untwisted β sheet core persisting along the entire length of the assembly as well as dormant ends in the absence of a monomer source. The positive domains of the segmented structures were anchored to the membranes of neurons, leaving the connected negative segments in a highly dynamic state near the cells through charge repulsion. The segmented architecture generated extensive neurite growth and synaptic activity.

abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is moving upstream in science. Systems such as AlphaFold have already transformed protein-structure prediction, while newer agentic systems can search literatures, generate hypotheses, write and execute code, interpret results, and automate much of the path from idea to paper. Recent debates have asked how such systems may change scientific progress, surprise, and human understanding. Yet they also change something more fundamental: who—or what—participates in deciding which questions are asked, which evidence is surfaced, and which alternatives survive. As machine intelligence becomes part of science’s epistemic infrastructure, steps must be taken to ensure that researchers who did not build, own, or operate the system can still contest how ideas and evidence became a claim.

X and Y chromosomes as determinants of aging and disease

Method highlight: Integration of sex chromosome biology research

abstract: Sex differences have traditionally been attributed to gonadal hormones, but accumulating evidence shows that sex chromosomes exert distinct, cell-autonomous effects on health, aging, and disease. XX and XY complements alter gene dosage, epigenetic programming, immune signaling, metabolism, and cellular stress responses, which shape aging and disease trajectories in women and men. This Review integrates mechanistic advances in sex chromosome biology—including escape from X chromosome inactivation, X reactivation, parent-of-X-origin, X-skew, X- and Y-linked gene functions, and Y loss—with aging, neurologic disease, immunity, cancer, and cardiometabolic disease. We highlight insights from mouse models, human studies, and emerging technologies that disentangle hormone-driven effects from chromosome-mediated effects and discuss translational implications for diagnostics, biomarkers, therapeutics, and clinical trial design, emphasizing the integration of sex chromosome biology into precision medicine.

title: Incorporation of atmospheric components in planetary magma oceans through bubble–metal compounds

方法亮点：气泡-金属化合物实验
关键发现：低重力下化合物沉降
insights_en: Novelty: Mechanism of atmospheric components entering magma oceans
Method highlight: Bubble-metal compound experiments
Key finding: Compounds sink under low gravity
abstract: Atmophile elements (carbon, hydrogen, and nitrogen) were thought to accrete late during planetary formation, yet cosmochemical and astrophysical evidence suggests that they were already present while small bodies, such as Vesta, were forming. High-temperature magmatic events on small bodies, however, should have outgassed these ultravolatile elements because gravity would have been insufficient to retain them. In this study, experiments reveal that gas bubbles strongly attach to metal droplets in magma ocean–like mixtures, forming compounds that resist segregation. Early flotation of such compounds would have enhanced mantle siderophile endowment, eliminating the need for late accretion. On small bodies, low gravity would have enabled millimeter- to centimeter-sized compounds to sink, trapping atmophiles in their interiors. This mechanism links core formation to the early entrapment of atmophile elements and provides a framework for reconciling volatile delivery across planetary bodies and planetary accretion models.

summary_zh: 揭示噬菌体前体蛋白酶作为CD-NTase激活的普遍机制，解释免疫信号合成的触发。

abstract: Cyclic oligonucleotide–based antiphage signaling systems (CBASS) are bacterial immune pathways evolutionarily related to cGAS-STING (cyclic GMP-AMP synthase–stimulator of interferon genes) in humans. In CBASS, cGAS/DncV-like nucleotidyltransferase (CD-NTase) enzymes sense phage infection and synthesize nucleotide signals to initiate antiviral defense. Here, we reveal phage prohead protease activity as a widespread mechanism of CD-NTase activation. We reconstitute CBASS recognition of phage T4 in vitro and identify proteolytic cleavage of a CD-NTase activation loop as a trigger of immune signal synthesis. Phage prohead proteases directly activate CBASS in vivo, explaining how immunity is initiated late during infection. Structure-based phylogenetic analyses identify activation loops in clade A, D, and G CD-NTases and define residues controlling recognition of distinct phage families. Our results establish CBASS recognition of phage protease activity as a widespread antiviral defense mechanism.

Method highlight: Utilizes electro-elastic interactions for dynamic reconfiguration

abstract: Materials capable of delivering giant and rapid piezoelectric responses at kilohertz frequencies are pivotal for advanced electromechanical technologies. However, their development has been constrained by a long-standing magnitude–speed trade-off: Ferroelectrics with intrinsic electric dipoles offer fast response but limited polarization, whereas ionic defect motion generates highly polarizable defect dipoles but responds slowly, limiting kilohertz-rate applications. We overcame this fundamental limitation by devising 8 mole % K-doped AgNbO 3 (Ag 0.92 K 0.08 NbO 3 ) thin films engineered to host dynamically reconfigurable polaron-defect complexes through electro-elastic interactions between small electron polarons and lattice defects. Field-driven multi–unit-cell polaron hopping reconfigures these complexes, producing giant defect polarization, and orders-of-magnitude faster kinetics of polaron hopping (versus ionic migration) enables their rapid response. This synergy leads to an unprecedented field-induced effective piezoelectric coefficient of ~7170 picometers per volt with ~6.2% strain at kilohertz frequencies in engineered silver niobate–based films.

Method highlight: Uses nationwide cohort analyses and hypertensive mouse models

abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a degenerative joint disease, the progression of which is accelerated by systemic metabolic stress. Here, we identified a neuroendocrine pathway through which hypertension accelerates OA pathogenesis in joints predisposed by mechanical injury or aging. Nationwide cohort analyses and hypertensive mouse models demonstrated that elevated blood pressure exacerbates OA pathogenesis. OA-primed chondrocytes up-regulated arginine vasopressin (AVP) receptor 1A (AVPR1A), rendering them responsive to hypertension-associated circulating AVP. AVP-AVPR1A signaling enhanced catabolic signaling while suppressing anabolic regulators, thereby promoting cartilage catabolism. Genetic deletion or pharmacological inhibition of AVPR1A protected against hypertension-driven OA acceleration. Transcriptomic profiling and gene-silencing analyses identified NR4A3 as the principal downstream transcriptional mediator. Collectively, these findings establish the AVP-AVPR1A axis as a mechanistic link between systemic hypertensive stress and joint degeneration.

summary_zh: 研究揭示珍珠母中有机无机框架的高模量增韧机制，纳米限域生物分子晶体作为纳米针，缓解应力集中，实现跨尺度同步变形。

abstract: Enhancing toughness in nanocomposites often involves viscoelastic organic phases, but this typically reduces stiffness. We describe a high-modulus toughening mechanism in mature Cristaria plicata nacre arising from a crystalline organic-inorganic framework composed of aragonite nanorods alternately integrated with intratabular biomolecular crystallites. Due to the critical slip-length effect, these crystalline units approach the theoretical limits of modulus and strength. The nanoconfined biomolecular crystallites function as nanopins at interlamellar interphases, alleviating stress concentrations and enabling cross-scale synchronized deformation, thereby conferring high fracture toughness. Inspired by this mechanism, reconstituted nacre fabricated from regenerated aragonite flakes simultaneously achieved high stiffness and crack resistance. These insights offer a promising pathway toward reliable, high-performance structural materials.

abstract: Pregnancy is one of the most extensive physiological transitions of adult life, requiring coordinated adaptation across virtually every maternal organ to support fetal growth while preserving maternal health. Although these changes have traditionally been viewed as endocrine driven, emerging evidence identifies the immune system as an active regulator of maternal physiology. The immune system is increasingly recognized as a broad regulator of host physiology, positioning it as a key driver of maternal adaptation. In this work, we discuss how pregnancy reprograms maternal immunity to orchestrate physiological reprograming of tissues. This framework shifts the view of maternal immunity from one centered on immune homeostasis and fetal tolerance to one in which immune cells actively instruct physiological short- and long-term adaptation across maternal organs to shape health beyond reproduction.

abstract: For decades, we have known that women, especially younger women, are disproportionately affected by pain disorders, including irritable bowel syndrome, endometriosis, menstrual migraines, fibromyalgia, osteoarthritis, and neuropathic pain, all of which degrade quality of life. The adoption of sex as a biological variable in 2016 has begun to transform the field, revealing distinct sex-specific pathways that initiate, amplify, and resolve pain. In this Review, we synthesize recent advances across visceral and somatic pain, highlighting the impact of sex hormones, immune-neural cross-talk, the gut microbiome, and endogenous analgesic circuits. Rather than clinging to the historical standard that simply described the female bias in pain symptoms, these studies begin to explain why females experience heightened pain, paving the path for mechanism-based precision therapeutics.

insights_en: Snowball Earth cooling simulates glacial erosion
Thermochronology data explains depth changes
Rock cooling linked to glacial erosion
abstract: Glaciation cools the crust by setting its surface temperature to 0°C or well below. During the Cryogenian Snowball Earth glaciations, these conditions were in place long enough to cool the entire crustal column. Although crustal thermal history can be deciphered by thermochronology, these data are typically interpreted to record depth changes due to burial or erosion. Thermal models of the crust under Cryogenian boundary conditions predict that thermochronometers were substantially altered in the upper quarter to half of the crust. This Snowball Earth refrigeration, with little to no coeval erosion, may have imparted a cooling signal mimicking up to 3‒5 km of glacial erosion. Rock cooling previously attributed to massive Snowball erosion and linked to the Great Unconformity may instead reflect a great refrigeration of Earth’s crust, with implications for thermochronology across other climate events.

title: Synergistic polar states by selective atomic gradients
summary_zh: 材料合成策略，实现强极性。原子梯度诱导极性。
summary_en: A material synthesis strategy achieves strong polarity. Atomic gradients induce polarity.
insights: 合成策略实现极性

insights_en: Synthesis strategy achieves polarity
Atomic gradients induce polarity

abstract: Materials that combine distinct properties within a single phase are of fundamental and technological interest. Here, we present a broadly applicable strategy to achieve strong bulk polarity that not only coexists with its originally incompatible properties, such as metallicity, but also synergistically enables exceptional functionalities. A combination of thin-film synthesis, atomic-scale imaging, and theoretical calculations reveals that A-site selective atomic gradients induce strong polar states in otherwise centrosymmetric perovskite oxides ABO 3 . These polar states unconventionally coexist with various preexisting properties, leading to bulk polar metallicity with tunable nonreciprocal transport; high-κ, low-loss dielectricity with an equivalent oxide thickness below 0.1 nanometer; and giant pyroelectricity. This work may enable the development of new multifunctional materials with unusual coexisting and synergistic properties.

Hormone therapy optimizes health
Focus on menopause research
abstract: Menopause is an important biological transition with up to 72 symptoms that shapes aging trajectories across organs and encompasses ~40% of the female lifespan. Although menopause awareness is increasing, research on strategies for menopause symptom management and optimizing health in the postmenopausal period is lacking. This Review highlights that menopause characteristics, such as type, timing, and symptom burden, influence health outcomes and later-life disease risk. Similarly, menopause hormone therapy comes in >200 varieties that differ by dose, formulation of estrogens and progestogens, and timing, each with their own distinct risk-benefit profiles. These distinctions are often missed in the literature but have considerable repercussions for outcomes. Optimized menopause care necessitates a precision medicine approach that considers menopause symptoms, genetics, and previous hormone exposures.

Impaired control of autoimmunity increases pediatric multiple sclerosis risk in EBNA-1-seropositives and -seronegatives
summary_zh: 研究EBNA-1阳性和阴性儿童多发性硬化症患者的自身免疫控制。方法为病例对照研究。发现自身免疫抗体在患者中更普遍。
summary_en: This study investigates autoimmune control in pediatric-onset MS patients with EBNA-1 seropositive and seronegative. The method is a case-control study. CNS-specific antibodies are more prevalent in patients.
insights: 创新点：发现自身免疫抗体在患者中更普遍。
方法亮点：采用病例对照研究设计。
关键发现：EBNA-1阳性和阴性患者均受影响。
insights_en: Novelty: CNS-specific antibodies are more prevalent in patients.
Method highlight: Utilizes a case-control study design.
Key finding: Both EBNA-1 seropositive and seronegative patients are affected.
abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is an autoinflammatory disease of the central nervous system (CNS). Epstein–Barr virus (EBV) encodes for EBNA-1 381-452 , which induces autoreactive immune responses against distinct CNS derived proteins (GlialCAM 370-389 , CRYAB 2-21 , MBP 205-224 , ANO2 135-154 ). Although EBV infection is considered essential for MS development, CNS-specific autoimmune responses may also be present in putatively EBV EBNA-1-seronegative patients, warranting further investigation. We studied 548 EBV EBNA-1 seropositive and 30 EBV EBNA-1 seronegative pediatric-onset MS (POMS) patients, along with 578 matched controls. CNS specific antibodies were significantly more prevalent in EBV EBNA-1 seropositive POMS patients (92.2%) than in EBV EBNA-1 seropositive controls (56.3%, P < 0.0001). However, high CNS specific antibody levels were also found in 56.6% of EBV EBNA-1 seronegative POMS patients and 17.4% of EBV EBNA-1 seronegative controls. These findings suggest that while EBV infection amplifies CNS specific autoimmune responses, high-level CNS autoreactive autoimmune responses can also occur independently of EBV EBNA-1. We further evaluated why only some individuals with high-level CNS autoreactive antibody titers develop MS. Mechanistically, we demonstrate that autoreactive immune responses are effectively controlled by NKG2C + and NKG2D + natural killer (NK) cells. These findings indicate that CNS-specific autoimmunity and impaired NK cell regulation, rather than EBV alone, are central to MS risk.

title: Generalized Taylor’s law for infinite-mean heavy-tailed data under dependence and heterogeneity
summary_zh: 研究无限均值重尾数据下的广义Taylor定律。方法为理论分析。扩展了Taylor定律的应用范围。
summary_en: This study investigates generalized Taylor's law for infinite-mean heavy-tailed data under dependence and heterogeneity. The method is theoretical analysis. It extends the application range of Taylor's law.
insights: 创新点：扩展Taylor定律的应用范围。
方法亮点：采用理论分析方法。
关键发现：适用于依赖性和异质性的数据。
insights_en: Novelty: Extends the application range of Taylor's law.
Method highlight: Utilizes a theoretical analytical approach.
Key finding: Applicable to dependent and heterogeneous data.
abstract: Taylor’s law, also known as fluctuation scaling in physics and the power-law variance function in statistics, is an empirical pattern widely observed across fields including ecology, physics, finance, and epidemiology. It states that the variance of a sample scales as some power of the mean of the sample. We study generalizations of Taylor’s law in the context of heavy-tailed distributions with infinite mean and variance. We establish the probabilistic limit and analyze the associated convergence rates. Our results extend the existing literature by relaxing the assumption that the observed random variables are independently and identically distributed to accommodate dependence and heterogeneity among them. This generalization enables application of Taylor’s law to dependent time series and network-structured data. We support the theoretical developments by extensive simulations, and the practical relevance through applications to real network data.

title: The mycomembrane proteins PorH and ProtX are inserted at polar growth zones and linked to the cell wall
summary_zh: 研究结核分枝杆菌的膜蛋白组装。方法为分子生物学研究。发现PorH和ProtX蛋白在极生长区插入并与细胞壁连接。
summary_en: This study investigates the assembly of mycomembrane proteins in Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The method is molecular biology research. It finds that PorH and ProtX proteins are inserted at polar growth zones and linked to the cell wall.
insights: 创新点：揭示了MOMP组装机制。
方法亮点：采用分子生物学技术。
关键发现：PorH和ProtX蛋白在细胞壁中起作用。
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the mechanism of MOMP assembly.
Method highlight: Utilizes molecular biology techniques.
Key finding: PorH and ProtX proteins play a role in the cell wall.
abstract: The Mycobacteriales order of bacteria includes important pathogens such as Mycobacterium tuberculosis . These organisms are surrounded by a unique cell envelope architecture that includes a two-layered cell wall composed of peptidoglycan (PG) and arabinogalactan. They also build an outer membrane called the mycomembrane that is made of mycolic acids. Mycolate outer membrane proteins (MOMPs) reside within the mycomembrane and a subset are thought to form pores that allow essential nutrients to permeate the envelope. However, little is known about the structure of these proteins or the mechanism by which they are assembled. Here, we investigate MOMP assembly in Corynebacterium glutamicum ( Cglu ) using PorH as a model corynebacterial MOMP. PorH is encoded in an operon with the MOMP PorA, and the two small, alpha-helical proteins have been proposed to form hetero-oligomeric pores in the mycomembrane. Consistent with this proposal, AlphaFold2 predicts a high confidence structure of a hetero-oligomeric pore formed by five copies each of PorH and its partner PorA, and we show that PorA is required for the surface assembly of PorH. Using a fluorescence assay for detection of surface-exposed PorH or another MOMP called ProtX, we found that MOMP assembly occurs within zones of active PG synthesis at the cell poles. We also found that PorH and ProtX are linked to the cell wall. Thus, like gram-negative bacteria, Cglu coordinates outer membrane protein assembly with PG biogenesis and uses proteins to connect the mycomembrane and the cell wall.

title: Constitutive sporulation in wild fission yeast enhances insect-mediated survival
summary_zh: 研究野生裂殖酵母的构成性产孢现象。方法为生态学实验。发现产孢酵母在昆虫传播中具有生存优势。
summary_en: This study investigates the constitutive sporulation in wild fission yeast. The method is an ecological experiment. It finds that sporulating yeast has a survival advantage in insect transmission.
insights: 创新点：发现构成性产孢的生态意义。
方法亮点：结合生态学实验。
关键发现：产孢酵母在昆虫传播中更有利。
insights_en: Novelty: Discovers the ecological significance of constitutive sporulation.
Method highlight: Combines ecological experiments.
Key finding: Sporulating yeast is more advantageous in insect transmission.
abstract: Sexual reproduction is generally considered costly for unicellular organisms and is typically induced in yeast only under nutrient limitation. However, wild strains of Schizosaccharomyces japonicus isolated from fruit flies in Japan exhibit constitutive sporulation even under nutrient-rich conditions. Here, we investigated the ecological and evolutionary significance of this unusual phenotype. We demonstrate that spores produced under nutrient-rich conditions survive passage through the digestive tract of Drosophila melanogaster , whereas vegetative cells do not. Although constitutive sporulation reduces competitive growth during laboratory serial passaging, fly-mediated transmission strongly enriches high-sporulation (hc 90 ) strains, indicating positive selection by insect predation. Experimental evolution using a chemically mutagenized library further confirmed that passage through fruit flies enriches mutants capable of nutrient-independent sporulation. Whole-genome and genetic analyses revealed that the hc 90 phenotype is associated with combinations of mutations in six meiotic regulatory genes— byr2, mcs4, ste6, ste11, tor2, and win1 —suggesting epistatic interactions rather than single-gene effects. Suppressor mutations arising during laboratory cultivation frequently targeted ste11 , reinforcing its central role in regulating this trait. Field surveys showed that genetically diverse hc 90 strains are widely distributed across Japan from insects, flowers, moss, and soil. Together, our findings indicate that long-term yeast–insect interactions can maintain costly sexual reproduction as an adaptive strategy for survival and dispersal. This study provides direct experimental evidence linking microbial reproductive strategies to ecological selection by animal hosts.

title: Signaling by a tyrosine-sulfated peptide balances growth and osmotic stress response in rice
summary_zh: 研究OsPSY8肽在水稻渗透胁迫响应中的功能。OsPSY8在非胁迫条件下主要表达于根部，促进侧根生长。OsPSY8突变体增强渗透胁迫耐受性。
summary_en: Investigates the function of OsPSY8 peptide in rice osmotic stress responses. OsPSY8 is predominantly expressed in roots under non-stress conditions, promoting lateral root growth. OsPSY8 mutants enhance osmotic stress tolerance.
insights: 创新点：揭示了OsPSY8在水稻渗透胁迫响应中的作用机制。
方法亮点：通过转录组分析揭示了OsPSY8的功能。
关键发现：OsPSY8突变体增强渗透胁迫耐受性。
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the mechanism of OsPSY8 in rice osmotic stress responses.
Method highlight: Transcriptomic analysis reveals the function of OsPSY8.
Key finding: OsPSY8 mutants enhance osmotic stress tolerance.
abstract: Peptide hormone signaling coordinates plant growth and osmotic stress responses, yet how the transition between these responses is regulated remains poorly understood. Here, we investigated the function of the rice PLANT PEPTIDES CONTAINING SULFATED TYROSINE 8 (OsPSY8) peptide in osmotic stress responses. OsPSY8 was predominantly expressed in root tissues under nonstress conditions, with preferential expression in lateral roots where it promoted root growth. Osmotic stress rapidly reduced OsPSY8 expression in roots through the OsWRKY24 transcription factor. Loss-of-function ospsy8 mutants exhibited enhanced osmotic stress tolerance, whereas OsPSY8 overexpression increased osmotic stress susceptibility. Transcriptomic analyses revealed that disruption of OsPSY8 activated stress-responsive pathways, including those associated with lignin biosynthesis, compatible solute production, cell wall remodeling, and reactive oxygen species scavenging, and was accompanied by increased lignin accumulation in roots. In contrast, overexpression of OsPSY8 resulted in maintenance of growth-associated transcriptional programs while suppressing stress-responsive pathways under osmotic stress. Together, these findings identify OsPSY8 as an important regulator of the transition from growth to stress adaptation in rice and suggest that stress-induced repression of PSY signaling is required to disengage growth programs and activate adaptive responses during osmotic stress.

title: Development of A10P3C, an isoform-selective inhibitor of EGLN2, for targeting breast cancer
summary_zh: 开发A10P3C，一种针对EGLN2的异构体选择性抑制剂。通过构象采样和模拟设计，A10P3C具有高活性和选择性。
summary_en: Develops A10P3C, an isoform-selective inhibitor of EGLN2. A10P3C exhibits high potency and selectivity through conformational sampling and simulation-based design.
insights: 创新点：A10P3C实现了对EGLN2的高效抑制。
方法亮点：采用构象采样和模拟设计提高抑制剂选择性。
关键发现：A10P3C对EGLN2具有异构体选择性。
insights_en: Novelty: A10P3C achieves efficient inhibition of EGLN2.
Method highlight: Conformational sampling and simulation-based design improve inhibitor selectivity.
Key finding: A10P3C exhibits isoform selectivity for EGLN2.
abstract: Oxygen sensing signaling is mainly mediated by EGLN prolyl hydroxylases, which plays important roles in physiology and diseases. Among them, EGLN2 plays an oncogenic role in breast cancer. However, the development of isoform-selective EGLN2 inhibitors remains a major challenge. Here, we report the identification of A10P3C, a small-molecule inhibitor that exhibits high potency and exceptional selectivity toward EGLN2. Guided by conformational sampling, ensemble-docking-based functional-group-residue contact analysis and simulation-based binding selectivity design, A10P3C was designed and strategically improved from an initially screened lead compound to selectively inhibit EGLN2. Unlike previously reported pan-hydroxylase inhibitors, A10P3C achieves potent isoform selectivity. Functionally, A10P3C effectively suppresses breast cancer cell proliferation, migration, and invasion, while inducing G1 cell cycle arrest and cellular senescence through on-target EGLN2 inhibition. These on-target effects are corroborated by transcriptomic profiling, which shows significant modulation of cell cycle and senescence pathways. Notably, A10P3C exhibits robust antitumor efficacy in patient-derived organoids and xenograft models, accompanied by favorable metabolic stability and minimal systemic toxicity. Collectively, these findings identify A10P3C as a selective chemical probe for EGLN2 biology and a promising therapeutic lead for precision treatment of EGLN2-driven breast cancers.

title: Defensive networks provide basis for late pre-Hispanic Andean polities
summary_zh: 研究安第斯地区防御网络对前西班牙时期政治实体的影响。通过空间和网络分析，揭示了防御网络与政治实体发展的关系。
summary_en: Studies the impact of defensive networks on late pre-Hispanic Andean polities. Spatial and network analyses reveal the relationship between defensive networks and the development of political entities.
insights: 创新点：提出防御网络对安第斯地区政治实体发展有重要影响。
方法亮点：结合空间和网络分析方法研究政治实体发展。
关键发现：防御网络与政治实体发展密切相关。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes that defensive networks significantly impact the development of Andean political entities.
Method highlight: Combines spatial and network analysis methods to study political entity development.
Key finding: There is a close relationship between defensive networks and the development of political entities.
abstract: Regional polities may emerge from the development of a centralized hierarchy of a specific political regime, or from bottom–up patterns of interaction and collective action, especially mutual defense. In this study, we assess the proposition that the development of late pre-Hispanic polities of the south-central Andes was significantly shaped by defensive networks of pukaras (hillforts), which were in turn shaped by variable affordances for fortification in the mountainous Andean landscape. Pukaras are very common in the Andean highlands and date overwhelmingly to 1250 to 1500 CE, reflecting a period of widespread concern with violent conflict. We apply a combination of formal spatial and network analyses to a dataset of 1,287 hillforts identified in a satellite imagery survey of over 150,000 km 2 in the south-central Andean highlands. Starting from the premise that interaction and mutual aid were key to defensive cooperation, we define and weight network edges between hillfort nodes based on intervisibility and walking cost. Groupings of pukaras are identified using formal network analysis and community detection. Analysis reveals substantial regional diversity in the structure of these defensive networks. Larger but less cohesive networks developed in open terrain that facilitated movement, interaction, and visual connection, while smaller, more cohesive networks emerged in more rugged terrain. These patterns correspond broadly to the size and characteristics of sociopolitical units evidenced in independent archaeological and ethnohistorical sources. This study highlights how interactions between local landscapes, levels of conflict, and social patterns of defensive cooperation participated in the formation of late pre-Hispanic polities.

title: Climate-driven adaptive microevolution in wild yeasts
summary_zh: 研究气候梯度对野生酵母自然微生物多样性的影响。通过环境、基因组学和表型分析，揭示了气候对微生物多样性的塑造作用。
summary_en: Investigates how climatic gradients shape natural microbial diversity in wild yeasts. Environmental, genomic, and phenotypic analyses reveal the shaping role of climate on microbial diversity.
insights: 创新点：利用野生酵母研究气候对微生物多样性的影响。
方法亮点：结合环境、基因组学和表型分析。
关键发现：气候对微生物多样性有显著影响。
insights_en: Novelty: Uses wild yeasts to study the impact of climate on microbial diversity.
Method highlight: Integrates environmental, genomic, and phenotypic analyses.
Key finding: Climate has a significant impact on microbial diversity.
abstract: Environmental variation imposes strong selection on microbial populations, yet linking ecological gradients to genomic and phenotypic diversification remains challenging due to limited sampling of wild microbes. Here, we leveraged the exceptional abundance of the cold-adapted yeast Saccharomyces eubayanus throughout Patagonian Nothofagus forests to investigate how climatic gradients shape natural microbial diversity. Using systematic sampling across ~1,000 km of Chilean Patagonia, spanning multiple seasons, altitudes, and thermal regimes, we integrated environmental, genomic, and phenotypic analyses of wild populations inhabiting Nothofagus forests. Whole-genome sequencing of 117 isolates identified three major Patagonian lineages that show strong latitudinal structuring and contrasting levels of nucleotide diversity, with colder, wetter southern populations harboring the greatest diversity. Multivariate and permutation-based analyses consistently identified latitude, temperature, and precipitation as the primary correlates of genomic variation, together explaining over half of the observed patterns of nucleotide diversity. Notably, S. eubayanus exhibited an inverse latitudinal diversity gradient, contrasting with patterns commonly reported in Northern Hemisphere populations. Climatic structuring was mirrored by pronounced phenotypic differentiation: Southern populations exhibited lower thermal optima, enhanced cold fitness, and increased sporulation capacity, whereas northern populations displayed greater growth performance under nutrient-rich and hyperosmotic conditions. Sporulation capacity closely paralleled nucleotide diversity along the same environmental gradient, linking climate, reproductive investment, and population diversification. Together, our results indicate that climatic gradients simultaneously shape demographic history, physiological performance, metabolic strategies, and life-history traits in natural yeast populations. More broadly, Patagonia emerges as a powerful natural system for understanding how environmental heterogeneity drives microbial diversification across heterogeneous landscapes.

title: T–B interactions yield CD3 + B cells and CD20 + T cells with pathogenic features in multiple sclerosis
summary_zh: 研究T-B细胞相互作用在多发性硬化症中的作用。发现CD3+ B细胞和CD20+ T细胞在疾病中具有致病特征。
summary_en: Studies the role of T-B cell interactions in multiple sclerosis. CD3+ B cells and CD20+ T cells with pathogenic features are identified in the disease.
insights: 创新点：揭示了T-B细胞相互作用在多发性硬化症中的作用。
方法亮点：结合单细胞技术和流式细胞术研究。
关键发现：CD3+ B细胞和CD20+ T细胞在疾病中具有致病性。
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the role of T-B cell interactions in multiple sclerosis.
Method highlight: Combines single-cell technology and flow cytometry.
Key finding: CD3+ B cells and CD20+ T cells are pathogenic in the disease.
abstract: Classically, B and T cells are differentiated by their mutually exclusive expression of surface markers such as CD3 and CD20, but it is now established that a few percent of T cells in human blood display also CD20. We analyzed CD3 + CD20 + cells in detail by combining single-cell proteogenomics, FACS, and ImageStream. Thereby, we identified CD3 + B cells and found that about 40% of plasmablasts displayed CD3 in both blood and tonsils. In tonsils, where T–B interactions occur, about 80% of follicular helper T (T fh ) cells displayed CD20. In vitro, coactivation of T and B cells induced marker exchange via trogocytosis. We refer to the resulting cells as “masquerading” lymphocytes and analyzed them in multiple sclerosis (MS). CD20 + T cells were markedly enriched in cerebrospinal fluid, exhibited cytotoxic gene signatures, accumulated in perivascular inflammatory cuffs, and showed increased myelin antigen reactivity. Anti-CD20 therapy (ofatumumab) not only depleted masquerading lymphocytes but also prevented their reinduction. Together, we identify CD3 + B cells as footprints of T–B interactions thereby shifting the paradigm of lymphocyte-specific surface markers and implicate masquerading lymphocytes as active contributors to MS immunopathology.
