Mechanistically, E-S potentiation critically requires GluN2B-containing N-methyl-D-aspartate receptors (NMDARs) localized to the neuronal soma. Sustained astrocytic activity promotes E-S potentiation through vesicular release of D-serine, which enhances tonic activation of somatic NMDARs, suppresses A-type potassium currents, and produces a lasting increase in neuronal excitability. Functionally, this astrocyte-dependent E-S potentiation lowers the threshold for subsequent long-term potentiation, conferring a metaplastic influence on hippocampal circuits. These findings identify an astrocyte-neuron signaling mechanism that drives intrinsic plasticity and establish somatic NMDARs as a key site of astrocytic regulation of hippocampal output.

title: Evolution shapes ecosystem resilience through spatial self-organization
summary_zh: 研究通过理论模型探讨空间自组织和快速进化如何共同塑造植被转变和生态系统韧性。
summary_en: This study explores how spatial self-organization and rapid evolution interact to shape vegetation transitions and ecosystem resilience using a theoretical model.
insights: 创新点：空间自组织与进化的相互作用
方法亮点：理论模型分析植被转变
关键发现：模式形成抑制适应性
insights_en: Novelty: Interaction between spatial self-organization and evolution
Method highlight: Theoretical model analysis of vegetation transitions
Key finding: Pattern formation suppresses adaptation
abstract: Drylands are globally widespread and ecologically important but vulnerable to climate change. Many exhibit spatially self-organized vegetation patterns that enhance resilience by enabling vegetation to reorganize their patterns under drying, thereby optimizing water use and maintaining productivity. Plants can also undergo evolution in response to environmental change. Although both spatial self-organization and rapid evolution are fundamental mechanisms of resilience, their interaction remains largely unknown. Using a theoretical model, we examine how these mechanisms interact to shape vegetation transitions—abrupt or gradual—and ecosystem resilience under climatic drying. We find that pattern formation can suppress adaptation by maintaining soil moisture beneath vegetation patches despite rainfall decline, thereby limiting selection for increased drought tolerance. However, this suppression is largely alleviated under the variable rainfall typical of drylands. In turn, evolution feeds back on self-organization by increasing the spatial plasticity of vegetation patterns and their ability to reorganize under changing climate, although this positive effect weakens as evolutionary rate increases. Considering direct (adaptation) and indirect (pattern-mediated) effects, evolution enhances resilience, with indirect effects via pattern plasticity dominating. Within model scenarios spanning plausible rainfall variability and relative evolutionary-to-ecological rates, more than half of vegetation transitions are abrupt involving biomass losses exceeding 50%, highlighting a potential mechanism underlying recent global observations of widespread abrupt vegetation losses in drylands. These results demonstrate that evolution and spatial self-organization jointly determine dryland resilience under environmental change and highlight the unexpected role of evolution in patterned landscapes, calling for integrative approaches to predict ecosystem responses in a changing world.

title: A water-pinning hot spot drives templated tau aggregation
summary_zh: 研究发现tau蛋白通过单个热点与自身或种子表面结合，形成种子竞争性纤维。
summary_en: This study finds that tau protein achieves in-register stacking to form seed-competent fibrils by a pinning action to itself or the seed surface via a single dominant hotspot.
insights: 创新点：tau蛋白的固定热点作用
方法亮点：结构水在tau纤维中的作用
关键发现：jR2R3-P301L tau的异质水合景观
insights_en: Novelty: Role of the water-pinning hotspot in tau
Method highlight: Role of structured solvation water in tau fibrils
Key finding: Heterogeneous hydration landscape in jR2R3-P301L tau
abstract: Tau assembles into fibrillar aggregates that are pathological hallmarks of a group of neurodegenerative diseases collectively called tauopathies. Templated aggregation of naïve tau to seeding-competent fibrils that proceed from cell to cell is a key driver of prion-like progression of tauopathies. This study tests the hypothesis that tau, an intrinsically disordered protein, achieves in-register stacking to form seed-competent fibrils by a pinning action of tau to each other and/or the seed surface via a single dominant hotspot to avoid mismatch in tau stacking to fibrils. Structured solvation water has been proposed to be a signature of such hot spots at both the tau fibril-end surface and soluble tau monomers. Although jR2R3-P301L tau exhibits a heterogeneous hydration landscape in its intrinsically disordered state, with enhanced water structuring near the P301L mutation site, it is unclear whether a localized hotspot exists at the fibril end surface and surface water facilitates the initial contacts in templated aggregation. Using rapid 1 H- 15 N SOFAST-HMQC NMR to track seed-induced aggregation of jR2R3-P301L in real time, complemented by molecular dynamics simulation of fibril surface hydration, we identify a residue-specific pinning hotspot that is prone to dewetting followed by sequential folding and incorporation of the remaining segment in a two-step dock-and-lock process. Site-specific spin labeling further demonstrates that blocking this pinning hotspot disrupts templated aggregation, leading to shorter fibrils. The identification of a dominant pinning site will facilitate the rational design of binders to effectively disrupt fibril extension or serve as diagnostic or therapeutic strategies.

title: In mice, a population of male germ cells show characteristics of nonapoptotic cell death during G0 arrest
summary_zh: 研究揭示小鼠G0期停滞期间，部分雄性生殖细胞表现出非凋亡性细胞死亡特征。
summary_en: This study reveals that a population of male germ cells in mice exhibit characteristics of nonapoptotic cell death during G0 arrest.
insights: 创新点：G0期停滞期间的非凋亡性细胞死亡
方法亮点：对雄性生殖细胞进行长期追踪
关键发现：G0期停滞期间的细胞质量选择
insights_en: Novelty: Nonapoptotic cell death during G0 arrest
Method highlight: Long-term tracking of male germ cells
Key finding: Selection for germ cell quality during G0 arrest
abstract: In mammals, a small population of spermatogonial stem cells (SSCs) is established shortly after birth. These cells self-renew and produce sperm for the male’s reproductive lifespan, passing the genome on to the next generation. Establishment of a population of SSCs with high genomic integrity is essential. SSCs are derived from a much larger precursor population of male germ cells (MGCs) that differentiate during fetal life. During the last third of gestation, MGCs undergo a prolonged period of G0 cell cycle arrest during which they sustain high levels of transcription and acquire epigenetic programming for SSC fate. Although these differentiation steps can cause cellular and genomic damage, it has been unclear whether selection for germ cell quality occurs during G0 arrest since no classic markers of cell death have been detected. In this study, we used a mouse model to characterize a population of MGCs that begin to accumulate markers of cell death, such as AnnexinV (AnV) and propidium iodide (PI), at E16.5. The AnV- and PI-positive MGC population is characterized by low expression of the RNA-binding protein, Dead End 1, and exhibits dsDNA breaks and mitochondrial dysfunction. Interestingly, we do not see evidence of an active cell death cascade until the time of birth, when phosphorylation of MLKL, a hallmark of necroptotic cell death, occurs. Based on these findings, we propose that variable cellular health is an important basis for selection of SSC precursors.

title: Correction for Pan et al., SNHG26 orchestrates pro-fibrotic fibroblast maintenance via PTBP1-mediated alternative polyadenylation of AKT3 in dermal fibrosis
Taylor’s law beyond finite moments: A route to dynamic financial risk
Cell identity competes with surface tension to determine stromal organization in tumor spheroids beyond the CAF shell paradigm
summary_zh: 研究挑战CAF壳层范式，发现表面张力在肿瘤球体中决定间质组织，CAF占据表面张力最高端。
summary_en: This study challenges the CAF shell paradigm, finding that surface tension determines stromal organization in tumor spheroids, with CAFs occupying the highest end of the surface tension hierarchy.
insights: 创新点：挑战CAF壳层范式
方法亮点：使用微加工3D模型研究表面张力
关键发现：CAF在肿瘤球体中的核心定位
insights_en: Novelty: Challenging the CAF shell paradigm
Method highlight: Using microfabricated 3D models to study surface tension
Key finding: Core localization of CAFs in tumor spheroids
abstract: Cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) are often found forming a peripheral stromal barrier around tumors. Here, this paradigm is challenged using microfabricated 3D cancer–CAF spheroid models combined with quantitative magnetic force tensiometry. A surface tension atlas is established for eight cancer cell lines, three CAF populations, and heterotypic tumor–CAF assemblies, spanning nearly two orders of magnitude. Surface tension is first shown to govern spheroid morphology and modulate drug response. Besides, CAFs consistently occupy the highest end of the surface tension hierarchy, predicting core rather than peripheral localization and directly challenging the shell paradigm. Yet confocal imaging reveals not only central accumulation but also complete CAF-tumor mixing, including in spheroids where cancer cells exhibit surface tensions nearly two orders of magnitude lower than CAFs. Surface tension alone therefore fails to predict CAF organization. Instead, the epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) state of cancer cells emerges as a major determinant: epithelial-like tumors promote CAF core accumulation, whereas mesenchymal-like states favor persistent mixing. Peripheral CAF localization emerges only under restricted conditions combining high tumor cohesion and sequential stromal recruitment. Together, these results identify surface tension, EMT state, and assembly chronology as joint determinants of tumor–stroma architecture, revealing a context-dependent organization landscape rather than a universal CAF shell.

title: Multidimensional vulnerabilities of informal settlements in the Urban South
summary_zh: 研究通过整合卫星图像和深度学习模型，描绘全球南方城市非正式定居区的分布和脆弱性。
summary_en: This study delineates the distribution and vulnerability of informal settlements across a sample of 1,914 cities in the Global South by integrating Sentinel-2 imagery with deep learning models.
insights: 创新点：非正式定居区的多维脆弱性
方法亮点：卫星图像与深度学习模型结合
关键发现：非正式定居区在非洲和亚洲的分布
insights_en: Novelty: Multidimensional vulnerabilities of informal settlements
Method highlight: Integration of satellite imagery with deep learning models
Key finding: Distribution of informal settlements in Africa and Asia
abstract: Informal settlements are widespread and rapidly growing, often associated with high vulnerabilities. However, global-scale understanding on their spatial distribution and complexity of vulnerability is limited. Here, we delineate the informal settlements across a sample of 1,914 cities of the Global South by integrating Sentinel-2 imagery with deep learning models, and we explore the heterogeneity of vulnerability using Urban Informal Settlement Vulnerability Index that encompasses living conditions, social infrastructure, and environmental risk. We found that Urban Informal Settlements cover 12.94 ± 2.52% of their total urban areas (approximately 34.04 × 10 3 km 2 ), especially in sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia, and Middle Asia. Sub-Saharan African cities have the highest vulnerability of informal settlements, with 31.75 ± 6.20% of total urban areas being occupied by informal settlements, while East Asian cities exhibit relatively low vulnerability across all dimensions. We also find that urban informal settlements with high environmental exposure are widespread in the Global South, and there is a significantly polarized distribution between “low” and “high” vulnerability categories. The findings highlight the disparate distribution of multidimensional vulnerability in informal settlements across the Urban South, providing a comparative evidence base for further local assessment and context-specific policy discussions related to SDG 11.

title: A multiscale framework for heme crystallization inhibition: From single-molecule step-capping to parasite suppression
summary_zh: 研究通过多尺度方法揭示抗疟药物如何抑制疟原虫的血红素结晶。
summary_en: This study reveals how antimalarial drugs modulate heme crystallization at the molecular level using multiscale in vitro approaches.
insights: 创新点：多尺度框架抑制血红素结晶
方法亮点：单分子步骤封顶法
关键发现：LF直接结合晶体步骤
insights_en: Novelty: Multiscale framework for heme crystallization inhibition
Method highlight: Single-molecule step-capping method
Key finding: LF binds directly to crystal steps
abstract: Heme crystallization is central to malaria parasites’ survival during the erythrocytic stage of the disease, yet how clinically relevant antimalarial drugs modulate this process at the molecular level remains unclear. Here we employ stage-resolved parasite assays and multiscale in vitro approaches to explore the interactions between lumefantrine (LF), one of the popular components of current combination therapies, and hematin crystallization. Pulse LF suppresses Plasmodium falciparum during both ring and trophozoite stages. Under biomimetic conditions, LF markedly reduces β-hematin crystal growth rates. High-resolution atomic force microscopy reveals that individual LF molecules bind directly to crystal steps, physically constraining step motion through a previously unreported step-capping mechanism. This localized inhibition propagates to the mesoscale, producing step broadening, reduced interstep spacing, and causing surface kinetic roughening. In contrast to its strong inhibition of crystal growth, LF enhances hematin nucleation by promoting the formation of mesoscopic hematin-rich clusters, as detected by a combination of scattering and microscopy techniques. Attachment of the nucleated crystallites to larger crystal surfaces initiates a nonclassical inhibition sequence by straining the crystal interface, which further impedes step growth.

title: Nonclassical growth to mesoporous quasi-single crystal CeO 2 superstructures with a well-defined surface
summary_zh: 研究报道了一种湿化学、无模板策略，用于合成介孔准单晶CeO2超粒子。
summary_en: This study reports a wet-chemical, template-free strategy for the synthesis of mesoporous quasi-single-crystal CeO2 superparticles.
insights: 创新点：介孔准单晶CeO2的合成策略
方法亮点：纳米簇构建块的定向附着
关键发现：高表面积准单晶
insights_en: Novelty: Synthesis strategy of mesoporous quasi-single-crystal CeO2
Method highlight: Oriented attachment of nanocluster building blocks
Key finding: High-surface-area quasi-single crystals
abstract: Single-crystal materials are essential for fundamental catalysis studies and advanced technologies; however, synthesizing single crystals that simultaneously integrate mesoporosity, tunable size, and well-defined surfaces remains challenging. Here, we report a wet-chemical, template-free strategy to synthesize mesoporous quasi-single-crystal CeO 2 superparticles (SPs). Operando wide- and small-angle X-ray scattering combined with theoretical modeling reveal a nonclassical growth mechanism driven by the oriented attachment of nanocluster building blocks. This process yields high-surface-area quasi-single crystals that preferentially expose energetically favorable (111) facets on both the external surfaces and internal pore walls, thereby enhancing the stabilization of active sites when used as heterogeneous catalyst supports. Using this approach, we demonstrate broad applicability by synthesizing highly dispersed precious metal–loaded CeO 2 (M/CeO 2 , M = Pd, Pt, Rh, or Ir) and metal-doped CeO 2 (Cu–CeO 2 ) SPs. Moreover, Pd/CeO 2 SPs exhibit effective stabilization of Pd clusters in CO 2 hydrogenation to methanol, delivering a high methanol selectivity of 85% and markedly improved durability compared with conventional supports.

title: Shedding light on left hippocampal mGlu5 in Alzheimer’s disease
summary_zh: 研究揭示阿尔茨海默病中左侧海马体mGlu5表达不对称性。发现AD模型中该不对称性消失。通过Alloswitch-1抑制mGlu5，观察到认知改善。
summary_en: This study reveals a left hippocampal mGlu5 expression asymmetry in Alzheimer's disease. It finds this asymmetry absent in AD models. Selective inhibition of mGlu5 with Alloswitch-1 shows cognitive improvement.
insights: 创新点：发现AD中mGlu5表达不对称性
方法亮点：使用Alloswitch-1进行选择性抑制
关键发现：mGlu5抑制改善认知
insights_en: Novelty: Identified mGlu5 expression asymmetry in AD
Method highlight: Utilized Alloswitch-1 for selective inhibition
Key finding: mGlu5 inhibition improves cognition
abstract: Metabotropic glutamate receptor 5 (mGlu5) is essential for synaptic plasticity and memory, making it a potential therapeutic target in Alzheimer’s disease (AD). While hemispheric asymmetries in hippocampal function have been observed in AD patients, the lateralized contribution of mGlu5 signaling to cognitive decline remains unclear. Here, we show a physiological left-right asymmetry in hippocampal mGlu5 expression in wild-type mice, with higher levels in the left hemisphere, consistent with previous reports. This physiological asymmetry is lost in two distinct mouse models of AD, the J20 and 5xFAD mice, revealing a hemisphere-specific disruption of hippocampal mGlu5 regulation. Using the light-controllable negative allosteric modulator Alloswitch-1, we show that selective inhibition of left, but not right, hippocampal mGlu5 restores working and short-term memory in AD mice. This finding indicates that altered mGlu5 expression does not simply reflect receptor loss, but rather a dysregulated signaling state that remains functionally relevant and pharmacologically targetable. Left-specific modulation also normalizes pathological downstream signaling, including aberrant Pyk2 and GSK-3β activation and tau hyperphosphorylation, across both hemispheres, indicating a widespread impact of hemisphere-selective intervention. These findings establish a functional lateralization of hippocampal mGlu5 signaling and identify the left hippocampus as a critical site for mGlu5-dependent memory dysfunction in AD. They also highlight the therapeutic potential of region-specific photopharmacology for precise intervention in early AD pathology, providing a strategy for spatially targeted modulation of pathological synaptic signaling in neurodegenerative disease.

title: P-body-mediated RNA decay controls neural crest EMT
summary_zh: 研究显示Draxin mRNA通过P-body降解调控神经嵴细胞EMT。发现DDX6缺失导致P-body破坏，抑制EMT。
summary_en: This study shows that Draxin mRNA is degraded via P-bodies to control neural crest EMT. DDX6 depletion disrupts P-bodies, inhibiting EMT.
insights: 创新点：揭示Draxin mRNA降解途径
方法亮点：使用CRISPR/Cas9技术
关键发现：DDX6调控P-body和EMT
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed the degradation pathway of Draxin mRNA
Method highlight: Employed CRISPR/Cas9 technology
Key finding: DDX6 regulates P-bodies and EMT
abstract: Neural crest cells, a multipotent vertebrate stem cell population, undergo a tightly regulated epithelial–mesenchymal transition (EMT) to delaminate from the neural tube and initiate migration. Neural crest EMT is controlled by a transient pulse of Draxin , which acts as a molecular rheostat of canonical Wnt signaling, and is then rapidly downregulated by unknown mechanisms. To address this, here we use in vivo reporter assays and live RNA imaging to show that Draxin mRNA is rapidly degraded posttranscriptionally via its 3′ untranslated region. We found that Draxin transcripts are targeted to cytoplasmic processing bodies (P-bodies), which are membrane-less sites of RNA processing and decay. Disruption of P-bodies by CRISPR/Cas9-mediated depletion of the RNA helicase DDX6 prevented posttranscriptional downregulation of Draxin and impaired neural crest EMT in vivo. These findings parallel observations in human patients carrying DDX6 mutations, who exhibit defects in P-body assembly and craniofacial abnormalities associated with neural crest dysfunction. Together, our results identify P-bodies as regulators of Draxin mRNA decay and reveal a spatially organized mechanism of RNA turnover that controls neural crest EMT during vertebrate development.

title: Phylogenomics confirms Palaeoptera monophyly and illuminates the origin of winged insects
summary_zh: 研究通过全基因组分析证实古翅目单系性和揭示有翅昆虫起源。发现早期有翅昆虫与古翅目关系密切。
summary_en: This study confirms Palaeoptera monophyly and illuminates the origin of winged insects through phylogenomic analysis. It finds early winged insects closely related to Palaeoptera.
insights: 创新点：全基因组分析揭示古翅目单系性
方法亮点：使用多物种共进化模型
关键发现：早期有翅昆虫与古翅目关系
insights_en: Novelty: Genomic analysis reveals Palaeoptera monophyly
Method highlight: Employed multispecies coalescent models
Key finding: Early winged insects related to Palaeoptera
abstract: The origin and early radiation of winged insects (Pterygota) represent one of the most transformative events in terrestrial evolution, yet phylogenetic relationships among their basalmost lineages (Ephemeroptera, Odonata and Neoptera) continue to be a central debate within insect systematics. Here, we present the most taxonomically comprehensive phylogenomic analysis to date, leveraging genomic and transcriptomic data from 101 species, including 16 sequenced ephemeropteran genomes. Employing 1,367 universal single-copy orthologs across two supermatrices, we used concatenation- and coalescent-based frameworks under homogeneous and heterogeneous, and multispecies coalescent models. Our analyses support Palaeoptera monophyly. Although coalescent-based methods initially suggested a Chiastomyaria (Ephemeroptera + Neoptera) topology, subsequent signal dissection and topology tests confirm that the preponderance of genomic signal favors a monophyletic Palaeoptera. Furthermore, we identify incomplete lineage sorting and gene tree estimation error as the primary drivers of previous topological conflicts. Our molecular dating results point to an Early Devonian origin of crown-Pterygota, whereas crown-Palaeoptera first emerged in the Late Devonian. By reconciling molecular evidence with morphological synapomorphies, such as wing-base sclerite homologies, this study provides a coherent framework for the early evolution of winged insects, supports a single origin of wings, and identifies the neopteran wing-folding mechanism as a singular evolutionary innovation.

title: Imaging and recording of synaptic zinc in the brain by covalent chemistry–based semisynthetic biosensors
summary_zh: 研究开发基于共价化学的半合成生物传感器，用于成像和记录大脑中的突触锌。发现这些传感器能够高分辨率记录突触锌。
summary_en: This study develops covalent chemistry-based semisynthetic biosensors for imaging and recording synaptic zinc in the brain. These sensors enable high-resolution recording of synaptic zinc.
insights: 创新点：开发新型生物传感器
方法亮点：化学敲入策略
关键发现：高分辨率记录突触锌
insights_en: Novelty: Developed novel biosensors
Method highlight: Chemical knock-in strategy
Key finding: High-resolution recording of synaptic zinc
abstract: Labile zinc ions (Zn 2+ ) are stored in glutamatergic vesicles at specific excitatory synapses in the central nervous system and released into synaptic clefts in an activity-dependent manner. However, the precise roles of synaptic Zn 2+ remain unclear due to a lack of tools capable of analyzing Zn 2+ with synapse-level spatial resolution in vivo. Here, we developed neuroreceptor-based semisynthetic biosensors that function as integrating dosimeters, recording synaptic Zn 2+ by covalent chemistry in the living mouse brain. Using a chemical knock-in strategy, we introduced activity-based Zn 2+ probes with distinct affinities into endogenous α-amino-3-hydroxy-5-methyl-4-isoxazole-propionic acid or γ-aminobutyric acid type A receptors. These in-brain-constructed Zn 2+ sensors enabled region-specific mapping of Zn 2+ in synaptic clefts in the living mouse brain. Imaging-based analyses revealed differences in apparent Zn 2+ levels at excitatory and inhibitory synapses across hippocampal regions during kainate-induced seizures, providing insights into the physiological and pathological functions of synaptic Zn 2+ .

title: Correction for Ran et al., Versatile Xenopus tropicalis model with targeted integration of human BRAF V600E
Discovery and characterization of miranthins, “Trojan horse” antibiotic modulators of bacterial composition in the oral microbiome
summary_zh: 研究鉴定并表征了miranthins，一种调节口腔微生物群细菌组成的“特洛伊木马”抗生素。发现miranthins通过特定转运蛋白进入细胞。
summary_en: This study discovers and characterizes miranthins, a 'Trojan horse' antibiotic modulating bacterial composition in the oral microbiome. It finds miranthins enter cells via a specific transporter.
insights: 创新点：发现miranthins及其作用机制
方法亮点：结构表征和功能研究
关键发现：miranthins通过转运蛋白进入细胞
insights_en: Novelty: Discovered miranthins and their mechanism of action
Method highlight: Structural characterization and functional studies
Key finding: Miranthins enter cells via a transporter
abstract: Bacteria of the human microbiota encode an abundance of natural products that likely mediate bacterial competition, local colonization patterns, and human health and disease. However, very few of these compounds have been identified and characterized to date. During our investigation of Streptococcus mitis , an important early colonizer of the oral cavity, we identified and structurally characterized a family of peptide natural products, termed miranthins herein, that contain an unusual macrocycle formed by an Asp-Cys β-carbon thioether crosslink. We determined that the most abundantly secreted miranthin is a “Trojan horse” antibiotic that enters sensitive cells via the Ami oligopeptide transporter, is hydrolyzed and activated by aminopeptidase N, and subsequently inhibits ribosomal translation to curb the growth of streptococcal competitors. The miranthins are narrow-spectrum antibiotics that could enable S. mitis to modulate community dynamics in the oral cavity, highlighting the importance of peptide natural products in interspecies competition in the microbiome.

title: Laundering and evasion in response to antislavery policies in Brazil’s cattle sector
summary_zh: 研究评估巴西牛肉行业反奴隶制政策对牧场主销售行为的影响。发现牧场主通过合规中介或非签约屠宰场逃避制裁。
summary_en: This study evaluates the impact of anti-slavery policies in Brazil's cattle sector on ranchers' selling behavior. It finds ranchers evade sanctions by laundering cattle through compliant intermediaries or selling to nonsignatory slaughterhouses.
insights: 创新点：评估反奴隶制政策对销售行为的影响
方法亮点：使用大量交易数据
关键发现：牧场主逃避制裁
insights_en: Novelty: Evaluating the impact of anti-slavery policies on selling behavior
Method highlight: Employed large transaction data
Key finding: Ranchers evade sanctions
abstract: Modern slavery remains pervasive across many economic sectors. Progress toward eradicating it has been partially hindered by a lack of tested, comprehensive policy responses. Using data on millions of cattle transactions in Brazil, we evaluated how ranchers changed their selling behavior after being added to the “Dirty List,” a public registry that names and shames employers found to use modern slavery. Dirty Listed ranchers significantly reduced direct sales to slaughterhouses that signed sustainable supply chain commitments but evaded sanctions by laundering cattle through compliant intermediaries or selling to nonsignatory slaughterhouses. These responses weakened the financial cost of listing to ranchers, and likely allowed beef and leather linked to modern slave labor to enter international supply chains. Our findings highlight the limits of downstream enforcement and underscore the need to monitor upstream suppliers to ensure slavery-free supply chains.

title: Integrating cooperative breeding with reciprocity and culture extends Hamilton’s rule to humans
summary_zh: 研究将合作繁殖与互惠和文化相结合，扩展汉密尔顿法则至人类。发现互惠性增加与遗传相关性和共同投资。
summary_en: This study integrates cooperative breeding with reciprocity and culture, extending Hamilton's rule to humans. It finds reciprocity increases with genetic relatedness and shared genetic investment.
insights: 创新点：将汉密尔顿法则扩展至人类
方法亮点：使用行为数据和调查
关键发现：互惠性与遗传相关性和共同投资相关
insights_en: Novelty: Extending Hamilton's rule to humans
Method highlight: Employed behavioral data and surveys
Key finding: Reciprocity related to genetic relatedness and shared genetic investment
abstract: We study how kinship and reciprocity shape giving and child care support in societies with limited access to markets. Extending Hamilton’s rule to incorporate reciprocity, we test it using behavioral data from dictator games and surveys in remote matrilocal and patrilocal villages of northeast India (N = 406 parents of young children). We replicate with data from urban Manila neighborhoods (N = 301) and the Solomon Islands (N = 624). Consistent with predictions, transfers to recipients increase with genetic relatedness to the donor and even more with relatedness to the donor’s child—a hallmark of reciprocity anchored in shared genetic investment. Nonanonymous conditions amplify giving, especially to nonkin. Cultural norms shape cooperation, but do not trump genetic relatedness. These results underscore the role of affinal ties and reciprocal exchange in sustaining cooperation, and suggest a mechanism through which cooperative breeding could contribute to the emergence of generalized reciprocity and human sociality.

title: Correction for Johnson et al., Antagonistic regulation of nitrogen and drought signaling mediated by NIN-like protein 7 transcription factor in Arabidopsis thaliana
Structural insights into the coupling mechanism of vectorial CO 2 uptake by DAB1
summary_zh: 研究通过冷冻电镜揭示DAB1介导的向量CO2摄取的耦合机制。发现DabA活性位点与DabB亚基结构耦合。
summary_en: This study reveals the coupling mechanism of vectorial CO2 uptake by DAB1 using cryoelectron microscopy. It finds the DabA active site structurally coupled to the DabB subunit.
insights: 创新点：揭示DAB1的耦合机制
方法亮点：使用冷冻电镜技术
关键发现：DabA与DabB结构耦合
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed the coupling mechanism of DAB1
Method highlight: Employed cryoelectron microscopy
Key finding: DabA structurally coupled to DabB
abstract: CO 2 transporters enable bacterial CO 2 -concentrating mechanisms by catalyzing directional hydration of CO 2 , yet the basis of this vectorial carbonic anhydrase (CA) activity remains an open question. We used cryoelectron microscopy to determine the structure of the DAB1 complex from Thermocrinis albus to 2.29 Å, revealing a heterotrimer in which a deeply buried β-CA active site in DabA is structurally coupled to the proton-translocating subunit DabB. Two conformational states define distinct solvent channels for substrate entry and product exit. A suppressor screen identifies mutations that disrupt coupling while retaining CA activity, underlying the importance of conserved residues that link proton translocation to active-site remodeling. These results support a model in which proton-driven conformational changes regulate substrate access to the active site, enabling vectorial CO 2 hydration.

title: A moveable feast: Neurons become less picky eaters after hibernation
Interfacial microenvironments enable abiotic ribonucleoside formation in micro- and nanoscale compartments
summary_zh: 本文研究界面微环境在微纳米尺度空间中促进非生物合成核苷酸。方法上，通过多种隔室化系统验证。实验表明，无需酶催化即可实现核苷酸的非生物合成。
summary_en: This paper investigates the promotion of abiotic ribonucleoside formation in micro- and nanoscale compartments by interfacial microenvironments. Methods include validation across various compartmentalized systems. Experiments show ribonucleoside formation without enzymatic catalysis.
insights: 创新点：界面微环境促进非生物核苷酸形成
方法亮点：多种隔室化系统验证
关键发现：无需酶催化实现非生物合成
insights_en: Novelty: Interfacial microenvironments promote abiotic ribonucleoside formation
Method highlight: Validation across various compartmentalized systems
Key finding: Abiotic synthesis without enzymatic catalysis
abstract: The abiotic emergence of ribonucleosides remains a central challenge in origin-of-life research because ribonucleosides form inefficiently and are often unstable under prebiotically plausible conditions. Here we show that interfacial microenvironments within aqueous micro- and nanoscale compartments containing D-ribose, phosphoric acid, and nucleobases promote ribonucleoside formation by creating reaction-permissive physicochemical conditions independent of the specific compartment type. Across a diverse range of compartmentalized systems, including gas–oil–water micro/nanobubbles, gas–water micro/nanobubbles, microscale lipid-bilayer vesicles, and oil–water emulsion systems, ribonucleosides form abiotically in the absence of enzymatic catalysis. Under selected interfacial conditions, multiple ribonucleosides, including cytidine, are generated without added catalysts. Comparison among these systems reveals that interfacial architecture and coupled physicochemical properties strongly influence both reaction efficiency and product stability. CO 2 -based micro/nanobubbles support sustained cytidine accumulation, highlighting the importance of coupled gas–liquid and liquid–liquid interfaces. Ribonucleoside synthesis also depends on compartment size, whereas variations in oil content within micro/nanobubbles selectively modulate inosine formation, underscoring the sensitivity of nucleoside chemistry to interfacial properties. These findings identify interfacial microenvironments within micro- and nanoscale compartments as a general physical framework for ribonucleoside emergence and suggest that ubiquitous compartmentalized interfaces on early Earth could have provided robust settings for prebiotic ribonucleoside chemistry.

title: An all-in-one foundation model for multimodal medical image restoration and enhancement
Autologous and broadly neutralizing antibodies drive ART-free HIV control
Characterizing the onset and progression of cancer cachexia using routine clinical data
JAMA
HCV incidence and prevalence trends among people who use drugs in France 2004 to 2023
summary_zh: 分析法国药物使用者HCV感染率和发病率趋势。研究基于多变量回归模型和传播模型。发现使用者年龄随时间增长。
summary_en: This study analyzes the trends of HCV incidence and prevalence among people who use drugs in France from 2004 to 2023. Based on multivariate regression models and transmission models, it finds that the age of users has increased over time.
insights: 创新点：多变量回归模型分析HCV趋势
方法亮点：结合行为和生物学数据
关键发现：使用者年龄随时间增长
insights_en: Novelty: Multivariate regression models for analyzing HCV trends
Method highlight: Combining behavioral and biological data
Key finding: Users' age has increased over time
abstract: Abstract Hepatitis C virus (HCV) remains a key public health challenge, particularly among people who use and inject drugs (PWUD, PWID). While direct-acting antivirals (DAA) have revolutionized HCV treatment, meeting the WHO’s 2030 elimination target requires accurate estimation of incidence and prevalence to guide prevention and care. We analyze cross-sectional surveys conducted in France in 2004, 2013, and 2023, recruiting PWUD at harm reduction services and collecting behavioral and biological data. We estimate age-and time-dependent prevalence of HCV antibodies and HCV RNA using multivariate regression models while incidence was estimated from two-state transmission models. The demographic profile of PWUD has aged over time (mean age 35 years in 2004 vs. 44 in 2023) while injection prevalence remained stable (61.7% in 2023). Between 2013 and 2023, HCV burden declined substantially: HCV RNA prevalence fell from 19.4% (95% CI 16.3–23.0) to 9.5% (7.2–12.3) among all PWUD, and from 29.6% to 14.5% among PWID. Incidence among PWID decreased from 6.5 (4.1–8.0) to 2.4 (1.4–4.2) per 100 person-years. These reductions likely reflect the combined impact of DAA scale-up and harm reduction policies, marking substantial progress toward elimination targets. However, ongoing transmission highlights persistent barriers requiring targeted public health actions.

title: Systematic comparison of affinity plasma proteomic technologies across multiple cohorts reveals generalizability of proteomic prediction
summary_zh: 比较多个队列中的亲和血浆蛋白质组技术。发现关键因素导致平台差异。建立高质量蛋白质探针对参考。
summary_en: This study compares affinity plasma proteomic technologies across multiple cohorts. It finds key factors causing platform disparities and establishes a high-quality set of protein probe-pairs as a reference.
insights: 创新点：跨队列比较蛋白质组技术
方法亮点：建立高质量蛋白质探针对
关键发现：平台差异的关键因素
insights_en: Novelty: Comparative analysis of proteomic technologies across cohorts
Method highlight: Establishment of a high-quality protein probe-pair set
Key finding: Key factors causing platform disparities
abstract: Emergence of biobank level proteomic datasets with extensive phenotype linkage has significantly improved our understanding of proteomic drivers in health and ushered in a flurry of disease risk prediction models. However, differences in cohorts and proteomic assays can significantly undermine transferability of proteomic models, severely limiting their general use. In this study, we generate and harmonize comparisons of two leading multiplex affinity-based proteomic platforms (Olink and SomaScan) across 11 independent cohorts. We find key factors contributing to platform disparities and establish a high-quality set of 757 protein probe-pairs consistently correlated across cohorts as a reference for new emerging studies. To investigate the impact on proteomic prediction, we train models to predict age, body mass index and 15 common diseases, evaluating performance across multiple independent cohorts and platforms. We find systematic deterioration in model performance across platforms, especially without filtering for probe correlations, and a U-shaped effect in model transferability reflecting a trade-off between cross-platform protein consistency and biological relevance. The optimal cross-platform correlation cut-off varied between traits, with 0.3–0.4 as most prevalent. Our study highlights practical considerations for assessing proteomic model performance across platforms and cohorts, offering guidance for robust protein biomarker development, disease prediction, and drug targeting. Proteomic prediction models often fail to transfer across cohorts and assay platforms. Here, the authors compare two leading proteomic technologies across 11 cohorts, identifying reliable proteins and correlation thresholds that yield more generalizable disease prediction models.

title: Unmet care needs at the end-of-life among older adults with activity limitations
summary_zh: 研究老年人临终未满足护理需求。比较美国、欧洲、韩国与中国、墨西哥的差异。发现机构死亡与较低未满足需求相关。
summary_en: This study investigates unmet end-of-life care needs among older adults with activity limitations. It compares the differences between the United States, Europe, and South Korea with China and Mexico, finding that institutional death is associated with lower unmet needs.
insights: 创新点：比较不同国家临终护理需求
方法亮点：使用协调的临终调查数据
关键发现：机构死亡与较低未满足需求相关
insights_en: Novelty: Comparative study of end-of-life care needs across different countries
Method highlight: Use of harmonized end-of-life survey data
Key finding: Institutional death associated with lower unmet needs
abstract: Despite the growing global demand for end-of-life care resulting from rapid social transformations, significant gaps exist in cross-national research examining unmet end-of-life care needs. Using harmonized end-of-life survey data (2010-2021) from the United States, 28 European countries, South Korea, China, and Mexico, here we show that the United States, Europe, and South Korea exhibit higher overall unmet end-of-life care needs than China and Mexico, where limited formal care provision is compensated with high levels of informal care. Death at institutions is associated with lower overall unmet end-of-life care needs in the United States and South Korea, with Mexico presenting an exception. Similarly, urban areas in Europe and South Korea exhibit lower unmet formal end-of-life care needs compared to rural areas. Among married individuals, only Mexico exhibits significantly lower unmet overall end-of-life care needs compared to unmarried individuals. Having children is consistently linked to lower unmet informal end-of-life care needs across the United States, Europe, and South Korea. Our findings highlight the complex interplay between care systems and family demographic structures in shaping end-of-life care access, and underscore the need for tailored policy approaches that strengthen both formal and informal care systems while addressing sociodemographic disparities in care access. Formal end-of-life care expansion in the US, Europe, and South Korea has not fully compensated for declining informal care, resulting in care gaps. Demographic transitions interact with development contexts to create distinct care landscapes.

title: Filovirus reactive antibodies in wildlife hunting communities suggest ongoing zoonotic spillover in forested Guinea
summary_zh: 研究森林地区狩猎社区中丝状病毒反应性抗体。发现与森林地区野生动物狩猎相关。
summary_en: This study investigates filovirus reactive antibodies in wildlife hunting communities in forested Guinea. It finds a link with wildlife hunting in forested areas.
insights: 创新点：研究森林地区狩猎社区丝状病毒抗体
方法亮点：整合血清学、空间和问卷数据
关键发现：与野生动物狩猎相关
insights_en: Novelty: Study of filovirus reactive antibodies in forested Guinea wildlife hunting communities
Method highlight: Integration of serological, spatial, and questionnaire data
Key finding: Link with wildlife hunting in forested areas
abstract: Forested Guinea has been the site of multiple high-consequence viral spillover events, including the index case of the 2013-16 West African Ebola epidemic. Deforestation and wildlife hunting rapidly expand the human-animal interface, increasing opportunities for transmission. Here we integrate serologic, spatial and questionnaire data to characterize zoonotic filovirus spillover events and risk factors amongst wildlife hunter communities in Forested Guinea. Hunters and close contacts from 43 villages in 2017 (n = 511) and 2023 (n = 648) were screened using a multiplex microsphere-based immunoassay panel of 9 filoviruses, identifying IgG binding against Ebola virus (EBOV) in 57/1159 individuals (4.9%), as well as species-specific binding against Bundibugyo (BDBV) (49/1159, 4.2%), Taï Forest (TAFV) (13/1159, 1.1%), Reston (4/1159, 0.3%), Měnglà (MLAV) (8/1159, 0.7%), Lloviu (LLOV) (8/1159, 0.7%) and Bombali (BOMV) (1/1159, 0.1%) viruses. Parallel pseudotyped virus neutralization assays identified species-specific neutralization of EBOV, BDBV and TAFV, as well as likely cross-neutralization of BOMV, LLOV and MLAV, suggesting multiple zoonotic virus spillover events. Mixed-effects regression analyses of satellite-derived land-cover data identified environmental risk factors (including forest fragmentation) reflecting potential pathways of exposure. Together, our data suggest multiple ongoing zoonotic filovirus spillover events in wildlife hunting communities and highlight the importance of landscape configuration in driving pathogen spillover.

title: Targeting CD28 on T lineage malignancies with chimeric antigen receptor T cells
summary_zh: 研究针对T细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病(T-ALL)开发CD28靶向嵌合抗原受体T细胞疗法。CD28在T-ALL细胞中高表达，通过CRISPR/Cas9敲除CD28，生成具有选择性细胞毒性的CAR T细胞。
summary_en: This study develops a CD28-targeted chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy for T cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (T-ALL). CD28 is overexpressed in T-ALL cells, and CD28 knockout using CRISPR/Cas9 generates CAR T cells with selective cytotoxicity.
insights: 创新点：CD28靶向CAR T细胞疗法
方法亮点：CRISPR/Cas9敲除CD28防止同种细胞毒性
关键发现：CD28高表达于T-ALL细胞
insights_en: Novelty: CD28-targeted CAR T cell therapy
Method highlight: CRISPR/Cas9 knockout of CD28 to prevent fratricide
Key finding: CD28 overexpression in T-ALL cells
abstract: Currently, no immunotherapy is approved for T cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (T‑ALL). High initial response rates to CD7‑directed chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cells are limited by profound T cell aplasia and CD7‑negative immune escape, underscoring the need for alternative targets. Here, we show that CD28 is overexpressed on T‑ALL blasts from children and adolescents compared with lymphoid progenitors from healthy donors and is uniformly upregulated in nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphomas (nTFHL-AI, nTFHL-F). Using CRISPR/Cas9-mediated CD28 knockout to prevent fratricide, we generate highly functional anti‑CD28 CAR T cells with selective cytotoxicity against CD28⁺ T‑ALL. Anti‑CD28 CAR T cells match anti‑CD7 CAR T cells in vitro and in vivo, but cause markedly less lymphodepletion, largely sparing CD8 T cells and NK cells while preferentially depleting CD4 T cells, particularly TH2 and TH17 subsets. These findings establish CD28 as an actionable target for CAR T cell therapy of T cell malignancies.

title: APOE2 attenuates APOE4-associated amyloid pathology and related toxicity in a mouse model of Alzheimer’s disease
summary_zh: 研究显示APOE2减轻APOE4相关阿尔茨海默病小鼠模型中的淀粉样蛋白病理和毒性。APOE3/4小鼠表现出增加的淀粉样蛋白沉积和微胶质激活，而APOE2/4小鼠则减轻这些变化。
summary_en: This study shows that APOE2 attenuates APOE4-associated amyloid pathology and related toxicity in a mouse model of Alzheimer's disease. APOE3/4 mice exhibit increased amyloid-β deposition and maladaptive microglial activation, while APOE2/4 mice mitigate these changes.
insights: 创新点：APOE2减轻APOE4相关病理
方法亮点：使用APOE2/4杂合小鼠模型
关键发现：APOE3/4小鼠表现出增加的淀粉样蛋白沉积
insights_en: Novelty: APOE2 mitigates APOE4-associated pathology
Method highlight: Use of APOE2/4 heterozygous mouse model
Key finding: Increased amyloid-β deposition in APOE3/4 mice
abstract: Abstract The apolipoprotein E ( APOE ) gene is the strongest genetic risk factor for Alzheimer’s disease (AD), influencing amyloid-β (Aβ) aggregation, clearance, and glial function. While APOE4 promotes Aβ pathology and APOE2 is protective, how these opposing alleles interact in the heterozygous APOE2/4 state remains unknown. Here, using littermate-controlled heterozygous APOE mice ( APOE2/3 , APOE3/4 , and APOE2/4 ) alongside APOE3/3 controls crossed with 5xFAD mice, we show that APOE3/4 mice exhibit increased Aβ deposition, maladaptive microglial activation, and reduced microglial interactions with plaques. These changes were attenuated in APOE2/4 mice, accompanied by a brain proteomic profile more similar to those of APOE3/3 and APOE2/3 mice. Increased myelin basic protein (MBP) abundance was observed in APOE2/3 but not APOE2/4 mice. Plasma lipidomics revealed shared alterations in APOE3/4 and APOE2/4 mice, with distinct signatures in APOE2/3 mice. These findings define allele interaction-dependent effects of APOE on brain and systemic phenotypes and provide a framework for understanding the biological consequences of the APOE2/4 genotype.

title: MACF1 condensates serve as molecular rheostats translating mechanical stress into bone adaptation
summary_zh: 研究揭示MACF1凝聚体作为分子变阻器，将机械应力转化为骨适应性。IDR2驱动凝聚体促进信号分子招募，维持骨生成准确性。
summary_en: This study reveals that MACF1 condensates act as molecular rheostats translating mechanical stress into bone adaptation. IDR2-driven condensates promote the recruitment of signaling molecules, sustaining osteogenic fidelity.
insights: 创新点：MACF1凝聚体作为分子变阻器
方法亮点：IDR2驱动凝聚体促进信号分子招募
关键发现：维持骨生成准确性
insights_en: Novelty: MACF1 condensates as molecular rheostats
Method highlight: IDR2-driven condensates promoting signaling molecule recruitment
Key finding: Sustaining osteogenic fidelity
abstract: Bone dynamically maintains homeostasis through mechanotransduction, a process essential for skeletal integrity and frequently disrupted in disease. Yet how bone cells decode mechanical cues into adaptive responses remains poorly understood. Here, we identify MACF1, a cytoskeletal crosslinker and core component of stress granules (SGs), as a mechanosensitive scaffold that undergoes phase separation via its intrinsically disordered region 2 (IDR2). In response to distinct mechanical cues, IDR2-driven condensation promotes the recruitment of PIEZO1, paxillin (PXN), and β-catenin (CTNNB1) into SGs, buffering these signaling molecules from ubiquitination-dependent degradation and sustaining osteogenic fidelity. Moreover, we identify an arginine-mutated IDR2 variant that separates protein interactions from condensate formation, revealing IDR2-driven phase separation as a requirement for MACF1-mediated SG assembly and mechanosensitive protein recruitment. Functionally, bone-targeted delivery of MACF1-IDR2 alleviates mechanical unloading-induced bone loss in male mice. These findings reveal a liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS)-mediated mechanism linking mechanical force sensing and transduction to bone adaptation. Together, these findings support a model in which MACF1 condensates act as molecular rheostats that coordinate mechano-responsive cargo sorting under stress and contribute to skeletal homeostasis. The authors show that mechanosensitive phase separation of MACF1 promotes stress granule formation and mechanosensitive protein recruitment, limiting their ubiquitin-mediated degradation. This supports bone mechanotransduction and homeostasis.

title: Multi-omics profiling uncovers diagnostic biomarker panel, progression-associated subtypes, and prognostic signature in pediatric mitochondrial disease
summary_zh: 研究提出多组学分析框架，解决儿童线粒体疾病的诊断难题。识别代谢和转录组失调，建立7特征诊断面板，实现高诊断准确性。
summary_en: This study proposes a multi-omics analysis framework to address diagnostic challenges in pediatric mitochondrial disease. It identifies metabolic and transcriptomic dysregulation, establishing a robust 7-feature diagnostic panel with superior diagnostic accuracy.
insights: 创新点：多组学分析解决诊断难题
方法亮点：建立7特征诊断面板
关键发现：高诊断准确性
insights_en: Novelty: Multi-omics analysis addressing diagnostic challenges
Method highlight: Establishment of a 7-feature diagnostic panel
Key finding: Superior diagnostic accuracy
abstract: Pediatric mitochondrial disease (PMD) is challenging due to its genetic heterogeneity, diagnostic difficulty, and unpredictable trajectories. Current biomarkers lack sensitivity to diagnose PMD or predict its severe course. Here, we show a multi-omics framework with longitudinal monitoring to resolve these challenges. We identify metabolic and transcriptomic dysregulation in PMD, deriving a robust 7-feature multi-omics diagnostic panel (6 metabolites, 1 transcript). In an independent validation cohort, this panel achieved superior diagnostic accuracy (AUC = 0.96) compared to conventional biomarkers. Beyond diagnosis, we addressed the need for patient stratification. Unsupervised proteomic clustering revealed two subtypes (Cluster I and II) that diverged over time; Cluster II patients had downregulation of cytoskeletal and immune pathways and worse clinical outcomes at 12 months. We leveraged these insights to develop a 12-transcript prognostic signature that predicts clinical prognostication with high accuracy (AUC = 0.85). This study establishes a molecular framework for PMD, offering validated tools for precision diagnosis and prognostic stratification. Pediatric mitochondrial disease lacks reliable biomarkers. Here, the authors show that a multi-omics study identified a 7-feature diagnostic panel (AUC = 0.96), revealed two proteomic subtypes with differing outcomes, and developed a 12-transcript prognostic signature (AUC = 0.85).

title: Landscape transcriptomics reveals ecological constraints on fish under anthropogenic coastal change
summary_zh: 研究应用景观转录组学框架，识别人类活动对沿海鱼类生态约束的分子特征。分析珊瑚礁鱼转录组，发现与人类活动相关的代谢、免疫和炎症通路变化。
summary_en: This study applies a landscape transcriptomics framework to identify molecular signatures of ecological constraints on fish under anthropogenic coastal change. Analyzing coral reef fish transcriptomes, it identifies coordinated shifts in metabolic, immune, and inflammatory pathways associated with human activities.
insights: 创新点：景观转录组学识别生态约束
方法亮点：分析珊瑚礁鱼转录组
关键发现：人类活动相关通路变化
insights_en: Novelty: Landscape transcriptomics identifying ecological constraints
Method highlight: Analysis of coral reef fish transcriptomes
Key finding: Pathway changes associated with human activities
abstract: Urban zones are rapidly expanding worldwide, exposing organisms to complex and multidimensional stressors. However, linking organismal responses to environmental change at ecologically relevant scales remains a major challenge. To investigate the constraints imposed on fish living in coastal urban environments, we apply a landscape-scale framework to identify molecular signatures associated with human activities. Using transcriptomes from a common coral reef fish, Chrysiptera cyanea, sampled across 18 coastal sites in Okinawa, Japan, we implement scalable analytical and visualisation tools and identify coordinated shifts in metabolic, immune, and inflammatory pathways. By integrating field data with a fasting-feeding experiment, we find that transcriptomes of adult fish from urbanised sites resemble those of well-fed experimental fish, suggesting that these areas provide an energy-rich diet while imposing chronic stress. Our findings reveal how anthropogenic activities reshape organismal resilience and demonstrate the power of landscape transcriptomics as a link between molecular signatures and ecological outcomes across changing environments.

title: Non-sewered sanitation systems reshape microplastics into chemically complex and reactive contaminants
summary_zh: 研究调查非污水卫生系统(NSSS)中微塑料(MPs)的特性。系统减少MPs丰度，但改变其特性，如碎片化、形态不规则和表面氧化。
summary_en: This study investigates the characteristics of microplastics (MPs) in non-sewered sanitation systems (NSSSs). Both systems significantly reduce MP abundance but also alter MP characteristics, such as fragmentation, morphological irregularity, and surface oxidation.
insights: 创新点：NSSS中MPs特性研究
方法亮点：使用激光直接红外光谱等分析技术
关键发现：MPs丰度减少但特性改变
insights_en: Novelty: Study of MPs characteristics in NSSSs
Method highlight: Use of laser direct infrared spectroscopy and other analytical techniques
Key finding: Reduced MP abundance but altered characteristics
abstract: Non-sewered sanitation systems (NSSSs) are gaining global attention as decentralized solutions, yet the transformation of microplastics (MPs) within these systems remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate MP characteristics in the influent and effluent of two NSSSs using laser direct infrared spectroscopy, Fourier transform ion cyclotron resonance mass spectrometry (FT-ICR MS), and liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS). Both systems substantially reduce MP abundance (retention: 53.7–77.1%) but also alter MP characteristics. MPs exhibit fragmentation, reduced particle size, increased morphological irregularity, and surface oxidation, evidenced by decreased spectral matching scores and emerging oxygen-containing functional groups. FT-ICR MS reveals molecular-level oxidation enrichment, and over 260 candidate plastic additives are identified. LC-MS/MS confirms elevated phthalate ester concentrations, including DBP and DEHP. Statistical analyses link MP fragmentation, oxidation, and additive release as coupled processes. These findings suggest that NSSSs reshape MPs into more chemically reactive forms, highlighting the need to evaluate transformation-associated risks beyond retention efficiency. Microplastics are known to be present within non-sewered sanitation systems, but how treatment processes alter their physicochemical properties is not well understood. Here, the authors use a range of techniques to study the fate and transformation of microplastics with treatment.

title: Resistance indicators in sewage microbiota mirror clinical antibiotic use with temporal lag linked to host
summary_zh: 研究利用5年门诊抗生素处方数据和一年长的废水处理厂宏基因组调查，区分粪便中抗生素耐药菌与社区抗生素使用的关联。
summary_en: This study uses a unique 5-year dataset of outpatient antibiotic prescriptions and a yearlong, twice-weekly metagenomic survey of a single wastewater treatment plant to differentiate associations between sewage-borne antibiotic-resistant bacteria and community antibiotic use.
insights: 创新点：粪便微生物群耐药指标与临床抗生素使用相关
方法亮点：结合门诊处方和宏基因组调查
关键发现：耐药基因与抗生素使用时间滞后相关
insights_en: Novelty: Resistance indicators in sewage microbiota mirroring clinical antibiotic use
Method highlight: Combination of outpatient prescriptions and metagenomic surveys
Key finding: Temporal lag of resistance genes linked to host
abstract: Wastewater-based surveillance (WBS) offers a promising window into community pathogens but extending it to antibiotic resistance (AR) is complicated by ecological and physical processes within sewer systems. The epidemiological meaning of antibiotic resistance gene (ARG) abundances in sewage remains unclear because signals reflect both human-derived inputs and in-sewer microbial dynamics. Using a unique 5-year dataset of outpatient antibiotic prescriptions and a yearlong, twice-weekly metagenomic survey of a single wastewater treatment plant, we differentiate associations between sewage-borne antibiotic-resistant bacteria and community antibiotic use. We find that ARGs linked to Enterobacteriaceae track closely with antibiotic usage, while those associated with ecologically-distinct Pseudomonadaceae show lagged correlations of 1–3 months. Nested statistical modeling further links Pseudomonas MAG dynamics with lagged sulfamethoxazole/trimethoprim use after accounting for sewage characteristics and seasonality. Our results demonstrate that WBS can capture local patterns of epidemiologically relevant AR when microbial ecological factors shaping sewage signals are considered. Profiles of antibiotic resistance genes in wastewater still often lack epidemiological context. In this study, the authors use wastewater metagenomics and antibiotic use data to reveal a variable lagging association between human antibiotic consumption and antibiotic resistance genes in sewage-derived bacterial hosts.

title: CROSS: A cross-species chromosome substitution platform for dissecting chromosome architecture and activity
summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物染色体功能完整性，开发跨物种染色体替换方法。实验中，将大鼠X染色体导入小鼠胚胎干细胞，维持其稳定性和完整性。
summary_en: Investigates the functional integrity of mammalian chromosomes and develops a cross-species chromosome substitution method. Experimentally, the rat X chromosome is introduced into mouse embryonic stem cells, maintaining its stability and integrity.
insights: 创新点：跨物种染色体替换技术
方法亮点：CRISPR/Cas9与微细胞介导的染色体转移结合
关键发现：大鼠X染色体在小鼠细胞中稳定替换
abstract: The functional integrity of a mammalian chromosome depends on its long-term co-evolution with species-specific nuclear environment. How chromosomes co-adapt with their native environment to define 3D architecture and transcription remains unclear, largely due to a lack of experimental models that dissect this co-evolution. Here, we report cross-species chromosome substitution (CROSS), a method enabling stable, scarless replacement of host chromosomes with divergent orthologs. We integrate microcell-mediated chromosome transfer with CRISPR/Cas9 to import the intact 152-Mb rat X chromosome into male mouse embryonic stem cells, and subsequently replace the mouse X chromosome, maintaining its stability and integrity. Rat-specific LINE1 and RatSatRep2 repeats recruit mouse SETDB1 inefficiently, causing local H3K9me3 loss. This triggers 3D remodeling, characterized by de novo topologically associating domain (TAD) boundaries that aberrantly activate adjacent genes, including Rhox5, impairing differentiation. We provide a platform for dissecting sequence and epigenome cooperation in chromosome regulation, and evaluating fidelity of large-scale heterologous DNA. Chromosome function depends on coevolution with nuclear environment, but how is unclear. Here, authors use CROSS to stably and scarlessly replace mouse chrX with rat chrX. Rat repeats poorly recruit SETDB1, causing H3K9me3 loss, new TAD boundaries, that dysregulate genes, impairing differentiation.

title: Building Confidence with Radiology AI
The companion website
Near-infrared photochromic miniprotein enables photoacoustic molecular imaging of acute inflammation and intracellular antigens
summary_zh: 开发近红外光开关光敏蛋白，实现高分辨率和灵敏度的深组织成像，并建立基于rsmiRFPnano的NF-κB和AP-1通路报告系统。
summary_en: This study develops a near-infrared photoswitchable photochromic miniprotein for deep-tissue imaging with high resolution and sensitivity, and establishes rsmiRFPnano-based reporters for NF-κB and AP-1 pathways.
insights: 创新点：紧凑型光敏蛋白，低分子量
方法亮点：基因编码探针，光声层析成像
关键发现：高效细胞内应用
insights_en: Novelty: Compact photochromic miniprotein, low molecular weight
Method highlight: Genetically encoded probes, photoacoustic tomography
Key finding: Efficient intracellular application
abstract: Abstract Using near-infrared photoswitchable photochromic genetically encoded probes, differential photoacoustic tomography (PAT) enables deep-tissue imaging with high resolution and sensitivity; however, current bacteriophytochrome-based probes are bulky multidomain proteins exceeding 55 kDa, which constrains their use for designing PAT molecular reporters. Here we engineer rsmiRFPnano, a compact cyanobacteriochrome-derived photoswitchable PAT probe. With a molecular weight below 19 kDa, rsmiRFPnano efficiently incorporates biliverdin, exhibits high extinction coefficients in both photochromic states and demonstrates robust performance in live cells. We established rsmiRFPnano-based reporters for NF-κB and AP-1 pathways, which display low basal activity and strong activation-dependent responses. These reporters effectively visualized acute inflammation using noninvasive PAT in vivo, further validated through cellular-level spatial omics mapping. We then created photoswitchable nanobody probes, rsNIR-Fbs, stabilized upon antigen binding and rapidly degraded otherwise, enabling selective photoacoustic immuno-imaging of intracellular antigens in vivo. Together, these results establish rsmiRFPnano as an ultracompact and versatile platform for molecular PAT.

title: Inverse probability weighting-based mediation analysis for microbiome data
summary_zh: 针对微生物组数据，提出基于逆概率权重的中介分析，解决高维度、零膨胀和依赖性等挑战。
summary_en: This study proposes an inverse probability weighting-based mediation analysis for microbiome data, addressing challenges such as high dimensionality, zero inflation, and dependence.
insights: 创新点：非参数识别公式，干预间接效应
方法亮点：解决高维度、零膨胀问题
关键发现：微生物组因果机制
insights_en: Novelty: Nonparametric identification formula, interventional indirect effect
Method highlight: Solving high dimensionality, zero inflation issues
Key finding: Causal mechanisms in microbiome
abstract: Abstract Motivation Mediation analysis is an important tool for elucidating causal mechanisms in biomedical research and has recently gained increasing attention in microbiome studies. Motivated by a microbiome study of acute myeloid leukemia (AML) patients, we investigate whether the effect of induction chemotherapy intensity on infection status is mediated through gut microbial taxa. This problem poses substantial methodological challenges due to the high dimensionality, zero inflation, and dependence of microbial mediators, as well as the presence of an exposure-induced mediator–outcome confounder, antibiotic use. Results To address these challenges, we propose a novel nonparametric identification formula for the interventional indirect effect, a causal mediation estimand that remains identifiable in the presence of exposure-induced mediator–outcome confounding. Building on this identification result, we develop an inverse probability weighting estimator and construct standard normal bootstrap confidence intervals for inference. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed method achieves accurate effect estimation and maintains appropriate type I error rates and power in finite samples. Application to the AML microbiome study provides evidence of a statistically significant interventional indirect effect of induction chemotherapy intensity on infection risk through alterations in the gut microbiome. Availability and implementation The R code for the simulation studies is available at https://github.com/YX-ZHANG-1/CausalMediationMicrobiome and archived on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21960802.

title: FAMUS: A Few-Shot Learning Framework for Large-Scale Protein Annotation
summary_zh: 提出FAMUS框架，通过对比学习进行蛋白质功能注释，提高注释准确性。
summary_en: This study proposes the FAMUS framework for protein function annotation using contrastive learning to improve annotation accuracy.
insights: 创新点：对比学习，全面相似性分析
方法亮点：监督对比学习，负样本训练
关键发现：提高注释准确性
insights_en: Novelty: Contrastive learning, comprehensive similarity analysis
Method highlight: Supervised contrastive learning, negative sample training
Key finding: Improved annotation accuracy
abstract: MOTIVATION: Gene function prediction is pivotal in genomic and metagenomic data analysis. Current annotation tools typically rely on the most similar sequence from the query database and struggle to robustly set meaningful hit thresholds, causing a major challenge for reliable annotation. RESULTS: Here, we present a contrastive learning framework for functional annotation. FAMUS (Functional Annotation Method Using Supervised contrastive learning) compares query sequences to a full array of profile Hidden Markov Models, encoding each sequence's complete similarity profile, rather than only its top-scoring hit, into a condensed vector space that minimizes the distance between proteins from the same family. Unannotated sequences are incorporated as negative examples during training, enabling robust detection of proteins that fall outside the reference database without requiring user-defined thresholds. FAMUS outperformed KEGG's native KofamScan for KEGG Orthology annotation and InterPro's InterProScan for PANTHER family annotation, especially on realistic, sparsely annotated data. We used this approach to build four protein annotation models spanning the KEGG Orthology, InterPro, OrthoDB, and EggNOG databases. FAMUS is a comprehensive, modular framework that supports both pre-defined and user-specific databases. It can be readily integrated into genomic and metagenomic analysis pipelines for accurate, large-scale functional annotation. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: All four models are available as a conda package and via our web server at https://app.famus.bursteinlab.org/, and source code is freely available on GitHub at https://github.com/burstein-lab/famus/ as well as a source code snapshot at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23132542. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Joint enzyme-reaction retrieval and catalytic optima prediction via multimodal fusion
summary_zh: 提出GERO框架，融合酶序列语义、口袋几何和反应表示，实现条件感知检索和催化最优估计。
summary_en: This study proposes the GERO framework, integrating enzyme sequence semantics, pocket geometry, and molecular reaction representations for condition-aware retrieval and catalytic optima estimation.
insights: 创新点：多模态融合，条件感知检索
方法亮点：特征门控融合，催化最优预测
关键发现：酶反应检索和催化最优估计
insights_en: Novelty: Multimodal fusion, condition-aware retrieval
Method highlight: Feature-gated fusion, catalytic optima prediction
Key finding: Enzyme-reaction retrieval and catalytic optima estimation
abstract: Abstract Motivation Enzyme-reaction retrieval prioritizes candidate biocatalysts for experimental follow-up, where recommendations should indicate catalytic compatibility and suitable pH and temperature conditions. Existing retrieval models optimize matching scores, whereas catalytic optima predictors are typically enzyme-level regressors because condition annotations are sparse. This separation leaves ranked pairs unevaluated for condition suitability and optima predictions without reaction context. Results We present GERO, a multimodal fusion framework integrating enzyme sequence semantics, sequence-derived pocket geometry, and molecular reaction representations through feature-gated fusion for condition-aware retrieval and catalytic optima estimation. We define the tolerance-restricted hit rate (Hit@k-TR), which requires both correct top-k retrieval and condition predictions within predefined tolerances. Across enzyme- and reaction-similarity splits, GERO improves Hit@k-TR over two-stage baselines under the primary tolerances. Benchmark examples and an iodinin biosynthesis case study illustrate candidate ranking and assay-condition estimation for experimental prioritization. Availability and implementation Source code is available at https://github.com/ykxhs/GERO. Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at XXXX online.

title: Dynamic Graph Prior-Guided Latent Adaptation for Generalizable Single-Cell Perturbation Response Prediction
summary_zh: 提出DGP-LA框架，结合动态图先验和潜在适应，提高单细胞扰动响应预测的泛化能力。
summary_en: This study proposes the DGP-LA framework, combining dynamic graph priors and latent adaptation to enhance generalizability in single-cell perturbation response prediction.
insights: 创新点：动态图先验，潜在适应
方法亮点：结合生物学先验知识，提高泛化能力
关键发现：单细胞扰动响应预测
insights_en: Novelty: Dynamic graph priors, latent adaptation
Method highlight: Combining biological prior knowledge, improving generalizability
Key finding: Single-cell perturbation response prediction
abstract: MOTIVATION: Predicting transcriptional responses to drug perturbations in unseen cellular contexts is a central challenge in single-cell perturbation modeling. This challenge creates a need for models that combine flexible state transitions with structured biological prior knowledge. Existing data-driven models often struggle to generalize across unseen cell types, while many prior-based models rely on static biological graphs without explicitly conditioning prior influence on perturbation-specific target support. RESULTS: We propose DGP-LA, a dynamic graph-prior latent adaptation framework that refines biological priors and injects them as gated latent corrections within a cell-state-conditioned transition model. DGP-LA couples a transition backbone with perturbation-conditioned sparse graph refinement. It propagates gene-aligned target support over the refined graph and selectively injects the resulting topology-aware signal into the hidden representation. On Tahoe and NeurIPS, DGP-LA improves Pearson Delta relative to State by 8.7% and 35.8% for generalization across unseen cell types. In zero-shot drug perturbation response prediction on unseen cell types, it improves Pearson Delta relative to CRISP by 79.1% and 67.6%. The model also improves DE-gene recovery, response discrimination, and Hallmark pathway recovery, supporting adaptive latent integration of biological priors for more generalizable and biologically interpretable perturbation modeling. AVAILABILITY: DGP-LA's source code and reproducibility materials are available at https://github.com/bieyl/DGP-LA and archived on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22155398. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Efficient and scalable Python implementation of ANCOM-BC and ANCOM-BC2 for omics differential abundance testing
summary_zh: 开发ANCOM-BC和ANCOM-BC2的Python实现，提高大规模微生物组数据分析效率。
summary_en: This study develops Python implementations of ANCOM-BC and ANCOM-BC2, enhancing efficiency in analyzing large-scale microbiome data.
insights: 创新点：Python实现，提高效率
方法亮点：处理高维数据，加速工作流程
关键发现：适用于大规模数据
insights_en: Novelty: Python implementation, improved efficiency
Method highlight: Handling high-dimensional data, accelerating workflow
Key finding: Suitable for large-scale data
abstract: Abstract Summary Analysis of Compositions of Microbiomes with Bias Correction (ANCOM-BC) and its successor ANCOM-BC2 are critical algorithms for differential abundance analysis. Designed for handling compositional data, they feature the ability to estimate the unknown sampling fractions and correct the bias induced by their differences. While the original R package implementing the two methods is robust for standard dataset sizes, the increasing magnitude of modern multi-omics studies presents computational challenges, often resulting in a runtime bottleneck for high-dimensional data. Here, we present native Python implementations of both ANCOM-BC and ANCOM-BC2 in the scikit-bio package, significantly accelerating the workflow and enabling their application to large-scale datasets. By leveraging vectorization with NumPy and numerical optimization in SciPy, we enhanced the efficiency of both methods without compromising their statistical accuracy. The benchmarking results revealed a dramatic increase in performance in both simulated and real datasets. We demonstrated that our Python implementations generated test results matching the original R code, while achieving 380- and 147-fold faster runtimes and 97.4% and 96.2% lower memory consumption on the largest tested dataset, respectively. The Python implementations allow for the analysis of datasets that are significantly larger than previously possible, and enable applications to alternative omics data types and complex statistical models that vary greatly by the number of samples, features, and covariates. Availability and Implementation https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio Supplementary information N/A

title: Seumetry: a versatile and comprehensive R toolkit to accelerate high-dimensional flow and mass cytometry data analysis
summary_zh: 本文提出Seumetry工具包，结合流式和质谱细胞分析，加速高维数据分析。方法上，整合Seurat功能，实现自动化分析。实验表明，Seumetry有效提高分析效率和准确性。
summary_en: This paper introduces Seumetry, an R toolkit integrating flow and mass cytometry analysis for high-dimensional data. The method combines Seurat capabilities for automated analysis. Experiments show Seumetry enhances efficiency and accuracy.
insights: 创新点：Seumetry工具包整合流式和质谱细胞分析，实现高维数据自动化分析。
方法亮点：Seumetry结合Seurat功能，提供强大的数据分析能力。
关键发现：Seumetry显著提高数据分析效率和准确性。
insights_en: Novelty: Seumetry integrates flow and mass cytometry analysis for automated high-dimensional data analysis.
Method highlight: Seumetry combines Seurat features to provide robust data analysis capabilities.
Key finding: Seumetry significantly improves data analysis efficiency and accuracy.
abstract: Abstract Motivation Recent progress in flow and mass cytometry technologies enables the simultaneous measurement of over 50 parameters for an individual cell. The resulting increase in data volume and complexity present challenges for conventional analysis methods, which are based on manual gating, are time-consuming and fail to capture unknown or minor cell populations. Advances in single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNAseq) technologies have prompted the development of computational analysis tools designed to process and analyze high-dimensional biological data. Building on these advances, we here present Seumetry, a framework that combines flow and mass cytometry data-specific analysis methods with the capabilities of Seurat, a powerful tool for the analysis of scRNAseq data. Results Seumetry offers methods for advanced quality control, data visualizations, and differential population abundance and protein expression analysis. We tested Seumetry on an in-house generated complex dataset of immune cells from different layers of human intestines, demonstrating that Seumetry accurately identifies distinct immune cell populations. Furthermore, benchmarking against public datasets showed that Seumetry aligns with manual-gated results, further validating its use for high-dimensional flow and mass cytometry data. In summary, Seumetry provides a new scalable framework for the comprehensive analysis of high-dimensional cytometry data with seamless integration into commonly used scRNAseq analysis tools, enabling in-depth analysis methods to facilitate biological interpretations. Availability Seumetry code is available open source under an MIT license and the current version can be viewed and used via Github: https://github.com/imsb-uke/Seumetry; and archived on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21216681. Flow cytometry data generated for this manuscript is available via Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.11935872. Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Polypharmacological Target-Aware Molecule Generation
summary_zh: 本文提出PolyTamGen框架，通过序列生成多靶点药物。方法上，将多靶点药物设计转化为序列生成任务。实验表明，PolyTamGen有效生成满足多样结合约束的分子。
summary_en: This paper proposes the PolyTamGen framework for generating polypharmacological molecules through sequence-based generation. The method transforms multi-target drug design into a sequence generation task. Experiments show PolyTamGen effectively generates molecules satisfying diverse binding constraints.
insights: 创新点：将多靶点药物设计转化为序列生成任务。
方法亮点：PolyTamGen框架实现端到端自回归生成。
关键发现：PolyTamGen有效生成满足多样结合约束的分子。
insights_en: Novelty: Transforms multi-target drug design into a sequence generation task.
Method highlight: PolyTamGen implements an end-to-end autoregressive generation framework.
Key finding: PolyTamGen effectively generates molecules satisfying diverse binding constraints.
abstract: MOTIVATION: Designing compounds capable of modulating multiple target proteins simultaneously (i.e., polypharmacology) is critical for treating complex diseases like cancer and neurodegenerative disorders. However, AI-driven multi-target drug design remains severely hindered by the scarcity of multi-target 3D structural data and the inefficiency of traditional "generate-then-filter" pipelines. There is a pressing need for scalable methods that can satisfy diverse binding constraints across multiple proteins without relying on scarce structural priors. RESULTS: To overcome these bottlenecks, we reformulate multi-target drug design as a sequence-based generation task and introduce PolyTamGen, an end-to-end autoregressive framework. We first curate a large-scale ligand-centric bioactivity dataset from ChEMBL and BindingDB, comprising 1.6 million unique ligands and 4.9 million bioactivity entries. PolyTamGen encodes target protein sets using ESM3, compresses these high-dimensional features into compact tokens via an attention module, and feeds them into a sequence-based compound generator to produce the final multi-target ligands. We further apply Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to improve docking-based affinity proxies and drug-likeness. Extensive experiments on dual- and triple-target benchmarks demonstrate that PolyTamGen improves joint success rates over representative baselines while maintaining high chemical validity and diversity. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: The code is available at https://github.com/bjzgcai/PolyTamGen. The processed data, model checkpoints, and benchmark results are available at Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20594128. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Letters and Biological Process: Linguistic Structure Encodes Hierarchical Depth in the Gene Ontology
summary_zh: 本文研究基因本体（GO）生物过程术语命名中的语言结构。方法上，通过语义表示和聚类分析，发现术语命名与GO层次深度相关。实验表明，术语长度与深度成正比。
summary_en: This paper investigates the linguistic structure in the naming of Gene Ontology (GO) Biological Process terms. The method uses semantic representations and clustering analysis to find a correlation between term naming and GO hierarchical depth. Experiments show term length correlates with depth.
insights: 创新点：发现术语命名与GO层次深度相关。
方法亮点：结合语义表示和聚类分析，揭示语言结构信息。
关键发现：术语长度与深度成正比。
insights_en: Novelty: Finds a correlation between term naming and GO hierarchical depth.
Method highlight: Combines semantic representations and clustering analysis to reveal linguistic structure information.
Key finding: Term length correlates with depth.
abstract: Abstract Motivation We asked whether the natural language used to name Gene Ontology (GO) Biological Process terms encodes hierarchical position in the GO directed acyclic graph. Results Semantic representations of term names, combined with UMAP visualization and k-means clustering (k=20) recovered biologically coherent semantic groups whose depth distributions differed strongly (Kruskal–Wallis H=5244, p<10−300; η2=0.217).
