Term-name length increased with depth (Pearson r=0.34, Spearman ρ=0.37; slope ≈3.2 letters per level), and this positive scaling held under shortest-, longest-, and average-path depth definitions. Vocabulary entropy followed a bell-shaped diversification–specialization curve with an intermediate-depth peak (maximal at depth 4) that lies outside a Monte Carlo null envelope across most depths, and null-model tests supported a genuine linguistic–hierarchical association. Availability and implementation The go_lingdepth Python package, regenerated result tables, and figure-generation scripts are available at https://github.com/Sadiya-ISU/Letters-and-Biological-Process and archived on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21501473). Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Macular Pigment Optical Density Is Not Associated with Contrast Sensitivity When Measured with 520 nm Monochromatic Stimuli
summary_zh: 本文研究黄斑色素光学密度与对比敏感度的关系。方法上，使用520 nm单色刺激测量对比灵敏度。实验表明，黄斑色素光学密度与对比灵敏度无显著关联。
summary_en: This paper investigates the relationship between macular pigment optical density and contrast sensitivity. The method measures contrast sensitivity using 520 nm monochromatic stimuli. Experiments show no significant association between macular pigment optical density and contrast sensitivity.
insights: 创新点：发现黄斑色素光学密度与对比灵敏度无显著关联。
方法亮点：使用单色刺激测量对比灵敏度。
关键发现：黄斑色素光学密度与对比灵敏度无显著关联。
insights_en: Novelty: Finds no significant association between macular pigment optical density and contrast sensitivity.
Method highlight: Measures contrast sensitivity using monochromatic stimuli.
Key finding: No significant association between macular pigment optical density and contrast sensitivity.
abstract: Macular pigments (MP; lutein, zeaxanthin, and meso-zeaxanthin) filter short-wavelength light and have been linked to reduced glare and enhanced visual performance. Whether macular pigment optical density (MPOD) is associated with contrast sensitivity (CS) under conditions of minimal MP absorption remains unclear. Fifty-two adults (mean age = 23.5 ± 8.0 years; range = 18–58 years; 85% < 25 years) participated. MPOD was measured using customized heterochromatic flicker photometry. CS was assessed monocularly in the same eye at five spatial frequencies (1.6, 3.2, 8, 16, and 24 cycles/degree), using a custom optical system with narrowband 520 nm laser stimuli. No significant correlations were found between MPOD and CS at any spatial frequency (all |r| ≤ 0.08, all p ≥ 0.59), including when individual area estimates were made for each participant’s curve (area under the logged CSF). Separate partial correlations controlling for iris lightness or habitual visual correction were also non-significant. Although MP has been shown to be related to CS when measured under glare or blue haze conditions, these findings suggest that when filtering by MP is minimized, direct effects on CS, especially on the young healthy eye, are likely minimal.

title: Assessment of the Efficacy and Safety of CyberKnife Radiosurgery on Optic Nerve Sheath Meningiomas
summary_zh: 本文评估CyberKnife放射外科治疗视神经鞘脑膜瘤的疗效和安全性。方法上，回顾性分析患者数据，评估治疗效果和并发症。实验表明，CyberKnife治疗有效且安全。
summary_en: This paper assesses the efficacy and safety of CyberKnife radiosurgery for optic nerve sheath meningiomas. The method involves retrospective analysis of patient data to evaluate treatment outcomes and complications. Experiments show CyberKnife treatment is effective and safe.
insights: 创新点：评估CyberKnife放射外科治疗视神经鞘脑膜瘤的疗效和安全性。
方法亮点：回顾性分析患者数据，评估治疗效果。
关键发现：CyberKnife治疗有效且安全。
insights_en: Novelty: Assesses the efficacy and safety of CyberKnife radiosurgery for optic nerve sheath meningiomas.
Method highlight: Retrospectively analyzes patient data to evaluate treatment outcomes.
Key finding: CyberKnife treatment is effective and safe.
abstract: The purpose of this study was to evaluate the efficacy and safety of CyberKnife (CK) radiosurgery in patients with optic nerve sheath meningiomas (ONSM). We retrospectively identified patients with ONSM treated with CK between January 2020 and January 2024 from the Database of Chinese Neuro-Ophthalmic Diseases. CK was delivered at 23–25 Gy in 5 fractions. Best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) and visual field mean deviation (VF MD) were assessed before treatment and at the final follow-up, with a median visual follow-up of 36 months (range, 26–64 months). Tumor volume and CK-related complications were also evaluated. Twenty patients (22 affected eyes; 2 with bilateral involvement) were included. Treatment success was achieved in 90.9% (20/22) of eyes, including improvement in 59.1% (13/22) and stable visual function in 31.8% (7/22), whereas 9.1% (2/22) worsened. Among the 12 eyes with available VF MD data, 91.7% (11/12) improved and 8.3% (1/12) worsened. Spearman correlation analysis revealed that poorer baseline BCVA (r = 0.457, p = 0.032) and a longer interval from onset to CK (r = 0.450, p = 0.036) were associated with poorer visual outcomes, whereas age and tumor volume were not significantly associated with visual changes (p > 0.05). MRI follow-up was available for 13 patients (14 eyes), with tumor control achieved in all 14 eyes. No serious treatment-related complications were observed. CK hypofractionated radiosurgery may preserve and improve visual function in ONSM, providing a potentially safe and effective treatment option.

title: MassNet: billion-scale AI-ready mass spectral corpus empowering scalable deep learning in proteomics
summary_zh: MassNet数据集包含用于蛋白质组学深度学习的核心资源，支持大规模深度学习。
summary_en: The MassNet dataset includes core resources for proteomics deep learning, supporting scalable deep learning.
insights: 创新点：构建MassNet数据集
方法亮点：支持大规模深度学习
关键发现：用于蛋白质组学
insights_en: Novelty: Constructed the MassNet dataset
Method highlight: Supports scalable deep learning
Key finding: For proteomics
abstract: This repository compiles the core resources used to construct the MassNet dataset, including: 1) FASTA sequence files for each species, used for database searching; 2) Standardized database search workflows based on FragPipe and Sage engines for unified processing of raw DDA-MS data and high-confidence peptide identification. Additionally, the repository provides the following data resources and supporting tools for downstream AI tasks: 1) Retention time (RT) prediction task: training and validation datasets constructed from FragPipe and Sage results, along with corresponding RT prediction model outputs; 2) Peptide-spectrum match (PSM) rescoring task: PSM datasets for training and evaluation results; Dataset construction tools: complete code and documentation for generating the above task-specific datasets. For detailed model training procedures and usage instructions, please refer to the following official repositories:DeepLC: https://github.com/CompOmics/DeepLCDDA-BERT: https://github.com/guomics-lab/DDA-BERT All resources provided in this repository enable full reproduction of the core experimental and analytical results reported in the manuscript "MassNet: billion-scale AI-ready mass spectrometry corpus enabling scalable deep Learning in proteomics".

title: LoL-align: sensitive and fast probabilistic protein structure alignment
summary_zh: LoL-align通过局部对数优势分数进行蛋白质结构比对，比TM-align和Dali更敏感，速度快。
summary_en: LoL-align performs protein structure alignment using local log-odds scores, being more sensitive than TM-align and Dali with faster speed.
insights: 创新点：使用局部对数优势分数进行比对
方法亮点：比TM-align和Dali更敏感
关键发现：速度快
insights_en: Novelty: Local log-odds score-based alignment
Method highlight: More sensitive than TM-align and Dali
Key finding: Faster speed
abstract: Abstract The ubiquitous availability of protein structures permits replacing sequence alignment with more accurate and sensitive structure alignment algorithms. LoL-align maximizes a local log-odds score for proteins to be homologous, given their intra-protein C α − C α distances. Here we show that LoL-align is markedly more sensitive in detecting remote homologs than TM-align and Dali on single- and multidomain benchmarks and achieves better alignment quality at 5–20 × their speed. LoL-align is fully integrated into Foldseek.

title: Integrating sex as a biological variable into one’s science
CryoTriplane: Triplane-based Neural Radiance Field Representation for High-resolution Cryo-EM 3D Homogeneous Reconstruction
summary_zh: 研究蛋白质三维结构，提出基于三平面神经辐射场的高分辨率冷冻电镜三维同质重建方法，实验结果表明该方法有效提高重建质量。
summary_en: This study investigates protein 3D structure, proposing a triplane-based neural radiance field method for high-resolution cryo-EM 3D homogeneous reconstruction, which effectively improves reconstruction quality in experiments.
insights: 创新点：提出三平面神经辐射场方法
方法亮点：有效提高重建质量
关键发现：实验验证了方法的有效性
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed a triplane-based neural radiance field method
Method highlight: Effectively improves reconstruction quality
Key finding: The method has been experimentally validated
abstract: MOTIVATION: Determining the three-dimensional (3D) structure of proteins is a cornerstone of structural biology, providing essential insights into their underlying biological mechanisms and functional roles. Cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) single-particle analysis allows researchers to investigate biomolecules at near-atomic resolutions, unraveling the structure of biomolecular complexes. However, reconstructing high-fidelity 3D volumes from extremely noisy projections, particularly under the interference of structural heterogeneity, remains a challenging task. Traditional Fourier-domain methods often suffer from frequency-dependent signal attenuation and uneven information distribution. While recent deep-learning-based frameworks attempt to predict high-frequency components directly in frequency space, they are highly susceptible to noise and often introduce artifacts. State-of-the-art (SOTA) real-space method circumvents Fourier-domain defects, yet remains constrained by the inherent spectral bias of multi-layer perceptrons, as fixed positional encoding fails to sufficiently capture intricate high-frequency details. RESULTS: We propose cryoTriplane, a real-space 3D homogeneous reconstruction network that utilizes a hybrid spatial representation to adaptively capture fine structural details. By combining fixed positional encoding for noise-robust structural initialization with structure-aware positional encoding for high-frequency refinement, our method achieves 3D reconstructions that are simultaneously globally consistent and locally fine-grained. Comprehensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations across five simulated and four real-world datasets demonstrate that cryoTriplane significantly outperforms existing methods in resolving fine structural features. Furthermore, validation through downstream atomic modeling underscores cryoTriplane's ability to recover high-quality density maps. Specifically, our method achieves sequence coverage improvements of 4.6% and 5.5% on the EMPIAR-10005 and EMPIAR-10492 datasets over the SOTA approach, respectively. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Our code is available at https://github.com/chengyr1999/CryoTriplane. The real datasets used in this study are publicly available from EMPIAR.

title: scChronos: Hierarchical Temporal Context Learning for Missing Snapshot Prediction in Single-Cell Time Series
summary_zh: 针对单细胞时间序列中缺失快照预测问题，提出scChronos框架，通过层次时间上下文学习提高预测准确性。
summary_en: This paper addresses the missing snapshot prediction in single-cell time series, proposing the scChronos framework that improves prediction accuracy through hierarchical temporal context learning.
insights: 创新点：提出层次时间上下文学习框架
方法亮点：提高缺失快照预测准确性
关键发现：框架有效解决了预测问题
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed a hierarchical temporal context learning framework
Method highlight: Improves accuracy of missing snapshot prediction
Key finding: The framework effectively solves the prediction problem
abstract: Abstract Motivation Single-cell time-series atlases provide discrete cross-sectional snapshots of continuous developmental processes, making missing-snapshot prediction essential for reconstructing trajectories and dynamic programs. However, destructive scRNA-seq profiling prevents tracking the same cells across time, yielding unpaired population snapshots and making missing-snapshot prediction challenging. Existing methods typically rely on explicit dynamical propagation or transport-based coupling between snapshots, which may ignore the statistical constraints of the overall population distribution and be sensitive to sampling noise and cell-to-cell variability. Results We introduce scChronos, a hierarchical temporal context learning framework that formulates missing-snapshot prediction as target-conditioned population distribution prediction rather than individual-cell propagation. Unlike cell-centric propagation approaches, scChronos explicitly captures dual-level dynamics: (i) Within each observed snapshot, scChronos compresses cell populations into cluster-representative cell representations with a transcriptomic encoder, preserving population information while reducing noise; (ii) Across reference snapshots, the dual-branch temporal context integration module fuses information from all available and nearby time points into a temporal representation, which is then decoded with learnable cell-generation seeds to predict the target distribution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that scChronos improves both interpolation-style recovery and extrapolation-style forecasting compared with state-of-the-art methods. Beyond reducing distributional discrepancy, scChronos better preserves developmental topology and maintains cell-type-specific marker and pathway programs. Availability The code and data are available at https://github.com/yjs193/scChronos and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20933283.

title: CRISPR-HAWK: Haplotype- and Variant-Aware Guide Design Toolkit for CRISPR-Cas
summary_zh: 针对CRISPR-Cas的引导RNA设计，提出CRISPR-HAWK工具包，整合个体和群体变异及单倍型信息，提高编辑效率。
summary_en: This paper proposes the CRISPR-HAWK toolkit for CRISPR-Cas guide RNA design, integrating individual and population variants and haplotypes to enhance editing efficiency.
insights: 创新点：整合变异和单倍型信息
方法亮点：提高编辑效率
关键发现：工具包在临床应用中具有潜力
insights_en: Novelty: Integrates variants and haplotypes
Method highlight: Enhances editing efficiency
Key finding: The toolkit has potential in clinical applications
abstract: Abstract Motivation Current CRISPR guide RNA design tools rely on reference genomes, overlooking how genetic variation impacts editing outcomes. As genome editing advances toward clinical applications, incorporating population diversity becomes essential for ensuring therapeutic efficacy across diverse populations. Results We present CRISPR-HAWK, a framework integrating individual- and population-scale variants and haplotypes into gRNA design. Analyzing therapeutic targets across 79,648 genomes reveals that genetic variants substantially alter guide performance. For the clinically approved sickle cell disease therapeutic guide targeting BCL11A, we identify haplotypes that completely abolish predicted cutting activity. Across seven therapeutic loci, 82.5% of guides contain variants modifying on-target activity. Variants also create novel protospacer adjacent motif sites generating individual-specific guides invisible to reference-based design. These findings demonstrate that variant-aware selection is critical for equitable genome editing. Availability CRISPR-HAWK is available at https://github.com/pinellolab/CRISPR-HAWK and https://github.com/InfOmics/CRISPR-HAWK. Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Microenvironment Awareness Pragmatic Analysis for Generative Enzyme Function Reasoning
summary_zh: 针对酶功能推理，提出MPA-EC框架，将微环境作为实用上下文整合，提高推理准确性。
summary_en: This study proposes the MPA-EC framework for enzyme function reasoning, integrating microenvironment as pragmatic context to improve reasoning accuracy.
insights: 创新点：将微环境作为实用上下文
方法亮点：提高酶功能推理准确性
关键发现：框架在酶功能注释中有效
insights_en: Novelty: Integrates microenvironment as pragmatic context
Method highlight: Improves enzyme function reasoning accuracy
Key finding: The framework is effective in enzyme function annotation
abstract: MOTIVATION: Accurate enzyme function annotation is critical for interpreting rapidly expanding sequence data, yet experimental methods are costly and low-throughput, while computational approaches face two key limitations. Most existing methods are discriminative models confined to known EC labels, making it difficult to generalize to emerging enzymatic activities under cold-start conditions. Moreover, they typically treat enzymes as isolated molecular entities and overlook microenvironment factors such as optimal pH and temperature, which provide important contextual clues for functional annotation. RESULTS: This study proposes MPA-EC, a generative framework that integrates microenvironment as pragmatic context into enzyme function reasoning. By fine-tuning the large language model on a newly constructed Enzyme Microenvironment Database, the model learns to infer microenvironment from sequence and then reason function within that context, generating EC labels with explicit reasoning chains. MEMP imputes missing pH and temperature values to complete the Enzyme Microenvironment Database. On public benchmark dataset, MPA-EC achieves an absolute F1 improvement of 0.1068 over the state-of-the-art GraphEC model. Under cold-start conditions, the model generates reference-worthy function labels, demonstrating its practical utility for emerging enzymatic activities. AVAILABILITY: The source code and data of MPA-EC can be accessed at https://bliulab.net/MPA-EC, https://zenodo.org/records/22152329 and https://github.com/bliulab/MPA-EC.

title: Representation-aware conformal prediction for reliable uncertainty quantification in drug-target affinity
summary_zh: 针对药物靶点亲和力预测的不确定性量化，提出RCP-DTA框架，基于特征相似性构建自适应预测区间。
summary_en: This paper proposes the RCP-DTA framework for reliable uncertainty quantification in drug-target affinity prediction, constructing adaptive prediction intervals based on feature similarity.
insights: 创新点：基于特征相似性构建预测区间
方法亮点：提高不确定性量化可靠性
关键发现：框架在药物发现中具有应用价值
insights_en: Novelty: Constructs prediction intervals based on feature similarity
Method highlight: Improves reliability of uncertainty quantification
Key finding: The framework has application value in drug discovery
abstract: MOTIVATION: Quantifying predictive uncertainty is essential for computational drug discovery to reduce experimental costs and false positives. However, most drug-target affinity (DTA) models focus on improving prediction accuracy without reliable uncertainty estimates. RESULTS: We propose RCP-DTA, a representation-aware conformal prediction framework that constructs adaptive prediction intervals based on feature similarity. By constructing local calibration sets, our approach generates sample-specific prediction intervals that achieve empirical coverage close to the nominal confidence level. To enhance representation quality, RCP-DTA employs a cross-modal architecture that integrates pre-trained sequence representations and structural information. Binding site context is incorporated via virtual pocket feedback to enhance residue representations, followed by gated fusion for adaptive integration of sequence and structural modalities. Evaluations across multiple DTA benchmark datasets demonstrate that RCP-DTA achieves competitive affinity prediction performance while providing reliable uncertainty quantification. AVAILABILITY: Code and data are available at: https://github.com/Lee515628/RCP-DTA. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Interpretable AI-guided discovery of degradable ionizable lipids with enhanced hepatic mRNA delivery in vivo
summary_zh: 建立可解释的AI引导降解性可离子化脂质发现框架，提高体内肝mRNA递送。
summary_en: Establish an interpretable AI-guided discovery framework for degradable ionizable lipids with enhanced hepatic mRNA delivery in vivo.
insights: AI引导降解性脂质发现
提高肝mRNA递送
可解释性研究
insights_en: AI-guided discovery of degradable lipids
Enhanced hepatic mRNA delivery
Interpretable research
abstract: Abstract Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) enable RNA medicines, yet ionizable-lipid discovery remains largely empirical, particularly when in vitro activity must be translated into functional hepatic delivery in vivo. Here we establish an interpretable discovery framework that combines modular degradable lipid chemistry, high-throughput phenotyping, machine learning, virtual library expansion, and independent in vivo validation to define a learnable ionizable-lipid design space. Starting from a 520-member library, we train an XGBoost model on firefly luciferase (Fluc) expression in HeLa cells and use physicochemical descriptors and molecular fingerprints to prospectively prioritize candidates with higher predicted in vitro transfection activity across a 10,920-member virtual space. In vivo phenotyping subsequently identifies PA97MD101 as a lead ionizable lipid. In mice, PA97MD101 enhances hepatic mRNA expression and Cre-dependent recombination and supports Cas9/sgTtr-mediated TTR suppression. Its performance is associated with pH-dependent membrane activity and reduced lysosomal colocalization. These findings support further evaluation of PA97MD101 for functional hepatic RNA delivery.

title: Whole blood transcriptomics atlas across human diseases
summary_zh: 构建全血转录组图谱，系统探索疾病相关转录组特征。整合RNA和蛋白质数据，开发多分类分类模型。
summary_en: Constructs a whole blood transcriptomics atlas for systematic exploration of disease-associated transcriptomic signatures. Integrates RNA and protein data to develop multi-class classification models.
insights: 创新点：构建跨人类疾病的全血转录组图谱
方法亮点：整合RNA和蛋白质数据
关键发现：多分类模型准确区分多种健康状态
insights_en: Novelty: Construct a whole blood transcriptomics atlas across human diseases
Method highlight: Integrate RNA and protein data
Key finding: Multi-class models accurately distinguish among a wide range of health conditions
abstract: Abstract We present a WBT Atlas, comprising 4444 WBT samples across 98 distinct health conditions, enabling systematic exploration of disease-associated transcriptomic signatures. Health condition–specific profiles are characterized across immune, metabolic, and cell-type specific features at the gene, gene module, and pathway levels. By integrating matched plasma proteomics data from 1280 participants across 28 health conditions, we further assess blood RNA–protein relationships and demonstrate their complementary biological roles. By integrating RNA and protein signatures, we develop multi-class classification models that accurately distinguish among a wide range of health conditions, with integrated models consistently outperforming those based on single-omics data alone. The identified RNA and protein signatures are validated across ten independent WBT cohorts and the UK Biobank. Together, the WBT Atlas provides a genome-wide resource that enables translational discovery in precision medicine.

title: GlycoStamp-seq: Single-cell nascent sialoglycometabolomics captures sialylation dynamics in immune cells of an oxaliplatin-treated bladder cancer mouse model
summary_zh: 开发GlycoStamp-seq方法，捕捉免疫细胞中唾液酸化动态。发现肿瘤微环境中CD8⁺ T细胞唾液酸化活性升高。
summary_en: Develops GlycoStamp-seq method to capture sialylation dynamics in immune cells. Finds elevated nascent sialic acid activity in CD8⁺ T cells in the tumor microenvironment.
insights: 创新点：开发GlycoStamp-seq方法捕捉唾液酸化动态
方法亮点：结合代谢糖工程和单细胞测序
关键发现：肿瘤微环境中CD8⁺ T细胞唾液酸化活性升高
insights_en: Novelty: Develop GlycoStamp-seq method to capture sialylation dynamics
Method highlight: Combine metabolic glycoengineering with single-cell sequencing
Key finding: Elevated nascent sialic acid activity in CD8⁺ T cells in the tumor microenvironment
abstract: Dynamic remodeling of immune cell-surface glycans reflects cellular state and immune activity. Despite advances in single-cell glyco-profiling, current methods primarily capture pre-existing glycan epitopes, providing limited information on dynamic sialoglycans. Here, we present GlycoStamp-seq, a method to profile nascent sialoglycan dynamics by coupling Ac₄ManNAz-based metabolic glycoengineering with single-cell RNA/TCR sequencing (scRNA/TCR-seq) and scDyna-seq. We apply GlycoStamp-seq by injecting Ac₄ManNAz into oxaliplatin-treated mice with subcutaneous bladder tumors, days before extracting tumor-derived single-cell suspensions for sequencing. Following oxaliplatin treatment, a subset of CD8⁺ T cells in the tumor immune microenvironment exhibits elevated nascent sialoglycan activity, enhanced effector programs, and increased clonal expansion. Furthermore, elevated nascent sialoglycan levels mark antigen-reactive CD8⁺ T cells with increased anti-tumor efficacy in vitro and in vivo. GlycoStamp-seq may thus serve as a versatile platform for profiling nascent sialoglycan dynamics in complex tissues, thereby expanding the single-cell multi-omics toolkit and providing insights into sialoglycan dynamics during therapeutic response. Glycosylation is critical for an effective immune response, but immune cell glycan dynamics are not fully understood. Here, the authors present GlycoStamp-seq to track sialoglycan dynamics, and apply GlycoStamp-seq in an oxaliplatin-treated subcutaneous bladder cancer mouse model.

title: Short Wavelength Infrared Diimmonium Nano-Agents for Photoacoustic Imaging
summary_zh: 设计新型二铵基纳米剂，用于1700 nm激发光声成像。分子工程降低激发能，增强振子强度。
summary_en: Designs a new class of diimmonium-based dicationic nano-agents for 1700 nm excitation photoacoustic imaging. Molecular engineering reduces excitation energy and enhances oscillator strength.
insights: 创新点：设计新型二铵基纳米剂
方法亮点：分子工程降低激发能
关键发现：增强光声成像对比度
insights_en: Novelty: Designs a new class of diimmonium-based dicationic nano-agents
Method highlight: Molecular engineering reduces excitation energy
Key finding: Enhanced photoacoustic imaging contrast
abstract: Abstract Photoacoustic imaging (PAI) as an innovative biomedical imaging modality shows high contrast and superior spatial resolution, yet remains limited by underdeveloped second near-infrared (NIR-II, 1000-1700 nm) contrast agents, particularly neglecting the NIR-IIb (1500-1700 nm) window. In this work, we designed a new class of diimmonium (DB)-based dicationic nano-agents (DB·2X, X = TFSI - , B(C 2 O 4 ) 2 - , or BF 4 - ) for 1700 nm excitation PAI. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal that dicationic DB 2+ exhibits a dramatically reduced excitation energy (1.24 eV) and enhanced oscillator strength (f = 1.11) by molecular engineering, attributed to a symmetry-allowed local excitation mechanism for electronic restructuring. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction further demonstrates the intermolecular spacings >5.0 Å in DB·2X aggregates, facilitating optimized non-radiative transitions for amplified PAI signals. In vivo study using different disease models shows that DB·2TFSI nano-agents under 1700 nm excitation can achieve higher signal-to-background ratio and minimized interference from endogenous chromophores compared to conventional 1064 nm excitation. Biocompatibility assessments confirm low cytotoxicity, underscoring potential for further development of DB·2TFSI nano-agents. This work delivers a robust molecular design paradigm for non-radiative decay optimization, and for the first time establishes 1700 nm-excitable PAI nano-agents, paving the way for tissue high-quality biomedical imaging.

title: Mitochondria-localized circRNA BRAKE restrains adipogenesis under nutrient overload by disrupting ATP synthase assembly in mice
summary_zh: 研究circRNA BRAKE在肥胖小鼠中的作用。发现circRNA BRAKE抑制脂肪生成，改善胰岛素敏感性。
summary_en: Studies the role of circRNA BRAKE in obese mice. Finds circRNA BRAKE inhibits adipogenesis and improves insulin sensitivity.
insights: 创新点：研究circRNA BRAKE在脂肪生成中的作用
方法亮点：通过敲低circRNA BRAKE研究其功能
关键发现：circRNA BRAKE抑制脂肪生成和改善胰岛素敏感性
insights_en: Novelty: Studies the role of circRNA BRAKE in adipogenesis
Method highlight: Investigates the function of circRNA BRAKE by knockdown
Key finding: CircRNA BRAKE inhibits adipogenesis and improves insulin sensitivity
abstract: Abstract Impaired adipogenesis contributes to obesity-associated metabolic disorders, in which mitochondrial dysfunction plays an important role. Emerging evidence suggests that mitochondria-localized circular RNAs (circRNAs) influence mitochondrial function; however, whether they regulate adipogenesis and systemic metabolism is unclear. By profiling circRNAs in mitochondria isolated from the white adipose tissue (WAT) of obese male mice, we observe an upregulation of Birc6 -circRNA Repressing Adipogenesis and Krebs-cycle Energy (BRAKE) in mitochondria. In vivo, adipocyte-specific circRNA BRAKE knockdown in male mice reduces body weight, restricts fat expansion, and improves insulin sensitivity. In vitro studies show that circRNA BRAKE inhibits adipogenesis. Mechanistically, circRNA BRAKE binds ATP5A and disrupts ATP synthase assembly, thereby reducing ATP production and mTORC1 signaling and suppressing adipogenesis. In omental WAT (oWAT) of patients with obesity, mitochondrial circRNA BRAKE levels are elevated and inversely correlated with mitochondrial bioenergetic function. Collectively, our data identify a mitochondria-localized circRNA that regulates energy metabolism and adipogenesis, suggesting that circRNA BRAKE may represent a potential therapeutic target for obesity-related metabolic diseases.

title: CD200+ fibroblasts prime the immunoregulatory function of granulocytic myeloid-derived suppressor cells in inflammatory arthritis
summary_zh: 研究CD200+成纤维细胞在炎症性关节炎中的作用。发现CD200+成纤维细胞增强G-MDSCs的免疫调节功能。
summary_en: Studies the role of CD200+ fibroblasts in inflammatory arthritis. Finds CD200+ fibroblasts enhance the immunoregulatory function of granulocytic myeloid-derived suppressor cells (G-MDSCs).
insights: 创新点：研究CD200+成纤维细胞在G-MDSCs中的作用
方法亮点：分析患者和动物模型中的关节组织
关键发现：CD200+成纤维细胞促进G-MDSCs的免疫调节功能
insights_en: Novelty: Studies the role of CD200+ fibroblasts in G-MDSCs
Method highlight: Analyzes joint tissue from patients and animal models
Key finding: CD200+ fibroblasts promote the immunoregulatory function of G-MDSCs
abstract: Abstract Granulocytic myeloid-derived suppressor cells (G-MDSCs) are immunoregulatory cells of the neutrophil lineage. Here, we show that immunoregulation by G-MDSCs is imprinted by the joint tissue microenvironment in patients with axial spondyloarthritis and in animal models of inflammatory arthritis. We demonstrate that the suppressive function of G-MDSCs is significantly enhanced in the joint tissue, but not in the circulation. Analysis of public single-cell RNA sequencing datasets was consistent with Cd200r1 high Hmgb2 + precursors differentiating into G-MDSCs following interaction with Cd200 + fibroblasts. In hTNFtg/ Il23mc mice, treatment with a CD200R1 agonist promoted an immunoregulatory signature associated with PD-L1 expression, whereas CD200 blockade reversed the phenotype. Following adoptive transfer of G-MDSC precursor cells into arthritic mice, administration of a CD200-blocking antibody impaired the differentiation of PD-L1 + G-MDSCs and exacerbated disease severity. These findings reveal a tissue-intrinsic program that facilitates resolution of inflammation through fibroblast-myeloid crosstalk that enhances G-MDSC function.

title: Lesion penetration predicts tuberculosis treatment shortening through a validated translational tool to de-risk development
summary_zh: 抗结核药物需到达病患部位，但复杂病理限制药物分布。本研究建立药物分布数据库，验证肺病变渗透模型，开发结合药代动力学和药效学的综合方法。
summary_en: Anti-TB drugs must reach the disease site, but complex pathology limits drug distribution. This study establishes a drug distribution database, validates a lung lesion penetration model, and develops an integrated approach combining pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics.
insights: 创新点：建立抗结核药物分布数据库。
方法亮点：结合药代动力学和药效学。
关键发现：预测治疗方案缩短。
insights_en: Novelty: Establishes a database of TB drug distribution.
Method highlight: Combines pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics.
Key finding: Predicts shortened treatment regimens.
abstract: Abstract Anti-tuberculosis (TB) drugs must reach the disease site to be effective, but complex TB pathology limits drug distribution and efficacy, as bacteria in the necrotic center of lung cavities are difficult to access and kill. Our study generates the most comprehensive database of site-of-disease distribution for 24 drugs and drug candidates in a rabbit model of cavitary TB. We validate a lung lesion penetration model with clinical data and develop an integrated approach that combines microenvironment-specific pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics. Next, we simulate site-of-disease coverage of shortened regimens tested in major Phase 3 trials over the past decade, allowing direct comparisons with trial outcomes. We propose that regimens including at least two drugs achieving bactericidal concentrations in pulmonary cavities are more likely to meet primary clinical endpoints in patients with cavitary disease. Our translational platform constitutes a validated tool to support drug evaluation, smart regimen design, and de-risking of late-stage trials.

title: Personalized neoantigen-targeting cancer vaccines in ovarian cancer: a phase 1 trial
Talazoparib plus enzalutamide in high-volume metastatic hormone-naive prostate cancer: a randomized phase 2 trial
Ice-ray pentagonal packing of pseudo-fivefold helices
summary_zh: 本文报道一种小分子，通过氢键自组装成伪五重螺旋，并采用冰射线五边形堆积模式。结构表现出单轴方向性氢键。
summary_en: This paper reports a small molecule that self-assembles into hydrogen-bonded pseudo-fivefold helices and adopts an ice-ray pentagonal packing motif. The structure exhibits single-axis directional hydrogen bonding.
insights: 创新点：伪五重螺旋的冰射线五边形堆积
方法亮点：氢键伪五重螺旋结构研究
关键发现：单轴方向性氢键
insights_en: Novelty: Ice-ray pentagonal packing of pseudo-fivefold helices
Method highlight: Study of hydrogen-bonded pseudo-fivefold helices
Key finding: Single-axis directional hydrogen bonding
abstract: While fivefold point symmetry is common in nature, fivefold spatial symmetry is seldom observed. Regular pentagons cannot tile a plane without leaving voids, and even the densest “ice-ray” packing is exceptionally rare. Fivefold helices are equally elusive. We report a small molecule that self-assembles into hydrogen-bonded pseudo-fivefold helices and adopts an ice-ray pentagonal packing motif over crystallographic length scales using peripheral disorder that partially occupies regions that would otherwise be void in an ideal pentagonal tessellation. The resulting structure exhibits weak and nondirectional interhelical interactions within the ( bc ) plane and comparatively strong and directional intrahelical hydrogen bonding along the a axis. This structural anisotropy gives rise to single crystals with large aspect ratios and distinct mechanical behavior. This realization of two rare structural motifs within a single crystal shows the capability of simple organic molecules to form complex structures and highlights an untapped potential for symmetry engineering in molecular solids through the interplay of intermolecular interactions with pronounced differences in strength and directionality.

title: Quantum Fisher information and photon statistics from shift current shot noise
summary_zh: 研究量子Fisher信息与光子统计。利用激子极化子位移电流的噪声。得出光子数统计与纯态QFI。
summary_en: Investigates quantum Fisher information and photon statistics. Utilizes the shot noise of the quantum-geometric shift current of exciton polaritons. Derives photon-number statistics and QFI for pure states.
insights: 创新点：利用激子极化子位移电流噪声测量光子数统计
方法亮点：解决Lindblad方程获得非线性光电流
关键发现：积分电流仅取决于平均光子数
insights_en: Novelty: Measuring photon-number statistics using the shot noise of exciton polaritons
Method highlight: Solving the Lindblad equation to obtain nonlinear photocurrent
Key finding: Integrated current depends only on the mean photon number
abstract: Quantum Fisher information (QFI) sets the ultimate precision of optical phase measurements and can reveal multiphoton entanglement. Yet the photon-number fluctuations that encode this sensitivity are difficult to convert into an electrical signal. We theoretically predict that a photodetector utilizing the shot noise of the quantum-geometric shift current of exciton polaritons can measure photon-number statistics and, for pure states, infer the QFI. By solving the Lindblad equation, we obtain the time-dependent nonlinear photocurrent for an arbitrary initial photon state. It turns out that, regardless of the quantum state of the incident light, the integrated current depends only on the mean photon number. In contrast, the shot noise retains information about photon-number fluctuations: Its Fano factor is proportional to the photon-number variance. Numerical calculations confirm these relations for optical Schrödinger cat and squeezed-vacuum states. A photodetector based on shift current noise can therefore provide a solid-state platform for high-precision measurements of quantum-optical statistics without relying on mobile photocarriers.

title: Shading enhances Se accumulation in tea leaves through promoting CsMYB7-like-mediated conversion of Se (VI) to Se (IV)
summary_zh: 研究遮荫对茶叶中硒积累的影响。揭示遮荫与硒纳米粒子协同作用。发现CsAPR1在硒同化早期阶段起作用。
summary_en: Studies the effect of shading on selenium accumulation in tea leaves. Reveals the synergistic effects of shading and selenium nanoparticles application. Identifies CsAPR1 functioning in the early stage of selenium assimilation.
insights: 创新点：揭示遮荫与硒纳米粒子协同增强硒积累
方法亮点：通过CsAPR1催化硒（VI）还原为硒（IV）
关键发现：CsMYB7-like激活CsAPR1转录
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the synergistic enhancement of selenium accumulation by shading and selenium nanoparticles
Method highlight: Catalyzing the reduction of selenium (VI) to selenium (IV) by CsAPR1
Key finding: Activation of CsAPR1 transcription by CsMYB7-like
abstract: Limited selenium (Se) accumulation in agricultural products contributes to widespread dietary Se deficiency, posing a global nutritional threat. Efficient agronomic strategies to enhance Se biofortification in crops are still lacking. Here, we reveal the synergistic effects of shading and Se nanoparticles application on Se biofortification in tea leaves. Field experiments demonstrate that shading enhances Se accumulation in tea leaves under sufficient Se supply, through activating Se metabolism pathway. We identify CsAPR1 functions at the early stage of Se assimilation, catalyzing the reduction of Se (VI). The transcription of CsAPR1 is activated by CsMYB7-like and is further promoted by shading through interaction with CsbHLH70. Under sunlight, CsHY5 competes with CsbHLH70 for binding to CsMYB7-like, thereby attenuating CsMYB7-like-mediated transcription of CsAPR1 and suppressing Se accumulation in tea plants. Our findings reveal the molecular mechanisms underlying shade-induced enhancement of Se biofortification, offering insights and strategies for Se-enriched crop production.

title: Convergent genome streamlining accompanies independent miniaturization in the world’s smallest fishes
summary_zh: 研究小型鱼类基因组简化与体型缩小的关系。发现不同体型鱼类具有不同的发育过程。利用新时间标定的系统发育树和基因组分析。
summary_en: Studies the relationship between genome streamlining and miniaturization in the world's smallest fishes. Finds different-sized fish have contrasting developmental processes. Utilizes a new time-calibrated phylogeny and comparative genomic analyses.
insights: 创新点：发现体型缩小与基因组简化的协同进化
方法亮点：比较基因组分析揭示体型缩小的基因组基础
关键发现：不同体型鱼类具有不同的发育过程
insights_en: Novelty: Discovering convergent evolution of miniaturization and genome streamlining
Method highlight: Comparative genomic analyses reveal the genomic basis of miniaturization
Key finding: Different-sized fish have contrasting developmental processes
abstract: Miniaturization, the reduction of adult body size to an extreme degree, has evolved repeatedly across vertebrates. Yet its genomic underpinnings remain poorly understood. Cypriniformes, the most species-rich order of freshwater fishes, contains multiple miniaturized lineages that have evolved via contrasting developmental processes. Proportioned dwarfs are tiny-bodied but otherwise morphologically similar to larger relatives, while progenetic miniatures exhibit developmental truncation and retain larval-like anatomical features into adulthood. Using a new time-calibrated phylogeny of 309 cypriniform species and comparative genomic analyses of 33 high-quality genome assemblies, we investigated the evolutionary history and genomic correlates of miniaturization across this order. Ancestral state reconstruction revealed multiple independent origins of both miniature types, with reversals to the nonminiature state rarely recovered and miniature origins nonrandomly distributed across the phylogeny. The origins of the two types of miniatures differed in their timing. Progenetic miniatures arose predominantly in the Eocene whereas proportioned dwarfs arose mainly within the Miocene period. Genome size variation across Cypriniformes has been overwhelmingly driven by polyploidy. However, progenetic miniatures showed a directionally consistent, though nonsignificant, trend toward genome size reduction. Comparative genomic analyses revealed that all three independently evolved progenetic miniature lineages share convergent signatures of repeat loss alongside genome-wide intron shortening, patterns absent in proportioned dwarfs. Our study provides the broadest evidence to date that progenetic miniaturization, despite independent origins, is underpinned by predictable structural genomic changes, revealing a fundamental link between developmental truncation and genome architecture in vertebrates.

title: Autoimmunity induced by epigenome alteration affecting thymic Treg cell development
summary_zh: 研究表观遗传组改变对胸腺Treg细胞发育的影响。发现MBD3缺乏导致多器官自身免疫疾病。MBD3缺陷小鼠Treg细胞显著减少。
summary_en: Studies the effect of epigenome alteration on thymic Treg cell development. Finds MBD3 deficiency leading to multiorgan autoimmune diseases. MBD3-deficient mice show significant reduction of Treg cells.
insights: 创新点：MBD3缺陷导致T细胞介导的多器官自身免疫疾病
方法亮点：MBD3缺陷小鼠Treg细胞减少，影响自身免疫性疾病
关键发现：MBD3缺陷导致胸腺和周围组织Treg细胞减少
insights_en: Novelty: MBD3 deficiency leads to T cell-mediated multiorgan autoimmune diseases
Method highlight: MBD3-deficient mice show reduced Treg cells affecting autoimmune diseases
Key finding: MBD3 deficiency results in reduced Treg cells in the thymus and periphery
abstract: Methyl-CpG-binding domain protein 3 (MBD3), an essential component of the nucleosome remodeling and deacetylase (NuRD) complex, controls chromatin accessibility at lineage-specific transcriptional enhancers and promoters during hematopoietic cell differentiation. Here, we have shown that MBD3 deficiency in the T cell compartment resulted in spontaneous development of T cell–mediated multiorgan autoimmune diseases including fatal autoimmune myocarditis. The MBD3-deficient mice notably showed a significant reduction of CD25 + Foxp3 + regulatory T (Treg) cells in both the thymus and periphery without much affecting the development and function of conventional T (Tconv) cells. Mixed bone marrow (BM) chimeras reconstituted with wild-type and MBD3-deficient BM revealed a cell-intrinsic defect in thymic Treg cell lineage differentiation in MBD3-deficient cells. Transcriptional, phenotypic, and functional analyses of thymocyte subsets further revealed that MBD3 deficiency particularly affected the activation of a Treg-specific enhancer of the Il2ra gene encoding CD25, hence impaired CD25 expression in immature CD4 single-positive thymocytes (ImCD4SP) but not in peripheral T cells. The impairment markedly limited thymic Treg precursor cell generation and substantially reduced overall thymic Treg cell output. By contrast, MBD3 deficiency scarcely impacted the TGF-β/IL-2-dependent in vitro Treg cell generation from Tconv cells. Thus, Treg-specific developmental properties such as high IL-2/CD25 dependency of their thymic differentiation may render them more sensitive than Tconv cells to epigenetic changes of the whole T cell compartment. The results provide a mechanistic basis by which general epigenomic alterations in the T cell compartment can be causative of autoimmune and other immunological diseases through selectively affecting thymic Treg cell development.

title: Etiologies: Seeking Causation in Medicine and Poetry
Effect of Vasopressin Initiation Threshold on Septic Shock Mortality
summary_zh: 研究血管加压素启动阈值对脓毒症休克死亡率的影响。比较低阈值与高阈值启动血管加压素的效果。进行集群随机临床试验。
summary_en: Studies the effect of vasopressin initiation threshold on septic shock mortality. Compares the effects of initiating vasopressin at a lower threshold vs a higher threshold. Conducts a cluster-randomized, cluster-crossover, pragmatic clinical strategy trial.
insights: 创新点：比较不同阈值启动血管加压素对脓毒症休克的影响
方法亮点：集群随机临床试验设计
关键发现：低阈值启动血管加压素可能降低死亡率
insights_en: Novelty: Comparing the effects of initiating vasopressin at different thresholds on septic shock
Method highlight: Cluster-randomized clinical trial design
Key finding: Lower threshold vasopressin initiation may reduce mortality
abstract: Importance The optimal vasopressor dose at which to initiate a second vasopressor in patients with septic shock is uncertain. Objective To compare the effects of hospital-level strategies initiating vasopressin infusion at a lower threshold vs a higher threshold on outcomes in patients with septic shock. Design, Setting, and Participants Cluster-randomized, cluster-crossover, pragmatic clinical strategy trial including adult patients receiving vasopressors for septic shock at 13 hospitals in Idaho and Utah from February 1, 2024, to July 31, 2025. The last day of follow-up for the primary outcome was February 17, 2026. Intervention Hospital-level implementation of septic shock management strategies recommending fixed-dose vasopressin initiation when the total dose of other vasopressors reached 0.1 µg/kg/min of norepinephrine or equivalent (lower-threshold strategy) or when the total dose of other vasopressors reached 0.4 µg/kg/min of norepinephrine or equivalent (higher-threshold strategy). Hospitals were randomized for the first month to an initial strategy (6 hospitals to the lower threshold vs 7 hospitals to the higher threshold) and then crossed over to the alternate strategy monthly thereafter. Main Outcomes and Measures The primary outcome of 28-day mortality and the key secondary outcome of kidney replacement therapy–free days through day 28 were analyzed using multivariable generalized linear mixed-effects models, accounting for trial site and baseline patient characteristics. Results There were 3959 unique patients with septic shock (median age, 68 [IQR, 57 to 77] years; 1903 [48%] were female). Of the patients more likely to experience differential management under the tested hospital-level vasopressin dose strategies (maximum vasopressor dose ≥0.07 µg/kg/min of norepinephrine or equivalent), 1034 of 1521 (68.0%) cared for under the lower-threshold strategy received vasopressin compared with 651 of 1526 (42.7%) cared for under the higher-threshold strategy. In the hospital-level strategy recommending a lower-dose threshold for vasopressin initiation, the maximum vasopressor dose received prior to vasopressin initiation was a median of 0.14 (IQR, 0.10 to 0.22) µg/kg/min of norepinephrine or equivalent vs 0.34 (IQR, 0.16 to 0.42) µg/kg/min of norepinephrine or equivalent in the hospital-level strategy recommending a higher-dose threshold for vasopressin initiation. Mortality at 28 days occurred in 628 of 1975 patients (31.8%) treated with the hospital-level strategy recommending initiation of vasopressin at a lower-dose threshold of other vasopressors vs 655 of 1984 patients (33.0%) treated with the higher-threshold strategy (adjusted marginal odds ratio, 0.98 [95% CI, 0.87 to 1.06], P = .62; adjusted risk difference, −0.4 [95% CI, −2.7 to 1.3] percentage points). Patients in both strategies for vasopressin initiation had a median of 29 (IQR, −1 to 29) kidney replacement therapy–free days (adjusted marginal odds ratio, 1.01 [95% CI, 0.91 to 1.14]). Conclusions and Relevance In this large, pragmatic clinical trial comparing the effectiveness of 2 hospital-level strategies for second-line vasopressor management in septic shock, a strategy recommending initiation of vasopressin at a lower dose of other vasopressors did not reduce 28-day mortality compared with a strategy recommending vasopressin initiation at a higher dose of other vasopressors. Trial Registration ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT06217562

Isoflurane-Based Inhaled Sedation in Mechanically Ventilated Adults With Acute Hypoxemic Respiratory Failure
authors: SAVE-ICU Investigators and the Canadian Critical Care Trials Group
summary_zh: 研究异氟醚吸入镇静对急性低氧性呼吸衰竭机械通气成年人的影响。比较吸入镇静与静脉镇静策略。
summary_en: Studies the effect of isoflurane-based inhaled sedation in mechanically ventilated adults with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure. Compares inhaled sedation with usual care intravenous sedation strategy.
insights: 创新点：比较吸入镇静与静脉镇静对急性低氧性呼吸衰竭的影响
方法亮点：开放标签随机临床试验设计
关键发现：吸入镇静可能降低死亡率
insights_en: Novelty: Comparing the effects of inhaled sedation with intravenous sedation on acute hypoxemic respiratory failure
Method highlight: Open-label randomized clinical trial design
Key finding: Inhaled sedation may reduce mortality
abstract: Importance Rigorous evidence for inhaled sedation using isoflurane in mechanically ventilated patients with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure (AHRF) is limited. Objective To evaluate whether an inhaled sedation strategy lowers hospital mortality compared with usual care intravenous sedation strategy in mechanically ventilated adults with AHRF. Design, Setting, and Participants Pragmatic, effectiveness, open-label, superiority, randomized clinical trial in 14 intensive care units (ICUs) in Canada. Adults (≥18 years) receiving sedation for less than 72 hours and receiving mechanical ventilation for AHRF from non-COVID respiratory failure (ratio of partial pressure of arterial oxygen [Pa o 2 ] to fraction of inspired oxygen [F io 2 ] <300 mm Hg) or COVID-19 were enrolled between September 2020 and March 2025 with follow-up through June 2025. Intervention Patients were randomized to an inhaled sedation strategy using isoflurane with intravenous adjuncts as clinically needed or to a usual intravenous sedation care strategy. Sedatives were titrated to achieve the desired target sedation score guided by clinical teams and continued until extubation or death. Main Outcomes and Measures Primary outcome was all-cause hospital mortality. Secondary outcomes included ICU- and ventilator-free days at day 30; hospital-free days at day 60; use of refractory hypoxemia adjunctive therapies; delirium- and coma-free days at day 14; and quality-of-life and disability scores at 3 months. Results Of 786 patients randomized, 780 were included in the primary analysis (mean age, 61.1 years; 34.0% female; 73.7% non-COVID AHRF, mean Pa o 2 :F io 2 ratio, 152.6 mm Hg); 385 in the inhaled sedation and 395 in the intravenous sedation groups. In the inhaled sedation group, 49.9% to 55.4% of patients received concomitant intravenous sedation on any day during the first 14 days after randomization. At hospital discharge, 161 of 379 patients (42.5%) in the inhaled sedation group had died, compared with 171 of 390 patients (43.8%) in the intravenous sedation group (risk ratio, 0.98 [95% CI, 0.84 to 1.14]; P = .85). There was no effect modification in prespecified subgroup analyses for age, sex, and COVID-19 status. ICU-, ventilator-, and hospital-free days were similar between groups. The inhaled sedation group received more adjunctive therapies for hypoxemia (239 [63.9%] vs 214 [55.0%]; between-group difference, 8.89% [95% CI, 1.95% to 15.83%]) and had fewer delirium- and coma-free days (between-group difference, −0.95 [95% CI, −1.69 to −0.22]). There was no difference in quality-of-life and disability scores between groups. Conclusions and Relevance In mechanically ventilated adults with AHRF, an inhaled sedation strategy using isoflurane with intravenous adjuncts as clinically needed did not reduce hospital mortality compared with an intravenous sedation strategy. Trial Registration ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT04415060

Fluid Therapy in Mechanically Ventilated Critically Ill Adult Patients
summary_zh: 研究ICU机械通气重症成人患者液体治疗实践。调查全球液体治疗剂量、指征和类型。分析不同国家ICU液体治疗现状。
summary_en: This study investigates fluid therapy practices in critically ill adult patients with mechanical ventilation in ICUs. It surveys global fluid therapy dosages, indications, and types, and analyzes fluid therapy practices across different countries' ICUs.
insights: 全球液体治疗实践差异显著
需标准化液体治疗指南
不同国家ICU液体治疗现状各异
insights_en: Significant differences in global fluid therapy practices
Standardized fluid therapy guidelines are needed
Diverse fluid therapy practices across different countries' ICUs
abstract: Importance Fluid therapy is ubiquitous in the intensive care unit (ICU) but carries risks, especially in mechanically ventilated patients. Contemporary global practice across dose, indication, and type is unknown. Objective To characterize ICU fluid practices in mechanically ventilated adults. Design, Setting, and Participants International prospective observational cohort study between April 2024 and July 2025, across 206 ICUs in 41 countries on 6 continents. Consecutive adult patients receiving invasive mechanical ventilation within 3 days of ICU admission and ventilated 24 hours or more. Exclusion criteria were age younger than 16 years and transfer under mechanical ventilation from another ICU. Exposures Fluid volume, indication, and type after intubation. Main Outcomes and Measures Key measures included (1) total infused volume and daily fluid balance over 7 days after intubation; (2) the indication for fluid therapy over the first 3 days after intubation; (3) the proportion of total administered fluid volume attributable to each fluid type over the first 3 days after intubation. Results Among 2454 patients analyzed (median age, 63 years [IQR, 49-73 years]; 63.6% [1560] male), median daily fluid input peaked on day 1 at 3.0 L (IQR, 2.2-4.0 L) and declined to 2.6 L (IQR, 1.8-3.5 L) through day 6. Daily fluid balance (median, 0.9 L; IQR, 0.1-1.9 L on day 1) decreased to less than 0.3 L (IQR, −0.5 to 1.2 L) by day 3 and remained near-neutral through day 6. Maintenance and replacement fluids (to meet daily requirements and to correct ongoing losses; 31.9%) and creep fluids (to deliver medications and maintain catheter patency; 30.9%) were the primary indications, whereas resuscitation (to restore circulating blood volume; 16.0%) accounted for a smaller proportion. Isotonic balanced crystalloids (48.9%) and isotonic saline (0.9% sodium chloride) (27.0%) were common; colloids were rare (1.3%). Substantial between-site variation persisted after adjustment for case-mix. Conclusions and Relevance In this prospective international cohort study, fluid therapy varied widely among mechanically ventilated critically ill patients, with maintenance and creep fluids—rather than resuscitation fluids—accounting for most total volume.
