Further high-quality studies are needed to confirm
High risk of AKI after surgical source control
abstract: IMPORTANCE International guidelines recommend dobutamine for management of septic shock and cardiac dysfunction with persistent hypoperfusion in adults based on very low–certainty evidence. Randomized trials are lacking on the effect of intraoperative dobutamine combined with norepinephrine vs norepinephrine on postoperative outcomes in patients with septic shock undergoing surgical source control. OBJECTIVE To determine whether intraoperative dobutamine combined with norepinephrine reduces acute kidney injury (AKI) within 7 postoperative days in patients with septic shock undergoing surgical source control. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS This randomized, open-label clinical trial in 39 tertiary hospitals in China enrolled adults with septic shock who were undergoing surgical source control between June 2024 and August 2025. Follow-up ended on November 15, 2025. INTERVENTION Intraoperative, intravenous infusion of dobutamine (up to 5 µg/kg/min) combined with norepinephrine vs norepinephrine alone. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES The primary outcome was new-onset AKI or worsening of preoperative AKI within 7 days after surgery, defined using Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) criteria. The 11 secondary outcomes included Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA) score on postoperative day 1 and urine output 1 hour post intervention. RESULTS Among 584 patients (median [IQR] age, 67.5 [55.0-76.0] years; 192 [32.9%] females), new-onset or worsening AKI within 7 postoperative days occurred in 22.8% (66/290) randomized to receive dobutamine plus norepinephrine vs 34.7% (102/294) randomized to receive norepinephrine alone (adjusted risk ratio [ARR], 0.64 [95% CI, 0.49-0.83]). No significant differences were observed in 9 of the 11 secondary outcomes. SOFA scores on postoperative day 1 (adjusted difference, −0.53 [95% CI, −0.98 to −0.07]) were lower and urine output 1 hour post intervention (adjusted difference, 0.55 [95% CI, 0.03 to 1.07] mL/kg/h) was higher in the dobutamine plus norepinephrine group. Stage 2 and 3 AKI were lower in the dobutamine plus norepinephrine group compared with the norepinephrine alone group (stage 2: 4.8% vs 9.9%; ARR, 0.48 [95% CI, 0.26-0.88]; stage 3: 7.9% vs 13.6%; ARR, 0.56 [95% CI, 0.35-0.91]). Tachycardia (heart rate >100/min) occurred more frequently in patients receiving dobutamine and norepinephrine than norepinephrine alone. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE Among adult patients with septic shock undergoing surgical source control, intraoperative dobutamine combined with norepinephrine reduced the incidence of new-onset or worsening AKI within 7 postoperative days compared with norepinephrine. TRIAL REGISTRATION ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT06462313

title: Etiology
Intraoperative Dobutamine Plus Norepinephrine to Prevent Postoperative Acute Kidney Injury in Septic Shock
Divergent genomic evolution in astrocytomas and oligodendrogliomas
summary_zh: 研究通过全基因组测序分析IDH突变胶质瘤。发现基因突变与肿瘤进展相关，揭示疾病遗传驱动因素。
summary_en: This study analyzes IDH-mutant gliomas using whole-genome sequencing. It finds genetic mutations associated with tumor progression, revealing genetic drivers of the disease.
insights: 创新点：全基因组测序分析胶质瘤，揭示遗传驱动因素
方法亮点：长期追踪肿瘤样本，提供纵向数据
关键发现：基因突变与肿瘤进展相关
insights_en: Novelty: Whole-genome sequencing of gliomas to reveal genetic drivers
Method highlight: Longitudinal tracking of tumor samples to provide longitudinal data
Key finding: Genetic mutations associated with tumor progression
abstract: Astrocytomas and oligodendrogliomas are isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH)-mutant gliomas that most commonly arise in adults under the age of 50 and exhibit variable responses to treatment1–3. To understand the genetic drivers of disease progression, here we used whole-genome and whole-exome sequencing to characterize longitudinally collected tumour specimens from 183 patients with IDH-mutant glioma. Samples were collected through the Glioma Longitudinal Analysis (GLASS) Consortium4. Most primary surgery samples were classified as grade 2 on the basis of histology (73% for astrocytomas and 93% for oligodendrogliomas). We validated known genomic markers of tumour progression, including hypermutation and homozygous deletion of CDKN2A or CDKN2B (hereafter, CDKN2A/B)5, and discovered genetic alterations that distinguish between the evolutionary trajectories of astrocytomas and those of oligodendrogliomas. Mutations in phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K) and NOTCH1 were newly acquired in recurrent oligodendrogliomas, regardless of treatment, and were associated with an increased tumour mutational burden. In recurrent astrocytomas, however, again irrespective of treatment, acquired focal oncogene amplifications and CDKN2A/B homozygous deletions were associated with an increase in chromosomal imbalances, which converged with markers of chromosomal instability such as chromothripsis and whole-genome doubling. In both types of IDH-mutant glioma, we observed a convergence of acquired alterations, genome-wide changes and worse patient outcomes, suggesting that treatment-refractory clones were being selected. Treatment with temozolomide was associated with the mutational signatures SBS11 and SBS119 in both tumour types, whereas the radiotherapy-associated ID8 signature increased in astrocytomas specifically. We show that the genomes of oligodendrogliomas and astrocytomas adapt to the selective pressures of tumour progression and treatment in distinct ways, suggesting that oligodendrogliomas and astrocytomas differ in their responses to treatment-induced DNA damage. Longitudinal genomic analyses in patients with astrocytoma or oligodendrioglioma suggest that these two types of tumour differ in the mechanisms by which they become resistant to treatment, with astrocytomas accumulating copy-number alterations and chromosomal instability markers but oligodendrogliomas acquiring new driver mutations.

title: Engineered TYK2 dependence enables myeloid-selective IL-10 receptor agonism
summary_zh: 研究利用TYK2依赖性设计IL-10受体激动剂。该激动剂选择性抑制髓系细胞，避免T细胞激活。
summary_en: This study designs an IL-10 receptor agonist that utilizes TYK2 dependence. The agonist selectively inhibits myeloid cells while avoiding T cell activation.
insights: 创新点：利用TYK2依赖性设计IL-10受体激动剂
方法亮点：纳米抗体技术，提高药物选择性
关键发现：激动剂选择性抑制髓系细胞，避免T细胞激活
insights_en: Novelty: Designing an IL-10 receptor agonist utilizing TYK2 dependence
Method highlight: Nanobody technology to improve drug selectivity
Key finding: Agonist selectively inhibits myeloid cells while avoiding T cell activation
abstract: Abstract Interleukin-10 (IL-10) is a central anti-inflammatory cytokine that suppresses immune responses in myeloid cells but can also activate T cells, limiting its therapeutic use in chronic inflammatory diseases owing to narrow efficacy windows and dose-limiting toxicities 1–5 . Here we show that myeloid and T cells differ in their dependence on JAK-family kinase pairing for IL-10 signalling and function. We took advantage of this differential kinase dependence to engineer a tetravalent nanobody-based myeloid-selective IL-10 receptor agonist (msIL-10R agonist) that fully recapitulates IL-10’s potent suppression of monocytes, macrophages and dendritic cells while avoiding stimulation of T cells. Cryo-electron microscopy structural analysis reveals a distinct receptor cross-linking geometry of the msIL-10R agonist compared with native IL-10 family cytokines. This tetravalent architecture renders signalling strictly TYK2-dependent and highly sensitive to IL-10Rα and IL-10Rβ receptor abundance, thereby conferring selective activity in myeloid cells. This msIL-10R agonist reduces inflammation in humanized mouse models of lipopolysaccharide challenge, delayed-type hypersensitivity and colitis. A humanized version exhibits IgG-like pharmacokinetics, sustained receptor occupancy and durable myeloid suppression up to 30 days without T cell activation or haematological toxicities in non-human primates. These findings establish a geometry-based strategy for achieving cell-type-selective cytokine signalling and identify the msIL-10R agonist as a therapeutic candidate for myeloid-driven inflammatory diseases, including inflammatory bowel diseases.

title: A microexon regulatory code reveals autism-linked genetic variation
summary_zh: 研究通过转录组分析发现新微外显子，揭示自闭症相关基因变异。
summary_en: This study detects hundreds of new microexons through transcriptome profiling, revealing autism-linked genetic variations.
insights: 创新点：发现大量新微外显子，扩展自闭症基因变异谱
方法亮点：机器学习预测神经元特异性外显子
关键发现：新微外显子与自闭症相关
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of a large number of new microexons, expanding the autism genetic variation spectrum
Method highlight: Machine learning to predict neuronally specific exons
Key finding: New microexons associated with autism
abstract: Abstract Neuronal microexons are a highly conserved class of alternative splicing events enriched in genes with critical functions in nervous system biology 1,2 . Microexon splicing is often disrupted in the brains of autistic individuals, and mice with microexon deficiencies display autism-like phenotypes 1,3,4 . However, the full landscape of microexons is not known, and the impact of genetic variation on these exons has not been systematically investigated. Here, through extensive transcriptome profiling, we detect hundreds of new microexons, including many with neuronal subtype-specific splicing patterns, and others that activate nonsense-mediated mRNA decay. Using machine learning, we define a sequence code predictive of neuronally spliced microexons and use this to identify critical regulatory elements surrounding the expanded microexon repertoire. This code further reveals genomic variants predicted to alter microexon splicing in individuals affected by autism, with rare variants having the strongest estimated impact. These variants are mostly detected in idiopathic individuals and are associated with autism status. They also converge on synaptic and other autism-linked genes, as well as genes not previously linked to autism. Our results collectively define an expanded repertoire of microexons, delineate their regulatory code, and pinpoint variants predicted to affect their splicing, with implications for the disruption of functions central to neuronal biology and brain disorders.

title: Multi-AI agent framework reveals the “oxide gatekeeper” in aluminum nanoparticle oxidation
summary_zh: 研究利用多智能体框架揭示铝纳米粒子氧化的原子机制。
summary_en: This study uses a multi-agent framework to reveal the atomic mechanism of aluminum nanoparticle oxidation.
insights: 创新点：多智能体框架应用于材料科学，揭示氧化机制
方法亮点：结合机器学习，提高模型准确性
关键发现：揭示“氧化物门控”机制
insights_en: Novelty: Application of multi-agent framework in materials science to reveal oxidation mechanism
Method highlight: Combination with machine learning to improve model accuracy
Key finding: Revealing the 'oxide gatekeeper' mechanism
abstract: Aluminum nanoparticles (ANPs) are among the most energy-dense solid fuels, yet the atomic mechanisms governing their transition from passivated particles to highly reactive states remain elusive. This stems from a fundamental computational bottleneck: Ab initio methods offer quantum-level fidelity but are restricted to small spatiotemporal scales (<500 atoms, picoseconds), while empirical force fields lack the reactive fidelity required for complex combustion environments. Here, we bridge this gap by employing a human-audited, multiagent framework to make the development and validation of a task-specific machine learning potential (MLP) more traceable and auditable. The workflow coordinates active learning, model evaluation, validation evidence, and human expert review, while leaving scientific interpretation and model-use decisions under researcher control. This collaborative cycle ensures quantum mechanical accuracy while exhibiting near-linear scalability. Strikingly, our simulations reveal a temperature-regulated dual-mode oxidation mechanism: At moderate temperatures, the oxide shell acts as a dynamic “gatekeeper,” regulating oxidation through a “breathing mode” of transient nanochannels; above a critical threshold, a “rupture mode” leads to shell failure and rapid combustion. Importantly, we resolve a decades-old controversy by demonstrating that aluminum cation outward diffusion, rather than oxygen transport, dominates mass transfer in studied regimes, with diffusion coefficients consistently exceeding those of oxygen by 2 to 3 orders of magnitude. These results provide an atomistic framework for interpreting ANP reactivity and illustrate how human-audited agentic workflows can make domain-specific reactive MLP development and deployment more reproducible.

title: A GPRC5B–Fyn signaling axis regulates VRAC activity by targeting LRRC8A
summary_zh: 研究识别GPRC5B-Fyn信号轴通过LRRC8A调控VRAC活性。
summary_en: This study identifies a GPRC5B-Fyn signaling axis that regulates VRAC activity by targeting LRRC8A.
insights: 创新点：发现GPRC5B-Fyn信号轴调控VRAC活性
方法亮点：细胞和分子生物学技术，验证信号通路
关键发现：LRRC8A是调控VRAC活性的关键分子
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of GPRC5B-Fyn signaling axis regulating VRAC activity
Method highlight: Cell and molecular biology techniques to validate the signaling pathway
Key finding: LRRC8A is a key molecule in regulating VRAC activity
abstract: The mechanisms by which physiological signals gate the volume-regulated anion channel (VRAC) remain poorly understood. Here, we identify a GPRC5B–Fyn signaling axis that directly controls VRAC activation by targeting the essential subunit LRRC8A. We found that the orphan G protein–coupled receptor GPRC5B binds LRRC8A and recruits the Src family kinase Fyn, which in turn suppresses hypotonicity-evoked VRAC activation. Disrupting Fyn binding to GPRC5B or substituting a predicted phosphorylation site on LRRC8A (Y362) abolishes this inhibition. Across primary astrocytes and reconstituted systems, GPRC5B prevents the intersubunit conformational rearrangements associated with VRAC opening without altering basal channel expression. In astrocytes, the MLC protein MLC1 partially sequesters GPRC5B, thereby reducing the GPRC5B–LRRC8A interaction, providing a mechanistic link to VRAC dysfunction in megalencephalic leukoencephalopathy. These results reveal a receptor-kinase-channel pathway that gates VRAC through Y362-dependent modulation of LRRC8A, establishing a molecular framework for VRAC regulation and its disruption in disease.

title: Global proteolysis during starvation governs proteome remodeling and a survival–regrowth trade-off in bacteria
summary_zh: 研究揭示细菌在饥饿状态下全球蛋白质降解调控蛋白质组重塑。
summary_en: This study reveals that global proteolysis during starvation governs proteome remodeling in bacteria.
insights: 创新点：揭示饥饿状态下蛋白质降解调控机制
方法亮点：利用大肠杆菌模型研究蛋白质组变化
关键发现：蛋白质降解与生存-生长权衡相关
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the mechanism of protein degradation governing during starvation
Method highlight: Using E. coli as a model to study proteome changes
Key finding: Protein degradation associated with a survival-regrowth trade-off
abstract: Starving bacteria must synthesize stress proteins to survive, but how protein synthesis persists in the absence of nutrient influx is unclear. We show that in Escherichia coli , carbon starvation triggers large-scale proteome remodeling, with global proteolysis supplying both the amino acids (AAs) and ATP for protein synthesis. This remodeling occurs in two phases, with a short preparatory phase relying on constitutive proteolytic machinery and fueled by residual carbon waste, and a more extended phase, relying on starvation-induced protein components synthesized during the preparatory phase and fueled by AA catabolism. The starvation-induced protein degradation (SPD) program dominating the extended phase depends on YeaG, a little-known, broadly conserved protein highly expressed in stationary phase under the control of the general stress sigma factor RpoS. SPD fuels the synthesis of stress proteins, including those in the RpoS regulon and AA catabolic enzymes, markedly enhancing survival and accounting for much of the viability benefit conferred by RpoS during carbon starvation. However, in mutants where an energy source can be supplemented without enabling biomass growth, SPD and the accompanying protein synthesis are largely dispensable for survival, indicating that a primary physiological function of the synthesized stress proteins is to conserve or recycle energy during carbon starvation. Because SPD targets biosynthetic enzymes nonspecifically, proteome remodeling via SPD imposes a fundamental trade-off between long-term survival and short-term metabolic activity, manifested as a lag before regrowth upon nutrient replenishment. Together, these findings establish SPD as a general physiological strategy shaping protein synthesis and survival in nongrowing bacteria.

title: Mechanistic versus descriptive interpretation of brain activity pattern reconstruction
summary_zh: 研究比较了脑活动模式重建的机制与描述性解释。使用几何本征模态进行重建。发现几何本征模态准确拟合脑活动。
summary_en: This study compares the mechanistic and descriptive interpretations of brain activity pattern reconstruction. Geometric eigenmodes are used for reconstruction. Geometric eigenmodes are found to accurately fit brain activity patterns.
insights: 创新点：提出几何本征模态作为脑功能模型的新视角。
方法亮点：采用功能MRI数据验证几何本征模态的准确性。
关键发现：几何本征模态可能混淆描述性和机制性解释。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes geometric eigenmodes as a new perspective for brain function models.
Method highlight: Validates the accuracy of geometric eigenmodes using functional MRI data.
Key finding: Geometric eigenmodes may conflate descriptive and mechanistic interpretations.
abstract: The geometric eigenmodes, derived from the shape of the cortical surface, have been suggested as a better model for explaining brain function due to their high accuracy in reconstructing patterns of both spontaneous and stimulus-evoked brain activity patterns captured by functional MRI, when contrasted with alternative models including structural connectome derived bases. While a descriptive representation offers valuable utility for neuroimaging studies, it is necessary to examine the extent to which it supports a mechanistic explanation for human brain function. Although the observation that geometric eigenmodes accurately fit brain activity is intriguing, we argue that accepting them as a model of brain function risks conflating descriptive and mechanistic interpretations. While a representation that effectively describes the underlying geometry is inherently adept at fitting patterns within that geometric space; it does not necessarily shed light on mechanisms that give rise to the brain’s functional attributes. To this end, we provide two lines of empirical results: a) geometric eigenmodes demonstrate a high flexibility when fit to a range of manipulated patterns, and b) localized parcel-based representations can reconstruct activity patterns as well. Based on those results, theoretical considerations, and previous data, we argue that more consideration is needed regarding the complementary roles of descriptive representation and mechanistic explanation in neuroimaging research. While we recognize the potential role of the brain’s geometry in influencing its dynamics, assertions regarding its efficacy should be weighed against its inherent lack of specificity, biological interpretability, and anatomical evidence.

title: Retraction for Bonetti et al., Decoding the elite soccer player’s psychological profile
Estimating the threat of AI-agent responding across online survey platforms
summary_zh: 研究评估了AI代理在在线调查平台上的威胁。开发了AI检测测试。发现不同平台AI测试失败率差异大。
summary_en: This study assesses the threat of AI agents on online survey platforms. AI detection tests were developed. Found wide variation in failure rates of AI tests across platforms.
insights: 创新点：提出了一种新的AI检测方法。
方法亮点：通过在线平台收集数据，评估AI代理的威胁。
关键发现：未检测到的AI代理可能影响在线调查结果。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed a new AI detection method.
Method highlight: Collected data from online platforms to assess the threat of AI agents.
Key finding: Undetected AI agents may impact the results of online surveys.
abstract: Recent research and advances in LLMs have led to widespread concern that AI agents could pose as human online survey-takers. However, it remains unclear how prevalent AI agents are on survey research platforms and how to effectively detect AI agents. We validated a series of AI detection tests that effectively separated verified-human participants from both prompted commercial and purpose-built AI agents. Using these tests, we collected surveys on seven online platforms and find wide variation in rates of respondents failing AI tests, ranging from 6 to 41% across platforms (compared to a 2.4% false-positive rate for in-person human participants). We further demonstrate that undetected AI agents can impact the results of online surveys. Our findings suggest that while there is an urgent need for AI detection tests and consistent, systematic monitoring of data quality on online platforms, some platforms currently appear to provide data with a low rate of AI agents.

title: Multivalent weak contacts shape chaperone–nascent protein interactions
summary_zh: 研究揭示了多价弱相互作用塑造伴侣蛋白与新生蛋白相互作用。使用单分子荧光和光镊技术观察。发现触发因子在核糖体上的结合。
summary_en: This study reveals that multivalent weak contacts shape chaperone-nascent protein interactions. Single-molecule fluorescence and optical tweezers techniques were used. Trigger factor binding to ribosomes was observed.
insights: 创新点：揭示了触发因子与新生链的动态相互作用。
方法亮点：采用单分子技术直接观察伴侣蛋白与客户蛋白的相互作用。
关键发现：触发因子在核糖体上的结合时间与链长度相关。
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed the dynamic interactions of trigger factor with nascent chains.
Method highlight: Employed single-molecule techniques to directly observe chaperone-client protein interactions.
Key finding: Trigger factor dwell times on ribosomes are related to chain length.
abstract: Molecular chaperones interact with non-native proteins, playing crucial roles in preventing misfolding and in enabling efficient folding in the cellular environment. Trigger factor is a bacterial chaperone that binds to ribosomes, interacting with nascent polypeptides emerging from the ribosome and guiding their early folding steps. In contrast to the central role of the chaperone in promoting folding of newly synthesized proteins, its dynamic interactions with nascent chains emerging from the ribosome remain poorly understood. Here, we use single-molecule fluorescence and optical tweezers approaches to directly observe and characterize trigger factor interactions with a ribosome-bound client protein at increasing chain lengths. We find that trigger factor dwell times on ribosome–nascent chain complexes increase non-monotonically with nascent chain length, and that binding to nascent proteins is best described by a combination of multiple weak, dynamic interactions that are established after the chaperone docks onto the ribosome and evolve during polypeptide elongation. Application of mechanical force perturbs trigger factor binding, supporting a multivalent interaction model. This binding mode may help to stabilize nascent proteins against misfolding while allowing them to dynamically sample conformational space in search of their native structures.

title: Distinct functional open states of the polymodal nociceptor TRPV1
summary_zh: 研究揭示了多模态伤害感受器TRPV1的功能性开放状态。发现TRPV1激活剂稳定不同的开放状态。观察到刺激特异性孔构象变化。
summary_en: This study reveals distinct functional open states of the polymodal nociceptor TRPV1. Found TRPV1 activators stabilize different open states. Stimulus-specific changes in pore conformation were observed.
insights: 创新点：发现TRPV1具有不同的功能性开放状态。
方法亮点：使用结构模型和荧光记录直接观察孔构象变化。
关键发现：刺激协同激活导致通道开放速度减慢。
insights_en: Novelty: Found TRPV1 to have distinct functional open states.
Method highlight: Used structural models and fluorescence recordings to directly observe pore conformation changes.
Key finding: Coactivation by two stimuli slows channel opening rather than producing synergistic acceleration.
abstract: The polymodal nociceptor TRPV1 integrates diverse physical and chemical stimuli, yet whether these inputs drive a common activated state remains unresolved. Here, we show that TRPV1 activators stabilize functionally distinct open states that yield discrete single-channel conductance levels. These functional states appear to arise from distinct open-pore conformations, as evidenced by anomalous mole fraction effect measurements. Structurally, stimulus-specific changes in pore conformation were directly observed using site-directed fluorescence recordings, consistent with Rosetta-guided structural models. Notably, coactivation by two stimuli markedly slows channel opening rather than producing synergistic acceleration, suggesting potential conformational incompatibility across subunits. Together, these findings define TRPV1 gating as a stimulus-partitioned, multistate process and highlight opportunities for selective modulation of TRPV1 in pain management.

title: In This Issue
An integrative transcriptomic atlas of ALS and aging skeletal muscle defines shared and distinct molecular programs of degeneration
summary_zh: 研究构建了ALS和衰老骨骼肌的转录组图谱。发现转录组差异与疾病和衰老相关。识别出疾病特异性肌核状态。
summary_en: This study constructs an integrative transcriptomic atlas of ALS and aging skeletal muscle. Found transcriptomic differences associated with disease and aging. Identified disease-specific myonuclear states.
insights: 创新点：构建了ALS和衰老骨骼肌的转录组图谱。
方法亮点：结合结构功能和转录组分析。
关键发现：识别出疾病特异性肌核状态。
insights_en: Novelty: Constructed an integrative transcriptomic atlas of ALS and aging skeletal muscle.
Method highlight: Integrated structural, functional, and transcriptomic analyses.
Key finding: Identified disease-specific myonuclear states.
abstract: Skeletal muscle atrophy and weakness resulting from loss of motor neuron innervation are shared hallmarks of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and age-associated sarcopenia. However, muscle wasting in ALS is rapid and severe, whereas sarcopenia progresses gradually over decades, peaking at an advanced age. The molecular mechanisms underlying muscle wasting in these conditions remain incompletely defined. Here, we used the SOD1 G93A ALS mouse model and wild-type mice across the lifespan to generate an integrated single-nucleus transcriptomic atlas of skeletal muscle, mapping changes associated with ALS and aging. This atlas is complemented by structural and functional analyses. Our results identify transcriptionally distinct condition-specific myonuclear states, including disease-responsive programs within synaptic myonuclei at the neuromuscular junction, that are shared or distinct between the two conditions. Notably, at early stages, muscle from ALS mice exhibits molecular hallmarks of aged muscle at the myofiber level, indicating premature aging and reinforcing aging as a risk factor in ALS. At advanced disease stages and in old age, myonuclear subpopulations follow similar degenerative pathways in fast glycolytic fibers, consistent with their loss in both conditions. However, a distinct ALS-enriched myonuclei subpopulation displays uniquely regulated genes not observed in aged muscle, potentially underlying the more rapid and severe pathology observed in ALS. This atlas maps shared and divergent mechanisms of muscle degeneration in ALS and sarcopenia and provides a resource for identifying therapeutic targets tailored to each condition.

title: Microbial niche partitioning explains N 2 O distributions and cycling in marine oxygen minimum zones
summary_zh: 研究解释了海洋缺氧区N2O分布和循环的微生物生态位分区。发现微生物群落产生和消耗N2O。模型显示氮循环代谢物间的相互作用。
summary_en: This study explains N2O distributions and cycling in marine oxygen minimum zones through microbial niche partitioning. Found microbial communities produce and consume N2O. Models show interactions among nitrogen-cycling metabolisms.
insights: 创新点：提出微生物生态位分区解释N2O分布。
方法亮点：将基于特征的生态系统模型嵌入到涡旋解析模拟中。
关键发现：氮循环代谢物间的相互作用影响N2O循环。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed microbial niche partitioning to explain N2O distributions.
Method highlight: Embedded a trait-based ecosystem model into an eddy-resolving simulation.
Key finding: Interactions among nitrogen-cycling metabolisms affect N2O cycling.
abstract: Oxygen minimum zones (OMZs) are marine hotspots for cycling and emission of the powerful greenhouse gas nitrous oxide (N 2 O). Steep redox gradients host diverse microbial communities that produce and consume N 2 O, generating a characteristic vertical distribution, with low concentrations in anoxic cores and supersaturated accumulation in surrounding oxyclines. Although the accumulation is commonly attributed to stronger O 2 inhibition of N 2 O consumption than production, this differential inhibition is not consistently observed, suggesting that interactions among nitrogen-cycling metabolisms may provide additional mechanisms. To evaluate the ecological controls on the N 2 O profile, we embed a trait-based ecosystem model into an eddy-resolving simulation of the Eastern Tropical South Pacific OMZ. In this framework, redox energetics, metabolite exchange, competition, and grazing structure microbial growth, setting emergent niches of microbial functional types, particularly aerobic ammonia oxidizers and diverse anaerobic denitrifiers that mediate N 2 O cycling. In the anoxic core, cross-feeding tightly couples denitrifiers that produce and consume N 2 O, maintaining low concentrations. As O 2 increases in the oxycline, competition with aerobic metabolisms and intensified grazing gradually exclude denitrifiers. However, because they draw on more abundant substrates, N 2 O-producing denitrifiers persist to higher O 2 than N 2 O consumers, reflecting the vulnerability of populations dependent on intermediate metabolites. This ecological decoupling drives N 2 O accumulation and captures the characteristic double-peaked vertical structure without imposing physiological O 2 intolerance thresholds. More broadly, by revealing how niche partitioning and producer–consumer coupling shape other features of OMZ biogeochemistry, these results provide a basis for projecting future shifts in marine nitrogen loss and N 2 O emissions.

title: Environmental chemical mixtures reprogram mammary epithelial development to epigenetic states associated with breast cancer
summary_zh: 研究揭示了环境化学混合物重新编程乳腺上皮发育。发现不同环境化学物质影响乳腺形态发生。低剂量混合物诱导乳腺癌相关转录程序。
summary_en: This study reveals that environmental chemical mixtures reprogram mammary epithelial development. Found different environmental chemicals perturb different aspects of mammary morphogenesis. Low-dose mixtures induce transcriptional programs associated with breast cancer.
insights: 创新点：发现环境化学混合物影响乳腺上皮发育。
方法亮点：建立3D人乳腺器官高内涵筛选平台。
关键发现：低剂量混合物诱导乳腺癌相关转录程序。
insights_en: Novelty: Found environmental chemical mixtures to affect mammary epithelial development.
Method highlight: Established a 3D human breast organoid high-content screening platform.
Key finding: Low-dose mixtures induce transcriptional programs associated with breast cancer.
abstract: Environmental exposures occur as complex mixtures, yet the mechanisms by which they alter human tissue development and generate cancer-relevant tissue states remain poorly defined. Here, we establish a physiologically relevant 3D human breast organoid high-content screening platform that relates exposure-induced developmental disruption to cancer-relevant cell states. Screening of structurally diverse environmental chemicals as single agents and mixtures reveals heterogeneous but reproducible developmental responses, indicating that distinct environmental chemicals perturb different aspects of mammary morphogenesis. Focusing on bisphenols, we show that a low-dose mixture (BPA, BPS, and BPF; 3BPX) disrupts organoid development and induces transcriptional programs characterized by extracellular matrix remodeling, epithelial plasticity, and partial epithelial–mesenchymal transition, accompanied by widespread DNA methylation remodeling. A 3BPX exposure signature maps to ER+ luminal breast cancers and is preferentially enriched in invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC), a subtype characterized by epithelial plasticity. The 3BPX-associated methylation signature is detectable in primary tumors and adjacent normal tissue and is enriched in ILC. Together, these findings show that environmentally relevant chemical mixtures induce heterogeneous developmental perturbations that converge on conserved transcriptional and epigenetic programs associated with epithelial plasticity and tissue remodeling. These exposure-associated signatures are represented in defined epithelial and stromal compartments in human breast cancers, supporting a model in which developmental exposures may establish field-like, cancer-relevant tissue states.

title: Synthetic reconstitution of planar polarity initiation reveals principles of symmetry breaking across scales
summary_zh: 研究通过合成重建平面极性起始过程。发现集体迁移作为对称破缺的线索。细胞直接解释迁移线索并对其敏感。
summary_en: This study synthesizes the reconstitution of planar polarity initiation. Found collective migration as the symmetry-breaking cue. Individual cells directly interpret the migration cue and remain sensitive to it.
insights: 创新点：通过合成方法重建平面极性起始。
方法亮点：使用工程上皮细胞进行体外重建。
关键发现：细胞直接解释迁移线索。
insights_en: Novelty: Reconstitutes planar polarity initiation using synthetic methods.
Method highlight: Uses engineered epithelial cells for ex vivo reconstitution.
Key finding: Individual cells directly interpret the migration cue.
abstract: Development often relies on molecular prepatterning over large tissue scales, and how these patterns emerge is an essential question. Planar cell polarity (PCP), manifested as asymmetric distribution of junctional proteins within individual cells and coordinated across entire tissues, is a key module controlling tissue morphogenesis and organization. How tissues break symmetry to initiate PCP remains unknown. By reconstituting polarity initiation ex vivo using engineered epithelial cells, we found that collective migration acts as the symmetry-breaking cue, inducing front–back enrichment of CELSR junctions and establishing aligned multicellular CELSR polarity. Individual cells directly interpret the migration cue and remain sensitive to it. Strikingly, CELSR polarity arises without reciprocal VANGL–FZD interactions, identifying CELSR as the driver for polarity initiation. These findings reveal that collective migration initiates and coordinates PCP across molecular, cellular, and tissue scales, demonstrating that morphogenetic events act as a trigger for spatial pattern emergence.

title: LEAP2 mediates long-term inhibition of orexigenic neurons of the hypothalamus in mice
summary_zh: 研究揭示LEAP2通过GHSR受体抑制摄食，作用于下丘脑弓状核。LEAP2在脑区及脑脊液中存在，提示其外周起源和中央保留。实验表明LEAP2与GHSR结合持久，限制ghrelin作用。
summary_en: This study reveals that LEAP2 inhibits feeding via the GHSR receptor, acting on the hypothalamic arcuate nucleus. LEAP2 is present in the brain region and cerebrospinal fluid, suggesting peripheral origin and central retention. Experiments show that LEAP2 binds to GHSR persistently, limiting ghrelin action.
insights: 创新点：LEAP2通过GHSR抑制摄食
方法亮点：多方法验证LEAP2作用
关键发现：LEAP2与GHSR结合持久
insights_en: Novelty: LEAP2 inhibits feeding via GHSR
Method highlight: Multi-method validation of LEAP2 action
Key finding: Persistent binding of LEAP2 to GHSR
abstract: Liver-expressed antimicrobial peptide 2 (LEAP2) acts via the growth hormone secretagogue receptor (GHSR) to reduce food intake, yet the central mechanisms underlying its anorectic effects remain unclear. Here, we show that circulating LEAP2 accesses discrete brain regions, including the arcuate nucleus of the hypothalamus (ARH), where it targets orexigenic AgRP/NPY neurons. Despite the negligible local expression in the hypothalamus, LEAP2 peptide is detectable in this brain region and in the cerebrospinal fluid, suggesting peripheral origin and central retention. Using fluorescent tracers, in vivo, ex vivo, and in vitro approaches indicate that LEAP2 exhibits prolonged binding to GHSR at the plasma membrane without promoting receptor internalization, thereby limiting subsequent ghrelin action. Using male mice, we found that central or systemic LEAP2 pretreatment results in a sustained inhibition of ghrelin-induced feeding that lasts for several hours after pretreatment. Notably, LEAP2 also suppresses food intake and c-Fos induction triggered by pharmacogenetic activation of AgRP neurons, indicating a broader inhibitory control over these circuits. Together, our findings establish that LEAP2 acts as a persistent inhibitor of hypothalamic orexigenic centers, providing a mechanistic framework for its long-lasting anorectic effects. These results highlight LEAP2 as a key regulator of energy balance and support its potential as a therapeutic target for obesity and metabolic disorders.

title: FOXG1 spatiotemporally orchestrates subtype fate specification and patch/matrix identity of striatal spiny projection neurons
summary_zh: 研究揭示FOXG1调控下丘脑神经元命运，促进dSPN和iSPN命运，抑制eSPN命运。单细胞RNA测序显示eSPNs与iSPNs发育相似。Foxg1缺失导致dSPNs和iSPNs命运改变。
summary_en: This study reveals that FOXG1 regulates the fate of hypothalamic neurons, promoting dSPN and iSPN fates while suppressing eSPN fate. Single-cell RNA sequencing shows that eSPNs share developmental similarities with iSPNs. Deletion of Foxg1 leads to altered fates of dSPNs and iSPNs.
insights: 创新点：FOXG1调控神经元命运
方法亮点：单细胞RNA测序分析
关键发现：Foxg1缺失改变神经元命运
insights_en: Novelty: FOXG1 regulates neuron fate
Method highlight: Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis
Key finding: Foxg1 deletion alters neuron fate
abstract: The striatum consists of three main spiny projection neuron subtypes, direct-pathway neurons (dSPNs), indirect-pathway neurons (iSPNs), and recently identified eccentric striatal neurons (eSPNs) with these SPNs organized into two complementary compartments, the patch and the matrix. However, the cellular basis underlying subtype specification especially that of eSPNs, and mechanisms governing the complementary patterning remain unclear. Here, employing single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) combined with loss-of-function we reveal that eSPNs share more developmental similarities with iSPNs and the transcription factor Foxg1 promotes dSPN and iSPN fates but suppresses eSPN fate in ventral region of the lateral ganglionic eminence lineage. Deletion of Foxg1 in progenitors forces both dSPNs and iSPNs into an eSPN fate. While postmitotic Foxg1 deletion impairs patch/matrix identity and leads to SPN aggregation. We identify FOXG1-driven transcriptional programs and key transcription factors that specify each striatal SPN subtype and patch/matrix identity, and uncover FOXG1 directly regulated cell migration- and cell adhesion-related molecules that control SPN migration. Our findings provide insights into striatal development.

title: The historical domestication of a Clostridium botulinum strain used for the industrial production of botulinum neurotoxin
summary_zh: 研究分析AHA菌株及其近缘种群的基因组，揭示其近缘种和共同祖先。AHA积累近100个遗传变化，包括单核苷酸替换、小插入/删除和大型删除。
summary_en: This study analyzes the genome of the AHA strain and its nearest relatives, identifying their closest relatives and common ancestor. AHA has accumulated nearly 100 genetic changes, including single-nucleotide substitutions, small insertions/deletions, and several large deletions.
insights: 创新点：揭示AHA菌株的进化历史
方法亮点：基因组分析
关键发现：AHA积累大量遗传变化
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the evolutionary history of the AHA strain
Method highlight: Genome analysis
Key finding: AHA accumulates a large number of genetic changes
abstract: Laboratory production of botulinum neurotoxin (BoNT) began more than 90 y ago for medical, military, and later pharmaceutical applications, creating one of the longest-running examples of microbial cultivation under sustained human control. A single Clostridium botulinum Group I lineage, Army Hall A (AHA), was established by the US military in 1942 and later gave rise to Hall A-hyper (HAH), the strain widely used for pharmaceutical BoNT production. We analyzed more than 1,000 C. botulinum genomes to identify AHA’s closest relatives and to infer the most recent common ancestor (MRCA) shared with its nearest lineage. Relative to this MRCA, AHA accumulated nearly 100 genetic changes, including 46 single-nucleotide substitutions, 44 small insertions or deletions, and several large deletions and structural variants that led to the loss of more than 80 genes. A nonsense mutation in mutS generated a hypermutator phenotype that accelerated mutation rates and increased genetic diversity. This event is inferred to have occurred early in the lineage’s domestication and appears to have facilitated laboratory-adaptive traits, including the lack of sporulation and increased BoNT yield. Competition experiments under standard growth conditions confirmed substantial laboratory adaptation, with AHA exhibiting a strong fitness advantage over a close relative. Together, these results reconstruct the genomic trajectory of a bacterium evolving under prolonged human-mediated selection and provide a genome-resolved example of microbial domestication. The findings show how laboratory conditions, industrial selection, and changing mutation rates can shape bacterial evolution, and they offer a general framework for understanding domestication and laboratory adaptation across microbial systems.

title: Restructuring hydrogen-bonding networks via hydroxyl-functionalized covalent organic frameworks for efficient nitrate electroreduction
summary_zh: 研究设计Cu-COF-nOH框架调节界面质子转移，提高NO3RR效率。羟基功能团增强水吸附和解离，形成连续氢键链，加速质子转移。
summary_en: This study designs Cu-COF-nOH frameworks to regulate interfacial proton transfer, enhancing the efficiency of NO3RR. Hydroxyl functional groups enhance water adsorption and dissociation, forming continuous hydrogen-bond chains, and accelerating proton transfer.
insights: 创新点：设计Cu-COF-nOH框架
方法亮点：调节界面质子转移
关键发现：提高NO3RR效率
insights_en: Novelty: Designing Cu-COF-nOH frameworks
Method highlight: Regulating interfacial proton transfer
Key finding: Enhancing the efficiency of NO3RR
abstract: Electrocatalytic nitrate reduction reaction (NO 3 RR) is a promising strategy for nitrate removal and ammonia synthesis, but its efficiency is largely limited by sluggish proton transfer kinetics and poor reaction selectivity. Herein, we rationally design a series of hydroxyl-functionalized copper phthalocyanine-based covalent organic frameworks (Cu-COF-nOH) to regulate interfacial proton transfer via restructuring hydrogen-bonding networks. The hydroxyl functional groups in Cu-COF-nOH enhance water adsorption and dissociation to enrich interfacial proton supply. Optimized hydroxyl loading further induces the formation of continuous hydrogen-bond chains, enabling oriented and accelerated proton shuttling toward Cu active centers instead of stochastic diffusion. Electrocatalytic tests in 0.5 M nitrate electrolyte show that the optimal Cu-COF-4OH catalyst achieves an ammonia Faradaic efficiency of 93.20% and an NH 3 yield rate of 65.84 mg·h −1 , along with excellent long-term stability, outperforming most state-of-the-art NO 3 RR electrocatalysts. Combined with in situ characterizations and theoretical calculations, we clearly clarify that hydroxyl-mediated hydrogen-bonding restructuring plays a critical role in boosting proton transfer kinetics and reaction selectivity. This work provides a versatile interface engineering strategy for efficient multiproton/electron-coupled electrocatalytic reactions, offering insights into the design of high-performance NO 3 RR catalysts.

title: Suspected distortion of citations in high-impact cancer journals
summary_zh: 研究揭示高影响力癌症期刊中疑似存在引用操纵。论文工厂文章显示系统性的引用膨胀。这些文章发表在高排名期刊中。
summary_en: This study reveals suspected citation manipulation in high-impact cancer journals. Paper mill articles show systematic citation inflation. These articles were published in journals in the top decile of journal rankings.
insights: 创新点：揭示高影响力期刊的引用操纵
方法亮点：分析论文工厂文章
关键发现：系统性的引用膨胀
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing citation manipulation in high-impact journals
Method highlight: Analyzing paper mill articles
Key finding: Systematic citation inflation
abstract: Research and scholarship are shaped by article citations, which underpin the communication of ideas, assignment of credit, journal impact factors, and author career progression. Given their key influence on author and journal metrics, citations can be intentionally manipulated to inflate the reputation of journals and researchers. Paper mills, unethical organizations that produce and sell manuscripts and publishing services, may also be manipulating citations, but the extent of this manipulation is unknown. Here, we show that molecular cancer articles sharing features with retracted papers from paper mills display citation patterns that suggest systematic inflation. These articles were published in journals in the top decile of journal rankings. Suspected paper mill articles received 50 to 100% more citations than other papers 1 to 3 y after publication, while paradoxically attracting fewer readers and online accesses. Suspected paper mill articles also cited—and were cited by—other suspected paper mill articles, which frequently appeared in journals previously reported as paper mill targets. Citations from suspected paper mill articles measurably inflated journal citation metrics. These findings suggest that paper mills inflate the citation metrics of supported publications and affected journals at scale. This widespread manipulation of citation metrics may amplify unreliable findings, slowing scientific progress and spurring unreasonable citation benchmarks for research articles, journals, and authors. Our findings point to measurable signatures of citation manipulation that could support article- and journal-level screening.

title: Drivers of the likelihood of evolutionary rescue in response to novel infectious diseases
summary_zh: 研究探讨新型传染病引发进化救援的可能性。结果取决于宿主和病原体特征，如传播规模、死亡率和免疫力。
summary_en: This study explores the likelihood of evolutionary rescue in response to novel infectious diseases. The outcome depends on host and pathogen characteristics such as transmission scale, fatality, and immunity.
insights: 创新点：探讨进化救援的可能性
方法亮点：分析宿主和病原体特征
关键发现：影响因素复杂
insights_en: Novelty: Exploring the likelihood of evolutionary rescue
Method highlight: Analyzing host and pathogen characteristics
Key finding: Complex influencing factors
abstract: The introduction of novel infectious diseases has caused significant declines in many species, and in some cases, local extinction. Simultaneously, hosts might adapt to these novel pathogens, allowing population recovery, an example of evolutionary rescue (ER). Novel infectious diseases differ from sudden, abiotic stressors in that disease only impacts a subset of individuals within the population and individuals might be affected for a finite period. Whether ER occurs in an infectious disease context, and how likely it is relative to abiotic stress, might depend on both host and pathogen characteristics such as the scale of transmission (e.g., local density-dependent transmission only or additional infection through an external reservoir), the degree of fatality or immunity, and the adaptive pathway in terms of whether adaptive alleles reduce mortality, reduce likelihood of infection, or enhance recovery. Here, we use a stochastic mathematical model of host-pathogen dynamics with evolution of a novel allele conferring disease robustness to quantify how population trajectories, including the probability of and time to ER, vary across adaptive pathways and disease characteristics. We find that ER is more likely to occur with dynamical disease transmission compared to a lasting stressor that affects the entire population, indicating that protecting a subset of the population from stress facilitates ER. Among cases with disease transmission, ER is generally more likely to occur with the adaptation of mortality-blocking alleles and sources of transmission that include an external reservoir.

title: Pollen tube integrity is critical for thermotolerance in tomato and is enhanced by loss of SlRALF1
summary_zh: 研究显示番茄花粉管完整性对耐热性至关重要。SlRALF1功能缺失可增强耐热性。热应激对抗维持花粉管完整性的RALF信号。
summary_en: This study shows that pollen tube integrity is critical for thermotolerance in tomatoes, and loss of SlRALF1 enhances thermotolerance. Heat stress antagonizes the RALF signaling required to maintain pollen tube integrity.
insights: 创新点：揭示花粉管完整性对耐热性影响
方法亮点：研究SlRALF1功能缺失
关键发现：热应激对抗RALF信号
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the impact of pollen tube integrity on thermotolerance
Method highlight: Studying the loss of SlRALF1 function
Key finding: Heat stress antagonizes RALF signaling
abstract: Reproductive success of angiosperms depends on the ability of pollen to build a highly polarized cellular extension (the pollen tube) that delivers sperm to female gametes for fertilization. This process is highly temperature sensitive, but we lack information about how heat stress affects pollen function and the molecular pathways that impart thermotolerance. Here we show that maintaining cellular integrity during pollen tube germination and extension is the pollen performance parameter that distinguishes thermosensitive from thermotolerant tomato cultivars and that loss-of-function of one of four pollen-expressed Rapid Alkalinization Factor (RALF) signaling peptides can enhance thermotolerance. Moreover, we found that heat stress antagonizes RALF signaling required to maintain patterns of pectin distribution in the pollen tube cell wall to ensure integrity. These findings establish a molecular framework for understanding how pollen tube growth is modulated in response to the environment and show that RALF signaling can be altered to achieve thermotolerant pollen tube growth.

title: Quantum-enhanced sensing of molecular excited-state dynamics with correlated photons
summary_zh: 研究利用纠缠光子增强分子激发态动力学传感。微观理论揭示高时间能量分辨信号，超越经典泵浦-探测方案。
summary_en: This study uses correlated photons to enhance the sensing of molecular excited-state dynamics. Microscopic theory reveals highly time-energy-resolved signals that surpass the classical pump-probe scheme.
insights: 创新点：利用纠缠光子增强传感
方法亮点：微观理论分析
关键发现：超越经典方案
insights_en: Novelty: Enhancing sensing using correlated photons
Method highlight: Microscopic theory analysis
Key finding: Surpassing the classical scheme
abstract: Squeezed photons, which provide a quantum-correlated light with reduced noise, have emerged as a powerful resource for sensing the structures of matter. Here, we study the pump–probe scheme using squeezed photons whose spectral correlation of amplitudes can be tailored. A microscopic theory reveals a highly time-energy-resolved signal that is not attainable by classical pump–probe scheme. The results show high selectivity of accessing the molecular correlation functions, e.g., suppression of ground-state bleaching signal, and can significantly enhance signal intensity that surpasses the bottleneck by entangled twin photons. An application to a monolayer semiconductor model reveals a real-time monitoring of valley excitons and their dynamics, i.e., conversion between dark and bright excitons. We further show the intermediate squeezing regime–not strong squeezing–where time-resolved spectroscopy is favorable. Our work offers a paradigm for studying nonequilibrium dynamics of matter, in photocatalysis and optoelectronics.

title: Abiotic conversion of nitrate to ammonium enhances nitrogen use efficiency in paddy soils
summary_zh: 研究揭示非生物过程在稻田土壤中硝酸盐还原为铵的关键作用。利用激光共聚焦显微镜和热力学定律，发现铁离子在水稻根际以特定方式存在，能促进硝酸盐还原。实验表明，这种非生物还原过程占总体还原的57%。
summary_en: This study reveals the key role of abiotic processes in the conversion of nitrate to ammonium in paddy soils. Using laser confocal fluorescence microscopy and thermodynamic laws, it was found that Fe(II) ions in the rice rhizosphere exist in a specific manner, capable of promoting the abiotic reduction of nitrate to ammonium. Experiments show that this abiotic reduction process accounts for 57% of the total nitrate reduction.
insights: 创新点：发现非生物过程在硝酸盐还原中的作用
方法亮点：结合激光共聚焦显微镜和热力学定律
关键发现：非生物还原过程占总体还原的57%
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the role of abiotic processes in nitrate reduction
Method highlight: Combination of laser confocal fluorescence microscopy and thermodynamic laws
Key finding: Abiotic reduction process accounts for 57% of the total reduction
abstract: Nitrogen (N) use efficiency is critical in ensuring food production while reducing nitrate (NO 3 − -N) to ammonium (NH 4 + -N) is widely recognized as a key for reducing N loss from paddy fields. Microbial involvement has long been regarded as the indispensable step for NO 3 − -N reduction to NH 4 + -N in nature; it remains largely unknown whether abiotic processes can drive this. Here, using laser confocal fluorescence microscopy and thermodynamic laws, we find that Fe(II) ions in the rice rhizosphere exist on iron plaque in a specific manner with strong reducing capability. These specifically adsorbed Fe(II) ions (Fe(II) SA ) could mediate the abiotic reduction of NO 3 − -N to NH 4 + -N, accounting for 57% of the total NO 3 − -N reduction. When cultured in a sterile nutrient solution containing only 15 NO 3 − -N and Fe(II) ions, over 90% of N in the xylem of rice plants exists as 15 NH 4 + -N, directly proving the occurrence of NO 3 − -N reduction to NH 4 + -N and taken up by rice. Theoretical calculations elucidate the Fe(II) SA -induced local electron depolarization enhances interfacial charge transfer which drives this reaction with the conversion of *NO to *NOH/*NHO identified as the rate-limiting step. We then propose a regulatory strategy to establish a stable Fe(II) SA /Fe(III) SA cycle utilizing FeC for controlled-release of Fe(II) ions. Two-year field experiments confirmed this strategy can increase rice yield by 16.1% while cutting half of the N input. Our work enables the design of novel pathways in improving N use efficiency for sustainable rice production.

title: The impact of modulator therapy on the Pseudomonas aeruginosa cystic fibrosis lung transcriptome
summary_zh: 研究评估了调节剂疗法对铜绿假单胞菌囊性纤维化肺转录组的影响。通过比较人类感染中的细菌基因表达，确定了疗法对铜绿假单胞菌生理的影响，并开发了改进的预临床模型。
summary_en: This study evaluates the impact of modulator therapy on the Pseudomonas aeruginosa lung transcriptome in cystic fibrosis. By comparing bacterial gene expression in human infections, the impact on P. aeruginosa physiology was determined, and refined preclinical models were developed.
insights: 创新点：开发了一种评估疗法影响的方法
方法亮点：比较人类感染中的细菌基因表达
关键发现：开发了改进的预临床模型
insights_en: Novelty: Development of a method to assess the impact of therapy
Method highlight: Comparison of bacterial gene expression in human infections
Key finding: Development of refined preclinical models
abstract: Chronic lung infection with Pseudomonas aeruginosa is a major complication of cystic fibrosis (CF), contributing to lung function decline and increased morbidity and mortality. Laboratory models are used to study CF infections, but their relevance depends on how accurately they reproduce microbial physiology during human infection. We previously developed a framework that uses bacterial gene expression in human infections to quantify model accuracy. Here, we applied this framework to determine how a major therapeutic intervention impacts P. aeruginosa physiology in the lungs of people with CF (pwCF) and to develop and evaluate refined preclinical models. We focused on elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor (ETI), a highly effective CFTR modulator therapy that has improved outcomes for pwCF. However, evidence indicates that P. aeruginosa lung infections persist despite ETI therapy. Analysis of P. aeruginosa transcriptomes from human sputum collected before and after ETI initiation revealed minimal changes in gene expression, indicating that the CF airway continues to support a similar bacterial transcriptional state despite therapy. We then evaluated how strain selection, zinc limitation, and polymicrobial coculture influence the ability of laboratory models to recapitulate P. aeruginosa gene expression in human CF sputum. Growth of CF clinical isolates in zinc-limited synthetic CF sputum medium produced the most accurate model, whereas population-based cultures and coculture with Staphylococcus aureus had limited effects. These findings show that ETI therapy has little impact on the conserved P. aeruginosa transcriptional state in human CF sputum and that refined sputum-like models remain useful for studying persistent infection in the postmodulator era.

title: Superconductivity in the high-pressure tetragonal phase of UTe 2
summary_zh: 研究测定了在高压四方相中UTe2的超级电导转变温度Tc与压力P的关系图。发现超导性在约5 GPa时出现，四方相Tc在6 GPa时达到最大值，随后随压力增加而降低。
summary_en: This study determines the superconducting transition temperature Tc vs. pressure P phase diagram in the high-pressure tetragonal phase of UTe2. Superconductivity emerges near ~5 GPa, with Tc reaching a maximum value of ~4 K at 6 GPa and then decreasing with pressure.
insights: 创新点：在高压四方相中发现了超导性
方法亮点：测定了Tc与P的关系图
关键发现：四方相Tc在6 GPa时达到最大值
insights_en: Novelty: Superconductivity discovered in the high-pressure tetragonal phase
Method highlight: Determination of the Tc vs. P phase diagram
Key finding: Maximum Tc in the tetragonal phase at 6 GPa
abstract: Electrical transport and magnetic measurements have been made on UTe 2 under pressure P up to ~16 GPa to determine the superconducting transition temperature T c vs. P phase diagram in the high-pressure tetragonal phase. Superconductivity emerges near ~5 GPa, coincident with the orthorhombic—tetragonal phase transition; in the tetragonal phase, T c reaches a maximum value of ~4 K at 6 GPa and then decreases with P and appears to vanish near 18 GPa. Tetragonal UTe 2 has a relatively small upper critical field H c2 (0) ≈ 1.2 T at 5.3 GPa, smaller than the Pauli paramagnetic limit, and is orbitally limited with a coherence length ξ tetra ≈ 16.5 nm. This small value of H c2 (0) favors more conventional superconductivity; in contrast, the large values of H c2 ( T ) for orthorhombic UTe 2 exceed the Pauli paramagnetic limit in all three crystallographic directions and have been attributed to unconventional superconductivity, widely believed to involve spin-triplet pairing. The temperature–pressure phase diagram of UTe 2 shows a striking dichotomy: a narrow, fragile, unconventional superconducting region in the orthorhombic phase vs. a broad, robust, and more conventional superconducting dome in the tetragonal phase. This dichotomy is consistent with the proposal that U-dimers, present (absent) in the orthorhombic (tetragonal) phase, may play a role in spin-triplet superconductivity of orthorhombic UTe 2 . In the tetragonal phase, the normal-state electrical resistivity ρ( T ) exhibits metallic behavior with a “knee” at 200 to 240 K that depends weakly on P and most likely marks the onset of a transition to a magnetically ordered phase that coexists with superconductivity.

title: Changing contributions of emotion and reward information to learning through adolescence
summary_zh: 研究探讨了情绪和奖励信息在青少年学习中的作用。发现情绪和奖励信息在不同条件下对学习过程的影响不同，有时促进正确选择，有时则相反。
summary_en: This study explores the changing contributions of emotion and reward information to learning throughout adolescence. It finds that the influence of emotion and reward information on learning processes varies under different conditions, sometimes promoting correct choices and sometimes the opposite.
insights: 创新点：揭示了情绪和奖励信息对学习的影响
方法亮点：使用强化学习任务研究学习过程
关键发现：情绪和奖励信息影响学习选择的多样性
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the influence of emotion and reward information on learning
Method highlight: Using reinforcement learning tasks to study learning processes
Key finding: Emotion and reward information affect the diversity of learning choices
abstract: From childhood to adulthood, individuals’ learning and decision-making may be differentially impacted by two salient value signals for adolescents: emotions and rewards. This study superimposed these information sources to assess their independent and joint influences on learning and choice processes. Participants ages 8 to 22 y completed a reinforcement learning task, in which monetary rewards conveyed information integral to making reward-maximizing choices, while emotional expressions conveyed information incidental to this goal. In some conditions, emotion and reward invoked congruent approach-avoid tendencies; following either information source promoted making reward-maximizing (“correct”) choices. In other conditions, emotion and reward invoked incongruent approach-avoid tendencies; following the emotion cue impeded reward capture. Participants completed several measures indexing the persistence of emotion and reward information on choice and evaluations of these signals. Statistical and computational models revealed that emotion-reward incongruence hampered early learning through an incidental emotion bias on value estimates. The emotion bias decayed as reward learning progressed in adolescents and adults but endured in children. Moreover, reward-based choice increased with age across the additional measures. Although participants of all ages were initially hindered by incidental emotion cues, adults’ shift toward prioritizing integral reward outcomes indicates that goal-relevant information comes to dominate choice with age.

title: Interpersonal value regulates infection-risky social contact across 61 societies
summary_zh: 研究调查了人际价值如何调节61个社会中感染风险性社会接触。发现人际价值与感染风险性社会接触之间存在关联，并受到生态和文化因素的影响。
summary_en: This study investigates how interpersonal value regulates infection-risky social contact across 61 societies. It finds an association between interpersonal value and infection-risky social contact, influenced by ecological and cultural factors.
insights: 创新点：揭示了人际价值对感染风险性社会接触的调节作用
方法亮点：收集了来自61个社会的数据
关键发现：人际价值与感染风险性社会接触相关
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the regulatory role of interpersonal value on infection-risky social contact
Method highlight: Collected data from 61 societies
Key finding: Interpersonal value is associated with infection-risky social contact
abstract: Interpersonal contact is essential for cooperation and care, but it also provides a route for pathogen transmission between individuals. Hence, a key challenge for social organisms involves maintaining beneficial social contact while also limiting exposure to infection risks. Existing proposals suggest that this trade-off is guided by the interpersonal value of specific social targets. In addition, ecological and cultural factors, including historical pathogen prevalence, individualism-collectivism, tightness–looseness, and relational mobility, might also shape how people avoid pathogens. To test whether and how infection-risky social contact varies with individual-level interpersonal value and these societal-level factors, we collected data from 47,756 participants across 61 societies. Participants were randomly assigned to picture a social target - either a friend, acquaintance, stranger, or enemy. They then rated their comfort with infection-risky contact with that target (e.g., drinking from the same water bottle) and whether they would touch the target when greeting them. In all societies, participants were more comfortable with infection-risky contact and more likely to engage in physical contact during greetings with targets of higher interpersonal value. Such associations varied only modestly across societies. Notably, the associations between infection-risky contact and societal-level factors depended on target interpersonal value and were concentrated among high-value targets—contact was lower where historical pathogen prevalence and tightness were greater and higher where individualism and relational mobility were greater. These findings suggest that infection-risky contact is primarily guided by the value of social targets, with ecological and cultural factors playing a lesser role.

title: Two clusters of brain regions with distinct age-related profiles of functional connectivity in autism spectrum disorder
summary_zh: 研究分析了自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）中大脑区域功能连接随年龄变化的差异。发现两组具有不同年龄相关特征的功能连接区域，表明ASD的稳定神经特征和暂时性变化。
summary_en: This study analyzes the age-related differences in functional connectivity between autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and typically developing controls. It identifies two clusters of cortical regions with distinct age-related profiles of ASD-TD connectivity differences, indicating stable neural signatures and transient changes in ASD.
insights: 创新点：发现两组具有不同年龄相关特征的功能连接区域
方法亮点：使用多站点fMRI数据
关键发现：ASD具有稳定和暂时性神经特征
insights_en: Novelty: Identified two clusters with distinct age-related profiles of functional connectivity
Method highlight: Used multisite resting-state fMRI cross-sectional datasets
Key finding: ASD has stable and transient neural signatures
abstract: Brain functional connectivity changes throughout development, and individuals with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) may follow trajectories that differ from those of typically developing controls. Using large multisite resting-state fMRI cross-sectional datasets, we examined how functional connectivity differences between ASD and typically developing controls change across a broad age range of 5 to 64 y. A data-driven analysis identified two spatially distributed clusters of cortical regions showing distinct age-related profiles of ASD–TD connectivity differences. Cluster 1 was marked by consistent hypoconnectivity across ages, suggesting a stable neural signature of ASD. Cluster 2 was characterized by hypoconnectivity in childhood that gradually diminished with age, suggesting a temporary delay profile. These clusters were systematically organized along the sensory–association axis. Cluster 1 mainly involved lower-rank sensory and sensorimotor cortices, while Cluster 2 mainly involved higher-rank association cortices. Brain–behavior analyses revealed greater and broader ASD symptom associations across ages in the consistent hypoconnectivity profile than the delay profile. Further subtype analyses suggested that social-affect symptoms were associated with greater hypoconnectivity than repetitive behavior symptoms in both clusters. Spatial correlation analyses with neurotransmitter maps revealed associations of Cluster 1 with mGluR5 and of Cluster 2 with GABA A α5, providing insight into the neurobiological basis of the two clusters. In a cross-disorder validation analysis, applying the same analytic framework to attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder did not reveal comparable results. Together, these findings suggest that ASD-related functional connectivity alterations are developmentally heterogeneous and organized along the cortical hierarchy, providing a developmental perspective for understanding the neurobiology of ASD.

title: Structure-based targeting of Atg8 uncovers its essential role in autophagy-mediated detoxification
summary_zh: 研究揭示了Atg8在自噬介导的解毒中的关键作用。通过结构指导的虚拟筛选，发现天然产物和自噬相关分子中的一种化合物能够抑制病原体生长。
summary_en: This study uncovers the essential role of Atg8 in autophagy-mediated detoxification. Through structure-guided virtual screening, a compound from natural products and autophagy-related molecules was found to suppress pathogen growth.
insights: 创新点：发现Atg8在自噬介导的解毒中的关键作用
方法亮点：结构指导的虚拟筛选
关键发现：发现抑制病原体生长的化合物
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the essential role of Atg8 in autophagy-mediated detoxification
Method highlight: Structure-guided virtual screening
Key finding: Discovery of a compound that suppresses pathogen growth
abstract: Autophagy degrades and recycles intracellular material, allowing cells to maintain homeostasis and adapt to environmental stress. In the rice blast fungus Magnaporthe oryzae , the core autophagy protein MoAtg8 is required for autophagosome formation and host infection. Here, we determined the crystal structure of MoAtg8 and used it for structure-guided virtual screening of a focused compound library enriched for natural products and autophagy-related molecules. This screen identified nordihydroguaiaretic acid (NDGA), a naturally occurring lignan, as a MoAtg8-binding compound. NDGA suppressed conidial germination and appressorium formation, disrupted membrane integrity, and reduced pathogenicity in M. oryzae , with no detectable phytotoxicity to rice under the conditions tested. Mechanistically, the 5-lipoxygenase Mo5Lox, a target of NDGA, bound NDGA with lower affinity than MoAtg8. MoAtg8 associated with NDGA through Gln81 and promoted its autophagy-dependent delivery to vacuoles, thereby reducing compound availability to toxicity-associated targets. Disruption of autophagy or mutation of Gln81 in MoAtg8 increased fungal sensitivity to NDGA. These findings identify an autophagy-mediated detoxification route for an exogenous antifungal compound and reveal how MoAtg8-dependent trafficking modulates NDGA efficacy in a plant-pathogenic fungus.

title: Word Origins
Clinician Use of an Artificial Intelligence–Enabled Clinical Information Platform
summary_zh: 研究分析了临床医生使用人工智能临床信息平台的情况。发现临床医生使用该平台查询临床信息，并分析了使用分布和查询目的。
summary_en: This study analyzes the use of an AI-enabled clinical information platform by clinicians. It finds that clinicians use the platform to query clinical information and analyzes the distribution of use and the purpose of submitted queries.
insights: 创新点：分析了临床医生使用人工智能平台的情况
方法亮点：使用大规模语言模型进行分类
关键发现：临床医生使用平台查询临床信息
insights_en: Novelty: Analysis of clinicians' use of AI platforms
Method highlight: Use of a large language model for classification
Key finding: Clinicians use the platform to query clinical information
abstract: Importance Despite growing interest in the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in medicine, empirical evidence on how clinicians use these tools is limited. Objective To characterize clinician use of an AI-enabled clinical information platform, the distribution of use across the clinical workforce, and the purpose of submitted queries. Design, Setting, and Participants This cross-sectional study analyzed clinicians with National Provider Identifier–verified accounts of a commonly used AI-enabled clinical information platform, OpenEvidence, from January 1, 2024, through June 30, 2026. A large language model was used to classify the clinical purpose and topic areas of a stratified random sample of 38.8 million queries. Main Outcomes and Measures The number of active users and clinical queries, the share of queries relative to representation in the national workforce, and the clinical purpose and topic of queries were examined. Results Overall, 952 008 clinicians (58.5% female), including 556 200 physicians, submitted 271 million queries during the 2.5-year study period. Monthly active users increased from 355 in January 2024 to 703 265 in June 2026, and average monthly queries per active user rose from 18.0 to 39.5. Nurse practitioners (44.5) and physician assistants (44.5) submitted more queries per active user-month than physicians (37.1). A higher share of queries relative to the national workforce was submitted by physicians within a decade of graduation (use ratio, 2.54) and residents and fellows (1.84). Use was also higher than average among physicians specializing in oncology and hematology (use ratio, 2.00), internal medicine (1.88), and family medicine (1.80), but lower in procedural and diagnostic specialties (ophthalmology, 0.23; radiology, 0.24; orthopedics, 0.24). Most queries addressed clinical decision-making (51.9%), particularly treatment and management (33.1%), whereas diagnosis accounted for 13.9% of queries. Queries addressing topics outside physicians’ own specialties ranged from 35% among oncologists and hematologists to 88% among emergency department physicians. Conclusions and Relevance Over 2.5 years, more than 950 000 US clinicians submitted greater than 270 million queries to an AI-enabled clinical information platform. Use varied across clinician types, specialties, and career stages and was frequently for treatment decisions rather than diagnostic tasks.

title: Lifestyle and Metformin Interventions and Risk of Multimorbidity in Individuals With Prediabetes—In Reply
Engaging With Medical Evidence in the Age of AI
Announcing JAMA AI —A New Journal From the JAMA Network
Over-the-Counter Hearing Aids 4 Years Later
summary_zh: 本文探讨2022年非处方助听器授权后的情况，强调临床和政策举措对提高采用率和实施的重要性。
summary_en: This paper discusses the situation of over-the-counter hearing aids following their authorization in 2022, emphasizing the importance of clinical and policy initiatives for improving adoption and implementation.

方法亮点：临床和政策分析
关键发现：提高采用率需综合措施

Method highlight: Clinical and policy analysis
Key finding: Comprehensive measures needed for increased adoption
abstract: This Viewpoint discusses over-the-counter hearing aids following their authorization in 2022, highlighting the importance of clinical and policy initiatives for improving uptake and implementation.

title: Testosterone Screening Thresholds in Active-Duty US Male Service Members
summary_zh: 本研究估计了19至39岁健康现役男性士兵中，睾酮浓度低于正常下限的普遍情况。
summary_en: This study estimates the prevalence of testosterone concentrations below the lower limit of normal in healthy active-duty male soldiers aged 19 to 39 years.

方法亮点：大规模流行病学调查
关键发现：睾酮浓度异常普遍存在
insights_en: Novelty: Relationship between testosterone concentration and military health
Method highlight: Large-scale epidemiological survey
Key finding: Prevalence of abnormal testosterone concentrations is widespread
abstract: This Research Letter estimates US Army–wide prevalence of healthy active-duty men aged 19 to 39 years with testosterone concentrations below the lower limit of normal.

title: See One
summary_zh: 本文通过一位医生的个人经历，探讨了当亲人住院时，朋友和家人所感受到的震惊和无助。
summary_en: This essay, through a physician's personal experience, discusses the shock and helplessness that friends and family members feel when a loved one is hospitalized.

方法亮点：叙事医学方法
关键发现：家庭支持的重要性
insights_en: Novelty: Exploring medical experiences from a personal perspective
Method highlight: Narrative medicine approach
Key finding: Importance of family support
abstract: In this narrative medicine essay, a physician discusses how someone close to her needing medical attention helped her understand the shock and helplessness that friends and family members feel when a loved one is hospitalized.

title: Treatment Discontinuation of Blood Pressure–Lowering Drugs
FDA’s Testosterone Label Changes
summary_zh: 本文讨论了美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）对睾酮产品标签的更新及其对处方实践的影响。
