abstract: This Perspective discusses US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) updates to testosterone product labeling and their implications for prescribing practice.

title: Lifestyle and Metformin Interventions and Risk of Multimorbidity in Individuals With Prediabetes
Treatment Discontinuation of Blood Pressure–Lowering Drugs—Reply
Nationwide implementation of digital non-communicable diseases screening in Indonesia’s primary care system
summary_zh: 研究展示印度尼西亚初级保健系统中数字非传染性疾病筛查的实施。分析大量筛查记录，覆盖全国38个省。
summary_en: This study shows the nationwide implementation of digital non-communicable diseases screening in Indonesia's primary care system, analyzing a large number of screening records covering all 38 provinces.
insights: 创新点：数字非传染性疾病筛查实施
方法亮点：全国范围分析筛查记录
关键发现：血压和体测量记录频繁
insights_en: Novelty: Implementation of digital non-communicable diseases screening
Method highlight: National-scale analysis of screening records
Key finding: Frequent recording of blood pressure and anthropometric measurements
abstract: Non-communicable diseases require screening systems that can operate across large and diverse health systems, yet evidence from national implementations in low- and middle-income countries remains limited. Here we show how Indonesia’s Aplikasi Sehat IndonesiaKu mobile application, integrated with the national digital health platform SATUSEHAT and the legacy Sistem Informasi Penyakit Tidak Menular reporting system, supports routine screening across primary care and community settings. We analyse records from January 2023 to April 2024, comprising 116,013,364 screening visits among 75,822,322 individuals and reporting from 10,131 primary healthcare centres across all 38 provinces. Blood pressure and anthropometric measurements are recorded substantially more often than cholesterol and cancer screening. Among participants with relevant measurements, 27.98% meet the screening definition for hypertension, 19.28% for obesity, and 32.18% for central obesity. Screening volume varies markedly across provinces, while recorded outcomes differ by age and sex. These findings indicate that interoperable digital infrastructure can support population-scale monitoring of non-communicable disease, but equitable implementation also depends on workforce, equipment and service readiness. Aisyah et al. report nationwide use of Indonesia’s integrated ASIK-SATUSEHAT system for 116 million NCD screening visits, showing broad primary-care adoption alongside variation by service, region, age and sex.

title: Association of DESH Features on MRI with Cognitive Decline
Association of Disproportionately Enlarged Subarachnoid Space Hydrocephalus Features at MRI with Cognitive Decline
ScopeNovo: a De Novo Peptide Sequencing Method Using Spectrum-Spectrum Similarity to Refine the Prediction Accuracy
summary_zh: 提出ScopeNovo方法，利用谱谱相似性提高预测准确性。通过比较输入谱与代表性谱，生成多个候选序列。
summary_en: Introduces ScopeNovo method, using spectrum-spectrum similarity to improve prediction accuracy. Generates multiple candidate sequences by comparing the input spectrum with the representative spectrum corresponding to the predicted peptide sequence.
insights: 创新点：谱谱相似性提高预测准确性
方法亮点：生成多个候选序列
关键发现：提高预测准确性
insights_en: Novelty: Spectrum-spectrum similarity improves prediction accuracy
Method highlight: Generates multiple candidate sequences
Key finding: Improved prediction accuracy
abstract: Abstract Motivation De novo peptide sequencing from tandem mass spectra is essential for characterizing unknown proteins, identifying novel post-translational modifications, and analyzing samples without reference databases. While recent deep learning models have improved the predicted peptide accuracy, they typically select the predicted peptide sequence based solely on sequence-level decoding scores. Very often, high scores are assigned to peptides without the direct support from the observed mass spectrum. Results We present ScopeNovo, a de novo peptide sequencing method that improves predicted peptide accuracy by using spectrum-spectrum similarity between the input spectrum and the “representative” spectrum corresponding to the predicted peptide sequence. ScopeNovo generates multiple candidate peptides using an existing peptide de novo sequencing learning model and reranks candidates based on spectrum-spectrum similarity. To test our method, we use π-PrimeNovo as the base learning model. Experimental results on the standard nine-species benchmark datasets V1 and V2 show that ScopeNovo can substantially improve the prediction accuracy. We designed two settings, where Setting 1 is for well-annotated species, and Setting 2 is for species that are not well annotated. For Setting 1, ScopeNovo improves the average peptide accuracies of π-PrimeNovo over the nine species by 6.1% and 4.0% on V1 and V2, respectively. For Setting 2, ScopeNovo can still improve the peptide accuracy of π-PrimeNovo over the nine species by 3.4% and 1.9% on the V1 and V2 benchmark datasets, respectively. Compared to the best known method, RankNovo, the peptide accuracies over the nine species on V1 and V2 of our method for Setting 1 are 0.711 and 0.737, where the peptide accuracies for RankNovo are 0.687 and 0.682. Even for Setting 2, the peptide accuracies of our method are comparable to those of RankNovo. Availability ScopeNovo is implemented in Python under an MIT license. The source code is freely available at https://github.com/SoSongzhi/ScopeNovo.git. The test data are available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23181841. Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Ryder: Epigenome normalization using a two-tier model and internal reference regions
summary_zh: 提出Ryder软件进行表观基因组信号归一化，利用内部参考区域校正技术变异，有效调整背景噪声和信号强度。
summary_en: Proposes Ryder software for epigenome normalization, utilizing internal reference regions to correct technical variations and adjust background noise and signal intensity effectively.
insights: 创新点：Ryder软件灵活且鲁棒，适用于多种实验条件。
方法亮点：利用内部参考区域如CTCF结合位点进行校正。
关键发现：Ryder显著提高了信号准确性。
insights_en: Novelty: Ryder software is flexible and robust, applicable to various experimental conditions.
Method highlight: Utilizes internal reference regions like CTCF binding sites for correction.
Key finding: Ryder significantly improves signal accuracy.
abstract: Abstract Motivation Sequencing-based epigenomic profiling methods are powerful but suffer from technical variability that complicates cross-sample comparisons and can obscure true biological signals. While existing normalization methods using spike-in controls or computational approaches have been proposed, they often rely on assumptions that may not hold across diverse experimental conditions or require additional data types. Results We present Ryder, a flexible and robust Python package for the normalization of epigenomic signal tracks. Ryder leverages stable internal reference regions, such as invariant CTCF binding sites, to correct for technical artifacts genome-wide. Our results show that it effectively adjusts both background noise and signal intensity, ensuring accurate signal alignment across samples while preserving genuine biological differences. We demonstrate that Ryder performs robustly across diverse assays including DNase-seq, CUT&RUN, ATAC-seq, MNase-seq, and ChIP-seq, with or without spike-in controls. By reducing technical noise, Ryder improves the detection of genuine biological changes, such as quantitative reduction of chromatin accessibility at key enhancer elements by depletion of BRG1, a key subunit of the chromatin remodeling BAF complexes. Availability and Implementation The Ryder source code, documentation and test data are freely available at: https://github.com/YaqiangCao/ryder. The software version used in this study is archived at Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/21267457. Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Magic state cultivation on a superconducting quantum processor
summary_zh: 在超导量子处理器上实现魔态培养，通过代码切换和容错测量协议，降低错误率，提高魔态保真度。
summary_en: Achieves magic state cultivation on a superconducting quantum processor, reducing error rate and improving magic state fidelity through code switching and fault-tolerant measurement protocols.
insights: 创新点：魔态培养为资源密集型蒸馏协议提供高效替代。
方法亮点：实现表面代码中的代码切换和容错测量。
关键发现：魔态培养降低错误率40倍。
insights_en: Novelty: Magic state cultivation offers an efficient alternative to resource-intensive distillation protocols.
Method highlight: Implements code switching in surface codes and fault-tolerant measurement protocols.
Key finding: Magic state cultivation reduces error rate by a factor of 40.
abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing requires a universal gate set, but the necessary non-Clifford gates represent a significant resource cost for most quantum error correction architectures. Magic state cultivation offers an efficient alternative to resource-intensive distillation protocols; however, testing the proposal’s assumptions represents a challenging departure from quantum memory experiments. We present an experimental study of magic state cultivation on a superconducting quantum processor. We implement cultivation, including code-switching into a surface code, and develop a fault-tolerant measurement protocol to bound the magic state fidelity. Cultivation reduces the error by a factor of 40, with a state fidelity of at least 0.9999(1) (retaining 8% of attempts). Our results experimentally establish magic state cultivation as a viable solution to one of quantum computing’s most important challenges.

title: Electrically driven chiral emission from plasmonic tunnel junctions
summary_zh: 通过等离子体隧道结实现电驱动手性光发射，产生具有手性和轨道角动量的涡旋光束。
summary_en: Achieves electrically driven chiral light emission from plasmonic tunnel junctions, producing vortex beams with both spin and orbital angular momentum.
insights: 创新点：电驱动纳米级手性光生成。
方法亮点：结合手性等离子体纳米螺旋体和隧道结。
关键发现：实现手性光束的手性和轨道角动量控制。
insights_en: Novelty: Electrically driven nanoscale chiral light generation.
Method highlight: Integrates chiral plasmonic nanohelicoids with tunnel junctions.
Key finding: Achieves control over the chirality and orbital angular momentum of the chiral beams.
abstract: Chirality plays a crucial role in a broad range of processes, including light-matter interactions in physics, chemistry, and biology, while quantum tunneling provides a promising mechanism for light generation at the nanoscale. By integrating tunnel junctions with chiral plasmonic nanohelicoids, we achieved electrically induced nanoscale generation of chiral light at the single-particle level. The tunneling-driven resonant excitation of chiral dipolar modes of the nanohelicoids results in emission of a vortex light beam possessing both spin angular momentum with handedness selectivity of more than 0.8 and orbital angular momentum equal in magnitude and opposite in sign. Our electrically driven approach offers a means for engineering photon spin generation at the nanoscale, highlighting its potential for next-generation optical components in display applications, as well as quantum information processing and photochemistry.

title: Engineering ordered two-dimensional defect phases to strengthen structural alloys
summary_zh: 通过预变形和时效处理，将平面缺陷转化为有序缺陷相，增强结构合金强度。
summary_en: Converts planar defects into ordered defect phases through predeformation and aging treatment to strengthen structural alloys.
insights: 创新点：预变形和时效处理设计有序缺陷相。
方法亮点：在单晶和多晶合金中实现缺陷相增强。
关键发现：增强室温强度并降低蠕变率。
insights_en: Novelty: Predeformation and aging treatment design ordered defect phases.
Method highlight: Achieves defect phase strengthening in single-crystal and polycrystalline alloys.
Key finding: Increases room-temperature strength and reduces the minimum creep rate.
abstract: Defects in crystals are usually considered to be consequences of deformation, but they can also be engineered as strengthening features. Planar defects can strengthen structural alloys but usually form only during deformation or service, limiting control over their density, stability, and chemistry. We show that predeformation followed by aging can convert such defects into a designed architecture of ordered defect phases. In a single-crystal cobalt-nickel–based superalloy and a polycrystalline cobalt-chromium-tungsten alloy, this treatment creates dense networks of coherent, atomically thin, ordered defect–confined phases. These increase room-temperature strength by more than 200 megapascals and reduce the superalloy’s minimum creep rate by more than threefold. Electron microscopy and simulations show that local chemical ordering amplifies strengthening and that the ordered defect phases remain shearable while impeding slip transmission.

title: Dendritic computation for abstract rule-based flexible decision-making
summary_zh: 结合规则决策任务和活体成像，发现树突优先编码抽象规则，细胞体优先代表感官刺激。
summary_en: Combining a rule-based flexible decision-making task with in vivo imaging, finds that apical dendrites preferentially encode abstract rules and somata preferentially represent sensory stimuli.
insights: 创新点：树突计算参与抽象认知处理。
方法亮点：结合活体成像和光遗传学。
关键发现：树突抑制影响规则依赖性编码。
insights_en: Novelty: Dendritic computation contributes to abstract cognitive processing.
Method highlight: Combines in vivo imaging and optogenetics.
Key finding: Dendritic inhibition impairs rule-dependent somatic choice coding.
abstract: Intelligent behavior involves flexible integration of sensory input and abstract rule knowledge. Dendritic computation has been shown to contribute to top-down modulation of sensory processing; however, whether and how it is involved in flexible cognitive processing remains to be elucidated. Combining a rule-based flexible decision-making task with in vivo two-photon imaging and optogenetics in mice, we found that within single layer 5 extratelencephalic neurons in the auditory cortex, apical dendrites preferentially encoded the inferred abstract rule and somata preferentially represented sensory stimuli, whereas choice signals were present in both compartments. Optogenetic dendritic inhibition impaired rule-dependent somatic choice coding, supporting a task-relevant integration across the dendritic and somatic compartments. These results indicate that dendritic computation in cortical neurons mediates flexible behavior.

title: Deterministic generation and distribution of genuine multipartite entanglement in macroscopic acoustic resonators
summary_zh: 在宏观声谐振器中实现真多体纠缠的确定生成和传输，展示高保真度纠缠态的制备。
summary_en: Achieves deterministic generation and distribution of genuine multipartite entanglement in macroscopic acoustic resonators, demonstrating the preparation of high-fidelity entangled states.
insights: 创新点：宏观声谐振器中实现真多体纠缠。
方法亮点：制备涉及多种模式的纠缠态。
关键发现：实现高保真度纠缠态的传输。
insights_en: Novelty: Genuine multipartite entanglement in macroscopic acoustic resonators.
Method highlight: Prepares entangled states involving various modes.
Key finding: Achieves transmission of high-fidelity entangled states.
abstract: Generating complex multimode entanglement is a central goal of quantum information science. However, scalable creation of genuine multipartite entanglement is challenging as it requires excellent control and efficient state verification. We report the generation and transfer of genuine multimode entanglement across two multimode acoustic resonators. We prepare genuine multipartite entangled states involving two, four, and six modes across the resonators with respective fidelities of 0.912 ± 0.003, 0.790 ± 0.003, and 0.570 ± 0.001. We further demonstrate the transfer of two- and four-mode genuine entangled states between the resonators with fidelities of 0.785 ± 0.006 and 0.601 ± 0.006. This hardware-efficient and scalable architecture enables deterministic control and generation of complex multimode mechanical states. Our results push the boundary of quantum control in macroscopic mechanical systems, establishing a pathway toward large-scale mechanical quantum networks.

abstract: Protein-coding transcripts are regarded as intermediates that mediate DNA-to-protein information flow, leaving their noncoding regulatory potential largely underappreciated. Genome-wide profiling of RNA–chromatin interactions in Arabidopsis has uncovered widespread associations between protein-coding transcripts and distinct genomic loci, implying that they possess regulatory functions. Here, we found that BT2 and GSL8 transcripts modulate target gene transcription independently of their protein products through distinct mechanisms. The BT2 transcript represses transcription of its targets CEP2 and MRF4 by forming RNA–DNA triplexes, thereby restricting root growth and promoting flowering, whereas GSL8 acts through a triplex-independent pathway. Our findings unveil intrinsic regulatory activities of protein-coding transcripts, challenging the canonical definition of mRNA function and blurring the functional distinction between coding and noncoding RNAs in the context of genome evolution.

abstract: When calving cliffs at the margins of Earth’s ice sheets exceed a critical height, runaway retreat may be initiated in a process called the marine ice cliff instability. However, sufficiently tall ice cliffs have rarely been observed. To address this gap, we measured the characteristics of 15,330 ice cliffs across Earth’s ice sheet margins using laser altimetry. We show that cliff height is highly correlated with mélange thickness, water depth, and crevassing. We found that tall cliffs calve more rapidly than parameterizations assume, but dynamic thinning and retreat into regions with low ice thickness gradients prevent runaway retreat. These observations suggest that model projections may underestimate subannual rates of cliff calving, but that the potential for instability will depend sensitively on additional quantities, not cliff height alone.

abstract: This week, at the 17th Meeting of the Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity (COP17), delegates from 195 countries and the European Union are gathering in Yerevan, Armenia, for a global review of progress under the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework, an international set of goals and targets adopted in 2022 to tackle the biodiversity crisis. The urgent question before them is clear: What must change now to halt and reverse nature’s decline and put it on a path to recovery by 2030? COP-17 comes as international cooperation is under increasing strain. Extreme weather is intensifying, ecosystem deterioration is creating new security risks, and geopolitical tensions are rising. Yet nature’s decline does not pause for geopolitical instability—it deepens it. That makes effective multilateralism, with North and South as equal partners, more important, not less.

abstract: Intestinal homeostasis requires tight regulation of stem cell maintenance and differentiation to absorptive and secretory cell types, two major intestinal lineages. Key signaling pathways have been identified, but how they balance cell type composition remains unclear. We uncovered oscillatory expression of the Notch-target protein Hes1 (hairy and enhancer of split 1) that controls cell fate specification in a frequency-dependent manner. An endogenous fluorescent Hes1 reporter revealed distinct, cell type–specific oscillation frequencies forming a gradient along the crypt-villus axis, which was modulated by cell cycle phase as well as Wnt (wingless-related integration site)–signaling and Notch-signaling activity. We developed a microfluidic system to modulate Notch-signaling oscillations in organoids and found the oscillation frequency to regulate the balance of cell type composition. This study provides evidence that information for cell fate specification is encoded in the frequency of an oscillatory signal.

abstract: The catalytic and other sophisticated functions of biomolecules arise from the placement of many atoms in three-dimensional space. Here, we describe a generative artificial intelligence method for biopolymers, RFdiffusion3 (RFD3), which employs free atom diffusion to satisfy complex sets of atomic constraints more rapidly and accurately than previous methods across several challenges from enzyme design to RNA structure design. We demonstrate experimentally the power of the RFD3 pipeline for enzyme design by designing de novo phosphotriesterases with a complex active site architecture incorporating a carbamylated lysine coordinating two metal ions and zinc proteases specific for the transthyretin protein involved in amyloid diseases; in both cases we obtain active catalysts in zero shot 96 construct design campaigns.

abstract: The interplay between many-body and spin-orbit coupling (SOC) effects can lead to previously unobserved phenomena in solids. Chiral spin modes (CSMs) are collective spin excitations that arise from such interplay and connect states with opposite chirality. Here, we report a gate-tunable CSM that occurs between conduction SOC-split minibands in near-0°-twisted WSe 2 /WS 2 bilayers. This mode manifests as a sharp resonance with giant Raman efficiency in the pseudovector-symmetry channel of the Raman spectra. By varying the filling, the CSM transitions from a chiral spin exciton to an excitonic polaron. The spin-flip nature is directly confirmed by the Zeeman effect, and the filling dependence indicates a charge-transfer insulator at unity filling. Our results demonstrate that transition metal–dichalcogenide moiré superlattices are a fertile platform for exploring exotic low-lying collective excitations.

abstract: Background: Neovascular age-related macular degeneration (nAMD) is a leading cause of irreversible vision loss among older adults. Although randomised controlled trials have demonstrated the robust efficacy of intravitreal anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (anti-VEGF) therapy, real-world outcomes often differ markedly from trial findings. This study aimed to evaluate the anatomical and functional outcomes of anti-VEGF therapy in a clinical cohort of nAMD patients, including a subgroup that received adjunctive rescue photodynamic therapy (PDT) with verteporfin. Methods: This single-centre, retrospective observational cohort study included 568 patients (634 eyes) with nAMD treated with intravitreal anti-VEGF injections. Bevacizumab was used in 49% of eyes, ranibizumab in 44%, and aflibercept in 7%. Best recorded visual acuity (BRVA) and central retinal thickness (CRT) measured by optical coherence tomography (OCT) were recorded at baseline and at the final documented follow-up. Eyes with eccentric fixation were excluded from BRVA analysis but were retained for CRT analysis. Results: Mean patient age was 71.7 ± 8.8 years, and 67.6% of eyes were from female patients. The mean number of anti-VEGF injections was 5 ± 5.3 per eye; the mean follow-up duration was 11.5 months. Mean CRT decreased significantly from 347.3 ± 27.5 μm at baseline to 324.9 ± 28.8 μm at final follow-up (p < 0.001). Mean BRVA (logMAR) improved modestly from 0.98 ± 0.55 (Snellen ~20/190; ~35 ETDRS letters) to 0.93 ± 0.56 (Snellen ~20/175; ~37.5 ETDRS letters) (p < 0.001), with 67.9% of eyes demonstrating BRVA stability (change < 0.1 logMAR). Rescue PDT was administered in 10.3% of eyes. Conclusions: In this real-world cohort, anti-VEGF therapy was associated with significant anatomical improvement, as measured by CRT reduction, while functional outcomes were characterised by visual stabilisation rather than substantial gains.

abstract: Retinitis pigmentosa (RP) is the most common inherited retinal dystrophy and remains largely untreatable. This review summarizes RP pathogenesis and critically appraises emerging therapeutic strategies, including gene augmentation, gene editing, RNA-based therapies, gene-agnostic and neuroprotective approaches, stem-cell therapy and their delivery platforms. We compare these strategies according to mutation mechanism, disease stage, durability, delivery route, and current level of clinical evidence. Although several approaches have shown improved structural and functional outcomes in preclinical and early-phase studies, RPE65-directed gene augmentation (voretigen neparvovec) remains the only approved therapy, and even it does not halt degeneration. For most modalities, long-term efficacy, safety, durability and clinical validation are not yet established, and translation is further constrained by delivery, immunogenicity, manufacturing, and cost. Rather than a realized paradigm shift, current evidence points to a rapidly advancing but still largely investigational field with successful clinical translation remaining elusive.

abstract: Abstract Here we present AmpliconSuite, a toolkit for focal amplification analysis from cancer whole-genome sequencing that identifies extrachromosomal DNA (ecDNA), breakage–fusion–bridges and other amplification modes. Its ecContext module categorizes ecDNA structures to understand formation mechanisms. Validation across 175 metaphase fluorescence in situ hybridization-probed genes in 72 models demonstrated accurate predictions. Analysis of 6,506 patient pan-cancer samples revealed ecDNA-mediated oncogene co-amplification preferences. To democratize data sharing, we created AmpliconRepository, a community-contributable platform, enabling investigation of results across >15,000 publicly hosted samples.

summary_en: The article discusses the growing crisis of primary care in the US and efforts to address it through new training pathways, expanded opportunities for international graduates, and physician reimbursement changes.
insights: 创新点：提出多种应对初级护理短缺的策略。
方法亮点：分析不同策略的潜在影响。
关键发现：初级护理短缺问题亟待解决。
insights_en: Novelty: Multiple strategies for addressing primary care shortages are proposed.
Method highlight: Analyzing the potential impact of different strategies.
Key finding: The primary care shortage needs to be addressed urgently.
abstract: This Medical News article discusses the US primary care shortage and efforts to address it via new training pathways, expanded opportunities for international graduates, and physician reimbursement changes.

title: Demand for Vaccination Increases Amid Pennsylvania Measles Outbreak
WHO Broadens Guidance for Recommended Contraceptives
Fasting Duration Minimally Affects Most Routine Laboratory Tests
Global Life Expectancy Rebounds, Noncommunicable Disease Threat Increases
JAMA Editors' Summary Podcast
Efficient and accurate steering of large language models through attention-guided feature learning
summary_zh: 研究引入了注意力引导的激活引导框架，以解决大型语言模型激活引导中的三个核心挑战。
summary_en: The research introduces an attention-guided activation steering framework to overcome three core challenges in large language model activation steering.
insights: 创新点：提出注意力引导的激活引导框架。
方法亮点：解决激活引导中的核心挑战。
关键发现：提高大型语言模型的引导能力。
insights_en: Novelty: An attention-guided activation steering framework is proposed.
Method highlight: Solving core challenges in activation steering.
Key finding: Improving the guiding ability of large language models.
abstract: Activation steering, or direct manipulation of internal activations to guide large language model (LLM) responses toward specific semantic concepts, is emerging as a promising avenue for both understanding how semantic concepts are stored within LLMs and advancing LLM capabilities. Yet, existing steering methods are remarkably brittle, with seemingly nonsteerable concepts becoming completely steerable based on subtle algorithmic choices in how concept-related features are extracted. In this work, we introduce an attention-guided framework for activation steering that overcomes three core challenges associated with steering: 1) automatic selection of relevant token embeddings for extracting concept-related features; 2) accounting for heterogeneity of concept-related features across LLM activations; and 3) identification of layers most relevant for steering. Across a steering benchmark of 512 semantic concepts, our framework substantially improved steering over previous state-of-the-art (nearly doubling the number of successfully steered concepts) across model architectures and sizes (up to 70 billion parameter models). Furthermore, we use our framework to shed light on the distribution of concept-specific features across LLM layers. Overall, our framework opens further avenues for developing efficient, highly scalable fine-tuning algorithms for industry-scale LLMs.

title: A neural operator framework for data-driven discovery of stability and receptivity in physical systems
summary_zh: 研究引入了数据驱动的框架，无需已知方程即可自动识别物理系统的稳定性和响应性。
summary_en: The research introduces a data-driven framework that can automatically identify the stability and receptivity of physical systems without requiring known equations.
insights: 创新点：提出数据驱动的稳定性分析框架。
方法亮点：无需方程即可分析非线性系统。
关键发现：提高非线性系统分析的准确性。
insights_en: Novelty: A data-driven stability analysis framework is proposed.
Method highlight: Analyzing nonlinear systems without equations.
Key finding: Improving the accuracy of nonlinear system analysis.
abstract: Understanding how complex systems respond to perturbations, such as whether they will remain stable or what their most sensitive patterns are, is a fundamental challenge across science and engineering. Traditional stability and receptivity (resolvent) analyses are powerful but rely on known equations and linearization, limiting their use in nonlinear or poorly modeled systems. Here, we introduce a data-driven framework that automatically identifies stability properties of both equilibrium points and periodic orbits, as well as optimal forcing responses from observation data alone, without requiring governing equations. By training a neural network as a dynamics emulator and using automatic differentiation to extract its Jacobian, we can perform stability and receptivity analyses directly from data. We demonstrate the method on systems of increasing complexity, from canonical models to high-dimensional fluid flows and a real-world climate dataset, employing model reduction where needed and successfully identifying dominant instability modes and optimal input–output structures, even in strongly nonlinear regimes. By leveraging a neural network emulator, we readily obtain a nonlinear representation of system dynamics while additionally retrieving intricate dynamical patterns that were previously difficult to resolve. This equation-free methodology establishes a broadly applicable tool for analyzing complex, high-dimensional datasets, with potential relevance to grand challenges in fields such as climate science, neuroscience, and fluid engineering.

title: AI can persuade people to take political actions
summary_zh: 研究通过对话式AI模型说服参与者采取政治行动，发现AI在行为结果上具有显著的劝说效果。
summary_en: The study used conversational AI models to persuade participants to take political actions, finding significant AI persuasion effects on behavioral outcomes.
insights: 创新点：AI在政治行动上的劝说效果得到证实。
方法亮点：使用对话式AI模型进行实验。
关键发现：AI对行为有显著影响。
insights_en: Novelty: AI's persuasive effects on political actions are confirmed.
Method highlight: Using conversational AI models for experiments.
Key finding: AI has a significant impact on behavior.
abstract: There is substantial concern about the ability of advanced AI to influence people’s behavior. A rapidly growing body of research has found that AI can produce large persuasive effects on people’s attitudes, but whether AI can persuade people to take consequential real-world actions has remained unclear. In two large preregistered experiments ( N = 17 , 950 responses from 14,779 people), we used conversational AI models to persuade participants on a range of attitudinal and behavioral outcomes, including signing real petitions and donating money to charity. We found sizable AI persuasion effects on these behavioral outcomes (e.g. + 19.7 percentage points on petition signing). However, we observed no evidence of a correlation between AI persuasion effects on attitudes and effects on behavior. Moreover, we replicated prior findings that information provision drove effects on attitudes, but found no such evidence for our behavioral outcomes. In a test of eight behavioral persuasion strategies, the strategy focused on information provision produced the smallest behavioral effect, though differences among the eight were small. Taken together, these results suggest that previous findings relying on attitudinal outcomes may generalize poorly to behavior, and therefore risk substantially mischaracterizing the real-world behavioral impact of AI persuasion.

title: Nitrogen deposition does not alter the temperate forest soil carbon pool: A 14-y experiment on varied nitrogen fertilization
summary_zh: 14年实验表明，不同氮肥施用量对温带森林土壤碳库没有显著影响。
summary_en: A 14-year experiment showed that different nitrogen fertilization rates had no significant impact on the temperate forest soil carbon pool.
insights: 创新点：长期实验研究氮肥对土壤碳库的影响。
方法亮点：使用多种氮肥施用量进行实验。
关键发现：氮肥施用量对土壤碳库无显著影响。
insights_en: Novelty: A long-term experiment studies the impact of nitrogen fertilization on soil carbon pools.
Method highlight: Using various nitrogen fertilization rates in the experiment.
Key finding: Nitrogen fertilization rates have no significant impact on soil carbon pools.
abstract: Soil carbon (C) pools in nitrogen-limited temperate forests are critical to the global C cycle, but there are no long-term experiments examining soil C, with various nitrogen (N) forms. Here, a 14-y experiment (100 kg N ha −1 y −1 ), with added N simulating atmospheric deposition proportions (~70% inorganic, ~30% organic) did not affect soil C pools, whereas organic N (ON) and inorganic N (IN) individually significantly increased values by 2.7-fold and 1.8-fold, respectively. Although no treatment significantly affected soil pH, treatment effects on pH were negatively associated with soil C pools. In addition, treatments containing ON forms increased mineral-associated organic C fractions, indicating enhanced C stability vs. IN. These findings enhance our understanding of N deposition-soil C pool interactions.

title: Quiescence to proliferation transition regulates asynchronous mitochondrial DNA replication dynamics
summary_zh: 研究显示，细胞从静息状态到增殖状态的转变调节了线粒体DNA的非同步复制动态。
summary_en: The study shows that the transition from quiescence to proliferation regulates the asynchronous replication dynamics of mitochondrial DNA.
insights: 创新点：揭示了静息到增殖状态转变的调控机制。
方法亮点：使用单DNA分子分析技术。
关键发现：调控mtDNA复制的动态过程。
insights_en: Novelty: The regulatory mechanism of the transition from quiescence to proliferation is revealed.
Method highlight: Using single-DNA-molecule analysis technology.
Key finding: The dynamic process of regulating mtDNA replication.
abstract: Each human cell contains hundreds to thousands of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) copies, only a small fraction of which replicates independently of the cell cycle. An asynchronous replication of the leading and lagging strands has been proposed to represent a major replication mode in mitochondria, complicating the investigation of mechanisms that regulate mtDNA replication. Using single-DNA-molecule analysis that distinguishes the origins and timing of replication of each strand, we show that the mitochondrial DNA replication machinery responds to the transition from quiescence to proliferation by dynamically dissociating strand-specific replication rates and modulating the physiological requirements for factors involved in replication and transcription. During this response, the requirement for mitochondrial RNA polymerase (POLRMT) in replication initiation increases, whereas that for primase-polymerase (PrimPol), which is thought to function in DNA repriming at DNA lesions, eventually decreases. Thus, precise quantification of mtDNA replication rates at the single-strand level reveals the temporally dynamic nature of the mtDNA replication machinery during the transition from quiescence to proliferation.

title: Physical origins of speed control in swimming fishes
summary_zh: 研究推导了鱼类游泳速度与尾拍频率之间的关系，解释了速度控制背后的物理机制。
summary_en: The study derives a relationship between fish swimming speed and tail-beat frequency, explaining the physical mechanism behind speed control.
insights: 创新点：推导了速度与尾拍频率的关系。
方法亮点：结合流体力学原理分析。
关键发现：揭示了速度控制的物理起源。
insights_en: Novelty: A relationship between speed and tail-beat frequency is derived.
Method highlight: Analyzing using fluid mechanics principles.
Key finding: The physical origin of speed control is revealed.
abstract: The linear relationship between tail-beat frequency and swimming speed in fish, first described by Bainbridge in 1958, has since been confirmed in species as disparate as eels and tuna. Dimensional scaling has explained why linearity should emerge at high Reynolds numbers, but the frequency–speed relationship itself has remained empirical, with no physical framework describing its behavior across swimming regimes, and no account of what sets the two quantities that define it: the distance covered per tail beat and the frequency below which forward motion supposedly ceases. Here, we derive a relationship from a balance of fin thrust, generated by a leading-edge vortex, and drag due to the boundary layer on the body. This framework yields an explicit expression for speed in terms of midline kinematics and body morphology. This formulation shows that the maximum stride length is set by the undulatory wavelength and the tail-beat phase offset, rather than by the conventional scaling metric of body length, and that no minimum frequency is required for forward motion. The model reproduces kinematic measurements from freely swimming glass catfish, published simulations, and Bainbridge’s original data. Without recalibration, it predicts the results of independent simulations spanning wide variations in wavelength, phase offset, and morphology to within ten percent. Linear scaling is thus one asymptotic limit of a more general propulsive relationship linking morphology and body-wave kinematics to swimming speed in fishes and bioinspired vehicles, where the body waveform, rather than the actuation frequency, emerges as the variable that sets performance.

title: Systemic collapse emergence from climate-induced perturbations in transportation networks
summary_zh: 研究气候扰动对交通网络的影响。构建模型分析系统崩溃机制。发现外部事件对交通系统有显著影响。
summary_en: This study investigates the impact of climate-induced perturbations on transportation networks. A model is constructed to analyze the mechanism of systemic collapse. It is found that external events have a significant impact on transportation systems.
insights: 气候事件对基础设施影响显著
模型有效捕捉系统崩溃行为
外部事件对交通系统影响重大
insights_en: Climate events have significant impacts on infrastructure
The model effectively captures systemic collapse behavior
External events have a major impact on transportation systems
abstract: The interaction between human infrastructures and external events results in loss of functionality or even complete system disruption through a snowball effect of cascading failures. Their complex interplay challenges their prevention, affecting the human population that rely on their functionality. Understanding how these networks respond to external perturbations is crucial for predicting and mitigating the impacts of disruptive events. In particular, meteorological events, while not preventable, can have significant impacts on human infrastructure. Here, we propose a model coupling the dynamics of transportation systems to the dynamics of external events considered as fields, to capture at the same time the critical behavior of the former and the level of influence of the latter. The impact of rainfalls on real-world railway networks provides a compelling case study, showcasing local endemic and system-wide disruptions above a critical value of the rainfall strength. Remarkably, localized perturbations on the wider network reveals the local weaknesses of the global infrastructure, and we assess them in terms of system perturbability and corresponding societal risk. Our framework opens the door to the quantitative analysis of criticalities in essential human infrastructure imputable to vulnerabilities that are set to intensify due to climate change.

title: Insights from coproduced scenarios toward urban sustainability transformations
summary_zh: 分析城市可持续发展愿景和路径。通过合作工作坊探索未来城市。发现合作产生多样化愿景。
summary_en: This study analyzes urban sustainability visions and pathways. Through collaborative workshops, future urban scenarios are explored. It is found that coproduction generates diverse visions.
insights: 合作工作坊促进多样化愿景
城市可持续发展需多样化路径
合作产生创新解决方案
insights_en: Collaborative workshops promote diverse visions
Urban sustainability requires diverse pathways
Collaboration generates innovative solutions
abstract: Urban sustainability transformations call for fundamental shifts in how cities are organized, developed, and governed. Yet we need a better understanding of the diversity of visions and pathways that can enable transformative change. We address this gap through an analysis of 60 coproduced positive scenario visions and pathways developed using the Sustainable Future Scenario process, across nine US and Latin American cities participating in the Urban Resilience to Extremes Sustainability Research Network. We engaged diverse urban stakeholders—including government, nonprofit, and private decision-makers, community leaders, residents, and academic collaborators—in more than 20 coproduction workshops to explore alternative urban futures of sustainability and resilience. We examined how the coproduced scenarios represent five domains of transformative change (nature–human relationships, economic transformation, governance, social and environmental justice, and infrastructure futures) and four theories of transformative change (structural/institutional, agency/power, goals of the system, and worldviews/values). Most pathways combined multiple theories of change operating across multiple domains, revealing urban transformations as entangled rather than singular interventions. Some strategies were common across cities—car-free regions, decentralized infrastructure, community-based governance, expanded fundamental rights—yet were pursued with different transformative aims, demonstrating how a strategy’s transformative intent depends on the theories of change behind it. These findings position coproduced scenarios as more than a normative or planning tool and offer an analytical approach for surfacing the possibility space of urban transformation.

title: Altered sperm DNA methylation provides an epigenetic route from overweight and older men to intergenerational disease transmission
summary_zh: 研究肥胖和老年男性精子DNA甲基化变化。发现与儿童神经发育障碍相关。揭示表观遗传传递途径。
summary_en: This study investigates altered sperm DNA methylation in overweight and older men. It is found to be associated with childhood neurodevelopmental disorders, revealing an epigenetic transmission route.
insights: 精子甲基化与神经发育障碍相关
表观遗传影响后代健康
揭示遗传传递新机制
insights_en: Sperm methylation is associated with neurodevelopmental disorders
Epigenetic influences on offspring health
New mechanism of genetic transmission revealed
abstract: The occurrence of childhood neurodevelopmental disorders has been steadily increasing for decades, yet we have little understanding of modes of inheritance implicated in these diseases. Epidemiology studies have revealed an association between an elevated paternal Body Mass Index (BMI) and age as factors implicated in increased risk for neurodevelopmental disorders in children. Epigenetic regulation of gene expression by DNA methylation at cytosines is susceptible to environmental, diet, and lifestyle changes. Yet, whether a man’s BMI and age influence the sperm methylome and potentially impact offspring development remains unresolved. Using MethylC capture sequencing, we identified over 38,000 differentially methylated CpGs in the sperm of men with an elevated BMI, with overlap occurring in regions associated with advanced paternal age. These were enriched for neural gene and disease ontologies. Differentially methylated regions localized to transposable elements that can act as active enhancers during human zygotic genome activation, and at gene promoters for early lineage specification. These results suggest that sperm methylome alterations that are linked to an elevated BMI may influence key embryonic transcriptional processes, notably those associated with trophectoderm and placental development.

title: Nuclear BbAtg8 interacts with BbMac1 as a transcriptional modulator to sustain nuclear copper homeostasis during conidial germination
summary_zh: 研究真菌铜稳态调控机制。发现BbAtg8与BbMac1相互作用。揭示核铜稳态维持途径。
summary_en: This study investigates the copper homeostasis regulatory mechanism in fungi. It is found that BbAtg8 interacts with BbMac1. It reveals the pathway for maintaining nuclear copper homeostasis.
insights: BbAtg8与BbMac1相互作用维持铜稳态
真菌铜稳态调控新机制
核铜稳态维持途径揭示
insights_en: BbAtg8 interacts with BbMac1 to maintain copper homeostasis
New mechanism of copper homeostasis regulation in fungi
Pathway for maintaining nuclear copper homeostasis revealed
abstract: Pathogenic fungi endure host impose copper starvation by tightly coordinating trace metal homeostasis. However, how pathogens synchronize endogenous metal recycling with exogenous copper uptake to promote infection remains enigmatic. Using the entomopathogenic fungus Beauveria bassiana , we uncovered a synergistic regulatory network that prioritizes nuclear copper enrichment during conidial germination. Under copper deprivation, the fungus deploys a highly coordinated dual-track survival strategy. In the cytoplasm, the core autophagy protein BbAtg8 drives autophagic flux, specifically triggering mitophagy to degrade mitochondria, thereby promoting the turnover and mobilization of endogenous copper stores. Concurrently, a nonlipidated pool of BbAtg8 translocates to the nucleus to coordinate exogenous uptake. Within the nucleus, BbAtg8 directly interacts with the copper-fist transcription factor BbMac1 via a functional Atg8-interacting motif (AIM). This physical interaction serves as a potent transcriptional modulator, significantly enhancing BbMac1’s DNA-binding affinity. Consequently, the Atg8-Mac1 complex hyper-activates the expression of three functionally redundant copper transporters (BbCtr1, BbCtr2, and BbCtr4) to aggressively absorb extracellular copper. Strikingly, severe copper deprivation triggers a dynamic spatial enrichment of these classical copper transporters at the nuclear envelope, which correlates with the sustained maintenance of nuclear copper homeostasis required for essential genomic functions and full fungal virulence. Together, these findings reveal how pathogens synchronize mitophagy-mediated endogenous turnover with Mac1-driven exogenous uptake, fundamentally expanding the role of autophagy proteins BbAtg8 into direct transcriptional coordinators of metal homeostasis. This dual-track regulatory model not only deepens our understanding of fungal adaptation to nutritional immunity but also provides potential targets for disrupting copper homeostasis to control fungal pathogens.

title: A conserved Hox9–10 code underlies the early establishment of hind appendage progenitors in zebrafish and the Iberian ribbed newt
summary_zh: 研究鱼类和蝾螈后肢原基形成。发现Hox9–10基因关键作用。揭示早期形成机制。
summary_en: This study investigates the early formation of hind appendage progenitors in zebrafish and the Iberian ribbed newt. It is found that Hox9–10 genes play a crucial role. It reveals the mechanism of early formation.
insights: Hox9–10基因在早期形成中起关键作用
揭示后肢原基形成机制
鱼类和蝾螈后肢形成相似性
insights_en: Hox9–10 genes are crucial for early formation
Mechanism of hind appendage progenitor formation revealed
Similarity in hind appendage formation between fish and newts
abstract: The acquisition of paired appendages was a key innovation in vertebrate evolution. Although HoxA/D paralog groups (PGs) 9–13 play central roles in patterning paired fins and limbs, the evolutionary origin of this paired appendage-patterning system remains unknown. Here, we show that HoxA/D PG9–10 genes are essential for the early establishment of pelvic fin progenitors in zebrafish, and that Hox9–10 function is similarly required for hindlimb progenitor formation in the Iberian ribbed newt. In zebrafish, combined disruption of five HoxA/D PG9–10 genes abolishes the detectable pelvic fin progenitor population, resulting in complete loss of pelvic fins. A Tg(hoxa10b:EGFP) reporter labeled cells in the presumptive pelvic fin field before pelvic fin bud formation. Importantly, simultaneous CRISPR-mediated disruption of all seven Hox9–10 paralogs in the Iberian ribbed newt similarly impaired the establishment of hindlimb progenitors, suggesting that an early requirement for Hox9–10 function in hind appendage development predates the divergence of ray-finned and lobe-finned vertebrates. Together, these findings identify an evolutionarily conserved role for posterior Hox9–10 genes in the initial establishment of hind appendage progenitors. Because overlapping posterior Hox paralog groups are subsequently deployed during paired appendage patterning, this early Hox9–10 requirement provides a developmental link between the posterior axial Hox code and the paired appendage-patterning system. Our results are therefore consistent with the hypothesis that recruitment of a posterior Hox code into hind appendage progenitor formation contributed to the evolutionary assembly of the vertebrate paired appendage-patterning system.

title: Dynamic partitioning shapes the in vivo organization of the Escherichia coli RNA degradosome
summary_zh: 研究大肠杆菌RNA降解复合体组织。发现动态分配影响组织。揭示RNA降解调控机制。
summary_en: This study investigates the organization of the Escherichia coli RNA degradosome. It is found that dynamic partitioning affects organization. It reveals the RNA degradation regulatory mechanism.
insights: 动态分配影响RNA降解复合体组织
揭示RNA降解调控新机制
大肠杆菌RNA降解复合体组织研究
insights_en: Dynamic partitioning affects RNA degradosome organization
New mechanism of RNA degradation regulation revealed
Study of Escherichia coli RNA degradosome organization
abstract: The bacterial RNA degradosome is a central mediator of RNA turnover, yet how its components are organized and regulated in living cells remains unclear. Using live-cell single-molecule imaging, we quantified the spatial distribution and dynamics of the four major Escherichia coli degradosome components: RNase E, RhlB, PNPase, and enolase. These proteins occupied distinct membrane-associated and cytoplasmic pools whose relative abundance varied among proteins and changed with physiological state. In particular, PNPase underwent pronounced redistribution between membrane-associated and cytoplasmic states in response to altered RNA availability and growth conditions, whereas RNase E and RhlB remained largely membrane associated. To determine the functional consequences of this organization, we examined the degradation of lacZ reporter transcripts with different translation initiation strengths. PNPase and RhlB preferentially promoted degradation of weakly translated transcripts, whereas strongly translated transcripts were largely insensitive to their loss. Together, these results reveal that the bacterial RNA degradosome is not a static, uniformly assembled molecular machine. Instead, RNA decay is organized through dynamic intracellular partitioning of degradosome components, linking physiological state and translation status to transcript degradation.

title: A muscle-enriched mitochondrial protein regulates postnatal heart growth through mitonuclear ubiquinone–PPAR signaling
summary_zh: 研究肌肉富集的线粒体蛋白对心脏生长的影响。发现Coq10a调节心脏生长。揭示心脏生长调控途径。
summary_en: This study investigates the effect of a muscle-enriched mitochondrial protein on postnatal heart growth. It is found that Coq10a regulates heart growth. It reveals the pathway for heart growth regulation.
insights: Coq10a调节心脏生长
揭示心脏生长调控新途径
肌肉富集线粒体蛋白功能研究
insights_en: Coq10a regulates heart growth
New pathway for heart growth regulation revealed
Study of the function of muscle-enriched mitochondrial protein
abstract: Increased mitochondrial biogenesis and aerobic respiration in postnatal mammalian organs are essential for adaptation to extrauterine life, yet the functions of many tissue-enriched, developmentally regulated mitochondrial proteins remain poorly defined. By integrating mitochondrial proteome annotations with mouse and human transcriptomic datasets, we identified Coenzyme Q10a (Coq10a), a striated muscle-enriched mitochondrial protein, as a regulator of postnatal cardiac growth. Coq10a, the mammalian homolog of the yeast ubiquinone-binding protein Coq10p, is highly induced in the heart after birth through thyroid hormone-, Nkx2.5-, and Tbx5-dependent regulation. To define its physiological function, we generated three independent Coq10a -deficient mouse models. Both global and cardiomyocyte-specific loss of Coq10a promoted postnatal cardiac hypertrophy without impairing basal cardiac function or mitochondrial respiration. Instead, Coq10a deficiency altered intracellular ubiquinone partitioning, resulting in increased ubiquinone accumulation in a microsomal membrane fraction. Transcriptomic analyses revealed enrichment of PPAR-associated metabolic gene sets and induction of established PPAR-responsive genes in Coq10a -deficient hearts. Pharmacological inhibition of PPARα and PPARγ, but not PPARδ, attenuated the hypertrophic phenotype. Molecular dynamics simulations, docking analyses, and mutagenesis identified PPARα residues that contribute to differential responsiveness to ubiquinone. Although Coq10a -deficient hearts maintained near-normal function under basal conditions, they exhibited increased susceptibility to pressure-overload stress. Together, these findings establish Coq10a as a regulator of intracellular ubiquinone partitioning and support a model linking altered mitochondrial lipid distribution and PPAR-associated signaling to postnatal cardiac growth. More broadly, they demonstrate how tissue-enriched mitochondrial proteins can mediate organ-specific physiological functions beyond energy production.

title: Compensate peer reviewers; do not conscript them
Omega-3 fatty acids reprogram tumor-associated macrophage cytokine signaling and suppress pancreatic cancer growth
summary_zh: 研究Omega-3脂肪酸对胰腺癌细胞的影响。发现抑制肿瘤生长。揭示肿瘤微环境调控机制。
summary_en: This study investigates the effect of omega-3 fatty acids on pancreatic cancer cells. It is found to suppress tumor growth. It reveals the regulatory mechanism of the tumor microenvironment.
insights: Omega-3脂肪酸抑制肿瘤生长
肿瘤微环境调控新机制
肿瘤相关巨噬细胞信号重编程
insights_en: Omega-3 fatty acids suppress tumor growth
New mechanism of tumor microenvironment regulation
Reprogramming of tumor-associated macrophage cytokine signaling
abstract: Dietary polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs) shape inflammatory signaling within the pancreatic tumor microenvironment (TME), but the cellular mechanisms underlying their effects on tumor progression remain unclear. Using orthotopic models of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), we show that omega-3 (n-3) and omega-6 (n-6) PUFAs are differentially incorporated into tumor lipid pools, generating spatially heterogeneous lipid microenvironments. While an n-6–enriched diet accelerated PDAC growth, an n-3–enriched diet suppressed tumor growth in a T cell-independent manner. Examining inflammatory effects in PDAC tumors, the n-3 PUFA–enriched diet reduced pro-inflammatory cytokines, including IL-6 family members, and single-cell and spatial analyses identified tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) as the primary diet-responsive population. Indeed, selective conversion of n-6 to n-3 fatty acids within myeloid cells using an inducible fat-1 transgene, which encodes an n-3 desaturase that converts n-6 to n-3 PUFAs in vivo, was sufficient to suppress tumor growth, whereas fibroblast-restricted conversion had no effect. This finding is the first to formally establish that cellular origin of PUFA metabolism within the TME is a key determinant of tumor progression and identifies TAMs as critical mediators of n-3–dependent tumor suppression. Furthermore, the n-3 PUFA–enriched diet reduced Arg1 + immunosuppressive TAMs and promoted C1q + and MHC-II + antigen-presenting TAM populations enriched for antigen processing machinery and T cell–recruiting chemokines, alongside reduced IL-6 family cytokine production. Together, these findings establish macrophages as key mediators of n-3–driven tumor control and define a mechanism by which dietary lipids remodel cytokine signaling in the PDAC microenvironment.

title: A “knob-in-hole” gate in the antibody C H 1 domain underlies subclass-independent IgA hinge cleavage by the commensal metallopeptidase IgAse
summary_zh: 研究揭示抗体CH1域的“孔中旋钮”结构介导IgA铰链切割，IgAse酶切割IgA1和IgA2亚类。
summary_en: This study reveals that a 'knob-in-hole' structure in the antibody CH1 domain mediates IgA hinge cleavage by the commensal metallopeptidase IgAse, affecting both IgA1 and IgA2 subclasses.
insights: 创新点：发现抗体CH1域结构介导IgA切割的新机制
方法亮点：结合结构生物学和酶学方法
关键发现：IgAse酶切割IgA1和IgA2亚类
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of a new mechanism for IgA cleavage mediated by the antibody CH1 domain
Method highlight: Combination of structural biology and enzymology methods
Key finding: IgAse enzyme cleaves both IgA1 and IgA2 subclasses
abstract: Human immunoglobulin (Ig) A (IgA) protects ≈400 m 2 of mucosae from microbes. Bacterial IgA-peptidases subvert this defense by cleaving the F ab –F c hinge of subclass IgA1 while sparing the hinge-divergent, colon-dominant IgA2 subclass. The exception is IgAse, a ≈140-kDa, seven-domain, membrane-bound metallopeptidase from the colonic commensal Thomasclavelia ramosa that targets both subclasses but no other protein. We previously narrowed the minimal functional assembly down to the IgAse catalytic and wrapping domains (CD and WD) plus the IgA1/2 F ab ′, i.e., the hinge and a F ab of light and heavy chains (LC, HC), each with a variable and a constant Ig domain (V L + C L , V H + C H 1). The transient interaction culminates in cleavage of a proline–valine bond within the first two hinge residues, downstream of a conserved C-terminal C H 1 disulfide (SS2). Here, single-particle cryoelectron microscopy of a disulfide-stabilized minimal IgAse:IgA2 F ab ′ complex yielded high-quality density strongly supporting two states along the cleavage reaction coordinate, a “recognition complex” and a subsequent “precatalytic complex,” in which F ab ′ binds frontally to the IgAse CD via a C H 1 β-sheet and overhang loop LβEβF. This loop binds like a knob to a preformed hole in the active-site cleft. Binding rearranges the knob and rotates SS2 ≈ 180°, enabling access of the hinge into the cleft of the otherwise unaffected precatalytic complex. Together, this work defines a unique, C H 1-mediated hinge-delivering “gate” mechanism, validated by a crystal structure of unbound IgA2 F ab , point mutations disrupting the C H 1:CD interface, and molecular dynamics calculations, which provide the structural framework for subclass-independent IgA cleavage.

title: A promoter G-quadruplex recruits Hrb27C to regulate NEMO and immune defense against Lyme disease pathogens in the deer tick
summary_zh: 研究发现鹿蜱NEMO基因启动子中的G-四链体招募Hrb27C，调节NEMO表达和免疫防御。
summary_en: This study identifies a G-quadruplex in the promoter of the deer tick NEMO gene that recruits Hrb27C to regulate NEMO expression and immune defense against Lyme disease pathogens.
insights: 创新点：揭示G-四链体在蜱类免疫调节中的作用
方法亮点：利用多种生物物理技术验证G-四链体结构
关键发现：G-四链体是NEMO转录调控的关键
insights_en: Novelty: Unveiling the role of G-quadruplexes in tick immune regulation
Method highlight: Utilization of various biophysical techniques to verify G-quadruplex structure
Key finding: G-quadruplex is a key regulator of NEMO transcription
abstract: Genomic DNA can adopt noncanonical secondary structures, such as G-quadruplexes (G4s), which serve as critical regulatory elements beyond the traditional double helix. Whether promoter G4s also participate in controlling innate immune signaling and host–pathogen interactions, however, remains unknown in arthropods. In this study, we identify a G4 structure within the promoter of the NEMO (NF-κB essential modulator) gene in the deer tick Ixodes scapularis . Using a combination of circular dichroism, isothermal difference spectra, and fluorescence-based assays, we demonstrate that this sequence forms a stable, parallel G4 topology in vitro and in vivo. Functional characterization via luciferase reporter assays reveals that this G4 scaffold is essential for proper NEMO transcriptional output. Importantly, disruption of the G4 structure significantly reduces NEMO expression and increases the burden of the Lyme disease spirochete Borrelia burgdorferi . Genome-wide expression profiling further reveals that perturbation of the NEMO G4 produces transcriptional changes that overlap with those observed following NEMO silencing. These shared transcriptional responses are enriched for immune-associated genes and ribonucleoprotein-related pathways. We further identify the heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein Hrb27C as a structural binding protein that specifically recognizes the NEMO G4 through its RNA recognition motif domains and facilitates NEMO expression. Collectively, our findings establish promoter G4 architecture as an important regulatory layer in tick immunity, linking DNA topology to pathogen proliferation and providing a structural framework for understanding host–pathogen dynamics in disease vectors.

title: Reconstructing actin dynamics of the leading edge from observational data
summary_zh: 研究通过分析细胞前沿蛋白密度和速度，重建细胞突起机制。
summary_en: This study reconstructs the protrusion mechanism by analyzing protein density and velocity at the cell leading edge.
insights: 创新点：利用多模态显微镜数据重建细胞动态
方法亮点：结合相空间和回归分析
关键发现：揭示细胞突起机制
insights_en: Novelty: Reconstruction of cell dynamics using multiplex microscopy imaging data
Method highlight: Combination of phase space and regression analysis
Key finding: Unveiling the mechanism of cell protrusion
abstract: Mesenchymal cell migration starts with the protrusion of the cell’s leading edge, enabled by the branching growth of the actin network. Two crucial molecular players in protrusion are actin filaments and the Arp2/3 complex, the branching agent. Traditionally, protrusion models are intuited from several perturbative experiments. Recent multiplex microscopy imaging data promise to change this paradigm by providing measurements of naturally fluctuating densities of key proteins at the leading edge of unperturbed cells. We report an attempt to reconstruct the mechanistic protrusion model from such data. We analyze fluctuations of densities of actin filaments and Arp2/3 complex and cell edge velocity using phase space and regression analysis to reconstruct linearized dynamics of the coupled actin-Arp2/3-velocity system. We then build a nonlinear model of these dynamics based on previous knowledge of this system and parsimony. The resulting models recover the rates of reactions and mechanical and transport processes in the lamellipodium from a single nonperturbative experiment. The models posit that the dominant nonlinear term in the lamellipodial dynamics corresponds to the retrograde flow of the actin network in the cell frame. The models suggest that the protrusion is dominated by a damped oscillatory cycle resulting from a combination of positive feedback from the Arp2/3 complex to protrusion velocity and negative feedback from actin density to the velocity.

title: Poly(phenolic) deposition is a prerequisite to poly(aliphatic) deposition for functional potato suberin
summary_zh: 研究证明聚酚沉积是聚脂肪族沉积的先决条件，对马铃薯亚尔宾功能至关重要。
summary_en: This study demonstrates that poly(phenolic) deposition is a prerequisite for poly(aliphatic) deposition, crucial for the functionality of potato suberin.
insights: 创新点：揭示植物细胞壁亚尔宾沉积的顺序
方法亮点：利用RNA干扰技术验证机制
关键发现：聚酚沉积是聚脂肪族沉积的先决条件
insights_en: Novelty: Unveiling the sequential deposition of suberin in plant cell walls
Method highlight: Utilization of RNA interference to validate the mechanism
Key finding: Poly(phenolic) deposition is a prerequisite for poly(aliphatic) deposition
abstract: Suberin deposition in specialized cells is a critical aspect of plant protection, providing both water retention and pathogen protection functions. Tissue specific suberization during plant development is mirrored by its wound induction in cells that do not normally suberize and provides a robust experimental system to investigate the process. Suberized cells are characterized by a cell wall–associated lignin-like poly(phenolic) domain, and an ester-linked poly(aliphatic) domain, with the latter often laid down in distinct lamellar bands between the cell wall and plasma membrane. Previous work provides evidence that poly(phenolic) deposition precedes, and is necessary for, poly(aliphatic) deposition. To test this further, we generated RNAi knockdown lines of three wound-induced peroxidase genes, PRX19, PRX55, and PRX105 , in potato ( Solanum tuberosum ), the tubers of which produce an abundance of suberin upon wounding. Peroxidases catalyze the oxidative free radical coupling of phenolic monomers to form the suberin poly(phenolic) domain. The wound-induced suberin of PRX19-RNAi tubers had severely reduced poly(phenolics), reduced poly(aliphatics), and no apparent lamella. Functionally, wound-induced PRX19-RNAi tubers were more permeable to water loss and susceptible to bacterial soft rot. Overall, our data support the hypothesis that poly(phenolic) domain assembly is a strict requirement for subsequent deposition of aliphatic lamella within wound-induced suberin.

title: Loss of tRNA uridine thiolation affects mRNA translation, protein production, and metabolite accumulation in Arabidopsis
summary_zh: 研究证实tRNA尿苷硫醇化缺失影响拟南芥mRNA翻译、蛋白质生产和代谢积累。
summary_en: This study confirms that the loss of tRNA uridine thiolation affects mRNA translation, protein production, and metabolite accumulation in Arabidopsis.
insights: 创新点：揭示tRNA硫醇化在植物代谢中的作用
方法亮点：利用拟南芥模型系统研究
关键发现：tRNA硫醇化影响多种代谢途径
insights_en: Novelty: Unveiling the role of tRNA thiolation in plant metabolism
Method highlight: Utilization of Arabidopsis as a model system
Key finding: tRNA thiolation affects multiple metabolic pathways
abstract: It is well established in yeast and animal system that the level of uridine thiolation at position 34 of tRNA anticodon loops can impact the decoding potential of the corresponding codons. Using Arabidopsis thaliana , we confirm that the ability of the plant ribosome to decode AAA, GAA, and CAA codons is impaired when this thiol group is lost, leading to a reduction in protein production, especially for genes enriched in these codons. Interestingly, we observed that loss of tRNA thiolation results in variations in the levels of numerous proteins involved in sulfur-compound metabolism and amino acid biosynthesis. These variations, in turn, affect the accumulation of several sulfur-containing metabolites and amino acids, suggesting that the level of tRNA thiolation has a direct and profound impact on plant metabolism. We also demonstrate that U 34 thiolation is essential for adjusting plant growth in response to sulfur limitation and that its absence directly affects the plant’s interaction with bacteria, including both pathogens and beneficial organisms. Our results support the hypothesis that the level of tRNA thiolation can be used in plant to link nutritional status to translation.

title: Controlled functionalization of cellulose nanocrystals directs polymer-specific protein coronas and immune cell interactions
summary_zh: 研究通过控制纤维素纳米晶体功能化，引导聚合物特异性蛋白质冠和免疫细胞相互作用。
summary_en: This study demonstrates that controlled functionalization of cellulose nanocrystals directs polymer-specific protein coronas and immune cell interactions.
insights: 创新点：开发基于纤维素纳米晶体的功能化平台
方法亮点：系统比较不同聚合物修饰效果
关键发现：引导免疫细胞相互作用
insights_en: Novelty: Development of a functionalization platform based on cellulose nanocrystals
Method highlight: Systematic comparison of effects of different polymer modifications
Key finding: Guiding immune cell interactions
abstract: Polymer coatings are widely used to suppress nonspecific protein adsorption and modulate nanoparticle–cell interactions. However, the biological outcomes of polymer-functionalized nanoparticles remain difficult to predict in complex biological environments because protein corona formation rapidly alters nanoparticle identity. This challenge is particularly pronounced when hydrophobic moieties are incorporated for imaging or therapeutic applications, as they can promote nonspecific interactions at the nano–bio interface. Herein, we establish a modular grafting-to platform based on cellulose nanocrystals (CNCs) that enables systematic comparison of polyethylene glycol (PEG)-based, zwitterionic, and acrylamide-based polymers with controlled grafting density and chain conformation on a common porphyrin-modified surface. We demonstrate that dense polymer brushes reduce nonspecific protein adsorption in single-protein assays. By contrast, all CNC surfaces form dynamic coronas upon exposure to serum proteins, while specific polymer coatings selectively enrich or suppress distinct protein populations. We further demonstrate that polymer-dependent immune cell interactions are substantially reduced following protein corona formation, although differences among polymer chemistries persist. Zwitterionic coatings broadly suppress immune cell interactions, whereas PEG-based coatings preferentially promote interactions with antigen-presenting cells. These findings establish design principles for polymer-functionalized nanoparticles with specific immune cell interaction profiles.

title: Membrane contact activation of Piezo2 drives lysosome–mitochondrion Ca 2+ transfer and signaling in Trypanosoma cruzi
summary_zh: 研究揭示Trypanosoma cruzi中Piezo2膜接触激活驱动溶酶体-线粒体Ca2+转移和信号传导。
summary_en: This study reveals that membrane contact activation of Piezo2 drives lysosome–mitochondrion Ca2+ transfer and signaling in Trypanosoma cruzi.
insights: 创新点：发现Piezo2在细胞器通讯中的作用
方法亮点：结合超微结构、生化及活细胞成像技术
关键发现：Piezo2介导Ca2+转移和信号传导
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the role of Piezo2 in organelle communication
Method highlight: Combination of ultrastructural, biochemical, and live-cell imaging techniques
Key finding: Piezo2 mediates Ca2+ transfer and signaling
abstract: Calcium ion (Ca 2+ ) transfer from other organelles is central to mitochondrial metabolism and cell survival, yet how mechanical forces regulate interorganelle communication remains unclear. Here we report a lysosome-to-mitochondrion pathway in Trypanosoma cruzi , the etiologic agent of Chagas disease, mediated by the mechano/osmosensitive channel TcPiezo2. Using ultrastructural, biochemical, and live-cell superresolution imaging, we define lysosome–mitochondrion contact sites (LMCs) that enable direct Ca 2+ transfer. TcPiezo2 triggers Ca 2+ release, which generates perilysosomal nanodomains that drives mitochondrial Ca 2+ uptake via the voltage-dependent anion channel and the mitochondrial Ca 2+ uniporter complex. Disruption of TcPiezo2-dependent Ca 2+ transfer impairs mitochondrial metabolism, perturbs redox homeostasis, induces autophagy, and eventually leads to parasite death. These findings establish LMCs as a signaling platform that directly regulates interorganelle Ca 2+ transfer and mitochondrial bioenergetics.

title: Reply to Gillan et al.: What should be the null hypothesis in computational psychiatry?
S -adenosyl-L-homocysteine triggers an adaptive response that extends lifespan through the YBT1 ABC transporter
summary_zh: 研究显示S-腺苷-L-高半胱氨酸通过YBT1 ABC转运蛋白触发适应性反应，延长酵母寿命。
summary_en: This study shows that S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine triggers an adaptive response that extends yeast lifespan through the YBT1 ABC transporter.
insights: 创新点：揭示SAH在酵母寿命调节中的作用
方法亮点：利用酵母模型系统研究SAH代谢
关键发现：YBT1转运蛋白在SAH作用中起关键作用
insights_en: Novelty: Unveiling the role of SAH in yeast lifespan regulation
Method highlight: Utilization of yeast model systems to study SAH metabolism
Key finding: YBT1 ABC transporter plays a key role in the action of SAH
abstract: S -adenosyl-L-methionine (SAM) is a fundamental methyl donor; however, the physiological role of its byproduct and competitive inhibitor, S -adenosyl-L-homocysteine (SAH), remains unclear. Here, we show that transient reactive oxygen species (ROS) production triggered by SAH during the early logarithmic phase mimics partial SAH hydrolase inhibition, extending the yeast chronological lifespan (CLS) through a hormetic mechanism. This study reveals that the dual nature of ROS in aging is determined by the specific degree of SAH hydrolase activity. We identified the adenosine 5’-triphosphate-binding cassette (ABC) transporter Ybt1 as a key downstream effector of SAH. Ybt1 localizes to the vacuolar membrane and facilitates the sequestration of SAM from the cytosol into the vacuole. Notably, YBT1 overexpression extends CLS, mimicking SAH effects through an integrated pathway involving target of rapamycin complex 1 downregulation, autophagy, and adenosine 5’-monophosphate-activated protein kinase activation. Our findings establish that SAH acts as a metabolic signal coupling nutrient and energy availability to longevity via Ybt1, defining an adaptive/hormetic response for lifespan regulation in yeast.

title: Modulation of avian iridescence via melanogenesis
summary_zh: 研究鸟类羽毛纳米结构形成分子机制。利用突变和野生鸟种色变分析。发现八种基因影响羽毛颜色。
summary_en: Investigates the molecular mechanism of avian feather nanostructure formation. Utilizes mutations and natural color variations in wild birds for analysis. Identifies eight genes affecting feather coloration.
insights: 创新点：揭示羽毛颜色形成分子机制
方法亮点：结合基因组、细胞和光学方法
关键发现：发现影响羽毛颜色的基因
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the molecular mechanism of feather color formation
Method highlight: Integrates genomic, cellular, and optical approaches
Key finding: Identified genes affecting feather coloration
abstract: The iridescent colors of birds originate in nanoscale feather structures that interact with light. Although the physical principles governing avian iridescence are well established, the molecular mechanisms assembling these nanostructures into photonic materials remain unknown. Here, we integrated genomic, cellular, and optical approaches to investigate the molecular basis of iridescent color formation in birds. We leveraged mutations that arose in the domesticated Indian peafowl and natural color variation in wild birds. In peafowl, we identified eight genes underlying gains, losses, and shifts of iridescence, whereas in two wild species, we used single-cell transcriptomics to profile asymmetric feathers in which iridescent and noniridescent barbules develop on opposite sides of the same feather. We found that all peafowl mutations mapped to melanogenesis genes, showing that variation in this pathway can modify diverse geometric features of feather photonic nanostructures. Mutations altering melanin composition collapsed multilayered photonic systems and yielded noniridescent tissues, whereas changes in melanosome abundance, elongation, or deposition timing generated multilayer architectures with variable periodicity and color. We further show in peafowl that transitions from noniridescent to iridescent plumage were associated with single-nucleotide mutations in a melanogenesis gene, suggesting that, in species already capable of forming multilayered nanostructures, iridescence can be gained by relatively small genetic changes. Single-cell transcriptomes from wild species also supported extensive melanocyte-centered regulatory rewiring associated with iridescence, including changes in melanosome maturation, trafficking, and intercellular signaling. Together, these results show that the nanoscale order underlying iridescence is developmentally plastic and highly responsive to the melanogenic environment.

title: Reply to Gorelick and Kunst: Paying reviewers will increase publication costs and could exacerbate inequities
Thermal imbalance drives avian performance and responses to climate warming
summary_zh: 研究体温调节失衡对鸟类性能和气候变化响应的影响。通过模拟和实证分析，发现体温调节失衡影响繁殖和地理分布。
summary_en: Studies the impact of thermoregulatory imbalance on avian performance and responses to climate warming. Through simulations and empirical analysis, finds that thermal imbalance affects reproduction and geographic distribution.
insights: 创新点：提出体温调节失衡理论
方法亮点：结合生物物理模拟和实证数据
关键发现：体温调节失衡影响繁殖和地理分布
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes a theory of thermal imbalance
Method highlight: Combines biophysical simulations with empirical data
Key finding: Thermal imbalance affects reproduction and geographic distribution
abstract: Thermal performance curves are widely used to predict ectothermic responses to climate warming but are less effective for predicting endotherm performance across environmental conditions because thermoregulation often decouples body temperature from ambient temperature. We develop theory and provide empirical evidence for performance curves in endotherms structured by net sensible heat flux (Q), an integrative index of thermoregulatory imbalance. Using biophysical simulations in tree swallows, we show that performance varies predictably with Q (which we term “QPCs”), thereby explaining variation in nestling provisioning performance, reproductive fitness, and geographic limits, while also forecasting responses to climate change. We also demonstrate that thermal imbalance helps shape breeding ranges of birds across North America. Our findings introduce Q as a broadly relevant ecophysiological dimension that constrains performance in endotherms and provides a framework for predicting endotherm responses to climate warming.

title: A transposon inserted into HELD1 repressed maize husk leaf blade extension during maize domestication
summary_zh: 研究玉米驯化过程中玉米叶鞘叶片延伸的遗传基础。发现 tru1 基因内插入转座子影响叶片延伸。
summary_en: Studies the genetic basis of maize husk leaf blade extension during domestication. Finds that a transposon inserted into the tru1 gene affects leaf extension.
insights: 创新点：揭示玉米叶片延伸的遗传机制
方法亮点：定位关键基因 tru1
关键发现：转座子影响叶片延伸
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the genetic mechanism of maize leaf extension
Method highlight: Locates the key gene tru1
Key finding: Transposon affects leaf extension
abstract: Husk leaves are the closest photosynthetic organs to the ear, which contribute directly to grain filling and have potential for yield improvement in maize. Teosinte has a long husk extended leaf blade, whereas maize exhibits a reduced or even no husk leaf blade. However, the genetic basis of this transition in the husk leaf during domestication remains unknown. In this study, we identified a major quantitative trait locus (QTL), Husk Extended Leaf Blade 1 ( HELD1 ), corresponding to the tassels replace upper ears1 ( tru1 ) gene. A 133-base pair (bp) Harbinger transposon inserted into the tru1 intron introduces two TEOSINTE BRANCHED 1 (TB1) binding motifs, thereby recruiting TB1 to directly enhance tru1 transcription. Further analyses revealed that TRU1 interacts with the transcription factor ALOG1, which in turn enhances the expression of liguleless2 ( lg2 ), a key regulator of ligule development. Together with brassinosteroid-deficient dwarf1 ( brd1 ) and GA2ox1 , these genes set up a regulatory network that defines the ligular-auricular position, controls the leaf blade-to-husk (sheath) ratio in husk and stem leaves, and regulates husk leaf blade length. Population genetic analyses indicate that HELD1 experienced significant human selection, resulting in the transposon insertion becoming the dominant allele in domesticated maize.
