Additionally, the teosinte HELD1 allele with extended husk leaf blades significantly enhances yield in maize. Our results demonstrate HELD1 is an important regulator of husk and stem leaf architectures, contributing to the ligular-auricular position to adjust the ratio of leaf blade to husk or sheath.

title: Perfusion beyond Margin in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Contrast-enhanced US Feature Related to Tumor Invasiveness and Prognosis
Deepweed: Automated Individual Segmentation and Tracking for Duckweed Lineage Analysis
summary_zh: 开发 Deepweed，用于水生植物鸭趾草的个体分割和谱系分析。通过深度学习实现个体追踪和谱系重建。
summary_en: Develops Deepweed for automated individual segmentation and lineage analysis of aquatic duckweed. Achieves individual tracking and lineage reconstruction using deep learning.
insights: 创新点：提出鸭趾草个体分割和谱系分析新方法
方法亮点：应用深度学习技术
关键发现：实现个体追踪和谱系重建
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes a new method for duckweed individual segmentation and lineage analysis
Method highlight: Applies deep learning technology
Key finding: Achieves individual tracking and lineage reconstruction
abstract: Abstract Motivation Aquatic duckweeds, including Wolffia australiana, are the smallest and fastest growing flowering plants on the planet, with numerous emerging biotechnological applications. Duckweed populations grow through rapid clonal budding, but existing phenotypic characterization and image analysis tools typically operate only at the population level, tracking neither individual plants nor their lineage structure. Deepweed addresses this gap, combining automated individual segmentation, temporal tracking, and clonal lineage reconstruction from time-lapse imaging of duckweed. Results Deepweed processes time-lapse duckweed imaging datasets using deep-learning–based instance segmentation and multi-object tracking to assign persistent identities to individual fronds and infer mother–daughter relationships. The workflow outputs lineage graphs, individual-level morphological metrics, and population-level growth summaries, supported by lineage-annotated time-lapse visualizations. Applied to dense Wolffia populations, in both freely growing or controlled microfluidic environments, our framework can track hundreds of Wolffia plants simultaneously, resolves overlapping individuals, and reconstructs multi-generation lineage structure, enabling analyses that are inaccessible with population-level phenotyping methods. Availability Deepweed is implemented in Python using PyTorch, scikit-image, OpenCV, and btrack. Source code, trained models, example datasets, and documentation are freely available at https://github.com/SamOliveiraLab/Deepweed. The Deepweed code is archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18844282 and the datasets are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18843917. Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Seq2Pocket: Augmenting protein language models for spatially consistent binding site prediction
summary_zh: 提出 Seq2Pocket 方法，增强蛋白质语言模型进行空间一致结合位点预测。结合微调、数据增强和结构感知后处理。
summary_en: Presents Seq2Pocket, a methodology for enhancing protein language models for spatially consistent binding site prediction. Combines fine-tuning, data augmentation, and structure-aware post-processing.
insights: 创新点：提出结合微调、数据增强和后处理的方法
方法亮点：实现空间一致结合位点预测
关键发现：提高结合位点预测的准确性
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes a method combining fine-tuning, data augmentation, and post-processing
Method highlight: Achieves spatially consistent binding site prediction
Key finding: Improves accuracy of binding site prediction
abstract: Abstract Motivation Protein-ligand binding site prediction (LBS) is important for many areas of structural biology and molecular modeling, where, as in other tasks, protein language models (pLMs) have shown great promise. In their application to LBS, the pLM classifies each amino acid as binding or not, but translating these predictions into three-dimensional binding pockets remains challenging; in particular, residue-centric predictions tend to produce spatially fragmented pockets. Results We present Seq2Pocket, a methodology for pocket-level LBS prediction that combines pLM finetuning, data enhancement, and structure-aware post-processing. First, we introduce sc-PDBenhanced, an extended training dataset that augments an existing sc-PDB dataset with additional small-molecule and ion-binding sites, improving coverage of non-obvious and small pockets. Second, we employ an embedding-supported smoothing classifier to refine residue-level predictions. Third, we define the Pocket Fragmentation Index and use it to select a clustering approach that preserves a consistent mapping between predictions and ground-truth pockets. We evaluate Seq2Pocket on two tasks: general binding site prediction using the LIGYSIS benchmark and cryptic binding site prediction using CryptoBench benchmark. Across both benchmarks, Seq2Pocket achieves state-of-the-art DCCtop-N and DCCtop-(N+2) performance. In particular, for general binding site prediction on the LIGYSIS benchmark, it improves distance-center-to-center recall by up to 13%, outperforming existing predictors. This improvement originates from training data quality rather than model architecture, as demonstrated by an ablation study. We believe that these findings contribute to more reliable evaluation practices in ligand binding site prediction, highlight the importance of training data curation, and provide pocket-level prediction tools that are better suited for downstream applications such as drug discovery. Availability The Seq2Pocket web interface is available at https://seq2pocket.projekty.ms.mff.cuni.cz, running the ESM-2 650M variant. The sc-PDBenhanced is published using Zenodo platform at https://zenodo.org/records/18271517 [Škrhák and Hoksza 2026]. The models are published at HuggingFace: https://huggingface.co/skrhakv/seq2pocket. Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: DNAharvester: A Nextflow Pipeline for Analysing Highly Degraded DNA from Ancient and Historical Specimens
summary_zh: 开发 DNAharvester，用于分析古代和历史样本中的高度降解 DNA。集成元基因组过滤和比较基因组学分析。
summary_en: Develops DNAharvester, a Nextflow pipeline for analyzing highly degraded DNA from ancient and historical specimens. Integrates metagenomic filtering and comparative genomics analysis.
insights: 创新点：提出高度降解 DNA 分析新方法
方法亮点：集成元基因组过滤和比较基因组学
关键发现：提高古代 DNA 分析的准确性
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes a new method for highly degraded DNA analysis
Method highlight: Integrates metagenomic filtering and comparative genomics
Key finding: Improves accuracy of ancient DNA analysis
abstract: Abstract Motivation Ancient DNA (aDNA) research has advanced rapidly with the development of high-throughput sequencing, enabling genome-wide analyses of large collections of prehistoric specimens. However, analysing palaeontological and archaeological material with highly degraded DNA constitutes a major bioinformatic challenge. DNA from such samples is characterized by short fragment lengths, low endogenous content, post-mortem damage, and cross-species contamination, which can increase spurious mapping and reference bias, affecting downstream population genetic inferences. Results We present DNAharvester, a modular and reproducible pipeline designed specifically for processing highly degraded DNA from ancient and historical specimens. DNAharvester integrates metagenomic filtering, competitive mapping, adaptive aligner selection (incorporating BWA-aln, BWA-mem, and Bowtie2), and systematic evaluation of reference bias and spurious mapping. By incorporating flexible mapping and filtering strategies, the pipeline can be adapted to varying sample preservation, focusing on maximizing authentic data recovery. DNAharvester features subworkflows for iterative assembly of mitogenomes, identification of genomic repeats and CpG sites, taxonomic classification, microbial/pathogen screening, genetic sex determination, and variant calling. To accommodate varying sequencing depths, the pipeline supports diploid variant calling, genotype likelihood estimation, and pseudo-haploid random allele calling. We validated the pipeline using simulated and empirical datasets, demonstrating its ability to systematically mitigate complex background contamination while preserving authentic genomic signals. By streamlining complex bioinformatic tasks through simple configuration files, DNAharvester establishes a standardized approach for analysing aDNA datasets and makes genomic analyses of ancient remains accessible to the broader research community. Availability and Implementation Implemented in Nextflow, DNAharvester provides a highly scalable, containerized framework that enhances reproducibility, portability, and robustness in aDNA analyses. DNAharvester is open source under the GNU General Public License v3.0 and freely available at https://github.com/NBISweden/DNAharvester. Supplementary Information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online and Zenodo repository: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22725211

title: Motion-corrected Noise2Noise denoising for structural analysis of cells and tissues with (cryo-)FIB/SEM
summary_zh: 开发运动校正的 Noise2Noise 去噪方法，用于细胞和组织的结构分析。提高 (cryo-)FIB/SEM 数据的分辨率。
summary_en: Develops a motion-corrected Noise2Noise denoising method for structural analysis of cells and tissues with (cryo-)FIB/SEM. Improves the resolution of (cryo-)FIB/SEM data.
insights: 创新点：提出运动校正的 Noise2Noise 去噪方法
方法亮点：提高 (cryo-)FIB/SEM 数据分辨率
关键发现：改善细胞和组织结构分析
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes a motion-corrected Noise2Noise denoising method
Method highlight: Improves resolution of (cryo-)FIB/SEM data
Key finding: Improves structural analysis of cells and tissues
abstract: MOTIVATION: (Cryo-)FIB/SEM enables three-dimensional (3D) ultrastructural analysis of cells and tissues at nanoscale resolution. However, its characteristically low signal-to-noise ratio severely hinders interpretation of the volume data. Noise2Noise has emerged as a state-of-the-art denoising paradigm with outstanding performance in 3D electron microscopy -particularly cryo-ET- but its direct application to (cryo-)FIB/SEM remains unfeasible due to the inherent acquisition workflows. RESULTS: A method to enable Noise2Noise denoising in (cryo-)FIB/SEM is introduced. The input volume is split into even and odd slices followed by the application of motion correction methods to estimate and compensate for the structural differences between the two subvolumes. The resulting motion-corrected subvolumes are then used to train the Noise2Noise model, which is ultimately applied to denoise the original volume. Representative (cryo-)FIB/SEM volumes have been used to validate the method and to demonstrate the critical importance of the motion correction stage for volumes with a slice thickness greater than 10 nm. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Code is available at https://github.com/microscopy-processing/N2N-REO and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22303478. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Multi-day recalibration-free electrophysiology interface based on carbon nanotube thin film dry electrodes
_topics: carbon nanotube thin film dry electrodes
summary_zh: 现有电极接口易受伪影或漂移影响，需频繁重训练。本研究提出基于碳纳米管干电极的接口设计，实现低阻抗、高信号保真度。
summary_en: Existing electrode interfaces are susceptible to artifacts or drift, requiring frequent retraining. This study presents an end-to-end design of dry electrodes based on carbon nanotube thin films, achieving low impedance and high signal fidelity.
insights: 创新点：碳纳米管干电极实现长期稳定信号
方法亮点：平衡结构和电学特性
关键发现：优于湿电极性能
insights_en: Novelty: Carbon nanotube dry electrodes achieve long-term stable signals
Method highlight: Balancing structural and electrical properties
Key finding: Outperforms wet electrodes
abstract: Abstract Electrophysiological signals provide crucial and reliable information for decoding behavioral and cognitive human states. However, existing electrode interfaces are susceptible to artifacts or drift over time, thereby requiring frequent machine-learning model retraining. Here we present an end-to-end design of dry electrodes based on carbon nanotube (CNT) thin films, synthesized by a roll-to-roll floating catalyst chemical vapor deposition process. By balancing structural and electrical properties, we achieved low electrode-skin impedance, high signal fidelity, minimal motion artifacts, high breathability, and biocompatibility, outperforming the gold standard wet electrodes. In a multichannel myoelectric interface demonstration, these CNT electrodes maintained stable signals and consistent task performance across 14 days using only minutes of training data and no further model retraining. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of a multi-day recalibration-free dry electrode system under naturalistic conditions, achieved by stable electrode–skin interface, rather than ongoing algorithmic adaptation.

title: Aberrant one-carbon metabolism and ancestral genetics underlie edematous severe acute malnutrition
summary_zh: 水肿性急性营养不良病因不明，本研究评估一碳代谢相关基因变异，发现与水肿性营养不良显著相关。
summary_en: The etiology of edematous severe acute malnutrition remains unclear. This study assesses genetic variants related to one-carbon metabolism, finding significant association with edematous malnutrition.
insights: 创新点：发现一碳代谢相关基因变异与水肿性营养不良相关
方法亮点：遗传变异关联分析
关键发现：一碳代谢变异显著相关
insights_en: Novelty: Genetic variants related to one-carbon metabolism associated with edematous malnutrition
Method highlight: Genetic variant association analysis
Key finding: One-carbon metabolism variants significantly associated
abstract: Edematous severe childhood malnutrition is distinct from the non-edematous form of malnutrition and remains a major cause of under-five mortality. Its etiology remains unclear, although aberrant one-carbon metabolism has emerged as a potential contributor. Here, we assess genetic variants at loci known to influence one-carbon metabolism, and determine their association with edematous malnutrition in Jamaica and Malawi. Six loci show evidence of association, including four related to homocysteine and folate metabolism - AHCYL1, PRICKLE2, GABBR2, and PLD2, with SNPs at the latter three also having direct effects on homocysteine-related metabolites in Mendelian Randomization. Collectively, one-carbon metabolism-related variants were significantly associated with edematous malnutrition (z = 3.2), with population differences linked to a shared East African genetic ancestry and distinct signatures of selection. These findings strengthen evidence implicating aberrant one-carbon metabolism in edematous malnutrition and highlight the utility of cell-free DNA, intra-continental admixture, and population genetics for mapping disease risk.

title: Bioinspired nanozyme-exoskeletonized yeast-derived polysaccharides for treating comorbid anxiety and depression in inflammatory bowel disease
summary_zh: 炎症性肠病常伴心理疾病，本研究开发纳米酶外骨骼化酵母多糖，具有抗炎、屏障修复和调节菌群作用。
summary_en: Inflammatory bowel disease often accompanies psychological disorders. This study develops nanozyme-exoskeletonized yeast-derived polysaccharides with anti-inflammatory, barrier-repairing, and microbiota-modulating effects.
insights: 创新点：纳米酶外骨骼化酵母多糖治疗心理疾病
方法亮点：结合纳米酶与酵母多糖
关键发现：抑制炎症循环
insights_en: Novelty: Nanozyme-exoskeletonized yeast-derived polysaccharides for treating psychological disorders
Method highlight: Integration of nanozymes with yeast-derived polysaccharides
Key finding: Inhibition of inflammatory cycle
abstract: Abstract Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a chronic condition frequently accompanied by psychological comorbidities, such as anxiety and depression. Although current treatments may alleviate some of these symptoms, the intricate pathogenesis of these comorbidities highlights an urgent need for therapeutic strategies with combined anti-inflammatory, barrier-reparative, and microbiota-modulating effects. Herein, we develop a series of nanozyme-exoskeletonized yeast-derived polysaccharides (NZEP) by integrating nanozymes with yeast-derived polysaccharides using an insect sclerotization-inspired strategy. Among them, NZEP TA-Ce , with the highest degree of nanozyme-exoskeletonization, is capable of disrupting the inflammatory vicious cycle by inhibiting MAPK and NF-κB-mediated inflammatory signaling pathways. Oral administration of NZEP TA-Ce in mice enables effective retention and accumulation in inflamed colonic regions, reverses the homeostasis imbalance of intestinal inflammation and promotes intestinal barrier repair. Furthermore, NZEP TA-Ce treatment reverses gut microbiota dysbiosis and optimizes the composition of microbial metabolites, thereby alleviating anxiety and depressive symptoms associated with IBD. This study provides a safe and promising therapeutic strategy for the management of IBD patients and their associated psychological comorbidities.

title: Regulation of PDH via cysteine oxidation on DLAT
summary_zh: 研究发现PDH活性除磷酸化调控外，还受DLAT亚基三个半胱氨酸氧化抑制。氧化增加于氧化应激，广泛存在于小鼠和人类组织中。此机制使细胞有效应对氧化应激。
summary_en: This study reveals that PDH activity is regulated by inhibitory oxidation of three cysteines in the DLAT subunit, in addition to phosphorylation. Oxidation increases under oxidative stress and is prevalent in mouse and human tissues, enabling cells to efficiently combat oxidative stress.
insights: 创新点：发现PDH活性受半胱氨酸氧化调控的新机制
方法亮点：通过氧化应激研究PDH活性调控
关键发现：氧化应激下细胞代谢转向戊糖磷酸途径
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of a new mechanism regulating PDH activity via cysteine oxidation
Method highlight: Investigating PDH activity regulation under oxidative stress
Key finding: Metabolic shift of cells towards the pentose phosphate pathway under oxidative stress
abstract: Abstract Pyruvate dehydrogenase (PDH) complex is a key regulator of metabolism, controlling flux from glycolysis into the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle. PDH is often dysregulated in metabolic diseases and cancer. We discover here that in addition to its well characterized regulation by phosphorylation, PDH activity is also regulated via inhibitory oxidation of three cysteines of the DLAT subunit - Cys488, Cys586 and Cys618. Oxidation of these cysteines increases under oxidative stress, and is highly prevalent in mouse and human tissues. This mechanism enables cells to efficiently fight oxidative stress. Under oxidative stress, cells execute a metabolic shift, blocking glycolytic flux into the TCA cycle to shunt glycolytic carbons toward the pentose phosphate pathway. This generates NADPH which cells use to detoxify H 2 O 2 and to reduce oxidized cysteines. We find that DLAT oxidation is required for cells to mount an effective antioxidant response. Mutations preventing DLAT oxidation render PDH resistant to oxidative inhibition, impair NADPH generation, reduce peroxide detoxification, and sensitize cells to oxidative damage and death. DLAT oxidation also drives a Warburg-like metabolic phenotype of increased glucose uptake, elevated lactate secretion, and reduced TCA cycle activity. Thus DLAT oxidation is a redox-sensing mechanism that regulates PDH activity and central carbon metabolism.

title: Integrated multi-omics identifies distinct immune signatures with diagnostic and therapeutic implications in immune checkpoint inhibitor-induced myocarditis
summary_zh: 研究通过单细胞RNA测序、流式细胞术、Olink蛋白质组学和多重细胞因子分析，揭示了免疫检查点抑制剂相关心肌炎的免疫景观。发现ISG15⁺CD8⁺ T细胞与心肌细胞毒性相关。
summary_en: This study delineates the immune landscape of ICI-myocarditis using scRNA-seq, flow cytometry, Olink proteomics, and multiplex cytokine profiling, revealing that ISG15⁺CD8⁺ T cells are associated with cardiomyocyte cytotoxicity.
insights: 创新点：多组学方法揭示ICI心肌炎的免疫特征
方法亮点：使用多种技术综合分析免疫数据
关键发现：ISG15⁺CD8⁺ T细胞与心肌细胞毒性相关
insights_en: Novelty: Multi-omics approach reveals immune features of ICI-myocarditis
Method highlight: Comprehensive analysis of immune data using multiple techniques
Key finding: ISG15⁺CD8⁺ T cells associated with cardiomyocyte cytotoxicity
abstract: Abstract Immune checkpoint inhibitor-associated myocarditis (ICI-myocarditis) is a rare but frequently fatal immune-related adverse event. A comprehensive understanding of the cellular and molecular determinants driving ICI-myocarditis is essential for improving diagnostic precision and developing targeted interventions. We delineate the immune landscape of ICI-myocarditis via scRNA-seq, flow cytometry, Olink proteomics, and multiplex cytokine profiling. We demonstrate that high levels of baseline ISG15⁺CD8⁺ T cells are linked to the proinflammatory features of monocytes and in vitro experiments confirm the existence of circulating ISG15⁺CD8⁺ T cells with a high potential to induce cardiomyocyte apoptosis, supporting their pathogenic potential for cardiomyocyte cytotoxicity. Notably, intercellular crosstalk between these subsets is possibly mediated via the CCL2-CCR2 axis, and its blockade attenuated ICI-induced cardiac injury in vivo. Based on the inflammatory signature in ICI-myocarditis, we develop an 8-protein custom panel with promising performance in distinguishing ICI-myocarditis from other ICIs-treated controls. JAK-STAT pathway activation promotes inflammatory programs in both ISG15⁺CD8⁺ T cells and monocytes. Furthermore, JAK-STAT inhibition ameliorates cardiac dysfunction and inflammatory infiltration while enhancing the response to anti-PD-1 therapy in mouse models. In summary, this study implicates immune-pathogenic features of ICI-myocarditis and provides a possible basis for future therapies.

title: Whole-genome sequencing reveals inter-household networks of gut-colonising ESBL-producing Escherichia coli in two rural Malawian districts
summary_zh: 研究通过全基因组测序和家户映射，分析了两个马拉维农村地区159个ESBL-Ec分离株的基因组流行病学和空间结构。发现殖民化率一年内从34.1%上升到54.2%。
summary_en: This study investigates the genomic epidemiology and spatial structure of 159 gut-colonising ESBL-Ec isolates from two rural Malawian villages using whole-genome sequencing and household mapping, revealing a colonization prevalence rising from 34.1% to 54.2% over one year.
insights: 创新点：揭示ESBL-Ec在社区中的殖民化和传播网络
方法亮点：结合全基因组测序和家户映射分析
关键发现：殖民化率显著上升
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing inter-household networks of ESBL-Ec colonization and transmission in communities
Method highlight: Combining whole-genome sequencing and household mapping for analysis
Key finding: Significant increase in colonization prevalence
abstract: Abstract Infection with extended-spectrum beta-lactamase-producing Escherichia coli (ESBL-Ec) is a global health concern that disproportionately affects sub-Saharan Africa. Gut mucosal colonisation is thought to precede invasive infection. Understanding ESBL-Ec colonisation and transmission across communities is therefore essential. Here, we investigate the genomic epidemiology and spatial structure of 159 gut-colonising ESBL-Ec isolates from the faeces of 211 people in two rural Malawian villages using longitudinal sampling (2023–24), whole-genome sequencing and household mapping. Colonisation prevalence rose from 34.1% (95% CI: 27.8–41.0) to 54.2% (95% CI: 46.0–62.3) over one year. Isolates belonged to 33 sequence types (STs), most commonly ST38 and ST131, harbouring 46 distinct antimicrobial resistance gene types. Fifteen strains were identified in ≥3 households that were typically separated by short geographic distances ( < 400 m). Of 190 pairwise comparisons between same-strain isolates from different households sampled concurrently within villages, 88.9% differed by ≤10 single nucleotide polymorphisms, consistent with multi-household involvement in community transmission networks. Lineage-specific ST38 and ST131 network analyses linked rural isolates to urban Malawian isolates collected within the last decade. Our findings provide a transferable framework for inferring ESBL-Ec flow in community settings and highlight the need for One Health surveillance and improved sanitation infrastructure to limit transmission.

title: A nanosystem manipulates angiocrine signaling for cardioprotection in male mice by relocalizing endothelial exosomes
summary_zh: 研究开发了一种纳米系统，通过重新定位循环内皮外泌体，增强其局部可用性，从而在雄性小鼠中通过血管生成信号进行心脏保护。
summary_en: This study develops a nanosystem that relocalizes circulating endothelial exosomes to enhance their local availability, thereby manipulating angiocrine signaling for cardioprotection in male mice.
insights: 创新点：开发纳米系统重新定位循环内皮外泌体
方法亮点：通过纳米系统增强血管生成信号
关键发现：纳米系统增强心肌梗塞区域的心脏保护
insights_en: Novelty: Development of a nanosystem for relocalizing circulating endothelial exosomes
Method highlight: Enhancing angiocrine signaling through the nanosystem
Key finding: Nanosystem enhances cardioprotection in ischemic myocardium
abstract: Acting as frontline sensors during cardiovascular injury, endothelial cells respond to acute ischemia by releasing exosomes as angiocrine signals for intercellular communication and cardioprotection. However, these endogenous signals are poorly utilized because released exosomes distribute systemically and show limited exposure in injured myocardium. Here we develop a systemically administered nanosystem for relocalizing circulating endothelial exosomes towards the myocardium, increasing their local availability. The nanosystem captures circulating endothelial exosomes, mediates their transvascular relocalization and promotes delivery to cardiomyocytes in the ischemic myocardium, thereby enhancing the local availability of native angiocrine signals. In a murine model of acute cardiac ischemia using male mice, this strategy increases endothelial exosome exposure in myocardium, improves cardiomyocyte survival, and preserves cardiac function. This approach enhances the reception of native angiocrine signals at the injured myocardium, therefore converting the originally diffuse, short-lived response into a sustained, organ-specific therapeutic exposure. Acute myocardial ischemia induces the release of endothelial exosomes with cardioprotective effect. Here, the authors show that a nanosystem relocalizes circulating endothelial exosomes to ischemic myocardium, increasing local exposure and preserving cardiac function

title: High fiber diet mitigates exposure risk of nanoplastics in male mice
summary_zh: 研究通过可见/近红外双重荧光标记技术和非侵入性成像，发现高纤维饮食可降低小鼠肠道中纳米塑料的暴露风险。
summary_en: This study investigates whether increasing dietary fiber intake reduces gastrointestinal nanoplastic exposure in male mice using visible/near-infrared dual fluorescence labeling and non-invasive imaging techniques.
insights: 创新点：发现高纤维饮食可降低纳米塑料暴露风险
方法亮点：使用双重荧光标记技术和非侵入性成像
关键发现：高纤维饮食减轻纳米塑料引起的肠道损伤
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery that high fiber diet mitigates nanoplastic exposure risk
Method highlight: Use of dual fluorescence labeling and non-invasive imaging techniques
Key finding: High fiber diet alleviates nanoplastic-induced intestinal damage
abstract: Abstract Potential health risk associated with dietary intake of nanoplastics has emerged as a global health concern, yet approaches for reducing gastrointestinal nanoplastic exposure remain poorly explored. Here, we investigated whether increasing dietary fiber intake influences the gastrointestinal fate of nanoplastics in male mice utilizing a visible/near-infrared dual fluorescence labeling technique combined with non-invasive imaging. The estimated retention rates of nanoplastics-associated fluorescence are decreased by two and seven times in male mice fed with medium fiber diet and high fiber diet compared to those with standard fiber diet, 24 h after oral intake. High fiber diet is associated with attenuated nanoplastics-induced epithelial damage to intestinal tract and declined detectable NIR fluorescence in important organs such as liver during 28-d oral exposure to nanoplastics. In vitro simulations show that dietary fiber physically encapsulates and adheres nanoplastics to decrease their bioavailability. Understanding how dietary constituents influence the gastrointestinal fate of nanoplastics may provide a scientific basis for the future development of dietary strategies aimed at reducing nanoplastic exposure.

title: Elevated prenatal IL-6 levels disrupt early patterns of hippocampal electrical activity and chloride homeostasis by targeting GABAergic signaling at perinatal stage
summary_zh: 研究显示孕期IL-6水平升高会干扰海马早期电活动和氯离子稳态。通过GABAergic信号在围产期阶段靶向作用。
summary_en: This study shows that elevated prenatal IL-6 levels disrupt early hippocampal electrical activity and chloride homeostasis by targeting GABAergic signaling at the perinatal stage.
insights: 创新点：孕期IL-6水平与神经发育关系
方法亮点：研究围产期GABAergic信号
关键发现：干扰海马电活动和氯离子稳态
insights_en: Novelty: Prenatal IL-6 levels and their relationship with neurodevelopment
Method highlight: Studying GABAergic signaling during perinatal stage
Key finding: Disruption of hippocampal electrical activity and chloride homeostasis
abstract: Abstract Early patterns of neuronal electrical activity are fundamental for driving critical developmental processes, including neuronal maturation and synapse formation. While genetic programs are key in orchestrating these events, the influence of environmental stressors remains poorly defined. Maternal immune activation (MIA) during pregnancy induces a systemic cytokine surge that can profoundly impact fetal brain development, increasing the risk of psychiatric and neurodevelopmental disorders. Here, we show that maternal elevation of interleukin-6 (IL-6) – a key cytokine upregulated during MIA – perturbs early hippocampal electrical activity in male offspring during the first postnatal week, a critical window for circuit formation. By triggering a STAT3-dependent modulation of early GABAergic synaptic transmission, IL-6 disrupts chloride homeostasis, causing a premature shift in the developmental GABA polarity switch. Our findings reveal a direct link between maternal immune signaling and early GABA-driven network maturation, providing insights into how inflammatory events during pregnancy may predispose male offspring to neurodevelopmental disorders.

title: 11 million days of longitudinal Fitbit data reveal novel future health insights
summary_zh: 本文分析11百万天Fitbit数据，研究活动与疾病关联。方法上，采用多时间窗口分析活动指标。实验表明，长期测量窗口揭示更强、更稳定的关联。
summary_en: This paper analyzes 11 million days of Fitbit data to study activity-disease associations. The method involves multi-time window analysis of activity metrics. Experiments show that longer measurement windows reveal stronger, more stable associations.
insights: 创新点：长期纵向数据分析揭示健康关联
方法亮点：多时间窗口分析活动指标
关键发现：长期测量揭示更强关联
insights_en: Novelty: Longitudinal data analysis reveals health associations
Method highlight: Multi-time window analysis of activity metrics
Key finding: Long-term measurement reveals stronger associations
abstract: Abstract Wearable devices offer a scalable, objective measurement of physical activity, but most studies reduce these data to a single metric over 7-days. Here, we compare wearable-derived phenotyping approaches to understand their impact on activity-disease associations, analyzing 11 million days of Fitbit data from 29,303 All of Us Research Program participants. We derive four daily activity metrics (step count, peak 1-min cadence, peak 30-min cadence, and heart rate per step) across five time-windows (1-day, 1-week, 1-month, 6-months, 1-year), then run phenome-wide analyses across > 700 incident and >1,400 prevalent disease outcomes. Though all phenotypes are highly correlated, longer measurement windows yield stronger, more stable associations: 1-year step count was associated with 389 prevalent and 61 incident outcomes (versus 271 and 33 for 1-day step count) after Bonferroni-correction, including novel links to chronic pain syndrome and SARS-CoV-2. Differences between prevalent and incident associations suggest that activity metrics may act as both early markers of disease and risk factors. These findings highlight how large-scale, longitudinal wearable data can advance understanding of health and disease.

title: LitGene: an interpretable transformer model integrating text and ontology for gene representation learning
summary_zh: 提出LitGene模型，整合文本和本体论进行基因表征学习。在多个基准任务中，模型表现优异，并实现零样本预测。
summary_en: Proposed the LitGene model, integrating text and ontology for gene representation learning. The model achieves competitive accuracy in multiple benchmark tasks and exhibits zero-shot prediction capabilities.
insights: 创新点：提出文本和本体论结合的基因表征学习方法
方法亮点：Transformer模型实现可解释性基因表征
关键发现：模型在基准任务中表现优异，实现零样本预测
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed a text and ontology-based gene representation learning method
Method highlight: Transformer model achieves interpretability in gene representation
Key finding: Model performs well in benchmark tasks and exhibits zero-shot prediction
abstract: Abstract Representation learning in genomics often relies on sequence, expression, and network data, thereby overlooking a wealth of insights in the scientific literature. Here, we present LitGene, an interpretable transformer-based model that refines gene representations by integrating unstructured textual information with Gene Ontology annotations through contrastive learning. In evaluations across eight benchmark tasks for protein properties, LitGene achieves competitive accuracy and exhibits zero-shot prediction of GO terms, KEGG pathways, and gene-disease associations. LitGene identified ANGPTL6 as a potential candidate gene for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), supported by its differential expression in independent IPF samples, illustrating LitGene’s utility for hypothesis generation. A SHAP-based interpretability tool highlights text features influencing predictions, while an automated literature-grounding framework provides corroborating support where available. Our results suggest that integrating textual and genetic information may help reduce biases associated with under-studied genes. The model is released as open-source code, along with a publicly accessible web interface at https://litgene.cs.unm.edu/ , which allows users to submit gene names, disease names, drug names, or custom text (e.g., publication abstracts) to obtain evidence-based predictions of related biomedical entities.

title: Circulating chromatin reveals effects of disease-associated variants on gene regulation
summary_zh: 利用循环染色质分析疾病相关变异对基因调控的影响。识别出影响多种非造血组织发育限制性元件的细胞游离染色质位点。
summary_en: Utilized epigenomic liquid biopsy to analyze the effects of disease-associated variants on gene regulation. Identified cell-free chromatin quantitative trait loci affecting regulatory element activities in diverse non-hematologic tissues.
insights: 创新点：循环染色质分析揭示疾病相关变异对基因调控的影响
方法亮点：大规模分析疾病相关变异和基因调控
关键发现：识别出多种非造血组织发育限制性元件的细胞游离染色质位点
insights_en: Novelty: Circulating chromatin analysis reveals the impact of disease-associated variants on gene regulation
Method highlight: Large-scale analysis of disease-associated variants and gene regulation
Key finding: Identified cell-free chromatin quantitative trait loci affecting regulatory element activities in various non-hematologic tissues
abstract: A fundamental challenge in human genetics is determining how regulatory genetic variation shapes complex traits and disease risk. Chromatin quantitative trait loci can link disease-associated variants to regulatory element activity, but mapping them in disease-relevant tissues at scale remains challenging. We leverage epigenomic liquid biopsy by profiling histone modifications in circulating chromatin from 328 cancer patients and 38 healthy individuals to identify cell-free chromatin quantitative trait loci. These loci affect regulatory element activities from diverse non-hematologic tissues and developmentally restricted elements reactivated in cancer. Through cistrome-wide association studies, we link 4891 loci to 1011 traits and diseases. Developmentally restricted loci absent in white blood cells are associated with 22.7 traits per 100 quantitative trait loci, compared to 0.58 for white-blood-cell-restricted chromatin quantitative trait loci. Here, we show that cell-free chromatin enables efficient and scalable discovery of regulatory genetic effects across tissues, diseases, and populations. Regulatory genetic variants can influence disease risk through effects on chromatin activity, but studying these effects across tissues remains challenging. Here, the authors use cell‑free chromatin profiling to identify chromatin quantitative trait loci across diverse tissues, linking regulatory variation to hundreds of human traits and diseases.

title: A smart photothermal microneedle system for dual-targeted therapy of osteoarthritis via MMPs inhibition
summary_zh: 开发智能光热微针系统，通过MMPs抑制治疗骨关节炎。系统在动物模型中有效减少疼痛、软骨退化和神经血管重塑。
summary_en: Developed a smart photothermal microneedle system for dual-targeted therapy of osteoarthritis via MMPs inhibition. The system effectively reduces pain, cartilage degeneration, and pathological neurovascular remodeling in an animal model.
insights: 创新点：开发智能光热微针系统治疗骨关节炎
方法亮点：结合MMPs抑制实现靶向治疗
关键发现：系统在动物模型中有效治疗骨关节炎
insights_en: Novelty: Developed a smart photothermal microneedle system for osteoarthritis treatment
Method highlight: Combined MMPs inhibition for targeted therapy
Key finding: System effectively treats osteoarthritis in an animal model
abstract: Temporomandibular joint osteoarthritis (TMJ-OA) causes chronic pain, cartilage degeneration and pathological neurovascular remodeling, yet effective local therapies remain limited. Here we develop a minimally invasive near-infrared (NIR)-responsive microneedle system (SFZICC MNs) that integrates cryptochlorogenic acid (CCA)- and carbon quantum dot-loaded ZIF-8 nanoparticles within a methacrylated silk fibroin hydrogel. The system provides mechanical integrity, photothermal responsiveness and NIR-assisted local drug release. In a mouse TMJ-OA model, SFZICC MNs combined with NIR irradiation reduce mechanical hypersensitivity, anxiety-like behaviors, cartilage degeneration and pathological neurovascularization, and outperform free CCA, blank microneedles and drug-loaded microneedles without NIR. Mechanistically, CCA directly interacts with MMP3, MMP9 and MMP13 and moderately inhibits their catalytic activities in vitro, while reducing intracellular superoxide accumulation, NF-κB p65 phosphorylation and MMP protein abundance. In vivo imaging further supports reduced overall MMP-associated proteolytic activity. These findings support SFZICC MNs as a locally responsive therapeutic platform for TMJ-OA. Temporomandibular joint osteoarthritis (TMJ-OA) lacks effective local therapies. Here, the authors develop an NIR-responsive microneedle patch that locally delivers cryptochlorogenic acid (CCA), reduces pain and cartilage degeneration, and suppresses MMP-associated pathological remodeling.

title: Coordinated inhibition of SOX9 and cell-cycle progression by microRNA-200 restricts sebaceous gland fate specification
summary_zh: miR-200s通过抑制SOX9和细胞周期进程限制皮脂腺命运决定。在毛基质祖细胞中富集，在上皮毛囊中缺失。
summary_en: miR-200s restrict sebaceous gland fate specification by coordinated inhibition of SOX9 and cell-cycle progression. Highly enriched in hair matrix progenitors but absent from the upper hair follicle.
insights: 创新点：揭示miR-200s在皮脂腺命运决定中的作用
方法亮点：发现miR-200s直接抑制WNT信号和细胞周期调节因子
关键发现：miR-200s在毛基质祖细胞中富集，在上皮毛囊中缺失
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed the role of miR-200s in sebaceous gland fate specification
Method highlight: Found direct repression of negative regulators of WNT signaling and cell-cycle regulators by miR-200s
Key finding: miR-200s are highly enriched in hair matrix progenitors but absent from the upper hair follicle
abstract: Abstract The microRNA-200 family (miR-200s) is known for inhibiting epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition and cell-cycle progression in cancer, but its function in epithelial development remains unclear. Here we show that miR-200s are highly enriched in hair matrix progenitors but absent from the upper hair follicle (HF), where sebaceous gland (SG) and HF stem cells are specified. Ectopic miR-200 induction abolishes SG specification while preserving hair morphogenesis. Genome-wide identification of miR-200 targets reveals direct repression of negative regulators of WNT signaling and cell-cycle regulators. Single-cell and spatial transcriptomic analyses uncover mutually exclusive domains of WNT activity and SOX9 expression in the upper HF that is disrupted by miR-200 induction. Genome-wide mapping of SOX9 targets further uncovers a lipogenic and fatty-acid metabolic program required for SG specification. Together, these findings show that miR-200 blocks SG fate by inhibiting SOX9 function and restricting cell proliferation, defining a spatially organized regulatory network essential for SG development.

title: Explainable artificial intelligence reveals spatially divergent effects of global change on mammals
summary_zh: 研究全球变化对哺乳动物分布的影响。应用可解释机器学习量化环境驱动因素。提出生态诊断揭示空间变化。
summary_en: Study the impact of global change on mammal distributions. Apply explainable machine learning to quantify environmental drivers. Propose ecological diagnostics to reveal spatial changes.
insights: 创新点：提出生态诊断揭示空间变化
方法亮点：应用可解释机器学习
关键发现：量化环境驱动因素
insights_en: Novelty: Propose ecological diagnostics to reveal spatial changes
Method highlight: Apply explainable machine learning
Key finding: Quantify environmental drivers
abstract: Abstract Understanding how global change reshapes species distributions remains a central challenge in ecology, yet most global assessments treat environmental drivers as static, uniform, or aggregate influences. This obscures where, why, and how specific drivers generate ecological risk or opportunity. Here, we apply explainable machine learning to assess how climate averages, variability, extremes, and land cover are projected to reshape future distributions of 1,992 terrestrial mammals. Using Shapley Additive Explanations with species distribution models, we quantify the directional contribution of 16 environmental drivers and track how these contributions change over space and time. We propose two ecological diagnostics, directional turnovers and favorability shifts, that reveal where drivers switch from favorable to unfavorable, or the reverse, and where their influence strengthens or weakens without sign reversal. While not designed to infer causation, our framework assesses whether projected spatial patterns align with ecological expectations. We show that climate extremes impose intense but spatially restricted impacts, temperature-related drivers dominate exposure patterns, particularly for specialist species, and the same driver can impose risk in one region while creating opportunity in another. By decomposing projected biodiversity change into driver-specific signatures, our framework advances biodiversity forecasting toward a more actionable understanding of ecological risk and opportunity.

title: The molecular heterogeneity and clinical impact of genomic driver alterations in prostate cancer
summary_zh: 分析前列腺癌中基因组驱动变异。进行前列腺癌全基因组测序数据集的整合分析。识别出驱动基因和失调机制。
summary_en: Analyze genomic driver alterations in prostate cancer. Perform integrative analysis of whole genome sequencing dataset from prostate cancer. Identify driver genes and dysregulation mechanisms.
insights: 创新点：识别出驱动基因和失调机制
方法亮点：进行全基因组测序数据集的整合分析
关键发现：前列腺癌中的基因组驱动变异
insights_en: Novelty: Identify driver genes and dysregulation mechanisms
Method highlight: Perform integrative analysis of whole genome sequencing dataset
Key finding: Genomic driver alterations in prostate cancer
abstract: Prostate cancer is a common malignancy with a heterogeneous disease course. Prior studies have identified a paucity of point mutations in protein-coding genes and only a few clinically relevant driver alterations. Here, using the Pan Prostate Cancer Group whole genome sequencing dataset from 1001 men, we perform an integrative analysis of cancer driver genes by quantifying recurrent genomic alterations among small mutations, structural variants, and copy number alterations in 961 primary prostate tumour samples. We identify at least one recurrent somatic or germline alteration in 97% of tumours and identify putative driver genes and mechanisms of dysregulation including frequently altered regulatory elements. A prominent example is the activation of oncogenes by structural variation-mediated hijacking of onco-enhancers of the solute carrier gene family including SLC30A4. Other recurrent alterations including FOXA1, MDM4, COL5A1, TP53, and BRCA1 stratify with metastatic disease, with additional drivers enriched in African-ancestry tumours. One quarter of tumours have acquired genome-informed therapeutic targets. Unsupervised analysis of alterations reveals four oncotypes with distinct genetic and clinical characteristics, including two clinically unfavourable oncotypes with shorter metastasis-free survival. Our study uncovers the full spectrum and recurrence patterns of genomic driver alterations in primary prostate cancers and delivers targets for biomarker development, mechanistic studies, and potential therapeutic interventions. The identification of clinically relevant driver alterations in prostate cancer remains elusive. Here, integrative analysis of cancer driver genes using the Pan Prostate Cancer Group whole genome sequencing dataset from 1,001 men identifies four oncotypes, two of which are associated with poor clinical outcomes.

title: ITLN1 suppresses colorectal cancer progression by orchestrating neutrophil maturation and spatial organization
summary_zh: 研究ITLN1在结直肠癌中的作用。整合多种技术定义ITLN1如何调节中性粒细胞成熟和组织。ITLN1表达与中性粒细胞浸润相关。
summary_en: Study the role of ITLN1 in colorectal cancer. Integrate multiple techniques to define how ITLN1 regulates neutrophil maturation and organization. ITLN1 expression correlates with neutrophil infiltration.
insights: 创新点：ITLN1调节中性粒细胞成熟和组织
方法亮点：整合多种技术
关键发现：ITLN1表达与中性粒细胞浸润相关
insights_en: Novelty: ITLN1 regulates neutrophil maturation and organization
Method highlight: Integrate multiple techniques
Key finding: ITLN1 expression correlates with neutrophil infiltration
abstract: Abstract Epithelial-derived intelectin-1 (ITLN1) is frequently downregulated in colorectal cancer, but whether it actively shapes anti-tumor immunity remains unclear. We integrate multiplex immunohistochemistry, spatial analysis, single-cell transcriptomics, chromatin-accessibility profiling, and perturbation models to define how ITLN1 regulates neutrophil maturation and spatial anti-tumor immunity. In treatment-naïve human colorectal cancer, higher ITLN1 expression associates with greater neutrophil infiltration, shorter distances between mature S100A9 + CXCR2 + neutrophils and ITLN1 + tumor epithelial cells, and improved survival. In mouse colorectal cancer models, Itln1 silencing accelerates tumor growth and metastasis, impairs CXCR2 + CD101 + mature neutrophil generation and tumor recruitment, and promotes LTF + S100A9 + immature neutrophil accumulation in hypoxic regions. Mechanistically, ITLN1 activates a JAK1/STAT3-associated C/EBPδ program that drives terminal granulopoiesis and CXCR2-dependent tumor homing, while recombinant ITLN1 restores neutrophil maturation and tumor-killing activity. Here, we reveal a cross-tissue ITLN1–STAT3/C/EBPδ–CXCR2 axis that links epithelial ITLN1 to bone marrow granulopoiesis, coordinating distal neutrophil maturation, mobilization and spatial organization in colorectal cancer.

title: Only time will tell
Real-world, digital-first delivery of GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy in women
summary_zh: 研究评估了通过数字护理模型为女性提供GLP-1受体激动剂治疗的实际效果。结果显示，平均减重16.1公斤，83.1%的女性减重10%以上。
summary_en: This study evaluates the real-world effectiveness of delivering GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy to women through a digital care model. Results show an average weight loss of 16.1 kg, with 83.1% of women losing more than 10% of their baseline weight.
insights: 创新点：数字护理模型在女性GLP-1受体激动剂治疗中的应用。
方法亮点：结合生化监测和临床指导，优化治疗过程。
关键发现：数字护理模型有效提升治疗效果。
insights_en: Novelty: Application of a digital care model in the treatment of women with GLP-1 receptor agonists.
Method highlight: Combining biochemical monitoring and clinical guidance to optimize the treatment process.
Key finding: The digital care model effectively improves treatment outcomes.
abstract: Abstract Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) have demonstrated substantial weight reduction and cardiometabolic benefit in randomized trials; however, prospective implementation evidence from digital care models and female sex community populations remains limited. Here we report outcomes from an observational study of 8,127 women initiating GLP-1RA therapy (99.8% tirzepatide) through a structured digital program incorporating mandatory biochemical monitoring, weekly video-supported follow-up and clinician-guided dose titration in the UK. Mean weight reduction was 16.1 kg (95% confidence interval 15.9 to 16.2; P < 0.001), representing 15.5% of baseline weight; 83.1% achieved ≥10% and 22.4% achieved ≥20% weight loss, with consistent responses across age, baseline weight and socioeconomic strata. Among participants with paired biomarker data, mean glycated hemoglobin decreased by 3.3 mmol mol − 1 (95% confidence interval 3.1 to 3.4; P < 0.001), normalizing in 84.5% of those with baseline diabetes-range values and 96.3% with prediabetes, and lipid parameters improved significantly (reductions in total cholesterol of 0.77 mmol l − 1 , low-density lipoprotein cholesterol of 0.61 mmol l − 1 and triglycerides of 0.47 mmol l − 1 ). Retention was 91.4% at 6 months, with no serious treatment-related adverse events. These findings support the feasibility of delivering structured, digitally enabled obesity pharmacotherapy at scale and provide prospective real-world implementation evidence for this care model. Interpretation is limited by the observational design, absence of a comparator group, self-pay population and 6-month follow-up.

title: A reality check for autoimmune CAR T cells
Conversational brain AI for adaptive epilepsy care
EGFR-targeted antibody−toxin conjugate in recurrent glioma: a phase 1 trial
Sexual dimorphism in epidermal stem cell dynamics
summary_zh: 研究表皮干细胞动态中的性别差异。通过活体成像追踪细胞命运。分析显示细胞异质性和命运模式。
summary_en: This study investigates sexual dimorphism in epidermal stem cell dynamics. Intravital time-lapse imaging tracks cell fate. Analysis reveals cell heterogeneity and fate patterns.
insights: 创新点：活体成像追踪细胞命运
方法亮点：定量分析细胞异质性
关键发现：性别差异影响细胞命运
insights_en: Novelty: Live-cell imaging to track cell fate
Method highlight: Quantitative analysis of cell heterogeneity
Key finding: Sexual dimorphism affects cell fate
abstract: Abstract The epidermis is a stratified epithelium comprising proliferative basal cells and differentiated suprabasal cells that are continuously renewed throughout life. Conflicting theories have been proposed regarding the heterogeneity of the basal cell layer, with some studies proposing that all proliferative cells have self-renewal potential during homeostasis 1–5 . Meanwhile, others posit a model in which stem cell differentiation occurs through an intermediate transit-amplifying-like progenitor state with strictly limited proliferative potential 6–10 . Here, to determine the heterogeneity and pattern of cell fate, we performed intravital time-lapse imaging to track the fate of lineage-labelled cells in the skin interfollicular epidermis. Results from quantitative analyses of clonal dynamics support a two-compartment model of epidermal homeostasis, whereby basal cells are organized in a stem cell–transit-amplifying cell hierarchy. Critical to these conclusions was the discovery of sexual dimorphism in epidermal fate, with female mice showing a highly synchronized pattern of cell division, differentiation and delamination that contributes to accelerated wound healing. Single-cell RNA sequencing, transcriptional profiling and clonal analyses of castrated mice revealed that male sex hormones promote stem cell differentiation and delamination. In summary, our study provides insight into the functional identity of the stem cell population and identifies sex-specific differences in the regulation of epidermal stem cells and transit-amplifying cell fate.

title: Soil proteogenomics uncover microbial strategies for soil depth-specific carbon cycling under whole-soil warming conditions
summary_zh: 研究土壤深度特异性碳循环中的微生物策略。通过全土壤增温实验揭示微生物特性和响应。
summary_en: This study investigates microbial strategies for soil depth-specific carbon cycling under whole-soil warming conditions. Reveals microbial traits and responses through a replicated whole-soil warming experiment.
insights: 创新点：研究土壤增温条件下的微生物策略
方法亮点：基因组解析蛋白质组学
关键发现：深度驱动微生物群落结构
insights_en: Novelty: Investigating microbial strategies under soil warming conditions
Method highlight: Genome-resolved proteogenomics
Key finding: Depth drives microbial community structure
abstract: Soils are Earth's largest carbon reservoir, yet microbial mechanisms controlling decomposition, and their warming response, remain poorly resolved, especially in subsoils. Using genome-resolved proteogenomics within a replicated whole-soil warming experiment (0-90 cm, +4 °C, 7.5 years) we map microbial traits, their depth stratification, and warming responses. Depth is the dominant driver of microbial community and trait structure. Depth-wise, metabolism converge on low-molecular-weight and C1 compounds, challenging glucose-centric models, with surface soils enriched in methanol oxidation and deep soils in alcohol fermentation, CO oxidation and N₂ fixation. Abundant sialidases in deep soils implicate glycoproteins as a key carbon source. Warming effects are smaller and decrease over time but are depth-specific: surface soils show enhanced amino sugar and sugar alcohol transport, phosphorus mobilization, and stress tolerance, whereas mid- and deep soils exhibit stimulated C1 metabolism, CO oxidation, and altered nitrogen turnover. These depth-specific microbial trait shifts may critically influence soil carbon-climate feedbacks.

title: Scellmate enables contamination aware curation and host mobilome linkage analysis of large SAG datasets
summary_zh: Scellmate框架整合SAG数据整理、物种分类和SAG-mobilome关联分析。
summary_en: Scellmate framework integrates SAG data curation, species-level taxonomic anchoring, and SAG-mobilome linkage analysis.
insights: 创新点：解决SAG数据片段化和污染问题
方法亮点：半监督框架处理大规模数据
关键发现：揭示微生物群落的异质性
insights_en: Novelty: Solving fragmented and contaminated SAG data
Method highlight: Semi-supervised framework for large-scale data
Key finding: Revealing the heterogeneity of microbial communities
abstract: Single-cell genomics enables cell-resolved insights into in-situ microbial communities, yet single amplified genomes (SAGs) are often fragmented, taxonomically ambiguous, and prone to contamination, limiting their biological interpretation. Here, we present Scellmate, a scalable, semi-supervised framework that integrates whole-SAG curation, species-level taxonomic anchoring and SAG–mobilome linkage analysis for large-scale SAG datasets. Following benchmarking of its SAG curation and SAG–eMGE linkage modules using in silico and four-strain mock SAG datasets, respectively, Scellmate was applied to 11,976 sewage-derived SAGs. This approach yielded 4,198 SAGs passing Scellmate’s whole-SAG curation, which captured pronounced heterogeneity masked by bulk methods. At the species level, we resolved extensive hidden diversity within abundant taxa such as Aliarcobacter that was unresolved by matched metagenome-assembled genomes; at the strain level, we pinpointed a distinct Agathobacter rectalis cluster carrying specialized carbon-utilization pathways, suggesting niche differentiation. Leveraging these curated SAGs, we identified 6,474 host–mobilome linkages across 2,378 SAGs; these linkages not only showed high concordance with host-association data within the Integrated Microbial Genomes (IMG) system but also significantly expanded species-level host assignments. Furthermore, we detected frequent inter-species sharing patterns of diverse cryptic plasmids within the order Bacteroidales. Together, this work demonstrates that high-throughput single-cell genomics, empowered by the robust framework, resolves fine-scale heterogeneity and host–mobilome dynamics, advancing culture-independent microbiome research. In this study, the authors develop a computational framework, Scellmate, that curates and analyzes large-scale microbial single-cell datasets from complex environments, and show that this helps to reveal microbial diversity and infer microbe–plasmid and microbe–phage associations in sewage.

title: Interpretable and scalable spatial gene set activity analysis with GESSO uncovers functional tissue architecture
summary_zh: GESSO方法分析空间基因集活动。量化基因贡献并定位统计测试。提高空间转录组分析效率。
summary_en: GESSO method analyzes spatial gene set activity. Quantifies gene contributions and performs location-specific statistical tests. Enhances efficiency of spatial transcriptomics analysis.
insights: 创新点：引入空间信息分析基因集活动
方法亮点：提供可解释的基因水平贡献
关键发现：GESSO提高统计测试准确性
insights_en: Novelty: Incorporating spatial information into gene set activity analysis
Method highlight: Providing interpretable gene-level contributions
Key finding: GESSO improves the accuracy of statistical tests
abstract: Spatially resolved transcriptomics (SRT) measures gene expression within tissues. Existing methods that summarize the activity of functionally related genes often ignore relationships between neighboring locations and offer limited statistical testing, gene-level interpretation, or scalability. Here we present GESSO, a method that incorporates spatial information to estimate gene set activity within tissues, quantify how strongly each gene contributes to the resulting activity scores, and perform location-specific statistical tests for elevated pathway activity. In simulations and analyses of 13 datasets from five SRT platforms, GESSO better recovers known spatial patterns, provides well-calibrated statistical tests and interpretable gene-level contributions, and scales more efficiently than existing methods. Applications across tumor, embryonic, and lymphoid tissues reveal localized biological programs, including epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition at tumor-stroma interfaces, developmental signaling gradients, and coordinated immune pathways within germinal centers. Therefore, GESSO enables interpretable and scalable spatial mapping of gene set activity across diverse SRT technologies and biological settings. Spatial transcriptomics measures gene activity while preserving tissue structure. Here, the authors present GESSO, a scalable method that uses spatial information to quantify pathway activity and detect localized biological programs.

title: Low-Dose Glucocorticoids Adjunctive to Flow Diverter Therapy for Unruptured Intracranial Aneurysms Improve Cerebrovascular Outcomes
summary_zh: 研究评估短期低剂量糖皮质激素与血流导向器治疗未破裂颅内动脉瘤的关联。
summary_en: This study evaluates the association between short-term, low-dose glucocorticoid use and cerebrovascular outcomes after flow diverter implantation for unruptured intracranial aneurysms.
insights: 创新点：糖皮质激素与血流导向器治疗的关联
方法亮点：倾向评分匹配和精确匹配
关键发现：糖皮质激素减少脑血管事件
insights_en: Novelty: Association between glucocorticoids and flow diverter therapy
Method highlight: Propensity-score matching with exact matching
Key finding: Glucocorticoids reduce cerebrovascular events
abstract: Abstract Flow diverter (FD) implantation is standard for unruptured intracranial aneurysms (UIAs), but cerebrovascular complications persist. This nested study within a prospective multicenter cohort evaluates whether short-term, low-dose glucocorticoid use is associated with cerebrovascular outcomes after FD implantation. Propensity-score matching with exact matching on UIA location yielded 1327 patients (360 glucocorticoid-treated; 967 controls). Intravenous glucocorticoids, initiated within 2 hours of the FD procedure and administered for ≥2 days, were associated with fewer in-hospital cerebrovascular events (6.9% vs. 13.1%; adjusted odds ratio [aOR], 0.53) and major cerebrovascular events (4.7% vs. 12.4%; aOR, 0.37). Over a median 2-year follow-up, glucocorticoid use was also associated with fewer new-onset major cerebrovascular events (3.6% vs. 8.7%; adjusted hazard ratio, 0.41) and less in-stent stenosis (7.9% vs. 13.2%; aOR, 0.55). Findings remained robust in unmatched patients on sensitivity analyses. We demonstrate that perioperative glucocorticoid regimens may reduce cerebrovascular events and in-stent stenosis in FD-treated patients, warranting randomized trials.

title: Baseline radiographic and microbiologic predictors of treatment outcomes in a shortened all-oral regimen for MDR/RR-TB
summary_zh: 研究评估了缩短疗程的MDR/RR-TB治疗方案中，基线微生物学和影像学特征与治疗结果的关系。结果显示，纤维化与不良结局相关。
summary_en: This study evaluates the association between baseline microbiologic and radiographic features and treatment outcomes in a shortened all-oral regimen for MDR/RR-TB. Results show that fibrosis is associated with unfavorable outcomes.
insights: 创新点：发现纤维化与不良结局相关
方法亮点：前瞻性队列研究设计
关键发现：纤维化与治疗失败相关
insights_en: Novelty: Identified fibrosis as associated with unfavorable outcomes
Method highlight: Prospective cohort study design
Key finding: Fibrosis associated with treatment failure
abstract: Abstract WHO-endorsed shortened, all-oral regimens have improved tolerability and outcomes for MDR/RR-TB treatment, but predictors of poor outcomes remain incompletely-characterized. We conducted a prospective cohort study (NCT05871489) of adults with bacteriologically-confirmed pulmonary MDR/RR-TB treated with a shortened, all-oral regimen in Lesotho. We evaluated baseline microbiologic and radiographic features and their associations with time-to-culture-conversion, end-of-treatment outcomes, and final post-treatment outcomes. Among 238 participants (median age 41 [IQR:31–56], 29% female, 62% with HIV), there were 27 unfavorable outcomes (20 deaths, 3 treatment failures, 4 recurrences). 142 of 148 (95.9%) with positive baseline cultures experienced conversion within four months. Fibrosis, cavitation, bilateral disease, and high smear grade were associated with delayed culture conversion and lower odds of treatment success. Bilateral disease was more strongly associated with unfavorable outcomes in those without HIV; fibrosis and high smear grade showed stronger associations among those with HIV. Cavitation with high smear grade (uOR=0.29, 95%CI:0.11–0.78; aOR=0.39, 95%CI:0.14-1.14), and severe fibrocavitary disease (multi-lobar fibrosis and at least one cavity ≥5 cm) (uOR=0.20, 95%CI:0.07–0.64; aOR=0.26, 95%CI:0.07-0.94) were negatively associated with favorable final outcomes. These findings suggest that baseline sputum and chest radiographic features—particularly in-combination—identify higher-risk patients and may inform risk-adapted strategies for shortened all-oral MDR/RR-TB regimens.

title: Brown adipose tissue ankyrin-B cell-autonomously modulates lipid content and its deletion protects male mice against diet-induced obesity
summary_zh: 研究揭示AnkB基因编码的ankrin-B蛋白调节棕色脂肪组织脂质稳态。AnkB缺失导致脂质积累，但保护雄性小鼠免受饮食诱导的肥胖。
summary_en: This study reveals that ankyrin-B, encoded by the ANK2 gene, regulates brown adipose tissue lipid homeostasis. AnkB deletion leads to lipid accumulation but protects male mice against diet-induced obesity.
insights: 创新点：发现ankrin-B调节棕色脂肪组织脂质稳态
方法亮点：BAT特异性基因敲除小鼠模型
关键发现：AnkB缺失导致脂质积累
insights_en: Novelty: Identified ankyrin-B as a regulator of brown adipose tissue lipid homeostasis
Method highlight: BAT-specific gene knockout mouse model
Key finding: AnkB deletion leads to lipid accumulation
abstract: Fatty acid (FA) availability for brown adipose tissue (BAT) thermogenesis depends in part on lipolysis of lipid droplet (LD) triglycerides. Here, we identify the membrane adaptor ankyrin-B (AnkB), encoded by the cardiometabolic disease-associated ANK2 gene, as a regulator of brown adipocyte lipid homeostasis and metabolic adaptation. BAT-specific AnkB deficiency caused excess lipid accumulation, enlarged LDs, and BAT whitening without altering mitochondrial oxidative capacity or thermogenesis in the fed state in male mice. Mechanistically, AnkB promoted basal lipolysis by recruiting hormone-sensitive lipase to LDs. However, AnkB loss compromised thermoregulation during cold exposure with fasting, linking AnkB-dependent FA release to thermogenesis under energetic stress. Unexpectedly, BAT AnkB deficiency protected male mice from high-fat diet-induced obesity (DIO), hepatic steatosis, glucose intolerance, and insulin resistance. This protection was associated with enhanced BAT mitochondrial oxidative capacity, oxidative remodeling of white adipose tissue, and increased circulating FGF21. Together, these findings establish AnkB as a previously unrecognized regulator of BAT lipid mobilization that coordinates thermogenic fuel availability with mitochondrial oxidative adaptation during metabolic stress. Ankyrin-B couples BAT lipid droplet lipolysis to thermogenic fuel availability. Its loss impairs thermoregulation during fasting but preserves fed-state thermogenesis and protects against diet-induced metabolic dysfunction.

title: APOE ε4 carriership status enhances age-related changes in Alzheimer’s disease plasma biomarkers concentrations
summary_zh: 研究显示APOE ε4携带状态加剧阿尔茨海默病血浆生物标志物浓度随年龄的变化。
summary_en: This study shows that APOE ε4 carriership status enhances age-related changes in Alzheimer’s disease plasma biomarker concentrations.
insights: 创新点：发现APOE ε4携带状态加剧生物标志物浓度变化
方法亮点：基于人群队列的研究设计
关键发现：APOE ε4携带者生物标志物浓度变化更显著
insights_en: Novelty: Identified APOE ε4 carriership as enhancing biomarker concentration changes
Method highlight: Population-based cohort study design
Key finding: More significant biomarker concentration changes in APOE ε4 carriers
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) plasma biomarkers are cost-effective tools to detect early stage amyloid pathology. We investigated how interactions between AD genetic risk (apolipoprotein E (APOE) ε4, AD polygenic risk score (excluding APOE; PRSAD)), age, and sex affected AD plasma biomarkers concentrations in a population-based cohort. We included 5913 participants from the Netherlands Twin Register age 30 – 80 (64.1% females, 29.8% ε4 carriers) and measured plasma phosphorylated-tau-217 (p-tau217), amyloid-β−42/40 (Aβ−42/40), neurofilament light (NfL), and glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP). We showed that the PRSAD did not associate with biomarker concentrations over age. In ε4 carriers, decreases in Aβ−42/40 became steeper after age 50, and increases in p-tau217 and GFAP became steeper after age 55 and 60 compared to non-carriers, respectively. Analyses in a separate longitudinal cohort (EMIF-AD) confirmed that p-tau217 concentration changes in ε4 carriers reflect AD pathology. These results highlight the potential of plasma biomarkers, especially p-tau217, for early detection of preclinical AD pathology. In cognitively normal individuals, the rate of change in concentrations of plasma ptau217 and Aβ−42/40 over age differs between APOE ε4 carriers and non-carriers. For p-tau217, the effect of APOE ε4 carriership is stronger in males than females.

title: Developing and benchmarking one health genomic surveillance tools for influenza A virus in wastewater
summary_zh: 开发并评估污水中的流感A病毒基因组监测工具，提高低丰度病毒检测能力。
summary_en: Develops and benchmarks genomic surveillance tools for influenza A virus in wastewater, improving detection of low-abundance viruses.
insights: 创新点：污水基因组监测工具开发
方法亮点：提高低丰度病毒检测
关键发现：监测低丰度病毒
insights_en: Novelty: Development of genomic surveillance tools for wastewater
Method highlight: Improved detection of low-abundance viruses
Key finding: Monitoring low-abundance viruses
abstract: Abstract Influenza A viruses (IAV) remain a persistent One Health threat, and whole-genome sequencing from wastewater offers a promising surveillance tool. However, IAV is at low abundance in wastewater, making it difficult to sequence. We benchmark four targeted enrichment methods suited for multi-subtype whole-genome IAV sequencing including custom and off-the-shelf methods. Our custom HA tiled-amplicon panel is sensitive, fast, and cost-effective, making it suitable for monitoring low-abundance seasonal variants of known subtypes, although its reliance on conserved and intact primer-binding sites limits primer design to fewer subtypes. A published universal amplicon method targets all IAV subtypes but performs poorly in wastewater due to its reliance on intact genome segments. Meanwhile, probe-capture methods are resilient to RNA degradation. In real wastewater samples, our custom probe panel recovers whole-genome signals from circulating H1N1, H3N2, H5N1, including validated H5N1 2.3.4.4b reads in samples where dPCR detection is limited. However, probe-capture is generally more costly and labor-intensive than amplicon methods. Across all four sequencing methods, two wastewater matrices, and most spike-in and endogenous virus targets, ultrafiltration-based virus concentration consistently outperforms large-volume direct extraction. Together, these benchmarking comparisons and custom panels provide needed information for implementing IAV genomic sequencing in routine wastewater surveillance.

title: Perk mediates tumor cell fate and therapeutic outcome in response to CDK4/6 inhibition
summary_zh: CDK4/6抑制剂通过PERK调控肿瘤细胞命运和治疗效果。
summary_en: CDK4/6 inhibitors mediate tumor cell fate and therapeutic outcome through PERK.
insights: 创新点：CDK4/6抑制剂通过PERK调控肿瘤细胞命运
方法亮点：克服CDK4/6抑制剂耐药性
关键发现：提高治疗效果
insights_en: Novelty: CDK4/6 inhibitors regulate tumor cell fate through PERK
Method highlight: Overcoming CDK4/6 inhibitor resistance
Key finding: Improved therapeutic outcome
abstract: Dysregulation of cyclin-dependent kinase 4/6 (CDK4/6) occurs in cancer and is targeted by CDK4/6 inhibitors (CDK4/6i) including palbociclib (PD). CDK4/6i triggers quiescence (reversible) which transitions to senescence (irreversible) following prolonged exposure. Resolving the program that directs this transition is critical to overcoming CDK4/6i resistance and improving the efficacy of CDK4/6 inhibitors. We demonstrate that CDK4/6i predominantly triggers PERK, a shared kinase between the unfolded protein response (UPR) and integrated stress response (ISR). Inhibition of PERK combined with CDK4/6i impairs UPR/ISR adaptive signaling instructing early commitment to senescence. Early senescence commitment reflects accelerated senescence markers, dephosphorylation of the Retinoblastoma (RB), and engagement of a senescence specific gene signature. Combined treatment with CDK4/6i and ISRIB (ISR inhibitor) reduces tumor growth more effectively than single agents through increased senescence and immune cell surveillance. This work highlights CDK4/6i+ISRIB as a potential therapy for a range of cancers with an intact CDK4/6-RB1 axis. CDK4/6 inhibitors can trigger stress responses that alter tumor outcomes. Here, the authors show that PERK signaling shapes cell fate after CDK4/6 inhibition and influences response to therapy.

title: Metabolic reprogramming of macrophage-specific transketolase orchestrates angiogenesis in diabetic wounds
summary_zh: 巨噬细胞转酮酶代谢重编程调控糖尿病伤口血管生成。
summary_en: Metabolic reprogramming of macrophage-specific transketolase orchestrates angiogenesis in diabetic wounds.
insights: 创新点：巨噬细胞转酮酶调控血管生成
方法亮点：改善糖尿病伤口愈合
关键发现：代谢重编程机制
insights_en: Novelty: Macrophage transketolase regulates angiogenesis
Method highlight: Improving diabetic wound healing
Key finding: Metabolic reprogramming mechanism
abstract: Diabetic wound healing is profoundly impaired by macrophage metabolic dysfunction, which compromises angiogenesis. Here, we show a macrophage transketolase (TKT) as a crucial metabolic checkpoint governing vascular regeneration in diabetes. We demonstrate that loss of TKT in macrophages accelerates amino acid and fatty acid catabolism, elevates reactive oxygen species, and disrupts endothelial cell proliferation and differentiation. Mechanistically, hyperglycemia activates the AGEs-RAGE signaling cascade through suppressing TKT expression, establishing a pathological TKT-AGEs-RAGE axis that reprograms macrophage metabolism toward dysfunction. Then, we engineer a nanozyme-integrated hydrogel patch that selectively increases TKT level in macrophages, which rebalances macrophage metabolism, reduces oxidative stress, and rescues angiogenic capacity. In a diabetic pig model, localized delivery of the nano-system markedly accelerates wound closure and vascular repair. These findings not only elucidate a macrophage-specific TKT metabolic reprogramming mechanism for enhancing angiogenesis, but also offer a potential therapeutic strategy for the clinical management of diabetic wounds. Diabetes impairs wound healing by disrupting macrophage metabolism and angiogenesis. Here, authors identify macrophage-specific transketolase (TKT) as a metabolic checkpoint and develop a nanozyme hydrogel that restores macrophage TKT to promote vascular repair in diabetic wounds.

title: Reusability report: multi-sample omics network inference operates in distinct robustness regimes defined by prior knowledge and data availability
summary_zh: 研究多样本组学网络推断的鲁棒性，评估CORNETO框架。实验表明，多样本推断提高鲁棒性和可重复性。
summary_en: This study investigates the robustness of multi-sample omics network inference, evaluates the CORNETO framework. Experiments show that multi-sample inference improves robustness and reproducibility.
insights: 创新点：提出CORNETO框架，提高组学网络推断的鲁棒性。
方法亮点：系统评估网络重建范式，保持方法特定评估程序。
关键发现：多样本推断提高鲁棒性和可重复性。
insights_en: Novelty: Introduces the CORNETO framework to enhance the robustness of omics network inference.
Method highlight: Systematically evaluates network reconstruction paradigms while preserving method-specific evaluation procedures.
Key finding: Multi-sample inference improves robustness and reproducibility.
abstract: Abstract Knowledge-constrained network inference enables the reconstruction of regulatory programmes from high-dimensional biological data, yet the conditions under which shared and context-specific structures can be reliably identified remain poorly understood. Pablo Rodriguez-Mier et al. recently introduced CORNETO, a framework for multi-sample constrained inference. Here we reproduce, evaluate and extend CORNETO in terms of robustness, identifiability and bias–variance trade-offs. Using dynamic haematopoiesis and stable cortical datasets, we systematically assess four network reconstruction paradigms while preserving the original method-specific evaluation procedures and benchmark definitions. We show that multi-sample inference generally improves robustness and reproducibility, although gains in predictive performance depend on biological context and the completeness of the prior network. To enhance stability, we introduce bootstrap aggregation and selective re-expansion strategies that improve consensus robustness and recovery while preserving context-specific signals without modifying the underlying optimization scheme or sacrificing generality. Across datasets and methods, our results reveal distinct inference regimes governed by sample availability, prior knowledge and regularization. Together, these findings position network reconstruction as a regime-dependent learning problem and provide practical principles for robust multi-sample biological network inference.

title: Waiting to get sick enough
Molecular predictors of minimal residual disease in newly diagnosed multiple myeloma treated with quadruplet therapy
summary_zh: 研究四联疗法治疗多发性骨髓瘤的分子预测因子。实验表明，基因表达亚型与MRD密切相关。
summary_en: This study investigates molecular predictors of minimal residual disease in newly diagnosed multiple myeloma treated with quadruplet therapy. Experiments show a significant association between gene expression subtypes and MRD.
insights: 创新点：发现四联疗法治疗多发性骨髓瘤的分子预测因子。
方法亮点：整合基因组、转录组和表观基因组分析。
关键发现：基因表达亚型与MRD密切相关。
insights_en: Novelty: Identifies molecular predictors for quadruplet therapy in multiple myeloma.
Method highlight: Integrates genomic, transcriptomic, and epigenomic profiling.
Key finding: Gene expression subtypes are significantly associated with MRD.
abstract: Quadruplet therapy, combining anti-CD38 antibodies, immunomodulatory drugs, proteasome inhibitors and dexamethasone, is now the standard induction treatment for newly diagnosed multiple myeloma (NDMM). However, treatment response is heterogeneous and molecular predictors are needed to guide early therapeutic decisions. We performed integrated genomic, transcriptomic and epigenomic profiling of 423 tumor samples from patients with NDMM from the MIDAS cohort to characterize molecular heterogeneity and its association with measurable residual disease (MRD) after quadruplet induction with isatuximab, carfilzomib, lenalidomide and dexamethasone (Isa-KRd). Postinduction MRD-negativity rates varied significantly across gene expression subtypes, with HP1/HP3 and MS groups showing superior responses compared to the MF and CD2 subtypes. B cell differentiation was associated with MRD positivity, while proliferation and MYC programs were associated with MRD negativity. These MRD-associated transcriptomic features were independently validated in the CASSIOPEIA cohort. Whole-genome sequencing revealed both known (APOBEC mutagenesis, chromothripsis) and new genomic instability phenotypes validated in the MMRF cohort. New driver alterations were identified with independent validation across three external cohorts with multiple myeloma (MMRF, MANHATTAN and CASSIOPEIA; 1,451 cases). Genomic instability features and driver genes such as CCND1 and MYC correlated with differential MRD outcomes. DNA methylation profiling identified nine MRD-linked subgroups distinguished by the extent of hypomethylation in quiescent chromatin and cis/trans signatures of driver translocations. A multimodal random forest model integrating genomic, transcriptomic and epigenomic features predicted MRD status after induction, with an area under the curve of 0.77, outperforming clinical and genomic models, while providing comparable discrimination and improved calibration relative to the transcriptomic and epigenomic models. These findings define a multiomic classification of NDMM linked to Isa-KRd response. ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT04934475 . In a multiomic analysis of samples from patients with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma treated with isatuximab, carfilzomib, lenalidomide and dexamethasone induction therapy followed by consolidation treatment guided by minimal residual disease (MRD) status, baseline genomic, transcriptomic and epigenetic features are associated with MRD status after induction.

title: Multi-immersion oblique plane microscope (miOPM): a reconfigurable platform for high-resolution light-sheet fluorescence microscopy
summary_zh: miOPM平台实现高分辨率成像，兼容多种样本和清液协议。实验表明，该平台提高LSFM的适用性。
summary_en: The miOPM platform enables high-resolution imaging, compatible with various samples and clearing protocols. Experiments show that the platform enhances the applicability of LSFM.
insights: 创新点：提出miOPM平台，提高LSFM的适用性。
方法亮点：支持油、水、空气物镜的无缝互换。
关键发现：提高LSFM的适用性和成像质量。
insights_en: Novelty: Introduces the miOPM platform to enhance the applicability of LSFM.
Method highlight: Supports seamless interchangeability of oil, water, and air objectives.
Key finding: Enhances the applicability and imaging quality of LSFM.
abstract: Light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) enables gentle, rapid and efficient volumetric imaging of biological specimens. Despite its potential, LSFM has fragmented into multiple variants, each narrowly optimized for specific samples or imaging regimes, limiting its broad applicability.
