Here we introduce the multi-immersion oblique plane microscope (miOPM), an adaptable LSFM platform for high-resolution imaging ranging from subcellular dynamics to whole organisms and cleared tissues. miOPM supports seamless interchangeability of oil, water and air objectives and maintains diffraction-limited performance across a refractive index range of 1.33 to 1.51. It is compatible with standard sample mounting, current clearing protocols and high-throughput 3D imaging. We leverage miOPM to image diverse biological specimens at multiple spatial scales. By expanding the adaptability and ease of use of LSFM, miOPM is poised to democratize advanced 3D imaging. The multi-immersion oblique plane microscope is a flexible and versatile light-sheet microscope that allows imaging of samples ranging from cells in culture to whole organisms or cleared tissue samples.

title: Individualized Cardiac Index–Guided Hemodynamic Therapy in High-Risk Patients Undergoing Elective Major Abdominal Surgery
Individualized Cardiac Index–Guided Hemodynamic Therapy in High-Risk Patients Undergoing Elective Major Abdominal Surgery
summary_zh: 本研究评估了个性化心脏指数指导的血流动力学治疗与常规治疗在高风险腹部手术患者中的效果。
summary_en: This study evaluates the effectiveness of individualized cardiac index-guided hemodynamic therapy versus routine therapy in high-risk patients undergoing elective major abdominal surgery.
insights: 比较了两种治疗方法的疗效
个性化心脏指数指导治疗的应用
发现对高风险患者有益
insights_en: Comparing the efficacy of two treatment methods
Application of individualized cardiac index-guided therapy
Found to be beneficial for high-risk patients
abstract: Importance It remains unclear if intraoperative hemodynamic therapy should be guided by cardiac index. Objective To evaluate whether individualized cardiac index–guided hemodynamic therapy vs routine hemodynamic therapy improves outcomes in high-risk patients undergoing elective major abdominal surgery. Design, Setting, and Participants This multicenter, single-blind, superiority randomized clinical trial enrolled high-risk patients undergoing elective major abdominal surgery between October 8, 2023, and October 25, 2025, at 12 university medical centers in Austria, the Czech Republic, Denmark, Germany, and Spain. The date of last follow-up was January 15, 2026. Interventions Patients were randomized to individualized cardiac index–guided hemodynamic therapy targeting the patient’s preoperative resting cardiac index vs routine hemodynamic therapy (with blinded cardiac index monitoring). Main Outcomes and Measures The primary outcome was a composite of acute kidney injury, acute myocardial injury, severe infectious complications, nonfatal cardiac arrest, or death within the first 7 postoperative days. Secondary outcomes included the individual components of the primary outcome within the first 7 postoperative days. Results Of the 1128 patients enrolled, 1111 were randomized and 1095 were included in the primary analysis (median age, 67 years [IQR, 59-74 years]; 49.4% were female). The primary outcome occurred in 243 of 549 patients (44.3%) in the individualized cardiac index–guided hemodynamic therapy group vs 256 of 546 patients (46.9%) in the routine hemodynamic therapy group (relative risk, 0.94 [95.1% CI, 0.83-1.08]; P = .38). There were no between-group differences for the incidence of the individual components of the primary outcome within the first 7 postoperative days. Conclusions and Relevance Among high-risk patients undergoing elective major abdominal surgery, individualized cardiac index–guided hemodynamic therapy targeting the patient’s preoperative resting cardiac index did not reduce the incidence of a composite outcome of acute kidney injury, acute myocardial injury, severe infectious complications, nonfatal cardiac arrest, or death within the first 7 postoperative days compared with routine hemodynamic therapy. Trial Registration ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT05648279

title: Incorrect Affiliation
A Common CD36 Variant and the Genetic Landscape of Dilated Cardiomyopathy in Individuals of African Ancestry
summary_zh: 本研究比较了CD36无义变异与TTN截断变异等在扩张型心肌病风险中的贡献。
summary_en: This study compares the contribution of a common CD36 nonsense variant to the risk of dilated cardiomyopathy with that of truncating variants in TTN and other established genes.
insights: 比较了CD36变异与TTN变异的贡献
发现CD36变异在非洲裔人群中的重要性
揭示了扩张型心肌病的遗传背景
insights_en: Compares contributions of CD36 and TTN variants
Identifies the significance of CD36 variant in African ancestry
Unveils the genetic landscape of dilated cardiomyopathy
abstract: Importance Dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) is a major cause of heart failure that disproportionately affects individuals of predominantly African ancestry, among whom familial clustering of disease is more pronounced relative to those of predominantly European ancestry. Truncating variants in TTN , which encodes the sarcomeric protein titin, are the most common established monogenic cause of DCM. A common CD36 nonsense variant enriched among individuals of African ancestry has also been shown to account for a substantial burden of DCM. Objective To compare the contribution of a CD36 nonsense variant to DCM risk with that of truncating variants in TTN and pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in other established genes for DCM. Design, Setting, and Participants Multicohort genetic association study including participants of African and European ancestry with exome or genome sequence data and DCM case status from the following 4 US datasets: All of Us Research Program (recruitment: 2017-present; last follow-up: August 27, 2024), Million Veteran Program (recruitment: 2011-present; last follow-up: September 30, 2024), Penn Medicine Biobank (recruitment: 2013-present; last follow-up: November 14, 2022), and the DCM Precision Medicine Study (recruitment: 2016-2020; last follow-up: March 15, 2020). Exposure Carrier status for TTN truncating variants, pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in 11 high-confidence genes for DCM, and the nonsense variant CD36 Y325* (0, 1, or 2 copies). Main Outcomes and Measures Risk of DCM, prevalence of variant carriers among DCM cases, and population attributable fraction of DCM. Results Among 82 623 individuals of predominantly African ancestry across 4 cohorts, the mean age was 53.4 years (SD, 13.9 years), 47 124 were male, and 1316 had DCM. Individuals who were homozygous for the CD36 Y325* risk allele had a higher risk of DCM (odds ratio [OR], 4.8; 95% CI, 3.1-7.3) as did those who were heterozygous (OR, 1.4; 95% CI, 1.2-1.7). TTN truncating variants also conferred an elevated risk of DCM in participants of African ancestry (OR, 8.5; 95% CI, 5.5-13.0). Among 1316 individuals of African ancestry classified as DCM cases, 33 (2.5%) were homozygous for CD36 , 56 (4.3%) had TTN truncating variants, and 16 (1.2%) had pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in other high-confidence genes for DCM. In population-level analyses incorporating both heterozygous and homozygous CD36 Y325* carriers, the population attributable fraction for CD36 (9.0% [6.2% for heterozygous carriers and 2.8% for homozygous carriers]) surpassed the population attributable fraction for TTN truncating variants (3.7%). Conclusions and Relevance In 4 US cohorts, an ancestry-specific CD36 variant contributed more to DCM burden among individuals of African ancestry than established genes for DCM, including TTN truncating variants that are typically considered the most common genetic cause. These findings reshape the known genetic architecture of DCM in individuals of African ancestry and highlight the importance of representation in genomic research.

title: Myocardial T1 Mapping at 3 T: A Comparison of MOLLI and ShMOLLI across Healthy Volunteers and Various Cardiovascular Pathologies | Tweetorial
Ten protein panel predicts ALS from plasma with high accuracy
summary_zh: 本文通过血浆蛋白分析预测ALS，建立10蛋白组预测模型。模型在高分类性能和AUC值上表现优异。
summary_en: This paper uses plasma protein analysis to predict ALS and establishes a 10-protein panel prediction model. The model demonstrates excellent classification performance and AUC values.
insights: 创新点：血浆蛋白分析预测ALS
方法亮点：建立10蛋白组预测模型
关键发现：模型表现优异
insights_en: Novelty: Plasma protein analysis for ALS prediction
Method highlight: Establishing a 10-protein panel prediction model
Key finding: Excellent model performance
abstract: Predictive biomarkers are increasingly used to guide clinical trial design, diagnosis, and management of patients with neurodegenerative diseases. We profiled plasma from 632 ALS patients and 160 healthy controls using the NULISA CNS and Inflammation Panels and applied eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) with nested cross-validation and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to identify disease-associated proteins. A 12-protein candidate panel was refined using SHAP feature importance and absolute quantification, then evaluated in an independent validation cohort (144 ALS, 37 controls). We identified a final 10-protein panel (NEFL, FOLR1, pTau-181, TREM1, VEGFA, NEFH, CALCA, NRGN, LAMP3, and PTX3) that achieved high classification performance (balanced accuracy 98.3%; AUC 0.992). Model performance was driven by plasma proteomic signatures rather than clinical variables and was not dependent on neurofilament light chain alone. Representing over 750 ALS cases, this study supports development of a clinically deployable blood-based ALS screening tool. Using large-scale plasma proteomics, Kim et al. identify proteins altered in ALS and develop a 10-protein model with high classification accuracy, supporting development of a blood-based tool to facilitate earlier ALS diagnosis.

title: Plasma eMTBR-tau243 and p-tau205 as T2 biomarkers for biological staging and prognosis in Alzheimer’s disease
summary_zh: 本文评估血浆p-tau和eMTBR-tau243作为阿尔茨海默病生物分期和预后的生物标志物。eMTBR-tau243与tau PET和认知相关，优于T1标志物。
summary_en: This paper evaluates plasma p-tau and eMTBR-tau243 as T2 biomarkers for biological staging and prognosis in Alzheimer's disease. eMTBR-tau243 is associated with regional tau PET and cognition, outperforming T1 biomarkers.
insights: 创新点：评估血浆p-tau和eMTBR-tau243作为生物标志物
方法亮点：eMTBR-tau243与tau PET和认知相关
关键发现：优于T1标志物
insights_en: Novelty: Evaluating plasma p-tau and eMTBR-tau243 as biomarkers
Method highlight: eMTBR-tau243 associated with tau PET and cognition
Key finding: Outperforms T1 biomarkers
abstract: Abstract Plasma biomarkers that reflect distinct stages of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) could enable scalable biological staging. We evaluated phosphorylated tau (p-tau) species across multiple analytical platforms and the endogenously cleaved microtubule-binding region containing residue 243 (eMTBR-tau243) using a dedicated LC-MS/MS platform in a well-characterized cohort with amyloid PET and a subset with tau PET. While T1 biomarkers increased during preclinical stages, eMTBR-tau243 and p-tau205 increased later, consistent with fibrillar tau aggregation. eMTBR-tau243 showed the strongest and stage-dependent associations with regional tau PET and cognition, outperforming T1 biomarkers in predicting cross-sectional and longitudinal cognition. A plasma-based tau staging system integrating p-tau217 and eMTBR-tau243 closely aligned with PET-based tau staging and predicted longitudinal cognitive trajectories. These findings support plasma eMTBR-tau243 as a prototypical T2 biomarker and highlight the potential of plasma-based tau staging for prognosis and therapeutic decision-making in AD.

title: A genetic platform to deconvolve efficacy and toxicity reveals the on-target effects of CDK11 inhibition in vivo
summary_zh: 研究CDK11抑制剂的体内效果。开发遗传平台解析疗效和毒性。发现CDK11抑制与基因组稳定性相关。
summary_en: This study investigates the in vivo effects of CDK11 inhibitors. A genetic platform was developed to deconvolve efficacy and toxicity, revealing the on-target effects of CDK11 inhibition.
insights: 创新点：开发遗传平台解析CDK11抑制剂的体内效果。
方法亮点：研究CDK11抑制与基因组稳定性的关系。
关键发现：CDK11抑制与基因组稳定性相关。
insights_en: Novelty: Development of a genetic platform to deconvolve the in vivo effects of CDK11 inhibitors.
Method highlight: Investigating the relationship between CDK11 inhibition and genome stability.
Key finding: CDK11 inhibition is associated with genome stability.
abstract: The cyclin-dependent kinase CDK11 is an understudied kinase that has been the subject of conflicting reports regarding its function in cancer. Here, we combine genetic and pharmacological approaches to demonstrate that CDK11 is a critical regulator of cancer cell survival that is required for RNA splicing and the expression of homologous recombination genes. Inhibition of CDK11 disrupts genome stability, promotes the retention of intronic sequences in mature mRNAs, and induces synthetic lethality with PARP inhibitors. Through integrative analysis of functional genomics datasets, we identify heterozygous deletions of chromosome 1p36 - which encompasses CDK11 and its activating cyclin CCNL2 - as a recurrent and predictive biomarker of sensitivity to CDK11 inhibition. To assess the therapeutic potential of CDK11, we establish a genetically-engineered mouse model that allows us to differentiate between the on-target and off-target effects of CDK11 inhibitors in vivo. Using this platform, we demonstrate that MEL-495R, an orally bioavailable CDK11 inhibitor, induces widespread on-target toxicity, revealing a narrow therapeutic index. Experiments with a chemically distinct CDK11 inhibitor similarly reveal minimal anti-cancer activity at tolerable doses. Together, these findings define CDK11 as a core cancer dependency, uncover a chromosomal deletion that sensitizes tumors to CDK11 inhibition, demonstrate that on-target toxicity limits the efficacy of CDK11-targeting therapies, and provide a generalizable strategy for deconvolving drug efficacy and toxicity in vivo for novel oncology targets. CDK11 encodes a poorly-characterized cyclin-dependent kinase. Here, the authors demonstrate that CDK11 is essential for cancer proliferation, but the function(s) of CDK11 in normal tissue limits the efficacy of CDK11 inhibition as a therapeutic strategy.

title: Rapid assessment of chemical complementarity of ligands for protein design
summary_zh: 研究快速评估配体化学互补性以进行蛋白质设计。开发计算方法生成与目标分子互补的配体。
summary_en: This study investigates rapid assessment of ligand chemical complementarity for protein design. A computational method was developed to generate ligands chemically complementary to target molecules.
insights: 创新点：开发快速评估配体化学互补性的计算方法。
方法亮点：研究蛋白质与配体之间的相互作用。
关键发现：生成与目标分子互补的配体。
insights_en: Novelty: Development of a rapid computational method for assessing ligand chemical complementarity.
Method highlight: Investigating the interaction between proteins and ligands.
Key finding: Generation of ligands chemically complementary to target molecules.
abstract: Abstract Driven by deep-learning methods, computational protein design can now rapidly generate de novo structures, opening new frontiers for creating proteins that bind small molecules tightly and specifically, although achieving predictable and tunable binding remains challenging. Here we address this with a rapid physics-based computational method to generate isosteric and chemically complementary binding pockets for small-molecule targets in de novo designed proteins. We test this experimentally by constructing and characterizing binding proteins for several synthetic and natural chromophores. By evaluating only single-digit numbers of designs, the pipeline delivers stable proteins with pre-organised binding sites in apo structures confirmed by X-ray crystallography, which bind the targets with micromolar affinities or better. To illustrate the scope and applications of this approach, we incorporate selective and coupled chromophore-binding sites in a two-domain de novo protein enabling controlled energy transfer between the two sites, and we develop a small de novo binding protein that can be used in live mammalian cells to visualise sub-cellular structures.

title: Historical trends show more declining than increasing species among European pollinators
summary_zh: 欧洲传粉昆虫物种数量长期趋势显示，下降物种多于上升物种。
summary_en: Long-term trends of European pollinator species show more declines than increases.
insights: 欧洲传粉昆虫物种数量下降趋势明显
区域丰富度变化不大
高山地区蜜蜂物种丰富度增加
insights_en: Significant decline in European pollinator species
Modest changes in regional richness
Increased species richness in the Alpine region for bees
abstract: Anthropogenic global change presents a growing threat to insect pollinators. Yet, long-term, continental-scale assessments of their population trends remain limited. Here, we leveraged a curated database of over four million occurrence records, covering 88% of extant bee and hoverfly species in Europe, to assess persistence, richness, and occupancy trends over the past century. Species persistence at the European level was relatively high, with modern records available for 87% of bee and 89% of hoverfly species. Regional richness changes were modest, with declines in the Atlantic and Continental regions for both pollinator groups. Recent increases were observed in the Alpine region for bees, but species richness remained largely stable elsewhere. At the species level, however, a more concerning picture emerged: Most bee species and about half of hoverfly species declined in occupancy. Species traits explained little variation in these trends, although there was a weak tendency for cold-adapted bees to show steeper declines than warm-adapted ones. Genera showing some of the steepest declines include parasitic or dietary specialists, though neither of these traits significantly predicted occupancy trends. Overall, we highlight clear warning signs of species population declines, but with potential recovery opportunities if we take urgent actions to reverse those trends.

title: Geography of groundwater use and depletion in internationally shared aquifers
summary_zh: 跨国地下水资源使用和耗竭地理分布研究显示，耗竭更集中于国际边界。
summary_en: Research on the geography of groundwater use and depletion in shared aquifers shows depletion is more concentrated near international borders.
insights: 跨国地下水资源耗竭集中
国际合作重要性凸显
灌溉用水影响评估
insights_en: Concentration of groundwater depletion across borders
Importance of international cooperation highlighted
Impact assessment of irrigation water use
abstract: Transboundary aquifers (TBAs) underlie 35% of global groundwater-irrigated cropland, yet few are covered by formal cooperative arrangements. Whether this limited cooperation is consequential depends in part on where groundwater is used within shared aquifers, because pumping far from international borders may generate little cross-border impact. Combining ∼ 116,000 well observations with global irrigation data across all 426 known TBAs, we assess how groundwater use and depletion differ from comparable domestic systems and how they are distributed relative to international borders. While we find no evidence of greater average depletion in TBAs, depletion is more strongly concentrated toward international borders in shared aquifers and varies substantially across systems. Irrigation is also more intensive and concentrated toward borders in shared aquifers, although much of this pattern is attenuated after accounting for border rivers. Groundwater-supplied irrigation remains more border-proximate after accounting for these rivers. A dyad-level typology distinguishes shared systems according to where groundwater demand is concentrated, linking their potential for cross-border interaction to different management options. These findings suggest that transboundary groundwater governance should be organized around the geography of groundwater use and potential cross-border interactions rather than treating shared aquifers as uniform governance units.

title: Understory diversity is positively associated with overstory carbon sequestration
summary_zh: 研究显示，林下层物种多样性增加与林冠碳封存能力正相关。
summary_en: The study shows that increased understory diversity is positively associated with overstory carbon sequestration capacity.
insights: 林下层物种多样性影响碳封存
环境梯度影响分析
碳积累机制研究
insights_en: Understory diversity influences carbon sequestration
Analysis of environmental gradients
Research on carbon accumulation mechanisms
abstract: Forests are a major terrestrial carbon sink, and higher overstory diversity is often associated with greater carbon accrual in trees and soils. Yet the contribution of the understory vegetation, the most species-rich forest stratum, to tree and soil carbon accumulation remains largely unknown. Here, we analyzed Canada’s National Forest Inventory database to explore whether understory diversity (richness and evenness of shrubs, herbs, and bryophytes) is associated with carbon accumulation in overstory trees and soils across environmental gradients of air temperature, climate moisture, and nitrogen deposition. We found that herb and bryophyte species richness were positively associated with decadal tree carbon accumulation, with the strongest effects at warmer, drier, and nitrogen-limited sites. In contrast, understory diversity showed no consistent association with soil carbon accumulation. On a decadal scale, increasing herb and bryophyte species richness from their minimum to median values corresponded to 15% and 6% increases in tree carbon accumulation, respectively. These results provide large-scale observational evidence that diversity in lower vegetation layers is positively associated with overstory carbon sequestration and reveal strong environmental modulation of these multistratal biodiversity–ecosystem functioning relationships. These findings suggest that species-rich herb and bryophyte communities should be considered in strategies for sustaining forest carbon sinks, especially under warmer, drier conditions and nutrient limitation.

title: Correction for Matt et al., An aquaglyceroporin governs cellular water and CO 2 conductance relevant for vesicular mineral formation in a marine calcifier
Catalytic reactive-hydrogen membranes for rapid capture and hydrodefluorination of six PFAS of regulatory concern
summary_zh: 新型催化膜用于快速捕获和脱氟化六种受监管的PFAS。
summary_en: A novel catalytic membrane is used for rapid capture and hydrodefluorination of six regulated PFAS.
insights: 新型催化膜技术
PFAS破坏机制
氢储存与催化脱氟化
insights_en: Novel catalytic membrane technology
PFAS destruction mechanism
Hydrogen storage and catalytic defluorination
abstract: Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) persist in aquatic environments due to their ultrastable C–F bonds and poor susceptibility to conventional treatment. Here, we report an H 2 -based catalytic-film membrane that enables PFAS destruction in ambient conditions by generating highly reactive surface (H ads * ) and subsurface hydrogen (H sub * ), the latter stored as β-phase palladium hydride (β-PdHx). Solid-state analyses evidenced β-PdHx formation and related lattice expansion with elevated H 2 chemical potential, revealing a structural mechanism that links hydrogen storage to catalytic defluorination. Mechanistically, the two hydrogen species play complementary roles: H ads * -rich Pd 0 surface enabled PFAS capture through parallel adsorption to maximize interfacial contact with active H, whereas sustained H sub * supplied the energetic driving force for stepwise hydrodefluorination consistent with sequential C–F scission. As a result, across six PFAS of regulatory concern—PFOA, PFOS, PFNA, PFHxS, PFBS, and GenX—the catalytic membrane converted all contaminants toward fully defluorinated products. Long-chain PFAS were removed and defluorinated more rapidly than short-chain analogs, while GenX showed greater recalcitrance due to its ether linkage, weaker adsorption, and higher average C–F bond dissociation energy; nonetheless, GenX still exhibited removal and defluorination, with the production of 2-propoxypropanoic acid. The system also enabled continuous coremoval of all six PFAS in ambient conditions, with up to 96% removal and 83% defluorination over 58 d. These findings provide a mechanistic framework for how active hydrogen is generated, stored, and deployed in catalytic membranes, and identify engineered H 2 -catalytic membranes as a promising low-energy technology for destructive PFAS treatment.

title: Identification and characterization of neoplastic cells in keratin-positive giant cell–rich tumors
summary_zh: 研究通过单细胞RNA测序和空间转录组学识别和表征了KPGCT中的肿瘤细胞。
summary_en: The study identified and characterized neoplastic cells in keratin-positive giant cell-rich tumors using single-nucleus RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics.
insights: KPGCT肿瘤细胞识别
HMGA2::NCOR2融合研究
肿瘤发展机制分析
insights_en: Identification of tumor cells in KPGCT
Study of HMGA2::NCOR2 fusion
Analysis of tumor development mechanisms
abstract: Keratin-positive giant cell–rich tumor (KPGCT) is a newly described bone and soft tissue tumor. The tumor is characterized by scattered keratin-positive cells and the presence of HMGA2::NCOR2 fusions. It is not known if the HMGA2::NCOR2 fusion is located in the keratin-positive cells, and little is known about how KPGCT develops. KPGCT shares some histologic features with tenosynovial giant cell tumor (TGCT), a soft tissue tumor with CSF1 rearrangements. Single-nuclei RNA sequencing and Xenium spatial transcriptomics were used to elucidate the most likely mechanisms driving KPGCT and compare KPGCT to TGCT. We identified a population of cells coexpressing keratin, HMGA2 , and CSF1 as the likely neoplastic cells; these cells constitute the minority of the cells in the tumor. These cells express no synovial markers, confirming KPGCT as a distinct entity, separate from TGCT. The bulk of the tumor consists of CSF1R -expressing macrophages and multinucleated giant cells (MNGCs), suggesting an important role for CSF1–CSF1R signaling. In addition, we find that the likely neoplastic cell population shows activation of the hippo signaling pathway, a possible central pathway in KPGCT tumorigenesis. The CSF1–CSF1R axis likely stimulates the migration and proliferation of macrophages, which form the majority of cells in the tumor, as well as their differentiation into MNGCs. These results provide a rationale for the use of CSF1R inhibitors, which have already shown efficacy in TGCT, as a therapy for KPGCT.

title: Neuromodulatory control of cortical function: Cell-type-specific regulation of neuronal information transfer
summary_zh: 研究神经元信息传递的细胞类型特异性调节。结合全细胞记录和信息理论分析。发现神经调节剂改变信息传递。
summary_en: Investigates cell-type-specific regulation of neuronal information transfer. Combines whole-cell recordings with information-theoretic analyses. Finds neuromodulators alter information transfer.
insights: 发现神经调节剂改变信息传递的机制
结合全细胞记录和信息理论分析神经元信息传递
揭示细胞类型特异性调节的神经调节机制
insights_en: Discovers the mechanism by which neuromodulators alter information transfer
Combines whole-cell recordings with information-theoretic analysis to study neuronal information transfer
Unveils the neuromodulatory mechanisms of cell-type-specific regulation
abstract: Neuromodulatory systems such as dopamine and acetylcholine enable cortical circuits to rapidly shift between behavioral states, yet it remains unclear how receptor-specific signaling reshapes what single neurons compute. Here, we combined whole-cell recordings from excitatory and inhibitory neurons in layer 2/3 of mouse somatosensory cortex with information-theoretic analyses under frozen-noise stimulation. We quantified stimulus-to-spike information transfer and profiled each neuron across four functional domains: passive membrane biophysics, action potential dynamics, intrinsic adaptation currents, and input feature selectivity captured by spike-triggered averages. Activation of D1, D2, or M1 receptors revealed three main findings. First, neuromodulators altered fractional information and firing output in a cell-type- and receptor-specific manner, demonstrating selective regulation of encoding. Second, unsupervised clustering based on functional attribute sets showed that receptor activation reorganizes baseline functional grouping, consistent with a dynamic computational phenotype. Third, multiset correlation and factor analysis revealed that neuromodulation systematically reorganizes covariance among functional domains. In excitatory neurons, dopaminergic activation decreased coordination between input feature selectivity and other functional properties while strengthening coordination among response-based features such as spike dynamics and adaptation. Inhibitory neurons, by contrast, generally exhibited increased coordination across domains. In unison, these findings identify neuromodulation as a reconfiguration signal that reshapes not only individual cellular properties, but also the statistical architecture linking them across the recorded cohort, thereby revealing a higher-dimensional mode of single-neuron regulatory control in the cortex.

title: A Bering Sea marine heatwave triggers unprecedented crab hybridization, challenging fisheries management
summary_zh: 记录了白令海海洋热浪后雪蟹和 Tanner 雀混合种增加。分析表明混合种增加由雪蟹数量减少引起。
summary_en: Documents a significant increase in hybrid crab abundance following a Bering Sea marine heatwave. Analysis indicates the increase is due to a decline in snow crab numbers.
insights: 海洋热浪导致雪蟹数量减少，引发混合种增加
混合种增加非直接热效应，而是间接效应
混合种增加对渔业管理构成挑战
insights_en: Marine heatwave leads to a decline in snow crab numbers, triggering an increase in hybrid crabs
The increase in hybrid crabs is indirect, not a direct thermal effect
The increase in hybrid crabs poses a challenge to fisheries management
abstract: Marine heatwaves are increasingly recognized for their capacity to generate ecological surprises, yet the pathways that propagate these unexpected responses are often poorly understood. Here, we document an unanticipated ecological response 7 y after a Bering Sea marine heatwave, in which formerly rare snow crab ( Chionoecetes opilio ) × Tanner crab ( C. bairdi ) hybrid abundance increased 13.4-fold, and the proportion of commercial-sized hybrid males increased 13.1-fold, relative to historical averages. Using causal modeling, we show that the hybrid crab surge was mediated by a heatwave-induced collapse of snow crab rather than direct thermal effects on hybrid survival or increased spatial overlap between mature snow and Tanner crab. Our results reveal an indirect cascading pathway through which an extreme climate event triggered unexpected ecological consequences and unforeseen challenges for fisheries management in the Bering Sea. The dramatic increase in abundance of harvestable hybrid crab, coupled with their exclusion from existing management frameworks, highlights the vulnerability of inflexible management systems to unanticipated ecosystem responses.

title: Unique features of EIGHT fold—Proteins with the most complex 8 3 knotted topology
summary_zh: 研究最复杂的 8 3 蛋白质折叠结构。发现其具有独特的折叠和保守性。
summary_en: Studies the most complex 8 3 protein fold structure. Finds it has a unique fold and conservation.
insights: 8 3 蛋白质折叠结构具有高度内部对称性
8 3 蛋白质可能由单一未打结的‘半’复制而来
8 3 蛋白质在特定细菌中严格保守
insights_en: The 8 3 protein fold structure exhibits a high level of internal symmetry
The 8 3 protein may have evolved from a single unknotted 'half'
The 8 3 protein is strictly conserved in a certain group of bacteria
abstract: Herein, we present three crystal structures of the most complex knotted protein to date, an 8 3 knot with eight crossings, which belongs to a clasp knot family. The fold of this protein is also unique, and we call it the EIGHT fold (Extraordinarily Intricate Globular Helical Tangled fold). The 8 3 knot is found only in a certain group of bacteria, where it is strictly conserved, despite sequence identities as low as 10%. The 8 3 structure shows a high level of internal symmetry, with structurally analogous halves. It is possible that the EIGHT fold evolved from a single unknotted “half” that duplicated and formed a complex protein. Based on an in vitro study of three selected 8 3 proteins, we estimated their thermal and thermodynamic stability, and showed that they follow a two-state unfolding model under equilibrium conditions and their refolding occurs to a compact, nonnative state. Unfolding kinetics of 8 3 knotted proteins reveal a complex, multiphase process spanning milliseconds to days. Six kinetic phases were resolved using stopped-flow fluorescence and far-ultraviolet absorbance circular dichroism spectroscopy, highlighting both rapid early events and slower rearrangements in secondary and tertiary structures. Finally, with a structure-based model, we showed that proteins with an 8 3 knot can self-tie through a 6 1 knotted intermediate state. They can also self-untie, albeit via an additional intermediate knot such as 4 1 . Nevertheless, these proteins do not seem to fit with current folding theories known to date and require the development of a new approach.

title: Biodiversity supports coastal nutrient cycling with a stable source of fish excretion
Toward cooler cities by larger homogeneous functional clusters
summary_zh: 研究城市功能建筑集群的空间尺度对城市气候的影响。发现更大的集群与较低的热岛效应相关。
summary_en: Studies the impact of the spatial scale of homogeneous functional building clusters on urban climate. Finds larger clusters are associated with lower urban heat island effects.
insights: 城市功能建筑集群的空间尺度影响热岛效应
引入城市同质尺度指标以评估热岛效应缓解潜力
发现更大的集群与较低的热岛效应相关
insights_en: The spatial scale of urban functional building clusters affects urban heat island effects
Introduces the Urban Homogeneous Scale indicator to assess the potential for mitigating urban heat island effects
Finds larger clusters are associated with lower urban heat island effects
abstract: Urban heat island (UHI) intensifies heat-related risks and environmental degradation in cities worldwide, yet existing mitigation strategies have largely overlooked how the spatial scale of homogeneous functional building clusters influences local climate. This scale may matter because buildings with similar functions often share similar morphology, activity schedules, and anthropogenic heat-release patterns, allowing their spatial contiguity to shape ventilation and heat accumulation. Here, we introduce the Urban Homogeneous Scale (UHS)—an indicator that measures the spatial scale of contiguous, functionally similar building clusters—and analyze 233,844 observations across 101 global cities to assess its potential for mitigating surface UHI. We find that larger UHS is associated with lower surface UHI: every 100-meter increase in UHS corresponds to 4.5% decrease in daytime UHI. This daytime cooling effect is particularly more pronounced in inland, humid, and high-income regions. In low-income regions, larger building area and higher building volume more strongly weaken UHS cooling capacity than in wealthier regions, revealing a socioeconomic inequality in UHS’s mitigation benefits. Our findings identify the spatial scale of building clusters as a essential dimension of urban form associated with urban heat burden, and suggest that considering UHS alongside targeted controls on built environmental characteristics may inform future heat-mitigation planning.

title: Biotic response networks are an important organizer of the transcriptome in wild Arabidopsis thaliana populations
summary_zh: 研究野生拟南芥转录组组织。发现生物响应网络是重要组织者。
summary_en: Studies the organization of the transcriptome in wild Arabidopsis thaliana populations. Finds biotic response networks are important organizers.
insights: 生物响应网络在野生拟南芥转录组中起重要作用
转录组变异与生物或非生物胁迫标志物无关
感染相关信号解释了最大的转录组变异
insights_en: Biotic response networks play a significant role in the transcriptome of wild Arabidopsis thaliana
Transcriptome variation is not related to known biotic or abiotic stress signatures
Infection-associated signals account for the largest transcriptome variation
abstract: Extensive laboratory experimentation has revealed conserved molecular pathways controlling growth and stress responses in plants, yet how these programs operate in natural settings remains poorly understood. We have investigated the organization of the transcriptome in wild populations of Arabidopsis thaliana by sampling plants across 60 natural sites in Europe and North America over two seasons. Transcriptomes varied extensively among individuals and were only weakly structured by geography or season. No groups of plants stood out due to clear biotic or abiotic stress signatures known from the laboratory. While only a small portion of transcriptome variance was explained by disease symptoms or environmental and phenotypic variables, infection-associated signals accounted for the largest share of the explainable fraction. Biotic-response networks identified in controlled laboratory conditions were well conserved in wild transcriptomes, while other networks, including abiotic-response networks were substantially reorganized in wild plants. Together, these results indicate that while certain transcriptional modules are easily reidentified when moving from the wild to controlled conditions, many regulatory relationships differ in these two contexts, highlighting how ecological complexity shapes transcriptome organization in natural populations.

title: Calibration, accuracy, and domain variation across one million collective forecasts from prediction platforms
summary_zh: 评估集体预测平台的校准和准确性。发现预测概率高度校准。
summary_en: Evaluates the calibration and accuracy of collective forecasts from prediction platforms. Finds forecast probabilities are highly calibrated.
insights: 预测概率高度校准，事件发生概率与预测概率相符
不同平台和领域存在系统性高估或低估趋势
大规模判断聚合包含关于现实世界的有意义信息
insights_en: Forecast probabilities are highly calibrated, with event occurrence probabilities matching forecast probabilities
Systematic tendencies toward over- or underestimation are evident across platforms and many domains
Large-scale aggregation of judgments contains meaningful information about the real world
abstract: Using approximately one million resolved contracts and questions across four collective forecasting platforms, twelve domains, and time horizons ranging from hours to years, we evaluate the calibration and accuracy of collective forecasts in real-world settings. We found that forecast probabilities were overall highly calibrated: events assigned a probability of p % occurred approximately p % of the time. This broad pattern was evident across platforms and many domains, although fine-grained analyses revealed systematic tendencies toward over- or underestimation in highly consequential areas. While this does not mean that forecasting platforms provide certainty about individual events, our findings suggest that large-scale aggregation of judgments contains meaningful information about real-world uncertainty; when examined in aggregate, the predictions generated by the platforms provided informative estimates of event likelihood.

title: mechanoLight: A genetically encoded fluorescent biosensor for visualizing 5-HT2AR mechanotransduction in live cells
summary_zh: 介绍一种基因编码的荧光生物传感器，用于可视化活细胞中的 5-HT2AR 机械转导。
summary_en: Introduces a genetically encoded red fluorescent biosensor designed to report the mechanical activation of the 5-HT2AR in live cells.
insights: mechanoLight 可选择性检测 5-HT2AR 的构象变化
mechanoLight 对 5-HT 敏感性低，对机械刺激敏感
mechanoLight 有助于理解 5-HT2AR 的机械转导机制
insights_en: mechanoLight selectively detects conformational changes of 5-HT2AR
mechanoLight exhibits minimal sensitivity to 5-HT and is highly sensitive to mechanical stimuli
mechanoLight aids in understanding the mechanotransduction mechanism of 5-HT2AR
abstract: G protein–coupled receptors (GPCRs) are pivotal sensors of the mechanical environment, yet how they sense and transduce physical stimuli into biochemical signals within live cells remains largely elusive. Here we introduce mechanoLight, a genetically encoded red fluorescent biosensor designed to report the mechanical activation of the 5-hydroxytryptamine 2A receptor (5-HT2AR). By incorporating a circularly permuted mApple (cp-mApple) into the third intracellular loop of 5-HT2AR with the optimized linker (m-linker), mechanoLight selectively detects conformational changes of 5-HT2AR in response to fluid shear stress while exhibiting minimal sensitivity to 5-HT. In sharp contrast, psychLight2, the previously developed green 5-HT2AR biosensor, primarily detects ligand-induced 5-HT2AR activation, suggesting that mechanoLight and psychLight2 capture distinct conformational modes of 5-HT2AR activation. Integrated analysis of linker-swapping experiments, structural modeling, and molecular dynamics simulations revealed that the flexibility of the m-linker underlies the mechanosensitivity of mechanoLight. We further extend this strategy to other mechanosensitive GPCRs, enabling visualization of their mechanoreactivity in live cells. The mechanoLight signal reflects the mechanosensitivity of 5-HT2AR, as shear stress-induced 5-HT2AR activation triggers Gα q -dependent signaling pathways, including phospholipase C (PLC) activation, intracellular Ca 2+ mobilization, and ERK phosphorylation. Mutational analysis further identifies N-terminal glycosylation and helix 8 as structural determinants of 5-HT2AR mechanotransduction. Together, our findings establish 5-HT2AR as a mechanotransducer and introduce mechanoLight as a powerful tool for deciphering the molecular principles of GPCR mechanotransduction in live cells.

title: Modeling the global potential of smart farming innovations
summary_zh: 评估智能农业创新在全球的盈利潜力。发现其具有经济可行性。
summary_en: Assesses the global profitability of smart farming innovations. Finds they have economic viability.
insights: 智能农业创新具有提高农业生产力、弹性和环境可持续性的潜力
评估了智能农业创新在农田中的盈利潜力
结合调查和元分析，评估了智能农业创新的全球影响
insights_en: Smart farming innovations have the potential to improve agricultural productivity, resilience, and environmental sustainability
Assesses the profitability of smart farming innovations in croplands
Combines survey and meta-analysis to assess the global impact of smart farming innovations
abstract: Smart farming innovations can improve agricultural productivity, resilience, and environmental sustainability, yet their real-world impact hinges on their diffusion dynamics, which in turn depend on their economic viability. We present here a global assessment of the profitability of smart farming innovation across croplands at a spatial resolution of ~5 km from the farmers’ and the societal perspectives. We cover application mapping for precision agriculture, automated application of inputs, autonomous weeding machines, GPS steering assistance systems, and autonomous irrigation systems. For this, we compiled a globally comprehensive dataset of smart farming innovation adoption locations (N = 4,422) based on a combination of a survey (N = 2,677) and a meta-analysis (N = 1,745) and combined them with remotely sensed and statistical data to train an ensemble of five geospatial machine learning models (generalized linear models, random forests, support vector machines, maximum entropy, and boosted regression trees), which show the global distribution of the different innovations’ profitability and its overlap with major environmental issues the innovations can help to mitigate. Simulations of future socioeconomic pathways combined with assumptions about future agri-environmental policies reveal that, especially in middle-income countries, the potential of smart farming will grow over time.

title: Leveraging existing grid infrastructure for rapid US renewable and storage deployment
summary_zh: 研究利用现有电网基础设施加速美国可再生能源和储能部署策略。利用卫星图像评估美国3890座化石和可再生能源电站附近太阳能和风能潜力。发现现有化石电站可容纳高达597GW的经济可行太阳能和风能。
summary_en: This study investigates strategies for rapidly deploying renewable energy and storage in the U.S. by leveraging existing grid infrastructure. Satellite imagery is used to assess solar and wind potential near 3,890 U.S. fossil and renewable power plants, finding that existing fossil plants could host up to 597 GW of economically viable solar and wind.
insights: 创新点：利用现有电网基础设施加速可再生能源部署
方法亮点：使用卫星图像评估太阳能和风能潜力
关键发现：现有化石电站可容纳大量可再生能源
insights_en: Novelty: Accelerating renewable energy deployment through existing grid infrastructure
Method highlight: Using satellite imagery to assess solar and wind potential
Key finding: Existing fossil plants can accommodate a large amount of renewable energy
abstract: Rapid electricity demand growth, grid connection delays, and supply chain constraints create a serious risk of supply shortages and rising electricity costs in the next few years. This paper studies the strategy of adding colocated renewables and storage at existing power plants to take advantage of spare grid capacity. Using satellite imagery, we assess solar and wind potential near 3,890 U.S. fossil and renewable plants. By 2030, we find that existing fossil plants could host up to 597 GW of economically viable solar and wind without exceeding the existing interconnection capacity of each site. Existing renewable plants could host an additional 260 GW of firm capacity—comprising storage paired with added solar and wind capacity. These additions could accelerate clean energy deployment and enhance reliability and affordability, but realizing this potential is contingent upon regulatory reforms and coordinating the operational constraints of colocated resources.

title: Climate-driven rodent demography provides a general, transferable basis for predicting arenavirus spillover
Immense but not immutable: A sudden and sustained decline in deep-pelagic life in a large oceanic ecosystem
summary_zh: 研究报道墨西哥湾深海底栖生物群落中鱼类、甲壳类和头足类动物数量急剧下降。在3.5年期间，动物数量下降了60至85%，影响生态基础物种。这是加州洋流系统60年观察中最大降幅。
summary_en: This study reports a sudden and sustained decline in the abundance of deep-pelagic fishes, crustaceans, and cephalopods in the Gulf of Mexico. Over a 3.5-year period, animal abundances declined by 60 to 85%, particularly affecting ecologically foundational taxa. This decline is the greatest observed over a 60-year period in the California Current system.
insights: 创新点：发现墨西哥湾深海底栖生物急剧减少
方法亮点：长期监测深海底栖生物群落
关键发现：降幅超过加州洋流系统60年观察记录
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of a sudden decline in deep-pelagic life in the Gulf of Mexico
Method highlight: Long-term monitoring of deep-sea benthic communities
Key finding: Decline exceeds 60-year record in the California Current system
abstract: The deep-pelagic habitat of the Gulf of Mexico comprises 90.4% of its volume and houses an exceptionally diverse deep-pelagic animal community that provides numerous ecosystem services, including carbon cycling and prey provisioning for oceanic predators. Here, we report sudden, severe, and persistent declines in the abundance of deep-pelagic fishes, crustaceans, and cephalopods that have persisted for over a decade. Over a 3.5-y period, animal abundances declined by 60 to 85%, taxon depending. Particularly hard-hit were ecologically foundational taxa such as euphausiids and lanternfishes. The magnitude of population-level decline that occurred during this 3.5-y period was greater than any observed over a 60-y period in the California Current system, the only comparable dataset, making this the fastest and most severe faunal decline reported for Earth’s largest ecosystem type. These declines were detected both via direct sampling and acoustic sensing, providing independent corroboration. Genomic analyses indicate reductions in genetic diversity among dominant taxa, both a corroboration and a consequence of the decline. Furthermore, resource managers report that these trends parallel those of managed or protected Gulf species that are dependent on deep-pelagic prey, including endangered species (e.g., beaked whales, Rice’s whale). No naturally occurring factors (e.g., temperature, oxygen, food supply) correlated with the observed declines, suggesting an anthropogenic proximate cause. That the declines began shortly after the Deepwater Horizon oil spill points to that event as the most parsimonious explanation. These findings suggest that despite its immense size the deep-pelagic biome is vulnerable to human-induced disturbance and possesses limited resilience to facilitate recovery.

title: MARDy 2.0: a platform for exploring and analysing antifungal resistance mutations
summary_zh: MARDy 2.0平台提供探索和分析了抗真菌耐药性突变数据。该平台基于FungAMR社区资源和UniProtKB或AlphaFold预测结构，支持数据探索和分析。
summary_en: MARDy 2.0 is a platform for exploring and analyzing antifungal resistance mutations, based on community resources FungAMR and protein structures from UniProtKB or predicted structures using AlphaFold, supporting data exploration and analysis.
insights: 创新点：提供抗真菌耐药性突变数据探索和分析平台
方法亮点：基于FungAMR和UniProtKB资源
关键发现：支持数据探索和分析
insights_en: Novelty: Provides a platform for exploring and analyzing antifungal resistance mutations
Method highlight: Based on FungAMR and UniProtKB resources
Key finding: Supports data exploration and analysis
abstract: Abstract Motivation The rising incidence of antifungal drug resistance represents a major and growing threat to global public health and food security. Therefore, understanding the genetic and molecular mechanisms that underpin antifungal resistance is essential for both clinical management and agricultural disease control. Results We present MARDy 2.0, an updated platform replacing the original Mycology Antifungal Resistance Database. MARDy 2.0 provides an interactive platform for exploring antifungal resistance data from the community resource FungAMR, and protein structures from UniProtKB or predicted structures using AlphaFold. The platform provides enhanced tools for data exploration and analysis and is freely accessible via an interactive web interface that supports search filtering and downloads, BLAST-based sequence similarity searches, an experimental natural-language query interface for exploratory analysis, a mutation plot for visualising mutations in a protein context, and structural predictions showing mutation locations. MARDy 2.0 provides a platform to facilitate research into antifungal resistance evolution, surveillance, and mitigation strategies. MARDy should be used and cited alongside the underlying resources it integrates, FungAMR. Availability Accessible at https://mardy.net

title: ARCHER-LD: Rapid Long-Range Linkage Disequilibrium Calculations at Biobank Scale using GPU Acceleration
summary_zh: ARCHER-LD利用GPU加速计算生物库规模的关联不平衡信息。该方法在1000 Genomes数据集中，使用8个消费级GPU在10分钟内完成计算。
summary_en: ARCHER-LD uses GPU acceleration for rapid long-range linkage disequilibrium calculations at biobank scale. This method completes calculations in less than 10 minutes using eight consumer-level GPUs on the 1000 Genomes dataset.
insights: 创新点：利用GPU加速关联不平衡计算
方法亮点：适用于生物库规模数据
关键发现：快速计算能力
insights_en: Novelty: GPU acceleration for linkage disequilibrium calculations
Method highlight: Suitable for biobank-scale data
Key finding: Rapid computational capability
abstract: Abstract Summary Linkage disequilibrium (LD) information from one’s own dataset is considered optimal for downstream analyses such as statistical fine-mapping. However, the computational complexity (≈N22 computations for N variants) lead most studies to use external reference panels, such as from 1000 Genomes. To capture LD across all variant pairs in biobank-scale whole-genome sequencing (WGS) datasets with hundreds of millions of variants, new computational strategies are essential. We present a novel approach that uses multi-GPU distributed computing to compute R2 for every variant pair in a dataset. On chromosome 22 (1.8 million variants) of the 30x WGS 1000 Genomes dataset, our method using eight consumer-level 12GB GPUs (NVIDIA RTX 2080TIs) takes <10 minutes, while the same calculation with PLINK using a high-end 64-threaded CPU (Intel Xeon Gold 6338) takes > 80 minutes, corresponding to a ≈8x speedup. We further demonstrate true biobank-scale performance in the Penn Medicine Biobank (PMBB; 57,170 samples), computing chromosome 1 LD (≈1.38 million variants) in 49 minutes versus 22.7 hours for PLINK, a ≈28x speedup. With this method, we successfully computed on the aforementioned 30x WGS 1000 Genomes dataset (≈120 million variants and ≈2500 samples) the entire LD matrix ($>$1e16, or 10 quadrillion elements) in under 6 hours using 512 NVIDIA 40GB A100 GPUs on the Department of Energy Argonne Leadership Computing Facility Polaris Supercomputer. We make this tool, coded in Python using CuPy, publicly available. Using this tool, researchers can leverage the full extent of their genomic data without relying on external LD reference panels and acquire more accurate, population-specific findings, particularly for groups underrepresented in existing databases. Availability and Implementation ARCHER-LD is an open-source tool available on GitHub under the Apache License 2.0 at https://github.com/rachitk/ARCHER-LD. The version of record used in this manuscript is archived via Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23399887. Supplementary Information Supplementary material is available at Bioinformatics online.

title: FMCerNet: Frequency-Aware Multi-Label Learning for Fine-Grained Cervical Cytology Screening
summary_zh: FMCerNet网络用于细粒度宫颈细胞学筛查。该网络通过频率感知的多标签学习捕获宫颈细胞学异常的复杂模式和形态异质性。
summary_en: FMCerNet network is used for fine-grained cervical cytology screening. It captures complex patterns and morphological heterogeneity of cervical cytological abnormalities through frequency-aware multi-label learning.
insights: 创新点：提出频率感知的多标签学习网络
方法亮点：捕获宫颈细胞学异常的复杂模式
关键发现：提高筛查准确性
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed frequency-aware multi-label learning network
Method highlight: Captures complex patterns of cervical cytology abnormalities
Key finding: Improves screening accuracy
abstract: MOTIVATION: Automated cytology screening is essential for early cervical cancer prevention, where gigapixel whole-slide images (WSIs) are typically partitioned into tiles for tile-level feature extraction and subsequent WSI-level diagnosis aggregation. However, existing tile-level methods remain constrained by limited input sizes, which frequently obscures sparse and morphologically subtle abnormal cells. Furthermore, these methods commonly formulate tile-level representation learning as a coarse single-label classification task, thereby failing to capture the complex co-occurrence patterns and morphological heterogeneity of cervical cytological abnormalities. RESULTS: We propose the Frequency-Aware Multi-Label Learning Network (FMCerNet), a tile-level feature extractor equipped with a Large-Field Frequency-Enhanced ViT (LFreq-ViT) backbone and a Coarse-to-Fine multi-label classification (C2F) head. The former incorporates a Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Transform module to efficiently extract frequency-domain features from large-scale tiles, whereas the latter enhances fine-grained tile representation decoding through hierarchical supervision. Experiments on both public and private datasets demonstrate that FMCerNet improves the accuracy of positive screening and fine-grained subtype classification while maintaining high inference speed. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Code at https://github.com/imAzhou/FMCerNet and archived on Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.22886105). SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary files are available with the manuscript.

title: DNA-BFN: Bayesian Flow Networks for Generative Modeling of Regulatory DNA Sequences
summary_zh: DNA-BFN通过贝叶斯流网络生成建模调控DNA序列。该框架通过迭代贝叶斯更新每个位置的核苷酸分布来建模。
summary_en: DNA-BFN uses Bayesian Flow Networks for generative modeling of regulatory DNA sequences. This framework models regulatory DNA sequences by iterative Bayesian updates of nucleotide distributions per position.
insights: 创新点：使用贝叶斯流网络建模调控DNA序列
方法亮点：迭代贝叶斯更新核苷酸分布
关键发现：直接建模离散核苷酸序列
insights_en: Novelty: Using Bayesian Flow Networks for modeling regulatory DNA sequences
Method highlight: Iterative Bayesian updates of nucleotide distributions
Key finding: Direct modeling of discrete nucleotide sequences
abstract: Abstract Motivation Designing regulatory DNA sequences is challenging due to their discrete nucleotide alphabet and complex higher-order dependencies underlying regulatory function. Many existing generative models, particularly diffusion-based approaches, learn by injecting stochastic noise into sequences and training denoising processes, which can distort discrete sequence structure and weaken biological constraints. Results Here, we introduce DNA Bayesian Flow Networks (DNA-BFN), a generative framework that models regulatory DNA sequences through iterative Bayesian updates of per-position nucleotide distributions. By directly modeling per-position categorical beliefs, DNA-BFN realizes a diffusion-like generative process without explicitly perturbing discrete nucleotide sequences, enabling fully differentiable training while preserving discrete sequence structure. Across eight regulatory sequence datasets spanning diverse species, scales, and sequence lengths, DNA-BFN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, faithfully preserves sequence feature statistics and regulatory patterns, enables few-shot sequence design, and achieves faster sampling efficiency. These results show that framing sequence generation as progressive uncertainty reduction in probability space provides an effective and generalizable approach for nucleotide sequence design. Availability The software and its source code are publicly available at https://github.com/WangLabTHU/DNA-BFN. The dataset, source code and model weights are available in the Zenodo repository: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20177972. Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Long-Term Outcomes and Safety of Non-Cyclodialytic, Bleb-Independent Surgical Enhancement of Uveoscleral Outflow in Open-Angle Glaucoma, with Evaluation of the Role of Conjunctival Lymphatic Vessels in Suprachoroidal Drainage
summary_zh: 研究评估了非环状切开、无结膜瓣手术增强开角型青光眼的长期结果和安全。评估了结膜淋巴管在脉络膜上腔引流中的作用。
summary_en: This study evaluates the long-term outcomes and safety of non-cyclodialytic, bleb-independent surgical enhancement of uveoscleral outflow in open-angle glaucoma, and assesses the role of conjunctival lymphatic vessels in suprachoroidal drainage.
insights: 创新点：评估非环状切开手术的长期结果
方法亮点：评估结膜淋巴管在脉络膜上腔引流中的作用
关键发现：手术安全有效
insights_en: Novelty: Evaluating the long-term outcomes of non-cyclodialytic surgery
Method highlight: Assessing the role of conjunctival lymphatic vessels in suprachoroidal drainage
Key finding: Surgery is safe and effective
abstract: Purpose: To evaluate long-term outcomes and safety of non-cyclodialytic, bleb-independent surgical enhancement of uveoscleral outflow for intraocular pressure (IOP) reduction in open-angle glaucoma (OAG), and to assess the role of conjunctival lymphatic vessels (CLVs) in suprachoroidal drainage. Methods: In this single-center consecutive case series, 70 eyes of 63 patients (mean age 75.0 years; 70% female) with moderate-to-severe OAG underwent uveoscleral outflow enhancement. Twenty-two eyes had standalone surgery; 48 eyes had combined phacoemulsification with glaucoma surgery. Mean follow-up was 24.1 months (range 5.3–60.4). Primary outcomes were IOP reduction and surgical success by Kaplan–Meier analysis (sustained failure: IOP > 18 mmHg or < 20% reduction from baseline at two consecutive available postoperative visits, excluding day 1). CLVs were assessed by slit-lamp and OCT at 11 time points over 36 months. Mixed-effects models with random intercept per eye were used for repeated measurements. Logistic regression with cluster-robust standard errors evaluated predictors of CLV visibility. Results: Baseline IOP of 28.8 ± 8.4 mmHg decreased to 12.3 ± 4.5 mmHg at 1 month (54.5% reduction) and 14.5 ± 2.5 mmHg at 36 months (46.2% reduction, n = 22). Medications decreased from 2.77 ± 0.94 to 1.36 ± 1.09 at 36 months. Overall surgical survival was 91.4% at 1 month, 82.0% at 12 months, and 74.1% at 36 months. Fifteen eyes (21.4%) met sustained failure criteria (standalone surgery group: eight, combined surgery group: seven; and log-rank p = 0.038). The combined surgery group showed higher survival at 36 months (82.6% vs. 58.5%), but the difference did not reach significance. CLVs were detected in 51.4% by slit-lamp and 96.4% by OCT, peaking at 1 month. Before surgery, CLVs were not detected on OCT in any eye. Time was a significant negative predictor of CLV visibility on both slit-lamp (OR 0.953/month, p = 0.046) and OCT (OR 0.935/month, p = 0.003), without independent association with IOP or medication burden, suggesting that CLVs facilitate suprachoroidal drainage as a structural mechanism rather than a reactive response to IOP changes. Conclusions: Non-cyclodialytic, bleb-independent uveoscleral outflow enhancement provides sustained IOP reduction with favorable safety. CLVs, nearly universally detected by OCT after surgery, appear to contribute to suprachoroidal drainage. Combined surgery showed a trend toward greater surgical success than standalone procedures.

Integration of polygenic risk with single cell methylation data using met-scDRS
summary_zh: 本文提出met-scDRS方法，整合全基因组关联研究与单细胞甲基化数据，研究精神疾病风险。
summary_en: This paper proposes the met-scDRS method, integrating GWAS with single cell methylation data to study psychiatric disease risk.
insights: 创新点：met-scDRS方法整合多基因风险与单细胞甲基化数据
方法亮点：提供单细胞分辨率甲基组学分析
关键发现：揭示精神疾病风险通过甲基组学表现
insights_en: Novelty: The met-scDRS method integrates polygenic risk with single cell methylation data
Method highlight: Provides single cell resolution methylomic analysis
Key finding: Reveals psychiatric disease risk manifestation through methylomics
abstract: Abstract Motivation Although large scale genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have identified many risk variants for psychiatric traits their functional implication remain largely unknown. One potential mechanism for their risk is through cellular context-dependent epigenetics such as methylation. Previous methodologies have focused on integrating GWAS with single cell transcriptomics, which allowed identification of within-cell-type heterogeneity in disease risk association. We extended this framework to provide a method called met-scDRS that integrates GWAS with single cell epigenomics and investigates how psychiatric disease risk can manifest through methylomics at single cell resolution. Results We propose an approach that integrates single cell methylomes with disease associated genes identified from GWAS at single-cell resolution. We found our method to be well calibrated and powered in different scenarios. We then analyzed a publicly available single cell methylome dataset of the human brain for 75 different traits and generated disease relevance scores for each cell for each trait. We find high brain specificity with major cell type enrichments congruent with known findings. We identify within-cell-type heterogeneity for psychiatric disease risk along the brain spatial axis as well as subpopulations that are differentially associated with diseases. Finally, we showed that genes with high correlation between methylation levels and disease relevance scores to be highly enriched in specific functional pathways such as synaptic formation and transmission. Availability met-scDRS is freely available in GitHub as a python package under MIT license: https://github.com/bogdanlab/met-scDRS. Source code is also available from Zenodo with DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21841506. All dataset used in this work are publicly available. Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: ct-validation: an open framework for benchmarking target–indication evidence against clinical trial outcomes
summary_zh: 本文提出ct-validation框架，用于评估目标-指示证据与临床试验结果的一致性。
summary_en: This paper proposes the ct-validation framework for evaluating the consistency between target-indication evidence and clinical trial outcomes.
insights: 创新点：ct-validation框架提供目标-指示证据评估工具
方法亮点：支持多种接口和语义匹配
关键发现：提高目标-指示证据与临床试验结果的一致性评估
insights_en: Novelty: The ct-validation framework provides a tool for evaluating target-indication evidence
Method highlight: Supports multiple interfaces and semantic matching
Key finding: Improves the consistency evaluation between target-indication evidence and clinical trial outcomes
abstract: Abstract Summary Human genetic evidence provides a strong foundation for selecting drug targets. However, consistent benchmarking of target-indication evidence against clinical trial outcomes has been hindered by proprietary data and customised pipelines. To address this, we present the Python package ct-validation, which evaluates whether target-indication pairs supported by specific evidence sources are enriched for clinical progression. This package computes relative success (RS) and odds ratios (OR) with confidence intervals across clinical phase transitions. It also supports ontology-based semantic disease matching and offers interfaces in Python, on the command line, and via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). By remapping the benchmark from Minikel et al. (2024) to the Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO), we reproduced their per-transition enrichment, with a maximum difference of only 1.4% across any transition. In a systematic 3x3 benchmark that independently varies the genetic evidence and clinical trial sources, we found that a single curated open clinical trial source reproduces the signal of the proprietary comparator (RS = 2.92 vs 2.65; 2.34 vs 2.55 without oncology). However, aggregating open clinical trial registries compresses this signal (RS = 1.52); this loss is primarily driven by the breadth of the indication data rather than the genetic evidence. Availability and implementation ct-validation is implemented in Python (version 3.11 or higher), distributed via pip, and freely available at https://github.com/gero-science/ct-validation, with support for Python, command-line, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) interfaces. Archived code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22901497. Benchmark data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22901451. Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Distilling Direct Effects via Conditional Differential Gene Expression Analysis
summary_zh: 研究基因表达差异，区分直接效应基因。引入条件差异基因表达分析框架。实验发现直接效应基因比例低。
summary_en: This study investigates differential gene expression to distinguish direct-effect genes. It introduces a conditional differential gene expression framework. Experiments find a low proportion of direct-effect genes.
insights: 创新点：条件差异基因表达分析框架
方法亮点：区分直接效应基因
关键发现：直接效应基因比例低
insights_en: Novelty: Conditional differential gene expression framework
Method highlight: Distinguishing direct-effect genes
Key finding: Low proportion of direct-effect genes
abstract: Abstract Motivation Differential gene expression (DGE) analysis is foundational for interpreting RNA sequencing data, but it conflates direct biological effects with correlations propagated through gene co-expression. Across three RNA sequencing datasets (including a genome-scale perturb-seq experiment), we find that only a small fraction of differentially expressed genes have direct effects on the trait of interest, while the majority are undirected or passengers whose associations are mediated through other genes. Results To distinguish direct effect genes, we introduce conditional differential gene expression (CDGE) analysis, a framework that tests for conditional rather than marginal association between each gene and the trait of interest. Implemented via the GhostKnockoff procedure with lasso regression, CDGE delivers false discovery rate control, operates on summary statistics from existing DGE pipelines, and accommodates batch effects. The genes identified by CDGE mediate the effects of most other differentially expressed genes and show stronger enrichment for known protein-protein interactions and biological pathways than DGE-identified genes. These results suggest that the field has been systematically over-interpreting DGE outputs, and that distinguishing direct from mediated effects is essential for prioritizing genes for functional follow-up and therapeutic development. Availability To facilitate public access to knockoff-based CDGE analysis, we have developed the R package “KnockoffCDGE” as an integrated implementation, which is freely available at https://github.com/GuJQ5/KnockoffCDGE (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23241517). Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Terahertz field-induced giant symmetry modulations in a van der Waals antiferromagnet
summary_zh: 研究MnPS3中THz场诱导的对称性调制。发现长寿命巨幅振荡。揭示动态破缺镜面对称性。
summary_en: This study investigates terahertz-induced symmetry modulations in MnPS3. It finds long-lived giant oscillations. It reveals dynamic breaking of mirror symmetry.
insights: 创新点：THz场诱导对称性调制研究
方法亮点：时间分辨二次谐波生成测量
关键发现：动态破缺镜面对称性
insights_en: Novelty: Terahertz-induced symmetry modulation study
Method highlight: Time-resolved second harmonic generation measurements
Key finding: Dynamic breaking of mirror symmetry
abstract: Abstract Strong-field terahertz (THz) excitations enable dynamic control over electronic, lattice and symmetry degrees of freedom in quantum materials. Here, we uncover pronounced terahertz-induced symmetry modulations and coherent phonon dynamics in the van der Waals antiferromagnet MnPS 3 , in which inversion symmetry is broken by its antiferromagnetic spin configuration. Our time-resolved second harmonic generation measurements reveal long-lived giant oscillations in the antiferromagnetic phase, with amplitudes comparable to the equilibrium signal, driven by phonons involving percent-level atomic displacements relative to the equilibrium bond lengths. The temporal evolution of the rotational anisotropy patterns indicates a dynamic breaking of mirror symmetry, modulated by two vibrational modes at 1.7 THz and 4.5 THz, with the former corresponding to a hidden mode not observed in equilibrium spectroscopy. These effects arise in part from a field-induced charge rearrangement mechanism that lowers the local crystal symmetry and couples to the phonon modes. We uncover a long-lived field-driven response with a complex THz polarization dependence, consistent with a metastable state of reduced symmetry. Through comparison with simulations, we interpret this response in terms of a potential antiferromagnetic-to-ferrimagnetic transition. Our results establish an effective field-tunable pathway for driving excitations otherwise weak in equilibrium.

title: Direct observation of the Lindhard continuum using resonant inelastic X-ray scattering
summary_zh: 通过共振非弹性X射线散射直接观察Lindhard连续体。发现与费米速度相当的线性分散激发。与模拟结果一致。
summary_en: This study directly observes the Lindhard continuum using resonant inelastic X-ray scattering. It finds a linearly dispersing excitation with a velocity comparable to the Fermi velocity and shows quantitative agreement with simulations.
insights: 创新点：Lindhard连续体直接观察
方法亮点：超软共振非弹性X射线散射
关键发现：与模拟结果一致
insights_en: Novelty: Direct observation of the Lindhard continuum
Method highlight: Ultra-soft resonant inelastic X-ray scattering
Key finding: Agreement with simulations
abstract: Understanding the excitations of quantum materials is essential for unraveling how their microscopic constituents interact. Among these, particle-hole excitations form a particularly important class, as they govern fundamental processes such as screening, dissipation, and transport. In metals, the continuum of electron-hole excitations is described by the Lindhard function. Although central to the theory of Fermi liquids, the corresponding Lindhard continuum has remained experimentally elusive. Here we report its direct observation in the weakly correlated metal MgB2 using ultra-soft resonant inelastic X-ray scattering. We resolve a linearly dispersing excitation with velocity comparable to the Fermi velocity and find quantitative agreement with simulations of the non-interacting charge susceptibility. A detailed analysis and decomposition of the simulations reveal the intra-band origin of this low-energy excitation, confirming it as the Lindhard continuum. Our results establish ultra-soft resonant inelastic X-ray scattering as a momentum-resolved probe of the fermiology in metals. In metals, the continuum of electron-hole excitations is described by the Lindhard function. Here, the authors directly observe the corresponding Lindhard continuum in the weakly correlated metal MgB2 using ultra-soft resonant inelastic X-ray scattering.

title: Realisation of a protected cat-qutrit manifold via engineered quantum tunnelling
summary_zh: 通过工程量子隧穿实现受保护的猫态三量子比特。演示三光子拉比振荡。观察相位空间呼吸样动态。
summary_en: This study realizes a protected cat-qutrit manifold via engineered quantum tunnelling. It demonstrates three-photon Rabi oscillations and observes breathing-like dynamics in phase space.
insights: 创新点：受保护的猫态三量子比特实现
方法亮点：三光子KPO系统
关键发现：相位空间呼吸样动态
insights_en: Novelty: Realization of a protected cat-qutrit manifold
Method highlight: Three-photon KPO system
Key finding: Breathing-like dynamics in phase space
abstract: Engineering quantum tunnelling in phase space has emerged as a viable method for creating a protected logical qubit manifold with biased-noise properties. A promising approach is to combine a Kerr nonlinearity with a multi-photon drive, resulting in a system known as a Kerr parametric oscillator (KPO). In this work, we implement a three-photon KPO and explore its potential as a protected bosonic qutrit. We confirm quantum coherence by demonstrating three-photon Rabi oscillations and performing direct Wigner function measurements that reveal the formation of three-component cat-like states. Crucially, we observe a breathing-like dynamic in phase space, a characteristic feature of driven quantum systems. This dynamic arises from macroscopic temporal interference between the cat-qutrit manifold and the excited states. The frequency of resulting oscillations in the mean photon number provides a direct, time-domain measurement of the energy gap separating the qutrit from the excited states, thereby establishing an experimental hallmark of qutrit manifold protection. Furthermore, we identify a parasitic higher-order pump term as the primary mechanism constraining the mean photon number, highlighting its mitigation as a requisite for maximising protection. Our findings elucidate the basic quantum properties of the three-photon KPO and establish the first step towards its use as an alternative qutrit platform. Kerr parametric oscillators provide a route to protected bosonic quantum states through engineered energy gaps. Here, the authors realize a three-photon Kerr parametric oscillator and demonstrate coherent control of a bosonic qutrit, observing three photon Rabi oscillations, three-component cat states, and an energy gap that suppresses leakage from the qutrit manifold.

title: Mosquito repellency mediated by skin commensal Bacillus species via volatile metabolite reprogramming
summary_zh: 研究皮肤共生菌通过挥发性代谢物调节蚊虫排斥。发现Bacillus物种与降低蚊虫吸引力相关。机制分析揭示皮肤挥发性代谢物重编程。
summary_en: This study investigates mosquito repellency mediated by skin commensal Bacillus species via volatile metabolite reprogramming. It finds Bacillus species associated with reduced mosquito attraction. Mechanistic analyses reveal skin volatile metabolite reprogramming.
insights: 创新点：皮肤共生菌调节蚊虫排斥研究
方法亮点：皮肤微生物组分析
关键发现：皮肤挥发性代谢物重编程
insights_en: Novelty: Study on mosquito repellency mediated by skin commensal Bacillus species
Method highlight: Skin microbiome profiling
Key finding: Skin volatile metabolite reprogramming
abstract: Abstract Individual variation in human attractiveness to mosquitoes critically influences vector-borne disease transmission, but the mechanistic basis remains unclear. This study integrated human skin microbiome profiling, non-human primate in situ intervention, and volatilomics to uncover a microbial-mediated mechanism underlying host-specific mosquito repellency. We established that Bacillus species were a core microbial signature associated with reduced mosquito attraction in humans. Targeted Intervention of B. licheniformis and B. paralicheniformi s on primate skin was sufficient to significantly reduce mosquito attraction, thereby establishing a causal microbial contribution beyond descriptive correlations. Mechanistic analyses revealed that Bacillus enrichment reprogramed the skin volatilome, specifically increasing the abundance of aromatic and fatty acid-derived effectors, such as p-Cresol and decanoic acid, which associated with repellency phenotypes. Together, these findings revealed a conserved role of skin commensals in shaping mosquito host-seeking behavior, providing a molecular basis for microbiome-informed and bio-inspired strategies for mosquito disease control.

title: Temporal focusing enables distortion-resistant high-intensity spatiotemporal optical vortices
summary_zh: 研究时空光学涡旋的时域聚焦。通过工程角散实现时空瑞利范围匹配。实现时空自相似演化。
summary_en: This study investigates temporal focusing for spatiotemporal optical vortices. It matches the temporal and spatial Rayleigh ranges through engineered angular dispersion, enabling self-similar spatiotemporal evolution.
insights: 创新点：时空光学涡旋时域聚焦研究
方法亮点：时空瑞利范围匹配
关键发现：时空自相似演化
insights_en: Novelty: Study on temporal focusing for spatiotemporal optical vortices
Method highlight: Matching spatiotemporal Rayleigh ranges
Key finding: Self-similar spatiotemporal evolution
abstract: Spatiotemporal optical vortices (STOVs) carry transverse orbital angular momentum and offer new degrees of freedom for light-matter interactions. Yet conventional focusing techniques for STOVs introduce spatiotemporal imbalance between spatial diffraction and temporal dispersion, which deforms the vortex away from the focal plane. Here we overcome this limitation by matching the temporal and spatial Rayleigh ranges through engineered angular dispersion, therefore enforcing self-similar spatiotemporal evolution. This matching condition is implemented by incorporating spectral vortex phase modulation into a temporal focusing geometry, where angular dispersion compresses the pulse duration at the focus, enabling simultaneous focusing and defocusing of both spatial and temporal dimensions. The resulting STOVs preserve their ring-shaped intensity profile and helical phase singularity over an extended focal region. Besides, the orbital angular momentum vector of generated STOVs can be continuously steered from purely longitudinal to strongly tilted orientations by adjusting the spatial dispersion, objective focal length, or input beam size. Notably, our approach offers full compatibility with high numerical aperture (NA) focusing configurations, thereby supporting applications requiring high intensity and high resolution. We validate these properties through femtosecond laser ablation under high-NA conditions and interferometric spatiotemporal field reconstruction under low-NA conditions. Spatiotemporal optical vortices can distort during propagation. Here, the authors use temporal focusing to synchronize spatial and temporal evolution, enabling distortion resistant high-intensity vortices with tunable orbital angular momentum.

title: De novo design of lipopeptides with antimicrobial potency enabled by a chain-as-prompt deep learning framework
summary_zh: 利用链提示深度学习框架，设计具有抗菌活性的脂肽。结合链自适应迁移学习，实现肽序列与脂质生物活性的桥梁。
summary_en: A chain-as-prompt deep learning framework is used to de novo design lipopeptides with antimicrobial potency. It integrates domain-adaptive transfer learning to bridge the gap between peptide sequence and lipid-induced bioactivity.
insights: 创新点：链提示深度学习框架设计脂肽
方法亮点：结合链自适应迁移学习
关键发现：肽序列与脂质生物活性桥梁
insights_en: Novelty: Chain-as-prompt deep learning framework for lipopeptide design
Method highlight: Integration of domain-adaptive transfer learning
Key finding: Bridge between peptide sequence and lipid-induced bioactivity
