abstract: Antimicrobial lipopeptides (AMLPs) represent a promising solution to global antibiotic crisis, yet their precision design remains challenging due to the inability of current computational models to account for N-terminal fatty acid modification. Here we develop a deep learning-driven AMLP model for de novo design of AMLPs by integrating a chain-as-prompt mechanism with domain-adaptive transfer learning, effectively bridging the representation gap between peptide sequence and lipid-induced bioactivity. Using the AMLP model, 2657 evolutionarily selected RiPP-derived core peptide sequences from 96,911 bacterial genomes are inspiringly designed for virtual lipidation with seven N-terminal fatty acid chains (C6–C18) followed by predictive screening, generating 6197 candidate sequences. Notably, we find that both high KRH rate ( ≥ 0.3) and common fatty acid tails (C12 and C16) are also critical for further selection of candidate AMLPs, resulting in 289 sequences. Then, 46 are randomly synthesized, with 44 showing antimicrobial activities (a positive rate of 95.7%). The lead antibiotic LP630 exhibits broad-spectrum activities against typical Gram-positive, Gram-negative and mycobacterial strains by targeting multiple bacterial cell membrane components, and demonstrates potent therapeutic efficacy in murine wound infection models. Our study provides a streamlined and universal paradigm for deep learning-enabled high-throughput discovery of novel lipopeptide therapeutics. Authors present their chain-as-prompt deep learning framework, which identifies antimicrobial lipopeptides that show efficacy against drug-resistant bacterial pathogens in laboratory and animal model.

title: Molecular architecture of Cryptococcus cell walls reveals species-specific chitosan-dependent remodeling
summary_zh: 分析隐球菌细胞壁结构，揭示种特异性壳聚糖依赖性重塑。固态NMR显示α-(1→3)-葡萄糖聚糖形成细胞壁主要刚性区域。
summary_en: Analysis of Cryptococcus cell wall architecture reveals species-specific chitosan-dependent remodeling. Solid-state NMR shows that aggregated α-(1→3)-glucans form the principal rigid domain of the cell wall.
insights: 创新点：揭示隐球菌细胞壁结构
方法亮点：固态NMR分析
关键发现：α-(1→3)-葡萄糖聚糖形成主要刚性区域
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the Cryptococcus cell wall structure
Method highlight: Solid-state NMR analysis
Key finding: Aggregated α-(1→3)-glucans form the principal rigid domain
abstract: Abstract Cryptococcus neoformans and Cryptococcus gattii are fungal pathogens that cause life-threatening infections, including cryptococcal meningitis. A distinctive feature of the cryptococcal cell wall is the extensive deacetylation of chitin to chitosan, a modification that is essential for virulence but whose structural role in cell-wall organization remains poorly understood. Here, we analyze the cell walls of wild-type strains of both species and their avirulent chitosan-deficient mutants, which serve as vaccine candidates. Loss of chitosan disrupted cell morphology and altered cell-wall ultrastructure, with more pronounced defects in C. neoformans . Solid-state NMR reveals that aggregated α-(1→3)-glucans form the principal rigid domain of the cell wall in both species and are closely associated with chitin microfibrils, whereas surrounding β-glucans and mannoproteins constitute a more dynamic matrix. Chitosan modulates hydration and flexibility, and its loss increases chitin exposure and triggers species-specific remodeling of the polysaccharide network. In C. neoformans , chitosan depletion increased α-(1→3)-glucan content and reduced β-glucan levels, whereas C. gattii selectively lost one α-(1→3)-glucan subtype while maintaining β-glucan levels. Although capsule production remained intact, chitosan deficiency altered glucuronoxylomannan linkage patterns and mannoprotein composition. These findings reveal how chitosan organizes cryptococcal cell-wall architecture and highlight distinct structural adaptation strategies among pathogenic Cryptococcus species.

title: Bacteroides–Escherichia interactions contribute to colonization resistance against Clostridioides difficile
summary_zh: 研究共栖肠道细菌间的相互作用，揭示对艰难梭菌的定植抵抗力。通过模拟社区和粪便菌群，分析代谢途径和抗感染机制。
summary_en: The study uncovers inter-species interactions and metabolic pathways underlying the emergent resilience against C. difficile invasion. It analyzes metabolic pathways and anti-infection mechanisms through synthetic communities and fecal microbiota.
insights: 创新点：揭示共栖细菌间的相互作用
方法亮点：模拟社区和粪便菌群
关键发现：抗艰难梭菌定植抵抗力机制
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing interactions among commensal bacteria
Method highlight: Simulation of synthetic communities and fecal microbiota
Key finding: Mechanisms of colonization resistance against C. difficile
abstract: Abstract Commensal gut bacteria are key contributors to the resilience against pathogen invasion. This is exemplified by the success of faecal microbiota transplantation in treating recurrent Clostridioides difficile infection. Yet, characteristics of communities that can confer colonisation resistance and the underlying mechanisms remain largely unknown. Here we use a synthetic community of 14 commensal gut bacteria to uncover inter-species interactions and metabolic pathways underpinning the emergent resilience against C. difficile invasion. We challenged this synthetic community as well as faecal-matter-derived communities with antibiotic treatment and C. difficile in a continuous flow bioreactor. Using generalised Lotka-Volterra and genome-scale metabolic modelling, we identified interactions between Escherichia coli and Bacteroides/Phocaeicola sp. as key to the pathogen’s suppression. Metabolomics and targeted validation experiments revealed that fructan-derived fructooligosaccharides, vitamin B3 biosynthesis, and competition for Stickland metabolism precursors causally contribute to suppression across multiple C. difficile strains and donor backgrounds. Analysis of metagenomics data from patient cohorts and clinical trials attested the in vivo relevance of the identified metabolic pathways and the ratio between Bacteroides and Escherichia in successful colonisation resistance. The latter was found to be a stronger discriminator than commonly used alpha diversity metrics. Together, our study uncovers emergent microbial interactions in pathogen resistance with implications for rational design of bacteriotherapies.

title: Solvent heterogeneity regulates assembly pathways in supramolecular polymerization
summary_zh: 溶剂异质性影响超分子聚合的组装途径。以两亲性Pd(II)复合物为模型，发现从动力学控制到热力学稳定的转变。
summary_en: Solvent heterogeneity biases assembly pathways in supramolecular polymerization. Using an amphiphilic Pd(II) complex as a model system, a transition from kinetically controlled discrete nanostructures to thermodynamically stable supramolecular polymers is observed.
insights: 创新点：溶剂异质性影响组装途径
方法亮点：两亲性Pd(II)复合物模型
关键发现：动力学到热力学转变
insights_en: Novelty: Solvent heterogeneity affects assembly pathways
Method highlight: Amphiphilic Pd(II) complex model
Key finding: Transition from kinetic to thermodynamic control
abstract: Abstract Supramolecular polymers are fundamental mimics of biological assemblies with diverse functions. However, predicting monomer solubility and controlling the colloidal stability of the resulting assemblies in solution remain major challenges. As a result, their preparation commonly relies on solvent mixtures, which can generate local heterogeneities during sample processing—an effect that remains poorly understood. Here, we demonstrate that solvent heterogeneity biases assembly pathways in supramolecular polymerization, with the extent of this effect modulated by monomer structure. Using an amphiphilic Pd(II) complex as a model system, we uncover a thermally accelerated transition from kinetically controlled discrete nanostructures to thermodynamically stable supramolecular polymers in water/1,4-dioxane mixtures. Combined experimental and theoretical analyses reveal that this transformation is mediated by microscopic liquid–liquid phase separation within the mixed solvent, creating 1,4-dioxane-enriched microdomains with increased local monomer concentration. Thermal annealing enhances molecular mobility and promotes the growth and coalescence of these microdomains, facilitating the transition to one-dimensional fibers. Extending the investigation to structurally related monomers further identifies the metal center and hydrogen-bonding motifs as key design elements governing this behavior. By linking molecular design and solvent heterogeneity to pathway complexity, our findings highlight how mixed solvents can be used to control supramolecular polymerization.

title: Miro1 mediates skeletal muscle insulin resistance in type 2 diabetes
summary_zh: 研究Miro1在2型糖尿病骨骼肌胰岛素抵抗中的作用。发现Miro1在肥胖和2型糖尿病患者骨骼肌中积累，运动训练可缓解。
summary_en: The study examines the role of Miro1 in skeletal muscle insulin resistance in type 2 diabetes. It is found that Miro1 accumulates in the skeletal muscle of patients with obesity and T2D, which can be relieved by exercise training.
insights: 创新点：Miro1在2型糖尿病中的作用
方法亮点：临床研究和小鼠模型
关键发现：运动训练缓解Miro1积累
insights_en: Novelty: The role of Miro1 in type 2 diabetes
Method highlight: Clinical studies and mouse models
Key finding: Exercise training relieves Miro1 accumulation
abstract: Imbalanced skeletal muscle mitochondrial dynamics contribute to the onset and progression of type 2 diabetes (T2D) by mechanisms that remain incompletely understood. Here, we examined the role of Mitochondrial Rho GTPase 1 (Miro1), an outer mitochondrial membrane enzyme, in regulating skeletal muscle insulin action and glucose homeostasis in type 2 diabetes (T2D). In a cross-sectional clinical study, we show that Miro1 accumulates in the skeletal muscle of patients with obesity and T2D, which was further replicated in mouse models of T2D. This accumulation is explained by inadequate insulin-mediated interaction between AKT and Miro1 at the outer mitochondrial membrane. In a randomized controlled trial (NCT02977442), we show that exercise training relieves skeletal muscle Miro1 accumulation while improving insulin sensitivity in patients with T2D. Muscle-specific Miro1 deletion improves oxidative capacity and insulin sensitivity in mice and cells. Taken together, these data support a key regulatory role for skeletal muscle Miro1 in the pathophysiology of T2D. ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT02977442 Insulin resistance in skeletal muscle contributes to type 2 diabetes (T2D), but its causes remain unclear. We identify the mitochondrial protein Miro1 as a key regulator of muscle insulin sensitivity, providing new insights into T2D development.

title: Cadonilimab plus gemcitabine and cisplatin as first-line treatment for unresectable locally advanced or metastatic biliary tract malignancies: the phase II bicureX clinical trial
summary_zh: Cadonilimab联合吉西他滨和顺铂作为不可切除的局部晚期或转移性胆管癌一线治疗。BicureX临床试验显示客观缓解率，疾病控制率和安全性。
summary_en: Cadonilimab combined with gemcitabine and cisplatin as first-line treatment for unresectable locally advanced or metastatic biliary tract malignancies. The BicureX phase II clinical trial shows objective response rate, disease control rate, and safety.
insights: 创新点：Cadonilimab联合治疗胆管癌
方法亮点：BicureX临床试验
关键发现：客观缓解率和安全性
insights_en: Novelty: Cadonilimab combination therapy for biliary tract cancer
Method highlight: BicureX clinical trial
Key finding: Objective response rate and safety
abstract: Immune checkpoint inhibitors plus gemcitabine and cisplatin (GC) are standard first-line treatment for advanced biliary tract cancer (BTC). Here we report BicureX (ChiCTR2300073023), a single-centre, open-label, single-arm phase II trial of cadonilimab, an anti-PD-1/CTLA-4 bispecific antibody, plus GC for unresectable locally advanced or metastatic BTC. Patients received up to eight combination cycles followed by cadonilimab maintenance. The primary endpoint was objective response rate (ORR) per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumours version 1.1 (RECIST v1.1); secondary endpoints included disease control rate (DCR), duration of response (DoR), progression-free survival (PFS), overall survival (OS), and safety. Sixty-one patients were enrolled. At a median follow-up of 23.5 months, ORR was 55.7% (34/61; 95% confidence interval, 42.4–68.5%), meeting the prespecified Simon two-stage efficacy criterion. DCR was 85.2%, median DoR 6.1 months, PFS 8.0 months, and OS 15.6 months. Grade ≥3 adverse events (AEs) occurred in 68.9% and grade ≥3 immune-related adverse events (irAEs) in 18.0%; no death was adjudicated as treatment-related. Proteomics identified a post-hoc exploratory three-protein response-associated signal without significance after false discovery rate correction. These findings support further randomized evaluation. Response rates with approved chemoimmunotherapy regimens remain modest in patients with biliary tract cancer (BTC). Here the authors report the results of a phase II study testing the anti-PD1/CTLA4 bispecific antibody cadonilimab in combination with gemcitabine and cisplatin as first-line treatment for unresectable locally advanced or metastatic BTCs.

title: Near-infrared-responsive thia-hexaphyrin-based covalent organic frameworks for cancer phototherapy
summary_zh: 本文开发近红外响应COFs，通过硫杂六吡啶构建块设计合成，实现808 nm激光照射下ROS和光热效应。
summary_en: This paper develops near-infrared-responsive COFs through the design and synthesis of a thia-hexaphyrin building block, achieving ROS and photothermal effects under 808 nm laser irradiation.
insights: 创新点：近红外响应COFs设计
方法亮点：硫杂六吡啶构建块合成
关键发现：ROS和光热效应
insights_en: Novelty: Design of near-infrared-responsive COFs
Method highlight: Synthesis of thia-hexaphyrin building blocks
Key finding: ROS and photothermal effects
abstract: Abstract Covalent organic frameworks (COF) have emerged as promising phototherapeutic platforms for tumor therapy, where the columnar π-arrayed metal-free photosensitizers serve as both a cooperative light-harvesting antenna and a semiconducting scaffold for efficient charge-carrier separation and transport. However, the phototherapeutic agents based on COFs are usually activated with ultraviolet and visible light, resulting in the limitation of deep-tissue phototherapy. Herein, we develop near-infrared-responsive COFs through elaborate design and synthesis of a thia-hexaphyrin building block, which feature well-aligned conjugation skeletons for the generation of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and photothermal effect upon 808 nm laser irradiation, outperforming conventional porphyrin-based COFs. This porous framework exhibits high phototherapeutic efficacy, leading to the tumor suppression for 4T1 tumors and CT26 tumors in female mouse model by inducing immunogenic cell death through phototherapy and triggering systemic anti-tumor immune responses.

title: Towards scalable DNA data storage with DNA-SaM codec system
summary_zh: 本文提出DNA-SaM系统，高效编码，生化约束检查严格，通过双层索引架构实现大规模数据存储。
summary_en: This paper presents the DNA-SaM system, which integrates highly efficient encoding, stringent biochemical constraint checks, and a storage unit distribution paradigm facilitated by a two-tiered indexing architecture for large-scale data storage.
insights: 创新点：DNA-SaM系统提出
方法亮点：双层索引架构
关键发现：线性编码时间复杂度
insights_en: Novelty: Presentation of the DNA-SaM system
Method highlight: Two-tiered indexing architecture
Key finding: Linear encoding time complexity
abstract: The exponential growth of global data volume is driving an urgent need for novel storage medium. Deoxyribonucleic Acid (DNA), nature’s genetic repository, presents a transformative solution with data storage density and lifespan orders of magnitude higher than conventional media. However, scaling DNA storage has been hindered by the complexity of codec algorithms, the generation of biochemically problematic sequences, and the absence of robust architecture for large-scale data. We present DNA-SaM, a system integrating highly efficient encoding, stringent biochemical constraint checks, and a storage unit distribution paradigm facilitated by a two-tiered indexing architecture. DNA-SaM demonstrates linear encoding time complexity and substantially reduced encoding time compared with representative approaches by in silico analysis. Critically, it proactively excludes sequences such as homopolymer runs, tandem repeats, and potential promoter motifs that could interfere with downstream biochemical processes, showing improved compatibility with in vitro and in vivo applications. It is further validated by practical data storage both in vitro and in vivo with a 100% success rate. On the basis of its encoding scheme and sequence design space, DNA-SaM could theoretically store data exceeding 270 petabytes (PB), marking an advancement in the scalability of DNA-based data storage. Scaling DNA storage is limited by complex codecs, biochemically problematic sequences, and insufficient architecture for large-scale data. Here, the authors present DNA-SaM, integrating efficient encoding, biochemical checks, and a storage unit distribution with a two-tiered indexing architecture.

title: Transforming electrified railway into mechanical energy storage for electricity system decarbonization
summary_zh: 本文将电气化铁路转化为机械储能，分析全球潜力，预测2050年可减少传统储能投资11.9-20.0%。
summary_en: This paper transforms electrified railways into mechanical energy storage for electricity system decarbonization, analyzes global potential, and predicts that by 2050, it can reduce investment in conventional storage by 11.9-20.0%.
insights: 创新点：电气化铁路储能转化
方法亮点：全球潜力分析
关键发现：储能投资减少
insights_en: Novelty: Electrified railway energy storage transformation
Method highlight: Global potential analysis
Key finding: Reduction in energy storage investment
abstract: Abstract Decarbonizing electricity requires vast energy storage capacity worldwide, but constructing dedicated storage assets creates substantial capital, material and embodied carbon burdens. Electrified railways already exchange energy with electricity systems through traction and regenerative braking, but their inherent potential as mechanical energy storage remains unexploited. Here we show that modulation of train operations can transform electrified railways into Electrified Rail-Based Energy Storage. By analyzing 326,034 inter-stop train operations, we estimate its global potential at 190 gigawatts in 2025 and 315–579 gigawatts by 2050. Capacity expansion models for China, Europe and India indicate that it can reduce investment in conventional storage by 11.9–20.0%, corresponding to an extrapolated global value of US$14.9–35.1 billion annually. Without increasing total system cost, electricity systems with this flexible resource could further reduce operational CO 2 emissions by 94.3–258.9 million tonnes per year. Electrified railways can therefore complement conventional storage technologies for electricity system decarbonization.

title: Human targeting of morphologically unique fishes amplifies the risk of functional erosion
summary_zh: 本文发现人类利用形态独特的鱼类，这些鱼类具有独特的特征组合，与受威胁物种相关。
summary_en: This paper finds that humans target morphologically unique fish species, which harbor unique trait combinations predominantly associated with threatened species.
insights: 创新点：形态独特鱼类利用
方法亮点：特征组合分析
关键发现：受威胁物种相关
insights_en: Novelty: Utilization of morphologically unique fish species
Method highlight: Analysis of trait combinations
Key finding: Association with threatened species
abstract: Human societies are drawing on wild species for food, fuel, medicines, and recreation. Yet, it remains unclear whether different types of human use target species with common or unique ecological roles. Here we show that humans use a fourth (26%) of the freshwater fish species and these species occupy almost half (45.2%) of the global spectrum of fish morphological diversity. Yet, used species harbour unique trait combinations, that differ according to the way humans use the species such as fisheries, aquaculture, game fish and aquarium. Moreover, the species targeted by humans are characterised by traits that are predominantly associated with threatened species. By simulating the extinction of threatened species used by humans, we revealed a pronounced and non-random erosion of the morphological spectrum. Understanding the trait-based impacts of human use is thus essential to buffer human impact on natural resources. Conservation should therefore safeguard threatened species but also preserve irreplaceable trait combinations that support unique ecological strategies. A quarter of the world’s freshwater fish species are used for food, recreation, or ornamental purposes. These species harbour unique morphologies, many threatened, whose loss would erode irreplaceable ecological strategies.

title: Nuclear adaptation to intracellular mechanical forces regulates the phagocytic capacity of Drosophila macrophages in vivo
summary_zh: 本文研究巨噬细胞如何通过感受细胞内机械输入来调节其吞噬能力。
summary_en: This paper investigates how macrophages fine-tune their appetite to fulfill their clearance role by sensing intracellular mechanical inputs.
insights: 创新点：巨噬细胞吞噬能力调节
方法亮点：遗传操作和活体成像
关键发现：Lamin B水平增加
insights_en: Novelty: Regulation of macrophage phagocytic capacity
Method highlight: Genetic manipulation and live in vivo imaging
Key finding: Increase in Lamin B levels
abstract: Abstract How macrophages fine-tune their appetite to fulfil their clearance role is incompletely understood. Phagocytosis exacerbates cytoplasmic crowding, but whether macrophages can sense this increase and use it to regulate their phagocytic capacity has never been investigated. Here, we test the hypothesis that phagosomes exert a strain on the nucleus, which in turn responds to the intracellular mechanical inputs influencing macrophage appetite. Combining genetic manipulation and live in vivo imaging, we show that engulfed apoptotic bodies indent and deform the nucleus of Drosophila embryonic macrophages, and that phagocytosis increases Lamin B levels. Importantly, we show that silencing Lamin B or components of the LINC complex negatively regulates apoptotic body engulfment in vivo. Thus, we demonstrate that phagosome-induced nuclear molecular and mechanical adaptations are critical for Drosophila embryonic macrophages to sustain apoptotic corpse uptake, thereby unveiling a role for nuclear plasticity in the regulation of macrophage phagocytic capacity in vivo.

title: Author Correction: Coastal aquifers key contributors to ocean chemistry through solute fluxes
summary_zh: 本文纠正了关于海岸含水层对海洋化学贡献的错误。
summary_en: This paper corrects errors regarding the contribution of coastal aquifers to ocean chemistry.
insights: 创新点：错误纠正
方法亮点：数据修正
关键发现：数据更新
insights_en: Novelty: Error correction
Method highlight: Data correction
Key finding: Data update
abstract: In the version of this article initially published, there was an error in Fig. 1, where in the Ca 2+ row, column 6, the current “+” sign appeared originally as a “–” sign; there was a typographical error in Eq. (5), now reading \({Q}_{{LTC}}=-\frac{\Sigma {F}_{i}\left[{R}_{i}\,-{{R}}_{{sw}}\right]}{{C}_{c}\left[{R}_{{LTC}}-\,{R}_{{sw}}\right]}\) , where “Σ” was missing in the numerator; in the Supplementary Information, there were typographical errors in Eqs. (2), (5). The figure, Eq. (5) and the Supplementary Information are now amended in the HTML and PDF versions of the article.

title: Short-term effectiveness and impact of Vaxchora vaccine during the 2024 cholera outbreak in Mayotte
summary_zh: 本文分析2024年马约特霍乱疫情中Vaxchora疫苗的短期有效性和影响。
summary_en: This paper analyzes the short-term effectiveness and impact of the Vaxchora vaccine during the 2024 cholera outbreak in Mayotte.
insights: 创新点：Vaxchora疫苗效果分析
方法亮点：随机模型开发
关键发现：症状发生率降低
insights_en: Novelty: Analysis of Vaxchora vaccine effectiveness
Method highlight: Development of stochastic models
Key finding: Reduced symptom incidence
abstract: Abstract Global cholera resurgence and vaccine shortage have driven the adoption of reactive one-dose strategies with killed oral cholera vaccines (OCVs). The live-attenuated vaccine CVD 103-HgR (Vaxchora) shows high efficacy in human challenge studies, but its real-world effectiveness in outbreaks is unknown. Here, we analyze the 2024 outbreak in Mayotte, focusing on Koungou village, which had high cholera incidence and vaccine uptake. We develop several stochastic models and calibrate them to daily cases by vaccination status. In total, 3354 individuals (71%) of Koungou’s at-risk population ( n = 4733) received CVD 103-HgR, and 77 cases were confirmed, with symptom onset between 19 April and 7 July 2024. At baseline, we estimate a basic reproduction number $${R}_{0}$$ R 0 of 1.5 (95% credible interval (CrI): 1.2, 1.9) and a CVD 103-HgR effectiveness in preventing cholera of 87% (95% CrI: 74, 99), remaining between 75% and 91% across scenarios. Counterfactual simulations estimate 536 (95% CrI: 240, 824) cases averted at baseline, with a range of point estimates from 152 to 1228 across sensitivity analyses. Rapid single-dose CVD 103-HgR deployment is associated with high effectiveness during a real‑world outbreak, with a substantial but more uncertain population impact, supporting the inclusion of live-attenuated OCVs in reactive strategies when necessary.

title: Projected intensification of soil salinization in global drylands under future aridity increase
summary_zh: 本文预测未来干旱加剧下全球干旱地区土壤盐碱化加剧。
summary_en: This paper projects the intensification of soil salinization in global drylands under future increased aridity.
insights: 创新点：土壤盐碱化加剧预测
方法亮点：机器学习模型应用
关键发现：高风险热点区域
insights_en: Novelty: Prediction of intensified soil salinization
Method highlight: Application of machine learning models
Key finding: High-risk hotspot regions
abstract: Abstract Soil salinization threatens agricultural production, water management, and ecosystem health. Yet, how increasing aridity will reshape 21st-century soil salinity patterns across drylands, particularly in croplands, remains unclear. Here, we compile a relatively comprehensive global soil salinity dataset from the past two decades, projecting future dryland soil salinity dynamics using climate-driven machine learning models with multiple covariates, including dynamic dryland extent and human influences. Our results show an 8% expansion of global drylands saline soils under increasing aridity by 2100 (SSP5-8.5) relative to 2004–2023. Southwestern US, Mexico, southern Europe, central South America, eastern and southern Africa are highest-risk hotspots. We further show dryland croplands face serious salinization, especially irrigated systems, where half of these newly salinized areas project more than 4.9% (maize), 17.2% (dryland rice), 3.3% (sorghum), and 21.2% (wheat) potential production losses. Our findings inform long-term adaptation strategies to mitigate emerging salinization risks and sustain water and food security.

title: Strong field spectroscopy of many-body interactions in solids
summary_zh: 研究固体中多体相互作用的高阶谐波产生。结合实验与理论计算。揭示波长依赖性。
summary_en: Investigates high-order harmonic generation in solids with many-body interactions. Combines experimental and theoretical calculations. Reveals wavelength dependence.
insights: 揭示波长依赖性高阶谐波产生机制
结合实验与理论计算研究多体相互作用
首次从第一性原理推导去相干率
insights_en: Unveils the mechanism of wavelength-dependent high-order harmonic generation
Combines experimental and theoretical calculations to study many-body interactions
Firstly derives dephasing rates from first principles
abstract: High-order harmonic generation (HHG) in solids offers a promising route to compact ultrafast sources of quantum light, but its efficiency and coherence are limited by ultrafast dephasing of laser-driven electron-hole polarization. Although widely described by a phenomenological coherence time, the microscopic origin of this dephasing has remained unresolved. Here, we combine wavelength-dependent HHG measurements in monolayer and bulk semiconductors with ab initio many-body calculations of electron-phonon scattering and strong-field simulations. We show that the measured wavelength scaling of the HHG yield is quantitatively reproduced only when semiconductor Bloch equations incorporate momentum-dependent dephasing derived from first principles scattering rates. The calculations reveal that strong-field-driven carriers rapidly enter regions of the Brillouin zone with enhanced electron-phonon scattering, giving rise to effective few-femtosecond dephasing. Our results establish a microscopic foundation for dephasing in solid-state HHG and provide a framework for engineering coherence in strongly driven solids for quantum photonic applications.

title: Passive abortive infection mechanisms targeting phage long tail fiber proteins
summary_zh: 研究细菌针对噬菌体尾纤维蛋白的防御机制。发现被动阻断感染的新机制。
summary_en: Studies bacterial defense mechanisms against phage long tail fiber proteins. Discovers a novel passive abortive infection mechanism.
insights: 发现被动阻断噬菌体感染的防御机制
揭示蛋白质降解和磷酸化在防御中的作用
提出被动阻断感染的新概念
insights_en: Discovers a defense mechanism for passive blocking of phage infection
Elucidates the role of protein degradation and phosphorylation in defense
Proposes a new concept of passive abortive infection
abstract: Abstract Bacteria employ diverse defense strategies against phage infection, yet mechanisms directly targeting viral proteins remain scarcely documented. In this study, we characterize two bacterial defense systems: TFAD1 featuring a serine protease and TFAD2 featuring a Ser/Thr kinase. We show that TFAD1 and TFAD2 act on phage long tail fiber proteins via protein degradation and phosphorylation, respectively. Intriguingly, both systems allow complete phage replication cycles but generate non-infective progeny—a mechanism distinct from classical abortive infection (Abi), which we term “passive Abi”. Our findings expand the paradigm of bacterial immunity by unveiling protease- and kinase-mediated incapacitation of phage structural proteins, offering insights into the molecular arms race between bacteria and phages.

title: dITP shifts the assembly equilibrium of Kongming to activate NAD+ hydrolysis
summary_zh: 研究dITP激活KomBC复合物水解NAD⁺的机制。揭示动态平衡与dITP结合作用。
summary_en: Studies the mechanism of dITP activating KomBC complex to hydrolyze NAD⁺. Reveals dynamic equilibrium and dITP binding action.
insights: 揭示dITP结合激活KomBC复合物的动态机制
发现KomBC复合物在两种状态间动态平衡
dITP结合稳定紧密组装
insights_en: Unveils the dynamic mechanism of dITP binding to activate KomBC complex
Discovers dynamic equilibrium between two states of KomBC complex
dITP binding stabilizes tight assembly
abstract: Abstract The Kongming (Kom) system, consisting of KomA, KomB, and KomC, protects bacteria from phage infection. KomA collaborates with a phage enzyme to generate deoxyinosine 5′-triphosphate (dITP), which activates the KomBC complex to hydrolyze NAD⁺ and trigger cell death. Recent studies propose that dITP activates KomBC through a simple conformational change. Our findings instead reveal a more dynamic mechanism. Without dITP, KomBC complexes exist in equilibrium between tightly packed oligomers and loosely packed filaments, both inactive. Tight packing accumulates unfavorable electrostatic interactions without positioning catalytic residues for NAD⁺ hydrolysis, whereas loose packing relieves these interactions but leaves catalytic residues misaligned. dITP binding at KomB stabilizes tightly packed KomC cores in the filament while aligning catalytic residues. Therefore, a small-molecule signal activates signaling by shifting the assembly equilibrium of higher-order protein complexes toward a catalytically competent state.

title: Superradiant charge density waves in a driven hybrid cavity-matter system
summary_zh: 提出实现驱动混合腔-物质系统中超辐射电荷密度波的方法。
summary_en: Proposes a method to realize superradiant charge density waves in a driven hybrid cavity-matter system.
insights: 提出实现超辐射电荷密度波的新方法
利用纳米光栅实现光子与电子密度耦合
线性稳定性分析确定阈值
insights_en: Proposes a novel method to realize superradiant charge density waves
Utilizes nanoscale gratings for photon-electron density coupling
Determines threshold through linear stability analysis
abstract: Abstract Optical cavities enable strong, long-range, light-matter interactions that drive collective ordering, such as superradiant self-organization in ultracold atomic gases. Extending these ideas to solid-state electron systems could enable continuous-wave optical control of electronic order, but is impeded by the mismatch between optical wavelengths and electronic length scales. Here, we propose a platform for realizing superradiant charge density waves in doped, driven transition-metal dichalcogenides coupled to an optical cavity. A nanoscale grating generates electric fields at large in-plane optical momenta, allowing cavity photons to couple efficiently to electronic density fluctuations through exciton-polaron processes. Using a linear-stability analysis, we determine the threshold for superradiant ordering and map out the driven phase diagram. We show that matching the grating periodicity to the enhanced electronic density fluctuations—such as those near Wigner crystallization—lowers the required pump intensity. Our results establish a route toward cavity-controlled electronic order in quantum materials.

title: Crystallization-mediated twisting of supramolecular nanoribbons from plant-derived triterpenes
summary_zh: 研究从植物来源的三萜中制备扭曲的超分子纳米带。
summary_en: Studies the preparation of twisted supramolecular nanoribbons from plant-derived triterpenes.
insights: 揭示结晶介导的扭曲纳米带形成机制
通过界面动力学与亲疏水性平衡调控组装
获得具有特定尺寸和间距的纳米带
insights_en: Unveils the mechanism of crystallization-mediated twisting of nanoribbons
Regulates assembly through interfacial dynamics and amphiphilic balance
Obtains nanoribbons with defined dimensions and interlayer spacing
abstract: Controlling crystallization can tailor crystal properties, yet directing the supramolecular organization of small bio-based molecules remains challenging because of their configurational diversity and chemical complexity. Here, we direct the self-assembly of birch-bark-derived betulin (BT), a nonionic triterpene, into twisted supramolecular nanoribbons (BT_S). By interrupting classical nanolayer restacking and coupling interfacial dynamics with amphiphilic balance, surfactant- and salt-mediated antisolvent crystallization perturbs growth symmetry and biases directional molecular packing. The resulting twisted nanoribbons exhibit defined dimensions (width ~200 nm, thickness ~50 nm and ∼3.6 μm pitch) and aligned BT nanolayers with ~1.3 nm interlayer spacing. Polarization-resolved optical coherence tomography reveals depth-resolved mesoscale polarization anisotropy and links ribbon topology to effective refractive index and linear and circular birefringence. Molecular dynamics simulations support cooperative twisting driven by hydrophobic interactions and London dispersion forces. This crystallization-mediated strategy enables multiscale periodicity and tunable optical anisotropy, expanding opportunities for sustainable soft photonic and optoelectronic materials derived from biomolecules. Controlling the crystallization conditions allows to tailor the properties of crystals, but achieving directed supramolecular organization of small bio-based molecules remains challenging. Here the authors demonstrate direct supramolecular twisting and hierarchical organization in a triterpene system by directing the self-assembly of betulin into nanoribbons.

title: Discovery of direct-acting small-molecule RIG-I agonists through creation of a selective CARD activation platform
summary_zh: 发现通过选择性CARD激活平台的小分子RIG-I激动剂。
summary_en: Discovers small-molecule RIG-I agonists through the creation of a selective CARD activation platform.
insights: 发现直接激活RIG-I受体蛋白的小分子激动剂
通过光学方法监测CARD释放
开发高灵敏度高通量筛选方法
insights_en: Discovers small-molecule agonists that directly activate the RIG-I receptor protein
Monitors CARD release through optical methods
Develops a sensitive high-throughput screening assay
abstract: Retinoic acid-inducible gene-I (RIG-I) plays a pivotal role in recognizing and combating RNA viruses in humans, and it has become a drug target of significant interest. RIG-I agonists composed of dsRNA represent antiviral and antitumor therapies, however the development of small-molecule RIG-I agonists, with their potential for improved pharmacokinetics, remains an unmet need. Here, we report small-molecule RIG-I agonists that directly activate the RIG-I receptor protein. These agonists stimulate the first step in RIG-I signaling by triggering release of the signaling domains (CARDs) from an autorepressed form of the protein. This was achieved by developing a sensitive high-throughput screening (HTS) assay that directly monitors CARD expulsion through optical methods. The resulting screen hits were refined and optimized, leading to a specific RIG-I agonist that induces a robust interferon response. This study establishes a pharmacophore and assay for development of small molecules that precisely modulate RIG-I signaling.

title: Author Correction: FcRH5×CD3 bispecific antibody cevostamab in relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma: a phase 1 trial
summary_zh: 原文中图3b的x轴标签错误，已更正为“1q正常”。此更正已应用于HTML和PDF版本。
summary_en: An error in the x-axis label of Extended Data Fig. 3b was corrected from 'No 1q gain or amp' to '1q normal'. This correction has been applied to the HTML and PDF versions of the article.
insights: 创新点：无
方法亮点：无
关键发现：更正了原文中的错误
insights_en: Novelty: None
Method highlight: None
Key finding: Correction of an error in the original article
abstract: In the version of the article initially published, in Extended Data Fig. 3b, the left x -axis label of both panels was “No 1q gain or amp” but should have been “1q normal”. This correction has been made to the HTML and PDF versions of the article.

title: Causality in liquid water as a hallmark of emergent glassy dynamics
summary_zh: 研究通过因果推断方法揭示了水分子间不对称耦合，揭示了水玻璃态动力学特征。实验发现旋转模式对平移动力学有方向性影响。
summary_en: This study uncovers asymmetric couplings between water molecules using causal inference, revealing the hallmark of emergent glassy dynamics in water. Experiments find that rotational modes have a directional influence on translational dynamics.
insights: 创新点：提出因果推断方法研究水动力学
方法亮点：应用因果推断分析水分子耦合
关键发现：发现旋转模式对平移动力学的影响
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing causal inference for studying water dynamics
Method highlight: Applying causal inference to analyze water molecule couplings
Key finding: Discovering the influence of rotational modes on translational dynamics
abstract: In molecular liquids such as water, time-delayed influences between microscopic or mesoscopic variables are typically probed using time-correlation functions, which are symmetric under detailed balance and therefore blind to dynamical asymmetries. Here, we characterize water’s dynamics using a causal inference metric that captures asymmetric couplings between collective variables. Analyzing equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations at ambient conditions and in the high-density liquid (HDL) regime of supercooled water, we uncover pronounced asymmetries in the couplings between orientational and translational degrees of freedom across multiple time and length scales. At room temperature, rotational modes exert a modest directional influence on translational dynamics. In contrast, in the supercooled HDL regime, translational motions emerge as the primary drivers of the dynamics, suggesting facilitation-like relaxation mechanisms characteristic of glassy systems. These results reveal a qualitative reorganization of dynamical couplings across thermodynamic conditions, implying that molecular liquids at thermal equilibrium can exhibit an emergent directionality in their fluctuation couplings. As a consequence, our analysis reveals that external perturbations acting on specific degrees of freedom can induce a stronger arrow of time in the causal relations between translational and orientational modes.

title: Widespread plasma jets in the Martian magnetosheath revealed by dual-spacecraft observations
summary_zh: 通过双星观测发现火星磁鞘中广泛存在等离子体喷流。与地球不同，火星的喷流分布与氢冠扩展有关。
summary_en: Dual-spacecraft observations reveal widespread plasma jets in the Martian magnetosheath, distinct from Earth where jet occurrence is strongly controlled by interplanetary magnetic field orientation.
insights: 创新点：首次发现火星磁鞘中的等离子体喷流
方法亮点：利用双星观测技术
关键发现：喷流分布与火星氢冠扩展有关
insights_en: Novelty: First discovery of plasma jets in the Martian magnetosheath
Method highlight: Utilization of dual-spacecraft observation techniques
Key finding: The distribution of jets is related to the extended hydrogen corona of Mars
abstract: Plasma jets in planetary magnetosheaths are transient, high dynamic pressure structures capable of strongly perturbing downstream magnetospheres and modulating solar wind energy transfer. Although recently identified at Mars, their formation mechanisms and global occurrence remain poorly constrained. Using dual-spacecraft observations from Mars Atmosphere and Volatile EvolutioN and Tianwen-1, we show that magnetosheath jets occur throughout the Martian magnetosheath, in striking contrast to Earth where jet occurrence is strongly controlled by interplanetary magnetic field orientation and largely confined to quasi-parallel shock regions. We propose that this widespread distribution is linked to Mars’ extended hydrogen corona, which generates pickup ions that drive proton-cyclotron waves upstream of the bow shock. Because this mechanism is generic to any body with an extended corona (or exosphere) embedded in a stellar wind, this finding bears on solar–wind interactions at comets and other small bodies, and on the space environments of unmagnetized terrestrial exoplanets. These results indicate that magnetosheath jet formation can be governed not only by external solar wind forcing but also by intrinsic planetary properties, pointing to a previously unrecognized pathway for solar wind–planet coupling at unmagnetized worlds.

title: First-principles channel model and capacity-achieving transmission scheme in thermal noise backscatter links
summary_zh: 研究提出了一种无线信道模型，解释了环境温度下系统如何调制热噪声进行信息传递。实验揭示了热噪声回波机制。
summary_en: This study presents a wireless channel model that explains how systems at ambient temperature can modulate thermal noise to convey information. Experiments reveal a thermal noise backscatter mechanism.
insights: 创新点：提出热噪声回波机制
方法亮点：建立无线信道模型
关键发现：调制热噪声进行信息传递
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing the thermal noise backscatter mechanism
Method highlight: Establishing a wireless channel model
Key finding: Modulating thermal noise for information transmission
abstract: Thermal noise communication systems transmit information by modulating thermal radiation, eliminating the need for a dedicated signal power source and making them attractive solutions for low-power sensor networks. Their efficiency enables long-lived, unobtrusive operation, which is valuable in the Internet of Things, electromagnetic interference-sensitive environments, and radio frequency identification tag systems. However, a limited understanding of the wireless channel model and efficient transmission schemes has hindered their practical deployment. Here, we present a wireless channel model that elucidates how systems operating at ambient temperature can modulate thermal noise to convey information. Our results reveal a thermal noise backscatter mechanism that enables significantly higher data rates than previously achieved. We designed and built a thermal noise communication system leveraging this mechanism to achieve data rates in the kilobits-per-second range—over two orders of magnitude higher than prior demonstrations. We also derive the system capacity and show that using polar codes, we are able to achieve this expected capacity. Our channel model and transmission scheme pave the way for strategies in thermal noise sensing and communication, advancing practical low-power networking for next-generation wireless applications.

title: PSF3 recruits Polθ to stalled replication forks to promote DNA repair
summary_zh: 研究显示PSF3通过招募Polθ到停滞复制叉来促进DNA修复。实验证明PSF3-Polθ相互作用对肿瘤细胞增殖至关重要。
summary_en: This study shows that PSF3 recruits Polθ to stalled replication forks to promote DNA repair. Experiments demonstrate that the PSF3-Polθ interaction is crucial for tumor cell proliferation.
insights: 创新点：揭示PSF3招募Polθ的新机制
方法亮点：研究停滞复制叉的DNA修复
关键发现：PSF3-Polθ对肿瘤细胞增殖的重要性
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing a new mechanism of PSF3 recruiting Polθ
Method highlight: Studying DNA repair at stalled replication forks
Key finding: Importance of PSF3-Polθ interaction for tumor cell proliferation
abstract: DNA polymerase theta (Polθ) plays a pivotal role in the maintenance of stalled replication forks. However, little is known about how Polθ is recruited to the stalled forks. Here we show that PSF3, a member of GINS replicative complex, recruits Polθ to the stalled replication forks. Polθ, which is recruited by interacting with the C-terminal portion of PSF3, restarts the forks, exerts DNA double-strand break end-joining to repair the breaks resulting from collapsed forks in BRCA1/2-deficient and proficient tumor cells, and also fills single-stranded gaps on the replication fork lagging strand in BRCA1/2-deficient tumor cells. Thus, PSF3–Polθ interaction promotes the proliferation of homologous recombination-deficient and proficient tumor cells. Overall, this study highlights an important mechanism of Polθ recruitment to the stalled replication forks to maintain Polθ-dependent fork protection in tumor cells.

title: Conformational flexibility of the nitrogenase-like reductase CfbC/D involved in coenzyme F 430 biosynthesis
summary_zh: 研究揭示了参与辅酶F430生物合成的氮化酶样还原酶CfbC/D的构象灵活性。实验发现CfbC/D具有简化的分子结构。
summary_en: This study reveals the conformational flexibility of the nitrogenase-like reductase CfbC/D involved in coenzyme F430 biosynthesis. Experiments find that CfbC/D has a simplified molecular architecture.
insights: 创新点：揭示CfbC/D的构象灵活性
方法亮点：研究辅酶F430的生物合成
关键发现：CfbC/D具有简化的分子结构
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the conformational flexibility of CfbC/D
Method highlight: Studying the biosynthesis of coenzyme F430
Key finding: Simplified molecular architecture of CfbC/D
abstract: The nitrogenase-like reductase CfbC/D catalyzes the six-electron reduction of the tetrapyrrole macrocycle of Ni 2+ -sirohydrochlorin a,c -diamide during the biosynthesis of coenzyme F 430 , an essential cofactor for biological methane formation and consumption. The individual dimeric protein components, CfbC 2 and CfbD 2 , form a complex to allow for electron transfer from the [4Fe:4S] cluster in CfbC 2 to the [4Fe:4S] cluster in CfbD 2 and onto the substrate. The overall process is ATP-dependent. Although CfbC/D belongs to the family of nitrogenase-like enzymes, there are several intriguing differences between CfbC/D, other nitrogenase-like enzymes and nitrogenase itself. In contrast to the other enzymes, CfbC/D exhibits a simpler molecular architecture, forming a heterotetrameric CfbC 2 D 2 assembly. Furthermore, the interaction of the CfbC and CfbD components does not depend on the presence of adenosine triphosphate (ATP). Here we report cryoelectron microscopy structures of the CfbC/D complex prepared in the absence and presence of substrates. These structures not only shed light on the molecular architecture of the CfbC/D complex but also reveal a high degree of structural flexibility within the CfbD 2 component, which undergoes a large conformational change in the presence of an ATP analog and the tetrapyrrole substrate. The interplay of CfbD with its reductase CfbC also strongly suggests an evolutionary pathway toward the modern nitrogenase from methanogenic archaea.

title: Programmable chemoenzymatic synthesis of a keratan sulfate N -glycan library for glycocode decoding
summary_zh: 研究开发了一种程序化化学酶法合成角蛋白硫酸酯N-聚糖库，用于糖码解码。实验构建了包含多种硫酸化和唾液酸化模式的库。
summary_en: This study develops a programmable chemoenzymatic synthesis of a keratan sulfate N-glycan library for glycocode decoding. Experiments have constructed a library encompassing diverse sulfation and sialylation patterns.
insights: 创新点：开发程序化化学酶法合成聚糖库
方法亮点：构建多种模式的聚糖库
关键发现：用于糖码解码的聚糖库
insights_en: Novelty: Development of programmable chemoenzymatic synthesis of glycan libraries
Method highlight: Construction of glycan libraries with diverse patterns
Key finding: Glycan libraries for glycocode decoding
abstract: Keratan sulfate (KS) is a unique and widely distributed glycosaminoglycans family implicated in diverse biological processes. KS features branched glycan architectures with diverse sialylation and sulfation patterns, encoding a vastly expanded chemical and biological space. The limited accessibility of well-defined structures has hindered precise investigations into the KS biological functions. Here we report a programmable chemoenzymatic platform for assembling a 106-membered library of KS N -glycans and their nonsulfated counterparts, featuring length-variable oligo- N -acetyllactosamine (LacNAc) extensions and encompassing diverse sulfation and sialylation patterns. The synthetic strategy integrates length-controlled iterative glycosylation to assemble versatile precursors, orthogonal deprotection for site-specific sulfation, and modular enzyme-driven diversification. Glycan microarray analysis of this comprehensive library reveals that glycan–protein recognition is governed by the interplay of sulfation and sialylation patterns, oligo-LacNAc chain length, and terminal epitope presentation, providing insight into the functional versatility of KS glycans.

title: Diminishing cooling returns of urban greening amid a warming climate
summary_zh: 评估全球城市绿化降温效果，发现全球北半球城市绿化饱和，南半球城市绿化减少。
summary_en: Assesses global urban greening cooling effects, finding saturation in the Global North and reduction in the Global South.
insights: 全球北半球城市绿化饱和
全球南半球城市绿化减少
气候公平差距明显
insights_en: Saturation of urban greening in the Global North
Reduction of urban greening in the Global South
Profound climate equity gap
abstract: Urban greening is widely prioritized as a nature-based solution to mitigating intensifying heat extremes in the context of climate change, yet its long-term global efficacy remains inadequately quantified. Here we present a two-decade assessment of vegetation dynamics and associated cooling effects across 3,806 urban clusters worldwide, integrating multisource satellite observations with ground measurements from 4,855 meteorological stations. We identify a pronounced climate equity gap: While cities in the Global North have largely expanded green infrastructure, they exhibit cooling saturation with diminishing biophysical returns. Conversely, most cities in the Global South show vegetation stagnation or loss, compounding rapid warming trends. This asymmetry exposes a critical climate justice challenge, indicating that current greening efforts are insufficient to offset a warming trend. Our findings underscore the necessity for context-specific, integrated climate adaptation frameworks that address both the quantity and quality of urban vegetation to achieve equitable thermal resilience in an increasingly warm world.

title: A tunable immune-evasion function of Zika virus NS5 governs viral fitness and pathogenesis
summary_zh: 研究寨卡病毒NS5蛋白的免疫逃逸功能，发现L162位点突变影响病毒复制。
summary_en: Studies the immune-evasion function of Zika virus NS5 protein, finding that mutation at L162 site affects viral replication.
insights: L162位点突变影响病毒复制
NS5蛋白免疫逃逸功能可调节
病毒复制与致病性相关
insights_en: L162 site mutation affects viral replication
NS5 protein immune-evasion function is tunable
Viral replication and pathogenicity are related
abstract: Type I interferon (IFN) signaling is a central antiviral defense, with STAT2 driving the expression of IFN-stimulated genes (ISGs) to restrict viral infection. Zika virus (ZIKV) and dengue virus evade this pathway through nonstructural protein 5 (NS5)-mediated ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation of STAT2, yet the contribution of this immune-evasion strategy to viral fitness and pathogenesis remains incompletely defined. Here, using a multistep mutational scanning strategy that jointly assessed STAT2 degradation and viral RNA replication, we identified a single NS5 residue, L162, as uniquely permissive to substitution that abolishes STAT2 degradation without compromising intrinsic replication functions. Substitution of L162 with alanine or glycine (L162A or L162G) selectively disrupted NS5 recruitment of the ZSWIM8-CUL3 E3 ubiquitin ligase, thereby preserving STAT2 stability and restoring IFN signaling. Recombinant ZIKV carrying these mutations exhibited reduced replication and enhanced ISG induction in human cells, defects fully rescued by STAT2 knockout. In A129 mice (type I IFN receptor deficient), mutant and WT viruses replicated comparably, but in human STAT2 knock-in mice, ZIKV-NS5 L162G exhibited markedly reduced viral loads and disease. In pregnant human STAT2 knock-in mice, the mutant also reduced placental and fetal viral burdens and adverse pregnancy outcomes. Notably, infection with ZIKV-NS5 L162G elicited robust neutralizing antibody and T cell responses that conferred protection against WT challenge. Together, these findings establish NS5-mediated STAT2 degradation as a central determinant of ZIKV immune-evasion, viral fitness, and pathogenesis and highlight disruption of NS5–STAT2 antagonism as a promising strategy for antiviral intervention and rational attenuation.

title: Molecular basis for discrimination of cGAMP linkage isomers by a c-di-GMP-II riboswitch variant
summary_zh: 研究c-di-GMP-II型核糖开关对cGAMP异构体的识别机制，发现结合口袋构象差异。
summary_en: Studies the recognition mechanism of cGAMP isomers by a c-di-GMP-II riboswitch variant, finding differences in binding pocket conformation.
insights: cGAMP异构体识别机制
结合口袋构象差异
核糖开关结构研究
insights_en: Recognition mechanism of cGAMP isomers
Differences in binding pocket conformation
Riboswitch structure study
abstract: Riboswitches are noncoding RNA regulatory motifs predominantly found in bacteria. Signaling molecules such as c-di-GMP, c-di-AMP, and 3′,3′-cGAMP have been reported to be recognized by riboswitches. In contrast, 2′,3′-cGAMP functions as a second messenger in mammalian cells, yet its interaction with RNA molecules remains unclear. Here, we report the crystal structures of a c-di-GMP-II riboswitch variant, c-di-GMP-II-Bh, bound to 2′,3′-cGAMP and 3′,3′-cGAMP. Both complexes adopt a similar overall RNA scaffold with an identical binding pocket composition. However, the ligand bases adopt inverted orientations in the binding pocket, resulting in distinct interaction patterns with residues A64 and G68 and differences in base-pair stacking against the phosphodiester backbone. Structural comparison together with ligand-binding assays of structure-guided mutants using isothermal titration calorimetry reveals the molecular principles by which an RNA riboswitch discriminates among cyclic dinucleotide linkage isomers, highlighting the remarkable sensitivity of RNA binding pockets to subtle ligand structural variations and provides a mechanistic framework for understanding ligand specificity in RNA–small molecule recognition.

title: Magnetically guided programmable thermomechanical protection enabled by biomimetic asymmetric design
summary_zh: 仿生不对称设计实现磁引导可编程热机械保护，提高材料机械可调性。
summary_en: Biomimetic asymmetric design enables magnetically guided programmable thermomechanical protection, enhancing material mechanical tunability.
insights: 仿生不对称设计
磁引导可编程保护
材料机械可调性提升
insights_en: Biomimetic asymmetric design
Magnetic guided programmable protection
Improved material mechanical tunability
abstract: Precision instruments operating in harsh environments require protective materials that can dissipate impact energy while resisting heat. However, actively tunable thermomechanical protection under coupled multiphysics conditions remains challenging. Inspired by shellfish and echinoderms, here we show that an asymmetrically engineered shear-stiffening gel (SSG) yields a Janus magnetorheological elastomer whose two faces mimic the brick-and-mortar architecture of shellfish and the impact-hardening behavior of echinoderms, respectively. Unlike single-modification anti-creep strategies of SSG that degrade shear-stiffening or severely increase initial modulus, our design achieves a 40-fold mechanical tunability, with the storage modulus ranging from 11.29 to 450.28 kPa, arising from the synergistic enhancement of strain-rate-dependent stiffening and magnetic interactions. The integration of magnetic and optical functions enables semiactive noncontact 2D-to-3D protection, achieving an 85% reduction in impact force and a 40 °C temperature difference via bidirectional photothermal regulation, demonstrating competitive thermomechanical protection performance. Furthermore, this strategy establishes a magnetically guided programmable pathway for thermomechanical protection and provides a generalizable blueprint for multifunctional intelligent materials, advancing protective technologies for outdoor equipment operating in extreme environments involving coupled physical fields.

title: Mediator-associated proteins and the small RNA–guided Polycomb repressive complex enhance cryptic transcription for transposon exclusion
summary_zh: 研究小RNA引导的多梳抑制复合体增强隐秘转录，抑制转座子。
summary_en: Studies how small RNA-guided Polycomb repressive complex enhances cryptic transcription to suppress transposons.
insights: 小RNA引导的多梳抑制复合体
隐秘转录增强
转座子抑制机制
insights_en: Small RNA-guided Polycomb repressive complex
Enhanced cryptic transcription
Transposon suppression mechanism
abstract: Suppression of transposable elements (TEs) is critical for maintaining genome integrity. The evolutionary arms race between TEs and their eukaryotic host organisms has driven the development of small RNA–dependent mechanisms that specifically suppress TEs while leaving non-TE regions unperturbed. In the binucleated ciliate Tetrahymena , small RNAs (sRNAs) are generated from both TE and non-TE regions of the germline genome, whereas noncoding RNAs (ncRNAs) from the TE-free somatic genome target and eliminate non-TE sRNAs, thereby selectively preserving TE-specific sRNAs for guiding TE recognition. Since sRNAs are produced from both strands, the counteracting ncRNAs must also occur bidirectionally. However, the mechanism by which the somatic genome generates ncRNAs from both strands remains unresolved. Here, we show that these ncRNAs arise from widespread cryptic transcription initiated outside canonical promoters and dependent on the developmentally specific Mediator complex–associated proteins Dima1 and Emit2. We further demonstrate that sRNA-guided recruitment of the Tetrahymena Polycomb repressive complex 2 and Dima1 occupancy are mutually reinforcing, promoting local accumulation of RNA polymerase II, which may facilitate cryptic transcription from these loci in a histone methyltransferase-independent manner. Disruption of Dima1 abolishes cryptic transcription, leads to aberrant accumulation of non-TE sRNAs, and results in erroneous genome elimination and cell death. These findings reveal a regulatory circuit involving sRNAs, Polycomb, and the Mediator-associated protein Dima1 that promotes cryptic transcription, thereby ensuring accurate TE exclusion and genome integrity.

title: Methanogenic archaea Methanobrevibacter smithii and Methanosphaera stadtmanae promote mucosal homeostasis and protect from colitis
summary_zh: 甲烷古菌促进结肠健康，增强上皮屏障和调节T细胞。
summary_en: Methanogenic archaea Methanobrevibacter smithii and Methanosphaera stadtmanae promote colonic health, enhancing epithelial barrier and regulatory T cells.
insights: 甲烷古菌促进结肠健康
增强上皮屏障
调节T细胞增加
insights_en: Methanogenic archaea promote colonic health
Enhanced epithelial barrier
Increased regulatory T cells
abstract: The intestinal microbiota is a critical determinant of mucosal homeostasis, yet the functional contributions of Archaea—which constitute up to 10% of the anaerobic community—remain largely undefined. Here, we provide evidence that the human methanogens Methanobrevibacter smithii (MSm) and Methanosphaera stadtmanae (MSt) promote colonic health. Transcriptomic analysis of germ-free mice reveals that MSm and MSt induce distinct colonic programs important for epithelial integrity. Using gnotobiotic and antibiotic-treated specific-pathogen-free mouse models, we show that MSm and MSt reinforce the epithelial barrier, characterized by increased goblet cell expansion, mucus thickening, and enhanced epithelial regeneration. Furthermore, methanogens expand Foxp3 + regulatory T cell (T reg ) populations without inducing pro-inflammatory T H 17 responses. Notably, MSm and MSt protect against dextran sodium sulfate-induced colitis. While MSt-mediated protection requires adaptive immunity, MSm retains partial efficacy in lymphocyte-deficient mice, revealing nonredundant protective mechanisms. These findings indicate that methanogenic archaea promote mucosal integrity during host association and suggest that methanogens may hold therapeutic potential for inflammatory bowel disease, though translation to human disease remains to be established.

title: In This Issue
CX3CL1 (fractalkine)–CX3CR1 interface drives CD8⁺ T cell–induced neurodegeneration in human brain organoids
summary_zh: 研究CX3CL1-CX3CR1界面驱动CD8⁺ T细胞诱导神经退行性变。
summary_en: Studies the CX3CL1 (fractalkine)–CX3CR1 interface driving CD8⁺ T cell-induced neurodegeneration in human brain organoids.
insights: CX3CL1-CX3CR1界面
CD8⁺ T细胞诱导神经退行性变
神经炎症与神经退行性疾病
insights_en: CX3CL1-CX3CR1 interface
CD8⁺ T cell-induced neurodegeneration
Neuroinflammation and neurodegenerative diseases
abstract: Immune–neuron interactions play a critical role in neuroinflammatory and neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s disease (AD), but how CD8⁺ T cells contribute to brain pathology remains poorly understood. Amyloid-β (Aβ), a hallmark of AD, is known to trigger neuronal stress and inflammation. Here, we established a human cortical organoid (hCO) model to investigate CD8⁺ T cell responses to Aβ-induced neurodegenerative stress. Aβ exposure increased neuronal expression of CX3CL1 (fractalkine), which engages its receptor CX3CR1 on CD8⁺ T cells. Transwell migration assays showed enhanced recruitment of CX3CR1⁺ CD8⁺ T cells toward Aβ-treated hCOs. In parallel, Aβ upregulated IL-15 expression, a cytokine that supports CD8⁺ T cell activation. The infiltration of CD8⁺ T cells led to neuronal injury, marked by MAP2 loss and cleaved Caspase-3 activation, accompanied by an increase in gene signatures for cell death and inflammation. Exposure to the conditioned medium of activated CX3CR1 high CD8⁺ T cell recapitulated this damage, and the neutralization of CD8 + T cell cytokines and cytotoxic molecules rescued the phenotype. These findings identify the CX3CL1–CX3CR1 axis and CD8⁺ T cell effector programs as drivers of neurotoxicity and establish brain organoids as a platform to study immune-driven neurodegeneration.

title: Disentangling the evolving effects of climate change and technology diffusion on building electricity demand
summary_zh: 研究气候变化和技术扩散对建筑电力需求的演变影响。
summary_en: Studies the evolving effects of climate change and technology diffusion on building electricity demand.
insights: 气候变化影响建筑电力需求
技术扩散作用
电力系统可靠性
insights_en: Climate change impact on building electricity demand
Technology diffusion effect
Power system reliability
abstract: Climate change and technology diffusion will jointly drive future growth in building electricity demand. How this nonadditive response evolves over time with the pace of climate change and technology diffusion has not previously been examined, despite its importance for maintaining reliable power systems. We estimate electricity demand from residential and commercial buildings under climate change and/or technology diffusion across 183 counties in the United States through 2060. Our framework drives 209,352 machine learning models of building electricity demand with 100 spatiotemporally downscaled climate realizations across four climate models and three emissions scenarios, and 18 technology diffusion pathways of air source heat pumps and insulation. We find that the combined response of peak demand to climate change and technology diffusion diverges substantially from the sum of their individual responses, with distinct patterns across hot and cold grid regions. In cold regions, climate change and technology diffusion drive roughly up to 10 times larger peak demand growth than climate change alone by 2060. Conversely, in hot regions, technology diffusion counteracts climate-change-driven peak demand growth. Across regions, climate-change-induced warming reduces or eliminates a shift toward winter peaking driven by technology diffusion. Via uncertainty partitioning, we find climate-related uncertainty dominates near-term peak demand uncertainty, while technology-diffusion-related uncertainty increases to 10 to 80% of uncertainty by 2060. Internal variability accounts for a much larger share of climate-related uncertainty in peak demand than in temperature itself. Our results demonstrate that capturing nonadditive responses between climate change and technology diffusion is important for planning reliable power systems.

title: Transient ATM inhibition enhances knock-in efficiency in hematopoietic stem cells by attenuating the DNA damage response
summary_zh: 研究通过暂时抑制ATM激酶提高造血干细胞基因编辑效率。方法上，利用Cas9/ribonucleoprotein和AAV供体DNA进行基因编辑。结果显示，ATM抑制减少了DNA损伤和细胞凋亡，增强了基因编辑细胞的存活率。
summary_en: This study demonstrates that transient ATM kinase inhibition enhances knock-in efficiency in hematopoietic stem cells. The method involves genome editing with Cas9/RNP and AAV donor DNA. Results show reduced DNA damage and apoptosis, leading to increased survival of edited cells.
insights: 创新点：发现ATM抑制可提高基因编辑效率
方法亮点：采用Cas9/ribonucleoprotein和AAV供体DNA进行基因编辑
关键发现：ATM抑制减少了DNA损伤和细胞凋亡
insights_en: Novelty: ATM inhibition improves gene editing efficiency
Method highlight: Genome editing with Cas9/RNP and AAV donor DNA
Key finding: ATM inhibition reduces DNA damage and apoptosis
abstract: Precise genome editing in hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) holds great potential for treating inherited blood disorders; however, low knock-in (KI) efficiency and loss of functional HSCs after genome editing remain major obstacles. Here, we demonstrate that transient inhibition of Ataxia-Telangiectasia Mutated (ATM) kinase markedly enhanced KI efficiency in mouse HSCs genome-edited with Cas9/ribonucleoprotein (RNP) and AAV donor DNA. Phosphoproteomic and capillary western blot analyses revealed that ATM inhibition suppressed aberrant Cas9-AAV-induced ATM activation and the subsequent DNA damage response, reduced p53-dependent apoptosis, and enhanced survival of KI HSCs. In serial transplantation assays, ATM inhibition preserved long-term engrafting KI HSCs, increasing their frequency from ~0.3 to 40% in secondary recipients, an over 100-fold improvement. Furthermore, in an X-linked severe combined immunodeficient mouse model, ATM inhibition increased KI efficiency and restored T- and B cell differentiation. Comprehensive safety analyses, including long-read nanopore sequencing, amplicon deep sequencing, whole genome sequencing and clonal tracking, did not detect increased genomic alterations, chromosomal abnormalities, or clonal expansion following transient ATM inhibition. Taken together, these findings establish transient ATM inhibition as an effective strategy to enhance KI-mediated genome editing while maintaining the long-term repopulating capacity of HSCs.

title: Evolution of the arbuscular mycorrhizal regulatory network through differential GRAS gene retention and protein interaction in land plants
summary_zh: 研究追踪了陆地植物中GRAS基因家族的进化轨迹，揭示了不同共生宿主间共生网络差异。方法上，通过系统发育分析确定了12个古老的分化谱系，并识别了3个潜在的共生调控GRAS谱系。
summary_en: This study traces the evolutionary trajectory of the GRAS gene family in land plants, revealing differences in symbiotic networks among different symbiotic hosts. The method involves phylogenetic analysis identifying 12 anciently diverged lineages and three potential symbiotic regulatory GRAS lineages.
insights: 创新点：揭示了GRAS基因家族在共生网络中的作用
方法亮点：系统发育分析确定GRAS谱系
关键发现：识别了潜在的共生调控GRAS谱系
insights_en: Novelty: Role of the GRAS gene family in symbiotic networks revealed
Method highlight: Phylogenetic analysis identifies GRAS lineages
Key finding: Potential symbiotic regulatory GRAS lineages identified
abstract: Plants rely on an ancient genetic “toolkit” to establish arbuscular mycorrhizal symbiosis (AMS) with fungal partners. However, the symbiotic outcomes vary among AMS hosts, indicating divergence in downstream transcriptional reprogramming after the perception of symbiotic signals. To uncover the cross-species variation of the AMS regulatory network, we traced the evolutionary trajectory of the GRAS gene family, which encodes the major group of transcription factors in AMS regulation. Phylogenetic analysis of the GRAS family across land plants placed known symbiotic GRAS members within 12 anciently diverged lineages, with multiple lineages showing pronounced gene loss in nonmycorrhizal plants. This pattern pointed to three additional GRAS lineages as candidates for AMS regulation. Given that tomato harbors single-copy, AMS-induced genes in these lineages, we selected it for functional validation. CRISPR-Cas9 mutagenesis, combined with detailed phenotyping of fungal colonization and arbuscule morphology, and transcriptome profiling of mutant roots, confirmed that all three tomato genes are individually required for AMS development, designated Symbiosis-Required GRAS (SRG) 1 to 3. Large-scale phylogenomic analysis and protein interaction assays (by yeast two-hybrid and bimolecular fluorescence complementation) further showed that both the repertoire and interaction networks of symbiotic GRAS members vary among AMS hosts. In summary, together with 12 previously characterized lineages, the three SRGs identified in this study bring the total number of GRAS lineages with known symbiotic members across land plants to fifteen. Furthermore, our findings demonstrate that the symbiotic GRAS network has been dynamically reshaped by gene loss and rewiring of protein interactions during land plant evolution.

title: Mechanism of HIV-1 capsid rupture and uncoating by reverse transcription
summary_zh: 研究通过多尺度计算方法模拟HIV-1逆转录过程中的囊膜破裂。方法上，开发了一种粗粒度动力学蒙特卡洛方法（CG-KMC）。结果显示，CG-KMC能够模拟逆转录过程中的DNA增长。
summary_en: This study simulates HIV-1 capsid rupture and uncoating during reverse transcription using a multiscale computational method. The method involves developing a Coarse-Grained Kinetic Monte Carlo (CG-KMC) method. Results show that CG-KMC can simulate DNA growth during reverse transcription.
insights: 创新点：开发CG-KMC方法模拟逆转录过程
方法亮点：多尺度计算模拟囊膜破裂
关键发现：CG-KMC模拟DNA增长
insights_en: Novelty: Development of CG-KMC method for simulating reverse transcription
Method highlight: Multiscale computational simulation of capsid rupture
Key finding: CG-KMC simulates DNA growth
abstract: One of the key events in the HIV-1 life cycle is reverse transcription (RT), during which single-stranded viral RNA (ssRNA) is converted into double-stranded DNA (dsDNA). This process occurs inside the mature HIV-1 capsid and, once it reaches a critical threshold, drives capsid rupture. This uncoating is essential for infection because it releases viral genetic material into the host cell nucleus. Despite its importance, many mechanistic details of this process remain to be fully understood. To address this gap, we develop a multiscale computational method for simulating RT inside the capsid, termed Coarse-Grained Kinetic Monte Carlo (CG-KMC). CG-KMC stochastically adds deoxynucleotide triphosphates (dNTPs) to the coarse-grained RNA model, enabling stepwise growth of DNA inside the HIV-1 capsid. We implement this method within an integrative coarse-grained framework that combines a “bottom-up” capsid model with a “top-down” representation of the viral RNA/DNA genome. Our simulations phenomenologically capture and predict diverse capsid rupture pathways during RT. The resulting ruptured structures closely match previously identified cryo-ET images. We further perform an extensive analysis of the rupture process, examining its mechanistic and kinetic aspects as well as the role of capsid–DNA interactions. Our findings illuminate how different capsid–DNA conditions give rise to distinct rupture pathways, which differ from ruptures due to simple outward pressure expansion models from within the capsid.

title: The susceptibility to weight gain in male C57BL/6 mice fed high-fat diet is due to a small set of genes predominantly not expressed in the brain
summary_zh: 研究揭示了高脂肪饮食下C57BL/6雄性小鼠体重增加的基因机制。方法上，通过交叉育种和基因型分析确定了与体重增加相关的基因。
summary_en: This study uncovers the genetic mechanism of weight gain in male C57BL/6 mice fed a high-fat diet. The method involves cross-breeding and genotyping to identify genes associated with weight gain.
insights: 创新点：发现特定基因与体重增加相关
方法亮点：交叉育种和基因型分析
关键发现：基因与体重增加相关
insights_en: Novelty: Specific genes associated with weight gain identified
Method highlight: Cross-breeding and genotyping
Key finding: Genes associated with weight gain
abstract: Obesity results from a gene by environment interaction. Understanding the impacts of environmental factors like diet on body weight/fatness has been greatly facilitated by rodent models. We previously identified the responses of males of five mouse strains fed 30 different diets. Two of these strains showed much greater weight gain and two were resistant. Sixty-six marker SNPs in 57 genes were identified, which have a genetic motif across the four strains reflecting their protection or susceptibility to high-fat diet (HFD). We used two of these strains: C57BL/6 and BALB/c, in a classic approach of cross-breeding the strains, to generate a F1 generation, and then cross-breeding their offspring to generate an F2 population. The F2 males were fed HFD and phenotyped for body weight, fat mass, and energy intake and genotyped for the 66 SNPs. Body mass gain on HFD was influenced by 17 SNPs in 11 genes explaining 87% of the individual variation in weight gain. We then measured gene expression of these 11 genes in 16 tissues of male and female C57BL/6 and Balb/c mice when fed high- or low-fat diets, and in 6 tissues of mice exposed to different levels of calorie restriction, to map their expression profiles. The genes were widely expressed in a diversity of tissues including several not normally suspected to be important for fat storage regulation (e.g., testis, lungs, and spleen) with only four expressed predominantly in the hypothalamus. Body fat regulation is probably more complex than current models focused on the brain–adipose axis suppose.

title: PLD1-driven oncogenic secretion creates a therapeutic vulnerability in chromosome 3q–amplified NSCLC
summary_zh: 研究揭示了PLD1驱动的肿瘤分泌在3q扩增的非小细胞肺癌中的治疗脆弱性。方法上，通过基因表达和功能分析确定了PLD1在肿瘤生长和转移中的作用。
summary_en: This study reveals the therapeutic vulnerability in chromosome 3q-amplified NSCLC driven by PLD1 oncogenic secretion. The method involves gene expression and functional analysis to determine the role of PLD1 in tumor growth and metastasis.
insights: 创新点：发现PLD1在肿瘤生长和转移中的作用
方法亮点：基因表达和功能分析
关键发现：PLD1驱动肿瘤分泌
insights_en: Novelty: Role of PLD1 in tumor growth and metastasis identified
Method highlight: Gene expression and functional analysis
Key finding: PLD1 drives tumor secretion
abstract: Chromosome 3q (3q) amplification is a frequent event in non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and other cancer types, yet therapeutic strategies targeting oncogenic drivers within this amplicon have been unsuccessful. Our study revealed that the 3q amplicon encodes multiple Golgi-related proteins, including Phospholipase D1 (PLD1), which catalyzes the production of a potential oncogenic lipid, phosphatidic acid. We found that PLD1 is highly expressed in 3q-amplified NSCLC (3q-NSCLC) and its enzymatic activity is further boosted by coamplified PLD1 activator, ARF-like GTPase 14. High PLD1 activity is essential for 3q-NSCLC growth and metastasis. Mechanistically, PLD1 drives secretion of oncogenic factors via the carriers from the trans Golgi network to the cell surface pathway to support tumor growth. Transferrin receptor 1 (TFRC), which encodes a membrane protein, is coamplified with PLD1 and overexpressed in 3q-NSCLC. A TFRC antibody–drug conjugate (ADC) carrying a PLD1 inhibitor exhibited potential antitumor activity in mouse models. These findings establish PLD1 as a promoter of 3q-NSCLC and provide proof of concept for the development of PLD1-targeted therapies, including ADC-based approaches, for this challenging cancer subtype.

title: Multiple sources contribute to predictive tactile attenuation in the mouse whisker system
summary_zh: 研究探讨了小鼠触须系统中预测性触觉衰减的多个来源。方法上，通过触须-抓取任务和触觉衰减测量，揭示了两种不同的系统。
summary_en: This study investigates multiple sources contributing to predictive tactile attenuation in the mouse whisker system. The method involves an open-loop whisker-reach task and tactile attenuation measurement, revealing two distinct systems.
insights: 创新点：发现触觉衰减的多个来源
方法亮点：触须-抓取任务和触觉衰减测量
关键发现：两种不同的系统
insights_en: Novelty: Multiple sources of tactile attenuation identified
Method highlight: Whisker-reach task and tactile attenuation measurement
Key finding: Two distinct systems
abstract: The brain predicts action outcomes using interacting neuronal systems that integrate sensory feedback, movement, and rewards. In the mouse whisker system, we investigated whether two presumed predictive mechanisms jointly attenuate ascending tactile signals during movement. To this end, we employed an open-loop whisker-reach task that monitored facial nucleus motor activity and presented experimental tactile consequences while measuring tactile attenuation in the barrel cortex. Experimentally manipulating sensory consequences revealed two distinct systems. Sensory gating, a previously documented but functionally unclear mechanism of tactile attenuation, appeared graded but persisted during and after movement. In contrast, a second system was found to be temporally precise, generate suppression when stimuli are omitted, and capable of being learned within hundreds of trials. We label it state estimation as its characteristics—active suppression of expected tactile input—aligns well with the classical reafference principle, previously overlooked in the whisker system.

title: Structure of bovine viral diarrhea virus E2 glycoprotein in complex with CD46 reveals the molecular basis of virus–receptor recognition
summary_zh: 研究揭示了牛病毒性腹泻病毒E2糖蛋白与CD46结合的结构，阐明了病毒-受体识别的分子基础。方法上，通过晶体结构分析确定了E2/CD46界面的相互作用。
summary_en: This study reveals the structure of bovine viral diarrhea virus E2 glycoprotein in complex with CD46, elucidating the molecular basis of virus-receptor recognition. The method involves crystal structure analysis to determine interactions at the E2/CD46 interface.
insights: 创新点：揭示病毒-受体识别的分子基础
方法亮点：晶体结构分析E2/CD46界面
关键发现：E2/CD46界面相互作用
insights_en: Novelty: Molecular basis of virus-receptor recognition revealed
Method highlight: Crystal structure analysis of E2/CD46 interface
Key finding: Interactions at the E2/CD46 interface
abstract: Bovine viral diarrhea virus (BVDV) is a major contagious pathogen of ruminants and imposes substantial economic burdens on the global livestock industry. The viral envelope glycoprotein E2 mediates host cell attachment by recognizing the CD46 receptor; however, the molecular basis of this interaction remains unclear. Here, we report the crystal structure of BVDV-1 E2 in complex with bovine CD46 at 3.1-Å resolution. The structure reveals that the SCR1-2 domains of CD46 engage the DII-DIV domains of E2 in a roughly antiparallel orientation.
