Atomic interactions at the E2/CD46 interface are dominated by van der Waals contacts, accompanied by only a limited number of hydrogen bonds, which explains the observed low-affinity binding between the two molecules. Structural analysis and mutagenesis studies identify key receptor features that govern host susceptibility to the virus and propose an interesting bipartite model: The D′/D interloop within SCR1 of CD46 likely serves as the “molecular determinant,” and key interface residues within SCR2 function as the “affinity regulator.” We further engineered CD46 decoy proteins exhibiting over 1,800-fold higher apparent binding to E2 than the wild-type receptor and demonstrated their potent virus-neutralizing activity. Collectively, these findings elucidate the molecular basis of CD46 recognition by BVDV, provide a structural framework for understanding the viral host range, and establish a receptor-based strategy for potential antiviral intervention.

title: Ecological, physiological, and evolutionary drivers of stoichiometry in insects
summary_zh: 研究评估了生态、生理和进化因素对昆虫化学计量比的影响。方法上，整合了全球昆虫化学计量数据库和系统发育主干。
summary_en: This study evaluates the impact of ecological, physiological, and evolutionary factors on insect stoichiometry. The method involves integrating a global insect stoichiometric database with a comprehensive phylogenetic backbone.
insights: 创新点：评估生态、生理和进化因素对化学计量比的影响
方法亮点：整合全球昆虫化学计量数据库和系统发育主干
关键发现：进化因素对化学计量比的影响
insights_en: Novelty: Impact of ecological, physiological, and evolutionary factors on stoichiometry evaluated
Method highlight: Integration of global insect stoichiometric database and phylogenetic backbone
Key finding: Evolutionary factors' impact on stoichiometry
abstract: The elemental composition of organisms links physiology to biogeochemical cycles, yet the relative contributions of evolutionary divergence, ecology, and allometry to stoichiometric variation remain incompletely resolved. Here, we integrate a global insect stoichiometric database spanning 223 species with a comprehensive phylogenetic backbone to evaluate the relative importance of hypothesized ecophysiological drivers of carbon (C), nitrogen (N), and phosphorus (P) stoichiometry within a multivariate framework. We found a strong phylogenetic signal in stoichiometric ratios and in P and N content, with evolutionary divergence (phylogenetic structure) accounting for approximately half of the explained variation in P-based ratios, exceeding the contribution of any individual ecological predictor. Phylogenetically corrected models recover trophic enrichment across successive trophic levels, consistent with previously documented patterns, and positive scaling between body mass and both C:P and N:P, in line with the general predictions of the Growth Rate Hypothesis. Temperature was the strongest ecological predictor of insect stoichiometry, with positive effects on C:P and N:P ratios and a negative effect on C:N, highlighting the thermal underpinnings of previously observed geographic patterns. Finally, our models recover higher P and lower C in terrestrial insects relative to their aquatic counterparts, contrary to classic expectations that invoke differences in structural constraints and autotrophic composition across habitats. Together, our work shows that variation in insect stoichiometry emerges from the interacting influences of evolutionary divergence and ecological and physiological variation, which can be disentangled through appropriately scaled, phylogenetically informed analyses.

title: Connexins are essential for the contribution of latent progenitors to healing after spinal cord injury
summary_zh: 研究探讨connexin在脊髓损伤修复中的作用。通过基因敲除，发现Cx26对损伤反应至关重要。实验表明Cx26调控神经干细胞反应。
summary_en: This study explores the role of connexins in spinal cord injury repair. Genetic deletion reveals that Cx26 is critical for the response of neural stem cells to injury, indicating its regulation of stem cell response.
insights: 创新点：Cx26在脊髓损伤修复中起关键作用
方法亮点：通过基因敲除研究Cx26功能
关键发现：Cx26调控神经干细胞反应
insights_en: Novelty: Cx26 plays a critical role in spinal cord injury repair
Method highlight: Studying Cx26 function through genetic deletion
Key finding: Cx26 regulates neural stem cell response
abstract: Gap junctions are important regulators of the biology of neural stem cells. Both in vertebrates with regenerative abilities and neonatal rodents, ependymal cells communicate via connexin (Cx) 43 and Cx26. Gap junction coupling and Cx26 are down-regulated as the ependyma becomes quiescent in adulthood, but injury overrules this developmental down-regulation suggesting a role for Cx signaling in the reactivation of ependymal cells. However, direct evidence of the involvement of these Cxs in the reactivation of the ependymal stem cell niche is lacking. Here, we aim to explore the role of Cx26 and Cx43 in the response of ependymal cells to injury by means of specific genetic deletion. We find that Cx26 is critical for the proliferative response of ependymal cells to injury. The reduced response of ependymal cells by Cx26 deletion increased the extension of the lesion because of impaired healing resulting from a weak contribution of the ependymal stem cell niche. On the other hand, Cx43—via gap junction coupling and hemichannels—plays a key role in the communication of Ca 2+ signals between ependymal cells induced by activation of P2X7 receptors. Our data show that Cxs are relevant targets to manipulate the ependymal stem cell niche to achieve better healing after spinal cord injury.

title: Lhx9 specifically modulates phalanx number, whereas Lhx2 constrains digit length in tetrapods
summary_zh: 研究揭示Lhx2和Lhx9在四肢发育中的不同作用。Lhx9减少后肢指骨数量，Lhx2调控软骨细胞和成骨细胞分化。
summary_en: This study reveals the distinct roles of Lhx2 and Lhx9 in tetrapod limb development. Lhx9 reduces the number of phalanges in posterior digits, while Lhx2 regulates chondrocyte and osteoblast differentiation.
insights: 创新点：Lhx9和Lhx2在四肢发育中作用不同
方法亮点：通过基因过表达研究Lhx2和Lhx9功能
关键发现：Lhx2调控软骨细胞和成骨细胞分化
insights_en: Novelty: Lhx9 and Lhx2 have distinct roles in limb development
Method highlight: Studying Lhx2 and Lhx9 functions through gene overexpression
Key finding: Lhx2 regulates chondrocyte and osteoblast differentiation
abstract: Most nonmammalian tetrapods exhibit more than three phalanges in their posterior digits (III–V), whereas mammals are restricted to no more than three. So far, the molecular mechanism underlying this evolutionary reduction and the functions of Lhx2 and Lhx9 in digit development remain unclear. Here we show divergent evolution of Lhx2 and Lhx9 expression patterns in embryonic limbs across tetrapods. We further demonstrate that although ectopic overexpression of each gene in chick embryos delayed limb skeletal development, only Lhx9 reduced the phalanx number in the posterior digits. Transcriptomic analysis showed that Lhx2 regulates pathways for chondrocyte and osteoblast differentiation, and Lhx9 preferentially influences skeletal segmentation via the bone morphogenetic protein (BMP) pathway. The unique function and differential expression of Lhx9 in the limb buds between mammals and nonmammalian tetrapods suggest it may have acquired a role in suppressing phalanx number, driving the evolutionary reduction of phalanx number in mammals.

title: Gut microbiota vesicle reprogramming by Ganoderma lucidum polysaccharide alleviates mycoplasmal pneumonia via the gut–lung axis
summary_zh: 研究显示灵芝多糖重塑肠道菌群，通过肠道-肺轴缓解支原体肺炎。GMEVs移植可提供肺保护，口服GMEVs具生物活性。
summary_en: This study shows that Ganoderma lucidum polysaccharide reshapes the gut microbiota, alleviating mycoplasmal pneumonia via the gut-lung axis. Transplantation of GMEVs provides pulmonary protection, and orally administered GMEVs remain bioactive.
insights: 创新点：灵芝多糖重塑肠道菌群缓解肺炎
方法亮点：通过酶解和NMR分析研究多糖结构
关键发现：GMEVs移植提供肺保护
insights_en: Novelty: Ganoderma lucidum polysaccharide reshapes gut microbiota to alleviate pneumonia
Method highlight: Studying polysaccharide structure through enzymatic fragmentation and NMR analysis
Key finding: GMEV transplantation provides pulmonary protection
abstract: Respiratory infections remain a major global health challenge, further compounded by antibiotic resistance. Among these, mycoplasmal pneumonia represents a particularly prevalent and refractory form. Here, using targeted enzymatic fragmentation combined with multidimensional NMR analysis, we resolved the structure of a homogeneous Ganoderma lucidum polysaccharide, GLFP2, and identified β-(1→6)-linked galactosyl motifs as key structural features. Despite minimal systemic absorption, oral GLFP2 alleviated mycoplasmal pneumonia in mice. Instead, GLFP2 reshaped the gut microbiota and functionally reprogrammed gut microbiota-derived extracellular vesicles (GMEVs), whose transplantation alone was sufficient to confer pulmonary protection. Orally administered GMEVs remained bioactive, showed systemic exposure, associated with the lung, and were preferentially taken up by alveolar macrophages. These vesicles activated AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) signaling, suppressed the S100A8/A9 inflammatory axis, and limited neutrophil-driven immunopathology. Collectively, these findings identify microbiota-derived vesicles as effectors of gut–lung communication and use a defined polysaccharide to uncover a remote protective mechanism against pneumonia.

title: Screw dislocation–mediated galaxy-mimicking superspiral assembly with amplified bio-piezoelectricity
summary_zh: 研究报道通过氨基酸自组装超螺旋结构，增强生物压电响应。螺旋组织可集成和放大电极化，实现高增益方向选择性运动传感。
summary_en: This study reports the self-assembly of galaxy-mimicking superspiral structures by an amino acid, enhancing bio-piezoelectric response. The spiral organization can integrate and amplify electrical polarization, resulting in high-gain direction-selective motion sensing.
insights: 创新点：氨基酸自组装超螺旋结构
方法亮点：通过螺旋位错诱导分级结晶
关键发现：螺旋组织增强生物压电响应
insights_en: Novelty: Self-assembly of amino acid-based superspiral structures
Method highlight: Hierarchical crystallization induced by screw dislocation
Key finding: Spiral organization enhances bio-piezoelectric response
abstract: From the galaxies to the petals, spiral architectures are ubiquitous to confer hierarchical organizations, supporting asymmetric galactic evolutions and biological activities. Herein, inspired from nature, we report the superspiral architectures self-assembled by a minimalist amino acid. These superspirals, with spirality and geometry programmably tuned by enantiomeric excess and organization parameters, are determined to arise from the screw dislocation induced hierarchical crystallization. Notably, the spiral organization can integrate and amplify electrical polarization, yielding 17-fold enhancement in piezoelectric response contrast to random aggregates. This allows engineering of piezoelectric bioelectronics, resulting in high gain direction-selective motion sensing. Our work establishes an alternative paradigm for developing bioinspired hierarchical architectures of oriented and amplified properties, offering a self-assembling route to explore programmably modulated functional architectures for bioelectronic engineering.

title: Meta-analysis of 990 EBV genomes identifies EBER2 SNP7048 and its interaction with HLA-A*11:01 driving nasopharyngeal carcinoma risk
summary_zh: 研究通过元分析识别EBV基因组中的高风险菌株，EBER2 SNP7048与HLA-A*11:01相互作用增加鼻咽癌风险。
summary_en: This study identifies high-risk EBV strains carrying a core variant in the EBER2 locus (SNP7048) that interact with HLA-A*11:01 to increase the risk of nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
insights: 创新点：识别高风险EBV菌株
方法亮点：通过元分析和系统发育分析
关键发现：EBER2 SNP7048与HLA-A*11:01增加鼻咽癌风险
insights_en: Novelty: Identification of high-risk EBV strains
Method highlight: Meta-analysis and phylogenetic analysis
Key finding: EBER2 SNP7048 and HLA-A*11:01 increase the risk of nasopharyngeal carcinoma
abstract: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) is a major health burden in East and Southeast Asia (SEA). While EBV infection is a primary driver, the specific viral strains responsible for NPC development and their interaction with host genetics across geographically diverse endemic regions remain poorly understood. We performed a whole-genome sequencing of 388 EBV isolates and matched host whole-exome sequencing in a Singaporean cohort. To define the global significance of these findings, we conducted a meta-GWAS and phylogenetic analysis across three independent cohorts (Singapore, Hong Kong, and Guangdong and Guangxi provinces of China), totaling 990 EBV genomes. Our study identifies high-risk EBV strains—carrying a core variant in the EBER2 locus (SNP7048)—as the key viral determinator of NPC risk, accounting for approximately 68% of the attributable risk in SEA. Meta-analysis reveals these strains are consistently associated with NPC across all populations, resolving previous regional genetic discordances. We demonstrate a potent synergistic interaction between these EBV risk strains and the host HLA-A*11:01 protective allele; individuals lacking this protection while carrying a high-risk strain exhibit a 30.9-fold increase in NPC risk. Phylogenetic analysis further reveals that these high-risk lineages populated SEA through clonal expansion from Southern China, following historical migration routes. These findings establish that NPC development is driven by the distribution of specific high-risk EBV lineages and their synergistic interaction with host immune susceptibility. This provides a definitive genetic framework for precision population screening and early diagnosis of NPC in the endemic regions.

title: Heterogeneous amyloid β dimerization revealed by single-molecule FRET and MD simulation
summary_zh: 研究通过单分子FRET和MD模拟揭示淀粉样β异构体二聚化。二聚化罕见，但存在多种二聚状态，其稳定性随离子强度和pH变化。
summary_en: This study reveals the heterogeneous dimerization of amyloid β by single-molecule Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET) and molecular dynamics (MD) simulation. Dimerization is rare but exists in multiple states with distinct FRET efficiencies and stabilities, which vary with ionic strength and pH.
insights: 创新点：揭示淀粉样β异构体二聚化
方法亮点：使用单分子FRET和MD模拟
关键发现：二聚化状态多样，稳定性受离子强度和pH影响
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the heterogeneous dimerization of amyloid β
Method highlight: Using single-molecule FRET and MD simulation
Key finding: Diverse dimer states with stability affected by ionic strength and pH
abstract: The correlation between specific amyloid fibril polymorphs and diseases suggests that characterization of heterogeneity in the aggregation process is key to understanding disease mechanisms. In this work, we use single-molecule Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET) spectroscopy and molecular dynamics (MD) simulation to quantitatively characterize dimerization of amyloid β (Aβ), the first step of the aggregation process. We find that dimerization is extremely rare, with a high dissociation constant of >16 mM, yet there are multiple dimer states with distinct FRET efficiencies and stabilities, many of which survive for milliseconds to seconds. The dimer population increases with the increasing ionic strength and decreasing pH, indicating the importance of nonspecific electrostatic interactions in dimer formation. MD simulations with enhanced sampling demonstrate the formation of diverse bound states having a range of FRET efficiencies and flexible N termini, compatible with the experimental observations. There are conformational clusters represented by the formation of three mixed parallel/antiparallel β strands forming Greek key-like motifs and the formation of antiparallel β strands, which may be representative of dimers with longer and shorter lifetimes, respectively, observed in the FRET experiment. This structural and kinetic heterogeneity, resulting from transient interactions, reflects the rugged energy landscape of amyloid formation and may be related to the great diversity of fibrils ultimately formed in the aggregation process.

title: Harnessing autoantibodies to target pathogenic plasma cells
Bridging spatial scales in respiratory viral infection
summary_zh: 研究提出LEAP模型，捕捉呼吸道病毒感染中的局部和长距离传播。模型预测长距离传播需要少量成功事件。
summary_en: This study proposes the LEAP model to capture local and long-range dissemination in respiratory viral infections. The model predicts that productive dissemination requires only a small number of successful long-range seeding events.
insights: 创新点：提出LEAP模型捕捉病毒传播
方法亮点：结合年龄依赖性分支过程
关键发现：长距离传播需要少量成功事件
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing the LEAP model to capture viral dissemination
Method highlight: Combining age-dependent branching processes
Key finding: Long-range dissemination requires a small number of successful events
abstract: Respiratory viruses spread within the host through a combination of local expansion and occasional long-range dissemination that seeds new infection foci. We present LEAP (Lotka-Euler Airway Pathogen model), an analytically tractable within-host model that captures this two-scale process. The model takes the form of an age-dependent branching process and yields a closed-form expression for the exponential growth rate during early infection. Using empirical data to parameterize the model, we find that productive dissemination requires only a small number of successful long-range seeding events per infected cell, with distinct values for SARS-CoV-2 and influenza A virus. LEAP further predicts that, in these well-adapted viruses, interferon-mediated restriction only weakly affects exponential growth, while remaining decisive for poorly adapted pathogens. More broadly, the model provides a flexible framework for experimentally testable predictions of early infection dynamics.

title: De novo design of enantioselective artificial metalloenzyme photocatalysts
Anterior cingulate input tunes striatal dynamics for context-dependent social preference in a mouse model of autism
summary_zh: 前扣带回输入调节纹状体动态，影响自闭症小鼠模型的社会偏好。ACC抑制消除基因型依赖性差异。
summary_en: Anterior cingulate input tunes striatal dynamics for context-dependent social preference in a mouse model of autism. ACC inhibition eliminates genotype-dependent differences.
insights: 前扣带回输入调节纹状体动态
影响自闭症小鼠模型的社会偏好
ACC抑制消除基因型依赖性差异
insights_en: Anterior cingulate input tunes striatal dynamics
Affects social preference in an autism mouse model
ACC inhibition eliminates genotype-dependent differences
abstract: Social preference in autism spectrum disorder varies across contexts, but the underlying neural mechanisms remain unclear. Here we show that Shank3 knockout (KO) mice, an autism mouse model, exhibit reduced preference for social over nonsocial stimuli while retaining a preference for females over males. Calcium imaging reveals context-dependent differences between KO and wild-type (WT) mice in the organization of neuronal population dynamics in the dorsomedial striatum (DMS), corresponding to their behavioural preferences. Functional imaging and molecular analyses reveal reduced functional connectivity between the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) and DMS and molecular alterations more pronounced in the striatal matrix. ACC inhibition eliminates genotype-dependent differences in DMS dynamics. Inhibiting the ACC–DMS pathway impairs social preference, whereas its activation in KO mice shifts DMS dynamics towards WT patterns and improves social preference. These findings identify a cortical pathway that shapes striatal population dynamics and context-dependent social preference in an autism mouse model. The mechanisms underlying social behavioural deficits in mouse models of autism are not fully understood. Here the authors link neural embedding geometry to context-dependent social deficits in the Shank3 knockout mouse.

title: High-risk antimicrobial resistance genomic traits in multidrug-resistant Salmonella across China’s food chain: projections to 2050
summary_zh: 研究中国食物链中多重耐药性沙门氏菌的AMR基因组特征，预测到2050年。社会经济、气候和健康因素影响其传播。
summary_en: Investigates AMR genomic traits in multidrug-resistant Salmonella across China’s food chain, projecting to 2050. Socioeconomic, climate, and health factors influence its spread.
insights: 研究中国食物链中多重耐药性沙门氏菌的AMR基因组特征
社会经济、气候和健康因素影响其传播
预测到2050年的AMR基因组特征流行趋势
insights_en: Investigates AMR genomic traits in multidrug-resistant Salmonella across China’s food chain
Socioeconomic, climate, and health factors influence its spread
Projects AMR genomic trait prevalence trends to 2050
abstract: Abstract Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is rising globally, yet factors shaping its genomic evolution remain poorly understood. We investigated how socioeconomic, climate, and health factors are associated with AMR spread in multi-drug resistant (MDR) Salmonella enterica across China’s food chain, mapped hotspots and forecasted genomic trait prevalence to 2050. We analysed 2,536 MDR genomes from 15 provinces over 16 years, covering patients, food and non-food workers, meat, livestock, and environmental sources. A machine learning framework integrated genomic surveillance with risk assessment to identify high-risk AMR traits (clinically relevant, MDR, mobile). Regression models linked trait prevalence to socioeconomic, climate, health, and antimicrobial consumption data, informing projections to 2050. Eighty-four high-risk traits, including carbapenem, colistin, and β-lactam resistance, are projected to rise, with antibiotic use, population growth, healthcare spending, and urbanisation. Projections were trait-specific: bla CTX-M-64 and bla TEM-1 may increase up to 20%, while bla CTX-M-65 and bla CTX-M-14 remain below 5%. A mechanistic shift in fluoroquinolone resistance is projected: mutation-based resistance ( gyrA 87) declines while plasmid-mediated genes ( qnrB17 , qnrS1 ) rise. Food workers emerged as a potential reservoir, showing higher trait prevalence than food sources, uniquely carrying last-resort antibiotic-resistance genes ( bla TEM-30 , bla NDM-5 , bla CTX-M-64 ). Integrating genomic with socioeconomic surveillance could shift AMR interventions from reactive to preventive.

title: Oncogenic signalling and host immunocompetency govern senescent cell clearance and systemic inflammation in a mouse model of oncogene-induced senescence
summary_zh: 研究通过移植Braf V600E或Braf ΔN表达细胞建立小鼠模型，发现免疫能力影响衰老细胞清除和炎症。
summary_en: This study establishes mouse models with Braf V600E or Braf ΔN expressing cells, revealing that host immunity affects senescent cell clearance and systemic inflammation.
insights: 创新点：发现免疫能力影响衰老细胞清除和炎症。
方法亮点：使用移植细胞建立小鼠模型。
关键发现：Braf V600E诱导更强衰老程序和更严重疾病。
insights_en: Novelty: Host immunity affects senescent cell clearance and inflammation.
Method highlight: Mouse models established by cell transplantation.
Key finding: Braf V600E induces a stronger senescence program and more severe disease.
abstract: Abstract Senescence is a stress-induced program defined by permanent cell-cycle arrest and a pro-inflammatory senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP). Defective clearance of senescent cells promotes inflammation, tissue dysfunction, and ageing, yet determinants of their elimination remain poorly understood. Here, we model oncogene-induced senescence in the hematopoietic system by transplanting Braf V600E - or Braf ΔN -expressing hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells into recipients with distinct immune backgrounds. Braf V600E induces a stronger senescence program and more aggressive disease than Braf ΔN . Survival depends on oncogene-expressing cell burden and host immunity: immunocompetent, lower-burden mice clear oncogene-expressing cells and survive long-term, whereas higher-burden mice show checkpoint upregulation, T-cell exhaustion, and early death. NSG, Rag1KO, and lymphocyte-depleted hosts fail to clear these cells, developing sustained inflammation and bone marrow failure. Rapamycin administration attenuates senescence-associated features and improves survival. These findings identify oncogenic intensity and adaptive immune competence as coupled determinants of senescent-cell fate, with implications for chronic inflammation and senescence-targeted therapies.

title: Peripheral glia drive the initiation of cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma
summary_zh: 研究揭示外周胶质细胞是皮肤鳞状细胞癌的关键驱动因素，通过UV诱导的巨噬细胞激活。
summary_en: This study identifies peripheral glia as a critical driver of cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, activated by UV-induced macrophages.
insights: 创新点：发现外周胶质细胞是皮肤鳞状细胞癌的关键驱动因素。
方法亮点：通过UV诱导的巨噬细胞研究胶质细胞作用。
关键发现：胶质细胞激活由UV诱导的巨噬细胞触发。
insights_en: Novelty: Peripheral glia are identified as a critical driver of cSCC.
Method highlight: The role of glia is studied through UV-induced macrophages.
Key finding: Glia activation is triggered by UV-induced macrophages.
abstract: Abstract Although tumor innervation is known to promote cancer progression, underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood and have mostly been linked to axonal signaling. Here, we identify peripheral glia as critical drivers of cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC), the second most common skin cancer in humans. Tumor-associated glial cells (TAGs) resemble embryonic Schwann cell lineage stages, are abundant in the stroma of premalignant lesions and established murine and human cSCC, and are essential for tumor formation. TAG activation in premalignant lesions is triggered by UV-induced anti-inflammatory macrophages, which in turn are polarized by TAGs into pro-tumorigenic FcεRIα⁺ macrophages, key components of the cSCC microenvironment. Consequently, TAG depletion reduces FcεRIα⁺ macrophages, cancer-associated fibroblasts, and epithelial-mesenchymal transition in keratinocytes, thereby impairing cSCC initiation by disrupting intercellular communication required for tumor development. As most solid tumors are innervated and harbor peripheral glia, our findings reveal TAGs as regulators of tumor initiation with potential relevance beyond skin cancer.

title: Exploring healthy aging through preclinical Alzheimer disease in the Knight Alzheimer Research Imaging dataset
summary_zh: 研究利用Knight Alzheimer Research Imaging数据集，分析从健康老化到阿尔茨海默病的神经影像。
summary_en: This study utilizes the Knight Alzheimer Research Imaging dataset to analyze neuroimaging across the spectrum from healthy aging to Alzheimer's disease.
insights: 创新点：Knight Alzheimer Research Imaging数据集用于研究。
方法亮点：多模态神经影像分析。
关键发现：数据集覆盖从健康老化到症状性疾病。
insights_en: Novelty: The Knight Alzheimer Research Imaging dataset is used for research.
Method highlight: Multimodal neuroimaging analysis.
Key finding: The dataset spans from healthy aging to symptomatic disease.
abstract: Alzheimer disease (AD) remains a significant global public health challenge, requiring robust multimodal datasets to elucidate its prolonged preclinical phase, improve early detection, advance understanding of disease trajectories, and guide intervention strategies. Here we present the Knight Alzheimer Research Imaging (KARI) dataset, established by the Washington University Knight ADRC to address this critical need. We detail comprehensive multimodal neuroimaging from 1,645 participants (aged 42-97) across 6,217 acquisitions. Spanning the AD spectrum from healthy aging to symptomatic disease, the cohort undergoes extensive longitudinal imaging using structural and functional magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) alongside positron emission tomography (PET) tracers for amyloid and tau pathology. This is complemented by rich clinical, cognitive, genetic, and biomarker data. In addition to raw imaging, the dataset provides quality-controlled processed outputs, including anatomical segmentations and biomarker quantification. By making this data accessible to researchers, the Knight ADRC aims to accelerate discoveries in pathophysiology, biomarker identification, and therapeutic development. The KARI dataset maps healthy aging through preclinical Alzheimer disease across >6,000 scans from 1,645 adults. Demonstrating its utility, imaging biomarkers scale with clinical severity, providing a resource to accelerate future Alzheimer research.

title: Concentration‑dependent switching between ligand‑like and solvent‑like lipid regulation in a model ion channel
summary_zh: 研究显示，磷脂酸在不同浓度下调节离子通道活性，表现出配体样和溶剂样特性。
summary_en: This study shows that phosphatidic acid regulates ion channel activity across concentrations, exhibiting both ligand-like and solvent-like characteristics.
insights: 创新点：发现磷脂酸在不同浓度下调节离子通道活性。
方法亮点：使用SthK离子通道模型。
关键发现：磷脂酸表现出配体样和溶剂样特性。
insights_en: Novelty: Phosphatidic acid regulates ion channel activity across concentrations.
Method highlight: SthK ion channel model used.
Key finding: Phosphatidic acid exhibits both ligand-like and solvent-like characteristics.
abstract: Abstract Cell membranes are not only protective barriers but also active chemical environments that regulate protein structure and function. However, how individual lipid species influence membrane proteins across physiological concentration ranges, either as specific ligands or through bilayer-mediated solvent effects, remains poorly defined. Here, using the cyclic nucleotide-gated ion channel SthK reconstituted into defined membranes, we show that phosphatidic acid enhances channel activity across all tested concentrations but, at low mole fractions ( ~ 0.7-1 mol%), it selectively and cooperatively increases agonist potency, meeting criteria for a site‑specific allosteric ligand. In contrast, the zwitterionic lipid phosphatidylethanolamine modulates SthK activity exclusively through linear, solvent‑like effects across the same concentration range. Structural analysis reveals that low anionic lipid content expands the closed‑state conformational ensemble without promoting pore opening, providing a structural basis for lipid-dependent latent allostery. Together, these results establish lipid concentration as a governing regulatory variable that quantitatively distinguishes ligand‑like from solvent‑like mechanisms of membrane protein regulation.

title: The Emirati pangenome featuring a diploid chromosome-level reference
summary_zh: 研究构建了包含二倍体染色体水平组装的阿联酋泛基因组。
summary_en: This study constructs the Emirati pangenome featuring a diploid chromosome-level assembly.
insights: 创新点：构建了包含二倍体染色体水平组装的泛基因组。
方法亮点：使用多平台测序数据。
关键发现：高连续性和良好的基础准确性。
insights_en: Novelty: A pangenome with diploid chromosome-level assembly is constructed.
Method highlight: Multi-platform sequencing data used.
Key finding: High contiguity and good base accuracy achieved.
abstract: Reference genomes are essential for identifying and representing human genomic variation, yet single-genome sequences fail to capture population-specific diversity. We present the Emirati pangenome comprising a trio-based, diploid chromosome-level assembly from deep, multi-platform sequencing data and 57 additional high-quality HiFi sequencing-based chromosome-scale assemblies, 27 of which are trio-based. Haplotypes demonstrate high contiguity (median N50 of 151.9 Mb) and good base accuracy (median QV score of 59.31). Of all assembled chromosomes, 31.8% are telomere-to-telomere (T2T) scaffolds (chromosome-spanning sequences flanked by telomeric repeats at both ends), and 64.3% achieved chromosome-level continuity (single scaffolds spanning an entire chromosome but retaining one or more sequence gaps or lacking a telomeric signature at one or both ends). These assemblies form the foundation of the population-specific pangenome graph of the Emirati Reference Genome Project (ERGP), which captures genomic variation comparable to the globally diverse HPRC reference graph, while covering regionally enriched variation. Applying the ERGP pangenome to short‑read genotyping of an independent Emirati cohort revealed structural variant sites in linkage disequilibrium with phenotype‑associated GWAS variants, demonstrating the value of population-graph-based variant inference. The ERGP reference complements human pangenomes and provides a critical foundation for population-specific genomics and precision medicine in the United Arab Emirates. Here the authors present a chromosome-level Emirati pangenome, capturing population-specific genetic diversity and improving the detection of genomic variants. The resource will support more accurate genetic research and precision medicine in the United Arab Emirates.

title: Fatty acids in the tumor microenvironment reprogram neutrophils to induce adenosine-mediated immunosuppression in mice
summary_zh: 研究揭示肿瘤微环境中的脂肪酸重编程中性粒细胞，诱导免疫抑制。
summary_en: This study reveals that fatty acids in the tumor microenvironment reprogram neutrophils to induce immunosuppression.
insights: 创新点：发现肿瘤微环境中的脂肪酸重编程中性粒细胞。
方法亮点：研究脂肪酸对中性粒细胞的影响。
关键发现：脂肪酸诱导免疫抑制。
insights_en: Novelty: Fatty acids in the tumor microenvironment reprogram neutrophils.
Method highlight: The impact of fatty acids on neutrophils studied.
Key finding: Fatty acids induce immunosuppression.
abstract: As solid tumors progress, the tumor microenvironment becomes increasingly immunosuppressive, impairing cytotoxic T-cell activity and limiting the efficacy of immune checkpoint blockade. However, the mechanistic drivers of this immunosuppression remain poorly understood. Here, we identify a tumor-derived lipid–neutrophil–adenosine axis as a critical regulator of immune suppression in advanced colorectal cancer (CRC). We show that fatty acids enriched in tumor interstitial fluid reprogram neutrophils toward an immunosuppressive phenotype through PPARα activation, upregulation of CD39 and CD73, and adenosine generation, ultimately leading to T-cell suppression. AB928, a dual A2aR/A2bR adenosine receptor antagonist currently in clinical trials, restores T-cell proliferation, effector function, and tumor-killing capacity in vitro and in vivo. Importantly, AB928 synergizes with anti-PD-1 therapy to enhance survival in an immunotherapy-resistant autochthonous model of metastatic CRC. Thus, our findings define a metabolic immune evasion mechanism in the microenvironment and provide a rationale for targeting neutrophil-derived adenosine signaling to improve immunotherapy responses in CRC. Lipid accumulation in solid tumors supports tumor progression by promoting immune evasion. Yet the molecular basis of this lipid-mediated immunosuppression remains unclear. Here, using murine models of advanced colorectal cancer, the authors uncover a metabolic-immune axis whereby tumor-derived fatty acids activate neutrophil PPARα, resulting in adenosine generation and T cell suppression. Importantly, treatment with a dual adenosine receptor antagonist restores T cell-mediated antitumor immunity and synergizes with anti-PD-1 therapy to enhance animal survival.

title: Nutrient stress-driven ACSS1 controls metabolic flexibility and bone formation
summary_zh: 研究确定ACSS1在营养应激下调节代谢灵活性和骨形成中的作用。
summary_en: This study determines the role of ACSS1 in regulating metabolic flexibility and bone formation under nutrient stress.
insights: 创新点：确定ACSS1在营养应激下的作用。
方法亮点：研究ACSS1在骨形成中的作用。
关键发现：ACSS1调节代谢灵活性和骨形成。
insights_en: Novelty: The role of ACSS1 under nutrient stress is determined.
Method highlight: The role of ACSS1 in bone formation is studied.
Key finding: ACSS1 regulates metabolic flexibility and bone formation.
abstract: Metabolic dysregulation under nutrient stress disrupts bone homeostasis. Although acetate metabolism is linked to diabetes and alcoholism, its role in the skeletal complications of these conditions remains unknown. Here we identify acetyl-CoA synthetase 1 (ACSS1) as a key stress responder that mediates mitonuclear communication in bone marrow skeletal stem cells. ACSS1-driven rewiring of acetate metabolism impairs cellular metabolic flexibility, mitochondrial function, and osteogenesis. Mechanistically, nutrient excess from glucose, alcohol or acetate upregulates ACSS1 via a mitochondrial ROS activated integrated stress response-CEBPB pathway. Maladaptive ACSS1 accumulation enforces excessive acetyl-CoA production from either exogenous or glucose/ethanol-derived endogenous acetate, promoting mitochondrial protein hyperacetylation specifically inactivating ME2 via lysine 94 acetylation. This ACSS1-triggered ME2 inactivation disturbs the malate-aspartate shuttle, leading to a self-perpetuating cycle of redox imbalance and oxidative stress that exacerbates mitochondrial dysfunction and osteogenic impairment. Importantly, genetic deletion of Acss1 or AAV-delivered non-acetylatable ME2 mutant in osteoprogenitor cells restores mitochondrial resilience, osteogenic capacity, and bone formation, protecting against osteoporosis or osteonecrosis in male mouse models of type 2 diabetes and chronic alcohol consumption. These results unveil an essential role for ACSS1 in controlling metabolic flexibility and osteogenesis, identifying ACSS1 as a potential therapeutic target for metabolic stress-related bone disorders. ACSS1 mediates maladaptive mitonuclear communication under nutrient stress, impairing metabolic flexibility and osteogenesis. Targeting ACSS1 preserves bone integrity in diabetic and alcoholic mice by sustaining bone formation.

title: Type I IFN promotes ILC2-to-ILC1 plasticity in pre-clinical radiation-induced lung injury
summary_zh: 研究显示I型干扰素促进辐射诱导的肺损伤中ILC2向ILC1的塑性转化。
summary_en: This study shows that type I interferon promotes ILC2-to-ILC1 plasticity in pre-clinical radiation-induced lung injury.
insights: 创新点：发现I型干扰素促进ILC2向ILC1的塑性转化。
方法亮点：使用辐射诱导的肺损伤模型。
关键发现：I型干扰素在ILC2塑性转化中起作用。
insights_en: Novelty: Type I interferon promotes ILC2-to-ILC1 plasticity.
Method highlight: A radiation-induced lung injury model used.
Key finding: Type I interferon plays a role in ILC2 plasticity.
abstract: Radiation-induced lung injury (RILI) is a common dose-limiting toxicity after radiotherapy for lung cancer, but the immunological mechanisms contributing to RILI pathogenesis remain poorly understood. Here we analyze a RILI mouse model using high-dose, restricted-field irradiation to the left lung. Flow cytometry and cytokine profiling analysis of innate lymphoid cells (ILC) reveals a radiation-induced shift from lung-resident type 2 ILCs (ILC2) toward pro-inflammatory type 1 ILCs (ILC1). Single-cell RNA-sequencing analysis of mouse lung ILC populations after radiation suggests that type I interferon (IFN) promotes radiation-induced ILC2-to-ILC1 plasticity. In vitro, IFN-β stimulation of mouse ILC2s leads to increased expression of the ILC1 markers T-bet and IFN-γ, while IFN-β stimulation of human peripheral blood mononuclear cells increases the ILC1-to-ILC2 ratio. In vivo, inhibition of type I IFN signaling attenuates lung damage after irradiation in our RILI model. Thus, our findings indicate that radiation-induced type I IFN induces ILC2-to-ILC1 plasticity to contribute to RILI pathogenesis, and suggest that targeting type I IFN signaling may be a therapeutic strategy to mitigate radiation-induced lung injury. Radiotherapy for lung cancer often induces radiation-induced lung injury (RILI). Here, the authors analyze innate lymphoid cells (ILC) in a RILI mouse model, finding that radiation-induced type I interferon directs ILC2-to-ILC1 plasticity, and inhibition of type I interferon signaling reduces ILC plasticity and RILI.

title: Human hemoglobin protects the parasite cytoskeleton during Plasmodium falciparum gametocyte development
summary_zh: 研究揭示人类血红蛋白保护疟原虫细胞骨架，促进配子体成熟。利用冷冻电镜技术解析了非典型微管网络结构。发现血红蛋白与微管蛋白结合，对配子体发育至关重要。
summary_en: This study reveals that human hemoglobin protects the parasite's cytoskeleton, promoting gametocyte maturation. Cryo-electron microscopy was used to determine the structure of the non-canonical microtubule network. It was found that hemoglobin binds to tubulins, which is crucial for gametocyte development.
insights: 创新点：发现血红蛋白与微管蛋白结合保护疟原虫细胞骨架
方法亮点：利用冷冻电镜技术解析非典型微管网络
关键发现：血红蛋白结合微管蛋白对配子体发育至关重要
insights_en: Novelty: Identified hemoglobin-tubulin binding to protect the parasite's cytoskeleton
Method highlight: Cryo-electron microscopy for determining the non-canonical microtubule network
Key finding: Hemoglobin-tubulin binding is crucial for gametocyte development
abstract: Transmission of Plasmodium falciparum requires the differentiation of asexual parasites into male and female gametocytes, which undergo extensive cytoskeletal remodeling, assembling a non-canonical subpellicular microtubule (SPMT) network. Using single-particle cryo-electron microscopy, we determined structures of SPMTs isolated from developing gametocytes. Unexpectedly, we identified human hemoglobin as a prominent microtubule-associated factor that binds to P. falciparum SPMTs in a dimeric form rather than the canonical tetramer. Pharmacological perturbation of microtubules and hemoglobin isoform switching experiments demonstrate that this hemoglobin-SPMT association is essential for proper SPMT organization and gametocyte maturation. Together, these findings reveal a strategy by which P. falciparum repurposes a host metabolic protein to stabilize its cytoskeleton, highlight the intimate co-evolution between parasite and host, and suggest avenues to block malaria transmission. Wang et al. apply single particle cryo-EM to developing gametocytes of Plasmodium falciparum, and identify human hemoglobin as a prominent factor that binds to P. falciparum subpellicular microtubule (SPMT) network.

title: Molecular characterization of large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of the lung by multilayered omics analysis
summary_zh: 多组学分析揭示大细胞神经内分泌癌的分子特征，发现LCNEC可能存在神经内分泌和非神经内分泌亚型之间的转化。
summary_en: Multilayered omics analysis uncovers the molecular features of large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma, revealing potential transitions between neuroendocrine and non-neuroendocrine subtypes of LCNEC.
insights: 创新点：多组学分析揭示LCNEC的分子特征
方法亮点：多组学分析结合空间组学
关键发现：LCNEC可能存在亚型转化
insights_en: Novelty: Multilayered omics analysis reveals the molecular features of LCNEC
Method highlight: Integration of multi-omics analysis with spatial omics
Key finding: Potential subtype transitions in LCNEC
abstract: Large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (LCNEC) is a rare type of lung cancer with a very poor prognosis, and its underlying molecular features remain elusive. Here, multi-omics analysis of 27 LCNEC cases along with seven small cell lung carcinomas is performed. The genomic and epigenomic alterations as well as the correlation of the genomic mutations with the pathological subtypes are characterized, which are not always consistent. Spatial omics analyses are also conducted, and most of the cases are successfully grouped into a high ASCL1 neuroendocrine (NE) subtype and high ASCL2 or YAP1 non-NE subtypes; however, an ambiguous state is observed for some specimens, which shows the simultaneous expression of NE and non-NE lineage markers. The findings of this study indicate that LCNEC may transit toward the NE or non-NE directions. By controlling the transcriptional regulatory networks of such elasticity, a new approach may be contemplated to overcome the pleiotropic therapeutic responses of LCNEC. Large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (LCNEC) is an aggressive lung cancer whose biological diversity remains poorly understood. Here, the authors combine genomic, epigenomic and spatial transcriptomic analyses to show that LCNEC cells can shift between neuroendocrine and non-neuroendocrine states, identifying intermediate cell states and immune microenvironment features that may influence prognosis and treatment responses.

title: PRMT5 activity sustains histone production to maintain genome integrity
summary_zh: PRMT5活性维持组蛋白合成，保障基因组完整性。研究发现PRMT5抑制或敲低导致组蛋白快速降解。
summary_en: PRMT5 activity maintains histone production to ensure genome integrity. The study finds that PRMT5 inhibition or knockdown leads to rapid histone depletion.
insights: 创新点：PRMT5活性对组蛋白合成至关重要
方法亮点：时间分辨转录组学和定量蛋白质组学
关键发现：PRMT5抑制导致组蛋白降解
insights_en: Novelty: PRMT5 activity is crucial for histone production
Method highlight: Time-resolved nascent transcriptional profiling and quantitative proteomics
Key finding: PRMT5 inhibition leads to histone depletion
abstract: Abstract Histone proteins package DNA into nucleosomes, forming chromatin and thereby safeguarding genome integrity. Proper histone expression is essential for cell proliferation and chromatin organization, yet the upstream regulators of histone supply remain incompletely understood. PRMT5, a protein arginine methyltransferase that catalyzes symmetric dimethylation of arginine residues, is frequently overexpressed in cancer and targeted in multiple clinical trials, but its cell-essential function remains unclear. Using time-resolved nascent transcriptional profiling, quantitative proteomics, and imaging, we show that PRMT5 activity is required to sustain histone transcription and histone protein synthesis during S phase. PRMT5 inhibition or knockdown leads to rapid, p53-independent depletion of histone mRNA, leading to loss of histone proteins and accumulation of replication-associated nuclear abnormalities. Parallel depletion of the histone gene transcription factor HINFP produces similar genomic instability, linking defective histone production to loss of genome integrity. We further show that histone H4 accumulates at both histone genes and histone locus bodies (HLBs) and that H4R3me2s is enriched at HLBs. These findings support a model in which PRMT5-mediated methylation of histone H4 regulates histone transcription. Our findings establish PRMT5 as a central coordinator of histone homeostasis and provide a mechanistic rationale for its essential role in proliferating cells.

title: Spatiotemporal analysis of insecticide-treated bednet coverage, age and type in Africa from 2006-2024
summary_zh: 构建ITN覆盖率模型，分析非洲2006-2024年蚊帐覆盖情况、年龄和类型。
summary_en: A model for ITN coverage is constructed to analyze bednet coverage, age, and type in Africa from 2006 to 2024.
insights: 创新点：构建多类型ITN覆盖率模型
方法亮点：空间分析结合数学模型
关键发现：蚊帐覆盖率随时间变化
insights_en: Novelty: Construction of a Multitype-ITN coverage model
Method highlight: Spatial analysis combined with mathematical modeling
Key finding: Temporal changes in bednet coverage
abstract: Abstract Since their rapid adoption from the mid 2000s, insecticide-treated nets (ITNs) have been one of the most impactful malaria interventions in Africa. Facing insecticide resistance and ever-increasing resource constraints, there is a growing need to revise previous modelling efforts of ITN coverage to better reflect the current epidemiological reality. Comprehensive estimates of ITN coverage must account for factors such as net type, net age, and user behaviours. By leveraging improved data availability, we propose a mathematically rigorous ITN coverage model that extends previous national-level models to the subnational level across 44 countries in Africa. The presented Multitype-ITN (MITN) model is used to construct longitudinal estimates of net demography by age and type from 2006-2024, and provide insights on potential sources of ITN distribution inefficiencies. Our findings show a significant increase in the uptake of next-generation ITNs, reflecting an increasingly diverse market. However, longitudinal trends suggests stagnation in key metrics of net coverage (nets-per-capita, access and use), alongside a downwards trend in utilisation – number of users per net, coupled with observed stationary use rates – proportion of people with access that also use nets. There are also early signs of interventions failing to meet the demands of increasing populations.

title: Author Correction: Released palmitic acid–mediated TLR4/NF-κB activation enhances the virulence of Bordetella pertussis MT28 lineage
summary_zh: 纠正文章中图2a和图6j的数据错误。
summary_en: Corrects data errors in Fig. 2a and Fig. 6j of the published article.
insights: 创新点：纠正数据错误
方法亮点：数据更新
关键发现：无
insights_en: Novelty: Correction of data errors
Method highlight: Data update
Key finding: None
abstract: In the version of this article initially published, in the Fig. 2a Source Data and associated figure plot, a copy-paste error led to duplicated columns of growth-curve data from two experimental batches, while for the Fig. 6j Source Data and associated figure plot, Fig. 3j group labels and two MPO density measurements were inadvertently included. The Source Data and figures are now updated in the HTML and PDF versions of the article. For comparison, the original figures are available as Supplementary Information accompanying this amendment.

title: IRAK4 autophosphorylation functions as a molecular switch to regulate death domain assembly and Myddosome maturation
summary_zh: IRAK4自磷酸化调控死亡域组装和Myddosome成熟，维持信号通路。
summary_en: IRAK4 autophosphorylation regulates death domain assembly and Myddosome maturation, maintaining signaling pathways.
insights: 创新点：IRAK4自磷酸化作为分子开关
方法亮点：研究死亡域组装机制
关键发现：IRAK4磷酸化调控Myddosome成熟
insights_en: Novelty: IRAK4 autophosphorylation as a molecular switch
Method highlight: Study of death domain assembly mechanism
Key finding: IRAK4 phosphorylation regulates Myddosome maturation
abstract: Abstract The organization of signaling proteins into multi-component complexes is essential for innate immune responses and is often achieved through the oligomerization of death domains (DDs). The Myddosome, composed of MyD88 and IRAK family kinases, exemplifies this mechanism. However, how DDs assemble in an ordered and regulated manner to form Myddosomes to control signaling output remains unclear. Here, we show that IRAK4 kinase activity and autophosphorylation are required for IRAK4:IRAK1 heterotypic DD interactions. We show that IRAK1 is autoinhibited by its kinase domain, and IRAK4 phosphorylation relieves this inhibition, enabling IRAK1 DD incorporation into Myddosomes. This phosphorylation-dependent switch similarly controls IRAK2/3 incorporation. Thus, IRAK4 autophosphorylation acts as an energy-dependent molecular switch that integrates phosphorylation with protein oligomerization to drive Myddosome maturation and signal transduction. This mechanism demonstrates how enzymatic activity can impose temporal and spatial control over macromolecular assembly to ensure directional and context-dependent inflammatory signaling.

title: Engineering the paclitaxel biosynthetic pathway in Physcomitrium patens for de novo and stable biosynthesis
summary_zh: 通过工程改造苔藓细胞，实现紫杉醇的从头合成和稳定生产。
summary_en: Engineering the moss Physcomitrium patens for de novo and stable paclitaxel biosynthesis.
insights: 创新点：苔藓细胞作为紫杉醇生物合成平台
方法亮点：多基因共表达系统
关键发现：工程菌株稳定生产紫杉醇
insights_en: Novelty: Moss as a platform for paclitaxel biosynthesis
Method highlight: Multi-gene co-expression systems
Key finding: Engineered strains stably produce paclitaxel
abstract: Abstract Paclitaxel is a highly valuable diterpenoid anticancer drug originally extracted from the yew tree. Due to the low efficiency of plant extraction and the high cost of semi-synthesis, efforts have been made to produce paclitaxel through biosynthesis. However, there have been no reports to date on engineered strains capable of paclitaxel biosynthesis. Here, we engineer a paclitaxel-producing line using the moss ( Physcomitrium patens ) chassis cells by combining transient expression verification, cytoplasmic localization strategies, self-cleaving 2 A peptide-mediated multi-gene co-expression systems and a modular iterative transformation strategy for stable genetic inheritance. Even after continuous subculturing multiple times, the engineered paclitaxel-producing lines obtained through both the initial reconstructed pathway and the optimized pathway are able to stably produce paclitaxel. This study proposes that Physcomitrium patens can serve as a plant chassis for paclitaxel biosynthesis.

title: HRDPath: an explainable multi-model deep learning architecture for predicting homologous recombination deficiency from histopathology images
summary_zh: 本文提出HRDPath，一种基于深度学习的HRD预测模型。模型从病理图像中预测HRD状态，无需额外分子测试。实验表明，HRDPath在多个队列中验证，AUC达到0.846，显著优于现有方法。
summary_en: This paper proposes HRDPath, a deep learning-based model for HRD prediction. The model predicts HRD status from histopathology images without additional molecular testing. Experiments show that HRDPath achieves an AUC of 0.846 across multiple cohorts, significantly outperforming existing methods.
insights: 创新点：HRDPath模型无需额外分子测试即可预测HRD状态。
方法亮点：模型结合多张病理图像和优化策略，提高临床实用性。
关键发现：HRDPath在多个队列中验证，AUC达到0.846。
insights_en: Novelty: HRDPath model predicts HRD status without additional molecular testing.
Method highlight: The model combines multiple slides and optimization strategies to enhance clinical utility.
Key finding: HRDPath achieves an AUC of 0.846 across multiple cohorts.
abstract: Abstract Homologous recombination deficiency (HRD) is a critical biomarker for guiding treatment decisions in high-grade serous tubo-ovarian carcinoma (HGSOC), a cancer with few reliable biomarkers. However, existing genomics-based tests for HRD are variable, expensive, and time-consuming. We develop HRDPath, a patient-level deep learning architecture that predicts HRD status from whole slide images, requiring no additional molecular testing. HRDPath is validated across three cohorts of female patients and achieves an AUC of 0.846, significantly outperforming previously reported results in HGSOC. By incorporating multiple slides per patient and targeted optimization strategies, we strengthen the model clinical utility, with both specificity and sensitivity reaching 0.90. Our interpretability pipeline enhances model trustworthiness and reveals important clinical and biological insights into HRD-positive cancers, highlighting the associated morphological and pathological changes at the cellular and tissue levels. HRDPath provides a foundation for an accessible and scalable digital biomarker to improve treatment stratification in ovarian cancer globally.

title: Tau isoform mapping across tissues and biofluids reveals a signature distinguishing Alzheimer’s disease from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
summary_zh: 本文通过分析血清BD-tau和p-tau217，发现阿尔茨海默病和肌萎缩侧索硬化症中BD-tau和p-tau217升高。BD-Tau IP后，BD-tau和BD-p-tau217仅在阿尔茨海默病中升高，提高了诊断准确性。
summary_en: This paper analyzes serum BD-tau and p-tau217, finding increased levels in Alzheimer's disease and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. After BD-Tau IP, BD-tau and BD-p-tau217 are elevated only in Alzheimer's disease, improving diagnostic accuracy.
insights: 创新点：发现BD-tau和p-tau217在阿尔茨海默病和肌萎缩侧索硬化症中升高。
方法亮点：利用BD-Tau IP提高诊断准确性。
关键发现：BD-tau和BD-p-tau217仅在阿尔茨海默病中升高。
insights_en: Novelty: Finds increased levels of BD-tau and p-tau217 in Alzheimer's disease and ALS.
Method highlight: Improves diagnostic accuracy using BD-Tau IP.
Key finding: BD-tau and BD-p-tau217 are elevated only in Alzheimer's disease.
abstract: Abstract Blood phosphorylated tau 217 (p-tau217) accurately detects Alzheimer’s disease (AD) pathology but is also elevated in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), likely reflecting peripheral (big) tau released from muscle. Assays selectively measuring brain-derived (BD-) tau and BD-p-tau217 are therefore needed. We analysed serum BD-tau and p-tau217 in ALS ( n = 139), AD ( n = 101) and controls ( n = 75) using direct immunoassays and after BD-Tau immunoprecipitation (BD-Tau-IP), and tau species in brain ( n = 16), spinal cord ( n = 11) and muscle ( n = 10) by targeted mass spectrometry. With the direct immunoassays, BD-tau and p-tau217 were increased in AD and ALS versus controls. After BD-Tau-IP, BD-tau and BD-p-tau217 were elevated in AD only, improving diagnostic accuracy. Mass spectrometry revealed a central-to-peripheral shift from BD-tau to big tau predominance, with exclusively big p-tau217 detected in muscle. Selective detection of BD-tau species improves the specificity of blood AD biomarkers by reducing peripheral tau confounding.

title: Intraindividual Comparison of Radiation Dose and Image Quality: Photon-counting versus Energy-integrating Detector CT in Obesity | Tweetorial
No Reflow at Perfusion Imaging: Thresholds That Distinguish Functional and Tissue Outcome Groups in Acute Stroke | Tweetorial
Linguistic intervention unlocks the economic gains of diversity
summary_zh: 研究显示，语言干预可以消除种族差异带来的经济收益损失。通过促进跨种族交流，提高福利和专业化水平。
summary_en: The study shows that linguistic intervention can eliminate economic losses due to racial diversity. By promoting cross-racial exchange, it enhances welfare and specialization levels.
insights: 创新点：语言干预可消除种族差异的经济损失
方法亮点：通过实验研究跨种族交流的影响
关键发现：提高福利和专业化水平
insights_en: Novelty: Linguistic intervention can eliminate economic losses due to racial diversity
Method highlight: Experimental study on the impact of cross-racial exchange
Key finding: Enhanced welfare and specialization levels
abstract: Gains from trade generate prosperity, yet interpersonal exchange can falter along racial lines. We study incentivized experimental economies where participants must spontaneously initiate and sustain trading relationships with others whose race is visible. When the highest gains from trade require cross-race exchange, diverse economies underperform: welfare and specialization suffer as many retreat to autarky. This underperformance reflects not segregation into racial trading blocs, but a collapse in exchange. Opportunities for contact alone do not close the performance gap, which persists and even widens over time. To understand why, we turn to communication itself. Lower welfare is associated with less communication, fewer expressions of affiliation and achievement, and less explicit signaling of needs, deficits, and surpluses. We call this communicative misalignment: differences in shared-language use that raise search, bargaining, and coordination costs. A brief linguistic intervention equips participants with a communicative toolkit. It increases communication volume and the frequency of motivational and state-signaling language. Crucially, when gains depend on cross-race exchange, the intervention restores specialization and cross-race trade, closing the performance gap. Its effects are minimal when efficient trade need not cross race, indicating specificity rather than generic skill training. Language thus operates bidirectionally, both revealing the state of cooperation and causally shaping it. Although we examine racial boundaries, the mechanism may operate along other fault lines where interactional norms diverge, including hierarchy, geography, or culture. Language, a primary conduit of culture, can impede exchange when misaligned and facilitate it when aligned. This suggests a scalable micro-governance tool for reducing transaction costs.

title: Translational control of microglial metabolism, inflammatory responses, and survival by the eIF4E-binding proteins
summary_zh: 研究发现，eIF4E结合蛋白通过调节mTORC1通路影响小胶质细胞代谢、炎症反应和存活。
summary_en: The study finds that eIF4E-binding proteins regulate microglial metabolism, inflammatory responses, and survival through the mTORC1 pathway.
insights: 创新点：揭示了eIF4E结合蛋白在调节小胶质细胞功能中的作用
方法亮点：利用线性回归分析研究CSF 4E-BP1水平与神经退化的关系
关键发现：eIF4E结合蛋白影响小胶质细胞代谢和炎症反应
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed the role of eIF4E-binding proteins in regulating microglial function
Method highlight: Used linear regression analysis to study the relationship between CSF 4E-BP1 levels and neurodegeneration
Key finding: eIF4E-binding proteins affect microglial metabolism and inflammatory responses
abstract: In Alzheimer’s disease (AD), activation of the mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway promotes microglial neuroprotective functions by engaging multiple cell receptors. However, the relevant downstream effectors are not fully understood. mTOR complex 1 (mTORC1) promotes mRNA translation by phosphorylating and inactivating eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4E-binding protein 1 and 2 (4E-BP1/2), which are expressed in microglia. 4E-BP1 levels in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) are elevated in AD and correlate with markers of microglial reactivity and disease progression. Using linear regression analysis, we found that elevated CSF 4E-BP1 levels strengthen the association between soluble TREM2 levels and neurodegeneration in amyloid-positive individuals. To investigate the underlying mechanism, we performed in vitro experiments demonstrating that amyloid-β inactivated 4E-BP1 in murine microglia. The mTOR-mediated inactivation is highly dependent on Spleen Tyrosine Kinase (SYK) signaling and repeated exposure to amyloid-β impaired this process, whereas prolonged exposure increased 4E-BP1 levels in microglia. Deletion of 4E-BP1/2 resulted in increased mitochondrial mass and oxidative phosphorylation, reduced pro-inflammatory signaling, and protected microglia from amyloid-induced apoptosis. Thus, impaired 4E-BP1 inactivation—due to reduced mTOR signaling or excess 4E-BP1—disrupts immune resolution, leading to metabolic exhaustion and microglial cell death. We identify the SYK–mTORC1–4E-BP1 signaling axis as a key regulator of microglial mitochondrial biogenesis and immune resolution in AD.

title: Macromolecular association creates dispersity of components that determines liquid–liquid phase separation of oppositely charged polyions
summary_zh: 研究揭示了多聚电解质混合物中液-液相分离的机制，即大分子相互作用导致组分分散。
summary_en: The study reveals the mechanism of liquid-liquid phase separation in polyelectrolyte mixtures, i.e., macromolecular interactions lead to component dispersion.
insights: 创新点：揭示了多聚电解质混合物中液-液相分离的机制
方法亮点：详细研究了相分离过程
关键发现：大分子相互作用导致组分分散
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed the mechanism of liquid-liquid phase separation in polyelectrolyte mixtures
Method highlight: Detailed study of the phase separation process
Key finding: Macromolecular interactions lead to component dispersion
abstract: Developing insight into liquid–liquid phase separation in complex polyelectrolyte mixtures has acquired new urgency considering the role this process plays in the formation of biomolecular condensates, which are involved in diverse processes including, stress response, signal transduction, metabolism, gene regulation, and many human diseases. Condensates can be viewed as a biological membraneless structure situated, in scale and function, between macromolecules and cells. The physical properties of, and the physico-chemical environments within, condensates are very important determinants of their biological function. These properties and environments are determined by the phase separation process. Earlier experimental work in one of our laboratories characterized in detail a phase separation process in solutions of oppositely charged polypeptides. Considering new information being developed on macromolecular association in homogeneous solutions of oppositely charged polyions, we have revisited our earlier data looking into the influence of intermolecular association on the outcome of the phase transition. Such influence is clearly established in this Brief Report. We demonstrate that dispersity of species in homogeneous solution owing to macromolecular association affects phase separation by creating an open miscibility gap, leading to a dependence of the phase compositions on the initial polymer volume fraction. It is very likely that this plays a significant role in the formation of condensates in the biological context that may have been overlooked.

title: Mass-independent oxygen isotope fractionation driven by energetic-particle irradiation of icy solids
summary_zh: 研究发现，能量粒子照射冰质固体可产生质量无关的氧同位素分馏。
summary_en: The study finds that energetic particle irradiation of icy solids can produce mass-independent oxygen isotope fractionation.
insights: 创新点：揭示了能量粒子照射冰质固体产生质量无关氧同位素分馏的现象
方法亮点：实验室实验研究低温下的同位素分馏
关键发现：能量粒子照射导致同位素分馏
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed the phenomenon of mass-independent oxygen isotope fractionation induced by energetic particle irradiation of icy solids
Method highlight: Laboratory study of isotope fractionation at low temperatures
Key finding: Energetic particle irradiation leads to isotope fractionation
abstract: Mass-independent isotope fractionation (MIF) of oxygen provides key insights into atmospheric chemistry and the origin of isotopic anomalies in planetary materials. To date, MIF has been primarily associated with gas-phase processes involving symmetry-dependent reaction pathways, most notably ozone formation. Whether analogous effects can arise in condensed phases or at interfaces remains an open question. Here we report laboratory experiments demonstrating that energetic particle irradiation of icy oxide surfaces produces mass-independent oxygen isotope fractionation at temperatures as low as 10 K. Electron irradiation of SiO 2 and Al 2 O 3 substrates in the presence of H 2 O ice results in measurable shifts in Δ 17 O in the underlying solids. The resulting three-isotope relationships include slope-1-like behavior in SiO 2 and Al 2 O 3 and distinct, substrate-dependent trends in Al 2 O 3 , indicating that irradiation-induced defect formation and interfacial chemistry govern the isotope effects. The magnitude of the observed anomalies demonstrates that irradiation-driven processes can generate substantial oxygen isotope heterogeneity in condensed phases. These results identify a previously unrecognized class of MIF and provide a quantitative framework for interpreting oxygen isotope signatures in radiation-processed environments, including interstellar grains and early solar system materials.

title: C1ql2 gates stress vulnerability by regulating microglia-mediated synaptic pruning in the BLA-vHPC circuit
summary_zh: 研究发现，C1ql2通过调节BLA-vHPC回路中小胶质细胞介导的突触修剪来调节压力易感性。
summary_en: The study finds that C1ql2 regulates stress vulnerability by modulating microglia-mediated synaptic pruning in the BLA-vHPC circuit.
insights: 创新点：揭示了C1ql2在调节压力易感性中的作用
方法亮点：研究C1ql2在BLA神经元中的表达和调节机制
关键发现：C1ql2调节突触修剪和压力易感性
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed the role of C1ql2 in regulating stress vulnerability
Method highlight: Study of C1ql2 expression and regulatory mechanisms in BLA neurons
Key finding: C1ql2 regulates synaptic pruning and stress vulnerability
abstract: Synaptic remodeling in emotional circuits contributes to the development of stress-related emotional disorders. However, such remodeling generally exhibits considerable heterogeneity across specific neuronal populations and the underlying molecular mechanisms remain poorly understood. Here, we identified C1ql2 as a key molecular regulator that governs projection-specific synaptic vulnerability within basolateral amygdala (BLA). Transcriptional profiling revealed that C1ql2 expression is enriched in BLA neurons projecting to ventral hippocampus (BLA →vHPC PNs), but not in those projecting to nucleus accumbens (NAc), and is significantly down-regulated following chronic social defeat stress (CSDS). Gain- and loss-of-function manipulations demonstrated that C1ql2 regulates stress-induced neuronal remodeling in BLA →vHPC PNs, including dendritic hypertrophy, synaptic outgrowth, and enhanced glutamatergic transmission, thereby shaping susceptibility to anxiety-like behavior. We further found that CSDS-induced C1ql2 loss impairs microglial engulfment of BLA →vHPC PNs synapses, leading to aberrant synaptic accumulation. Our findings establish C1ql2-mediated neuron-microglia cross talk that critically regulates circuit-specific synaptic pathophysiology in stress-related disorders.

title: Structure of a sparsely populated chimeric intermediate that facilitates fold-switching of a metamorphic protein
summary_zh: 研究揭示了具有互补功能的变构蛋白在折叠转换过程中的“隐形”状态结构。
summary_en: The study reveals the atomic-resolution structure of an 'invisible' state of a chimeric intermediate that facilitates fold-switching of a metamorphic protein.
insights: 创新点：揭示了变构蛋白折叠转换过程中的‘隐形’状态结构
方法亮点：利用多种技术可视化变构蛋白结构
关键发现：结构为理解折叠转换提供新视角
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed the structure of an 'invisible' state during fold-switching of a metamorphic protein
Method highlight: Used multiple techniques to visualize the structure of the metamorphic protein
Key finding: Structure provides a new perspective for understanding fold-switching
abstract: Metamorphic proteins challenge the single-sequence-structure-function paradigm by switching between distinct folds that often adopt complementary functions. However, the conformational states sampled along the fold-switching pathway have remained elusive because they are transient and unstable. Using multinuclear chemical exchange saturation transfer and relaxation dispersion NMR, combined with chemical shift–based structure determination and protein engineering, we visualized the atomic resolution structure of an “invisible” state of the metamorphic chemokine lymphotactin. This state is a chimera that integrates the secondary and tertiary structure of one fold with the quaternary assembly of the other. Locking lymphotactin into a single conformation abolishes access to this state, supporting its role as an on-pathway intermediate in metamorphosis. The stabilization of such hybrid intermediates is likely to have facilitated the evolution of fold-switching and represents a powerful strategy for protein design.

title: Signal peptides for engineered protein secretion by free and hydrogel-encapsulated cyanobacteria
summary_zh: 研究确定了信号肽，用于通过自由和凝胶封装的蓝细菌进行工程蛋白分泌。
summary_en: The study identifies signal peptides for engineered protein secretion by free and hydrogel-encapsulated cyanobacteria.
insights: 创新点：确定了蓝细菌中用于蛋白分泌的信号肽
方法亮点：通过基因工程融合异源酶和信号肽
关键发现：提高了蛋白分泌效率
insights_en: Novelty: Identified signal peptides for protein secretion in cyanobacteria
Method highlight: Genetically fused heterologous enzymes with signal peptides
Key finding: Increased protein secretion efficiency
abstract: Cyanobacteria provide a promising platform for light-driven heterologous protein production. In heterologous production systems, cells are typically lysed for product purification or to facilitate interaction with external substrates, unless the product is secreted. Fusion to molecular “shipping labels” known as signal peptides can target chimeric proteins to native membrane translocation pathways and result in secretion. In this work, we identified signal peptides from the model cyanobacterium Synechococcus elongatus PCC 7942 ( S. elongatus ) and genetically fused to two heterologous enzymes: the reporter nanoluciferase (NLuc) and an oxidative laccase (CotA). Increased extracellular activity was observed for one or more signal-protein variants for both enzymes. Furthermore, cells of S. elongatus producing a signal-laccase chimera were encapsulated within an alginate hydrogel, and the resulting engineered living material released sufficient enzyme to decolorize a dye pollutant in its surroundings. These findings streamline recombinant protein production in cyanobacteria and facilitate environmental interactions with cell products, expanding the potential applications of both free-living and material-encapsulated cyanobacteria.

title: Validation of targets linked to weight gain in C57BL/6 mice and translational aspects in humans
summary_zh: 研究识别C57BL/6N小鼠HFD肥胖相关基因。验证基因在组织表达，揭示潜在治疗靶点。
summary_en: Identifies genes associated with obesity in C57BL/6N mice. Validates tissue expression of genes, revealing potential therapeutic targets.
insights: 创新点：发现HFD肥胖相关基因
方法亮点：基因表达组织特异性分析
关键发现：揭示潜在治疗靶点
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of genes associated with HFD obesity
Method highlight: Tissue-specific gene expression analysis
Key finding: Identification of potential therapeutic targets
abstract: Obesity is linked to complex interactions between an organism’s genetic background and its environment. Mouse models have been invaluable research tools to study obesity, with C57BL/6N being widely studied, given its propensity for weight gain on a high-fat diet (HFD). Despite this, the genetic basis of its susceptibility is poorly understood. In a partner paper we have identified SNP variants in 11 genes causing susceptibility to, or protection against, HFD-induced obesity in male C57BL/6N mice explaining 87% of the individual variation in fat gain. Surprisingly, most of them were maximally expressed outside the brain. In this study, we further validate some of these targets. We demonstrate that tissue-specific inhibition of Nova1 and Mchr1 in muscle, Nr1i3 in liver, and Ahr in lung and liver led to resistance to HFD–induced obesity or glucose intolerance. Further RNAseq analysis revealed that mTOR, Acox1, IL-15, and eIF2a signals are positioned downstream of these genes, potentially mediating their effects on obesity susceptibility. Importantly, variants in eight of the genes identified here have been previously implicated in human obesity, suggesting that a deeper understanding of the genetic/environment interactions of model systems can inform this complex human disease. Our work confirms that body fat regulation is likely more complex than current models which focus on the brain–adipose axis suggest.

title: Harry L. Swinney: Nonlinear science and chaos pioneer
summary_zh: Harry Swinney，非线性科学和混沌领域的先驱，享年87岁。
summary_en: Harry L. Swinney, a pioneer in nonlinear science and chaos, passed away at the age of 87.
insights: 创新点：非线性科学和混沌领域的贡献
方法亮点：流体、化学和颗粒系统的实验研究
关键发现：科学和工程学科的广泛影响
insights_en: Novelty: Contributions to nonlinear science and chaos
Method highlight: Experimental studies in fluid, chemical, and granular systems
Key finding: Broad influence on scientific and engineering disciplines
abstract: Harry Leonard Swinney passed away peacefully at his home in Austin, Texas, on July 13, 2026, at the age of 87. Harry was an exceptional experimental physicist, well-known for elegant studies of instabilities, nonlinear dynamics, chaos and pattern formation in a wide variety of fluid, chemical, and granular systems, work whose influence propagated into numerous scientific and engineering disciplines well beyond the particular problems that prompted it. The late Russell Donnelly of the University of Oregon used to say, “Harry is a prince”; Russ meant it, in the spirit of the tenth-century Persian poet Ferdowsi, as a compliment affirming the nobility, dignity, integrity, and grace with which Harry pursued his science and treated everyone he worked alongside.

title: Naturalistic spatial education engages distinct neural processes for mental rotation, cognitive load, and linguistic demands
summary_zh: 研究通过fMRI评估教育空间可视化课程中的神经系统。分析认知负荷和语言密度。
summary_en: Study assesses neural systems in educational spatial visualization lessons using fMRI. Analyzes cognitive load and verbal density.
insights: 创新点：自然空间教育对神经过程的影响
方法亮点：fMRI技术应用于教育研究
关键发现：空间认知的复杂性和动态性
insights_en: Novelty: Impact of natural spatial education on neural processes
Method highlight: Application of fMRI in educational research
Key finding: Complexity and dynamics of spatial cognition
abstract: Neuroscience studies typically isolate spatial cognition using simplified tasks targeting a single cognitive process. However, during formal spatial education, the brain rarely performs one cognitive operation at a time. Here, we used functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) to assess neural systems involved in dynamically processing an educational spatial visualization lesson. We quantified lesson content using an instructional-design framework capturing variation in spatial complexity, cognitive load, and verbal density. We then characterized how instructional demands modulated brain function using content-evoked responses, functional connectivity, and network-centrality. Spatial transformations during instruction robustly recruited parietal and premotor regions, which were linearly modulated by spatial complexity. This parietal dominance aligns with theories that these areas encode geometric and quantitative dimensions. In contrast, domain-general frontal activity tracked overall processing demands, and language regions tracked verbal density. Activity also varied with learners’ spatial abilities: higher spatial performers showed stronger modulation of parietal and premotor regions as spatial demands increased, and greater domain-general modulation across content types. Thus, the same circuitry representing spatial transformations during instruction also reflects individual variation in spatial cognition. Parietal regions showed the highest centrality and strongest within-network coherence, marking them as the central hub of the system, and distinguishing them from less central and less coherent domain-general regions. Together, the findings reveal how the brain dynamically decomposes complex spatial instruction, preserving parietal-centered spatial processing, while coordinating support from premotor, domain-general, and language systems. These findings begin to reveal how spatial cognition operates within the complexity of formal instruction.

title: Correction for Liu et al., A spinoreticular pathway mediates nocifensive responses to noxious mechanical stimuli
In-cloud motions shape warm-rain production in marine clouds: Evidence from multiyear observations
summary_zh: 多年观测揭示海洋云中云内运动对暖雨形成的影响。
summary_en: Multiyear observations reveal the impact of in-cloud motions on warm-rain production in marine clouds.
insights: 创新点：云内运动对暖雨形成的影响
方法亮点：多年海洋区域观测数据
关键发现：云层性质对暖雨的影响
insights_en: Novelty: Impact of in-cloud motions on warm-rain formation
Method highlight: Multiyear observations across oceanic regions
Key finding: Influence of cloud regime properties on warm precipitation
abstract: Despite years of research, the processes controlling warm-rain formation remain uncertain. Leveraging multiple years of observations collected across four oceanic regions, we systematically reassess the properties of precipitation just beneath cloud base. The observations show that warm-rain characteristics are remarkably consistent within cloud regimes yet differ substantially between stratocumulus and cumulus, indicating that cloud-regime properties exert a stronger influence on warm precipitation than regional environmental variability. Precipitation is observed beneath marine stratocumulus in over 56% of cloudy columns with liquid water path (LWP) <130 g m −2 , rising to more than 84% in columns with LWP beyond 130 g m −2 . This indicates that marine stratocumulus routinely support warm-rain formation and suggests that barriers to precipitation onset in this regime are weaker than commonly assumed. For the same LWP, oceanic cumulus precipitate less frequently than stratocumulus but on average produce two times larger and one to two orders of magnitude fewer precipitation drops. This contrast is consistent with cumulus presenting two times stronger updrafts and lower adiabaticity than stratocumulus, both of which can affect drop growth histories. Whereas the precipitation characteristics of stratocumulus are generally consistent with growth by collision–coalescence during gravitational free fall in low LWP clouds, those of cumulus cannot be explained without invoking additional processes. Together, these findings suggest that warm-precipitation parameterizations should more explicitly account for the influence of small-scale dynamical processes on precipitation growth. The apparent importance of drop growth histories further motivates continued exploration of Lagrangian particle-tracking approaches in both models and observations.

title: Molecular fossils of an ancestral code revealed by large-scale analysis of tRNAs
summary_zh: 大规模tRNA分析揭示祖先遗传代码的分子遗迹。
summary_en: Large-scale analysis of tRNAs reveals molecular fossils of an ancestral genetic code.
insights: 创新点：tRNA分析揭示祖先遗传代码
方法亮点：结构感知统计框架
关键发现：非密码子区域的同源三联体富集
insights_en: Novelty: tRNA analysis reveals ancestral genetic code
Method highlight: Structure-aware statistical framework
Key finding: Enrichment of cognate anticodon-like triplets in non-anticodon regions
abstract: Modern tRNAs are thought to have evolved from simpler RNA minihelices resembling acceptor stems, some of which could be specifically aminoacylated. A central and testable prediction of minihelix-based models is that vestiges of ancestral coding relationships should remain embedded within the acceptor stems of contemporary tRNAs and should persist after correction for structural constraints.
