Here, we ask whether cognate anticodon-like triplets are statistically enriched in nonanticodon regions of modern tRNAs beyond what would be expected from structural and compositional constraints alone. Using a curated dataset of 77,335 canonical tRNA sequences and a structure-aware statistical framework, we find that for a subset of amino acids cognate anticodon-like triplets are significantly enriched in acceptor stems and, to a lesser extent, in other structural domains. Notably, these amino acids include those previously shown to support specific minihelix aminoacylation [Y. M. Hou, P. Schimmel, Nature 333 , 140–145 (1988); C. Francklyn, P. Schimmel, Nature 337 , 478–481 (1989)]. The strongest acceptor-stem signals survive structure-preserving null models, and cluster nonrandomly against proposed chronologies of amino acid incorporation into the genetic code. Together, these findings identify molecular fossils within modern tRNAs consistent with the persistence of an ancestral operational code, and provide refined statistical support for the notion that extant codon–amino acid relationships evolved from early aminoacylation systems involving RNA minihelices.

title: Multi-omics and spatial analysis of microgravity-grown glioblastoma organoids reveal superior modeling of advanced disease after long-term spaceflight
summary_zh: 微重力培养的胶质母细胞瘤类器官揭示长期太空飞行后疾病模型的优势。
summary_en: Microgravity-grown glioblastoma organoids reveal superior modeling of advanced disease after long-term spaceflight.
insights: 创新点：微重力培养类器官模拟太空疾病
方法亮点：多组学和空间分析
关键发现：太空飞行对疾病模型的影响
insights_en: Novelty: Microgravity culture of organoids simulates spaceflight disease
Method highlight: Multi-omics and spatial analysis
Key finding: Impact of spaceflight on disease modeling
abstract: Creating accurate organoid models remains a challenge, particularly for diseases like glioblastoma (GBM), an aggressive, treatment-resistant brain cancer with an immunosuppressive microenvironment. To overcome limitations of Earth-based models (sedimentation and disaggregation) and leverage the unique advantages of space (accelerated disease progression and immune dysregulation), this study utilizes a panel of GBM-myeloid organoids cultured for 40 d aboard the International Space Station. Spaceflight-grown GBM organoids have more uniform morphology compared to ground controls. We observed a context-dependent response to spaceflight, with the inclusion of macrophages and monocytes altering the bulk and spatial transcriptional response. While GBM-alone organoids have transcriptional markers of less aggressive disease in microgravity, organoids containing GBM cells + monocytes have increased expression of genes associated with disease progression and poor patient outcomes. Gene expression patterns are more spatially organized, with mesenchymal-related genes enriched in the core and inflammation-related genes enriched at the periphery, mimicking GBM tumor architecture. Microgravity-grown GBM+monocyte organoids exhibit increased secretion of proteins such as CXCL12 and LOX-1, associated with more aggressive disease. Infrared chemical imaging confirms spatial chemical gradients of DNA, protein, and lipid species in both space- and terrestrially-grown organoids. In summary, this work presents not only an advanced model of glioblastoma for basic and translational research but also demonstrates methods to acquire diverse data from organoids compatible with the unique constraints of in-space systems, helping establish a working model for orbital oncology.

title: IL36γ signaling promotes mammalian anti-tick immunity
summary_zh: IL36γ信号通路促进哺乳动物抗蜱免疫。
summary_en: IL36γ signaling promotes mammalian anti-tick immunity.
insights: 创新点：IL36γ在抗蜱免疫中的作用
方法亮点：基因敲除和化学抑制实验
关键发现：IL36γ信号通路与抗蜱免疫的关系
insights_en: Novelty: Role of IL36γ in anti-tick immunity
Method highlight: Gene knockdown and chemical inhibition experiments
Key finding: Relationship between IL36γ signaling and anti-tick immunity
abstract: Ticks, like Ixodes scapularis , can parasitize a diverse array of vertebrates, favoring natural hosts but feeding opportunistically on others. Natural hosts, as well as permissive hosts such as laboratory mice, tolerate repeated infestations, while many incidental hosts may acquire anti-tick immunity, as first described in guinea pigs. We show that tick-immune guinea pigs display altered dermal cytology and a distinct transcriptome, predominantly upregulating the IL36γ cytokine. Interference with IL36γ signaling, via gene knockdown, chemical inhibition, or its natural antagonist IL36RN, reversed anti-tick immunity in guinea pigs. Conversely, genome engineering to silence IL36RN in C3H mice, representing a permissive host, disrupted tick engorgement, interfering with the transmission of Lyme disease pathogens. These findings firmly establish IL36γ as a central mediator of protective anti-tick immunity involving I. scapularis in mammalian hosts and support future strategies to interfere with tick-transmitted infections.

title: CD28 costimulation is organized by signaling condensates and counteracted by PD-1
summary_zh: CD28共刺激由信号凝聚体组织，PD-1进行调节。
summary_en: CD28 costimulation is organized by signaling condensates and counteracted by PD-1.
insights: 创新点：CD28共刺激的信号凝聚体机制
方法亮点：CD28/Lck凝聚体研究
关键发现：PD-1作为调节因子
insights_en: Novelty: CD28 costimulation organized by signaling condensates
Method highlight: CD28/Lck condensate study
Key finding: PD-1 as a regulatory factor
abstract: T cell activation relies on the coordinated integration of T cell receptor (TCR) and cosignaling pathways, yet how these signals are physically organized remains unclear. Here, we demonstrate that CD28 co-stimulation is driven by a condensation mechanism in which the CD28 intracellular domain (ICD) forms signaling condensates with the Src-family kinase Lck. Ligand engagement promotes CD28 ICD accessibility and triggers rapid CD28/Lck condensation, enhancing CD28 phosphorylation, cytoskeletal polarization, and cytokine production. The downstream effectors of CD28, including PI3K and GRB2, can also be recruited into the CD28-Lck condensates in our reconstituted system. We further identify PD-1 as a graded regulator of this process: Monophosphorylated PD-1 is recruited into CD28/Lck condensates, whereas diphosphorylated PD-1 competitively binds the CD28 ICD and dissolves these assemblies. CD28 and PD-1 ICDs also undergo condensation directly, revealing a dynamic and compositionally heterogeneous signaling system. Guided by this competitive condensation mechanism, we engineer CD28 ICD mutants that preserve Lck condensation while resisting PD-1-mediated disruption. Incorporation of these condensation-selective mutants into Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) constructs confers resistance to inhibitory signaling and enhances antitumor efficacy in vivo. These findings establish condensation as a central organizing principle of CD28 costimulation and provide a biophysical framework for engineering more resilient therapeutic T cells.

title: Random, fragile, or correlated: Mechanisms of synteny decay in mammals
summary_zh: 本文建立了三种基因组进化模型，通过比较分析近200种哺乳动物基因组，发现脆弱断裂模型和关联断裂模型与哺乳动物基因组进化更一致。
summary_en: This paper establishes three genome evolution models and finds that the fragile and correlated breakage models are more consistent with mammalian genome evolution through comparative analysis of nearly 200 mammalian genomes.
insights: 创新点：提出关联断裂模型解释哺乳动物基因组进化
方法亮点：使用比较基因组学分析不同断裂模型
关键发现：脆弱和关联断裂模型与哺乳动物基因组进化更一致
insights_en: Novelty: Propose the correlated breakage model to explain mammalian genome evolution
Method highlight: Use comparative genomics to analyze different breakage models
Key finding: The fragile and correlated breakage models are more consistent with mammalian genome evolution
abstract: We formalize three models of genome evolution, yielding analytical distributions of synteny block sizes between pairs of genomes. To evaluate each model, we fit theoretical synteny block size distributions to empirical distributions from a comparative analysis of nearly 200 mammalian genomes. Between the random breakage model (RBM), with uniformly distributed breakpoints, the fragile breakage model (FBM) with breakpoint hotspots, and what we term the correlated breakage model (CBM) with pairs of nearby breakpoints, we find that the FBM and CBM are far more consistent with mammalian genome evolution than the RBM. Inferred parameters of each model qualitatively agree with previously calculated rates of mammalian genome evolution. The FBM and CBM perform comparably with each other, suggesting that either model could serve as an improved null model of genome evolution to use in statistical tests for syntenic regions that are unlikely to exist due to random chance.

title: Comparative analysis of photocatalytic, enzymatic, and chemical approaches to identify canonical and noncanonical surfaceomes
summary_zh: 本文描述了五种光催化表面组学策略，用于检测表面组改变，以发现新的药物靶点。
summary_en: This paper describes five photocatalytic surfaceomics strategies for detecting surfaceome alterations to discover new drug targets.
insights: 创新点：开发光催化技术用于表面组分析
方法亮点：无需细胞工程即可应用光催化剂
关键发现：光催化技术有助于发现新的药物靶点
insights_en: Novelty: Develop photocatalytic technology for surfaceome analysis
Method highlight: Apply photocatalysts without cellular engineering
Key finding: Photocatalysis aids in discovering new drug targets
abstract: The cell surface is a critical nexus in cellular communication and a rich landscape yielding the majority of current therapeutic targets, yet only a small fraction of cell surface proteins have been targeted therapeutically. The cell surface proteome (surfaceome) comprises only ~1% of the human proteome by mass, motivating enrichment strategies to detect surfaceome alterations in disease for drug target discovery. Developments in photocatalytic technology have revolutionized the study of protein neighborhoods around specific targets of interest, but photocatalysis has been underutilized for global surfaceome analysis. Here, we describe five distinct photocatalytic surfaceomics strategies, all without the need for cellular engineering, that apply the photocatalyst Eosin Y attached to different cell surface structures: direct glycan ligation, glycan attachment via two different lectins, membrane insertion, and free in extracellular space. We systematically compare these photocatalytic surfaceomics methods to each other as well as to three established chemical and enzymatic surfaceomics methods. We demonstrate that the different photocatalytic surfaceomics techniques achieve broadly similar canonical cell surface protein enrichment but show some important differences reflective of cell surface attachment mechanism. These mechanistically orthogonal surfaceomics techniques consistently identified numerous nonglycosylated proteins with high concordance, many of which represent an underappreciated class of noncanonical cell surface proteins lacking traditional cell surface protein features that may represent potential drug targets. This study substantially expands options for surfaceomics methods using photocatalytic proximity labeling.

title: Mitochondrial subpopulations promote cellular responses to changes in metabolic demand and signal transduction
summary_zh: 本研究发现，在增加的ATP需求下，线粒体会形成两个不同的亚群，分别负责氧化磷酸化和还原合成。
summary_en: This study finds that mitochondria segregate into two distinct subpopulations under increased ATP demand, one for oxidative phosphorylation and another for reductive synthesis.
insights: 创新点：发现线粒体亚群的形成与ATP需求相关
方法亮点：使用线粒体DNA和蛋白质成分分析亚群
关键发现：还原性线粒体亚群可能消除线粒体NAD(P)H的替代用途
insights_en: Novelty: Discover the formation of mitochondrial subpopulations is related to ATP demand
Method highlight: Analyze subpopulations using mitochondrial DNA and protein components
Key finding: The reductive mitochondrial subpopulation may eliminate alternative uses of mitochondrial NAD(P)H
abstract: When mammalian cells are under increased ATP demand, mitochondria segregate into two distinct subpopulations, one capable of oxidative phosphorylation (oxidative subpopulation) and another specialized in reductive synthesis of metabolic precursors (reductive subpopulation). Here we report that mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) along with protein components of the mitochondrial nucleoid segregate to the oxidative subpopulation in response to increased ATP demand. This suggests that formation of the reductive mitochondrial subpopulation might serve to eliminate alternative uses of mitochondrial NAD(P)H when cells are under bioenergetic or nutrient stress. To examine this further, we studied mitochondria in cells exposed to low levels of glutamine. Mitochondria use glutaminase (GLS1) to maintain net glutamine uptake when cytosolic glutamine decreases, by converting glutamine to glutamate. The resulting glutamate can either be oxidized into α-ketoglutarate to enter the TCA cycle or utilized in the reductive synthesis of proline/ornithine. GLS1 can polymerize into hyperactive filaments in response to elevations in inorganic phosphate as might occur when ATP consumption exceeds production. However, when extracellular glutamine is reduced, GLS1 filaments segregated away from mtDNA, becoming colocalized with pyrroline-5-carboxylate synthase (P5CS) filaments in reductive mitochondria lacking ATP synthase markers. This cosegregation supported the ability of TGF-β signaling to enhance reductive proline/ornithine biosynthesis under low glutamine conditions despite compromising oxidative TCA cycle support from glutamine. The cosegregation of GLS1-P5CS filaments depended on continuing mitochondrial fission/fusion and occurred even in cells lacking mtDNA. Together, these data demonstrate that the reductive mitochondrial subpopulation is functional and under regulation by both metabolic demand and intercellular signal transduction.

title: Unveiling the structure of Leishmania flagella through cryoelectron tomography
summary_zh: 通过冷冻电子断层扫描，揭示了利什曼原虫鞭毛的超微结构，包括独特的非对称特征。
summary_en: Cryoelectron tomography reveals the ultrastructure of Leishmania flagella, including unique asymmetric features.
insights: 创新点：使用冷冻电子断层扫描研究利什曼原虫鞭毛
方法亮点：揭示鞭毛的独特结构
关键发现：鞭毛具有非对称的径向辐条头部
insights_en: Novelty: Use cryoelectron tomography to study Leishmania flagella
Method highlight: Reveal the unique structure of the flagella
Key finding: Flagella have asymmetric radial spoke heads
abstract: Leishmania are unicellular parasites that cause the serious disease leishmaniasis, presenting ongoing global challenges as existing treatments face issues with resistance and toxicity. Leishmania contain a single motile flagellum, essential for transmission, which has the conserved [9 + 2] microtubule arrangement. We used cryoelectron tomography to determine the ultrastructure of the Leishmania tarentolae 96-nm repeat and paraflagellar rod. While the overall structure, including three broad radial spokes and two-headed outer dynein arms, resembles other eukaryotes like Trypanosoma brucei, Tetrahymena, and Opisthokonts, the Leishmania flagellum also exhibits unique and asymmetrical features. These include asymmetrically shaped radial spoke heads similar to T. brucei , suggesting this may represent a kinetoplastid-specific feature. Further, Leishmania contain an additional inner-junction and 8-nm wide A2 protofilament hole. Strikingly, Leishmania have many doublet-specific structures such as outer dynein arm tethers, interdoublet linkers, and heterogeneous connections to the paraflagellar rod. In this work, we show that divergent structural traits of Leishmania flagella highlight lineage-specific adaptations within eukaryotes.

title: Compensation of the effects of temperature on a motor system in the crab, Cancer borealis
summary_zh: 本研究研究了螃蟹Cancer borealis的消化道系统，发现温度升高会增加幽门节律频率。
summary_en: This study investigates the stomatogastric system of the crab Cancer borealis, finding that warming increases pyloric rhythm frequency.
insights: 创新点：研究温度对螃蟹消化道系统的影响
方法亮点：记录神经元活动、肌肉纤维膜电位和收缩力
关键发现：温度升高导致幽门节律频率增加
insights_en: Novelty: Study the effect of temperature on the crab's stomatogastric system
Method highlight: Record neuron activity, muscle fiber membrane potential, and contraction force
Key finding: Warming increases pyloric rhythm frequency
abstract: Understanding how warming affects life-critical physiological processes is increasingly important as ocean temperatures rise at unprecedented rates. We study the stomatogastric system of the crab Cancer borealis . Movement depends on multiple temperature-sensitive processes, from motor pattern generation to neuromuscular transmission and contraction. Previous studies examined these levels separately and showed that warming increased pyloric rhythm frequency until the rhythm crashed at extreme temperatures. Here, we examined how the neuromuscular transform responds to this increase in motor neuron activity. We simultaneously recorded motor neuron activity, muscle fiber membrane potential, and contraction force. As temperature increased, the pyloric rhythm frequency increased, the excitatory junctional potential amplitudes remained constant, and muscle contraction diminished and failed. When muscles were stimulated at a fixed low frequency mimicking neuronal activity at cold temperatures, contraction decreased with acute warming. Increasing motor nerve stimulation frequency to mimic neuronal activity at warm temperatures partially rescued contraction. This shows that the temperature-dependent increase in neuronal firing provides partial compensation but is insufficient to prevent the loss of contraction at high temperatures. Because warming hyperpolarized muscle fibers, it moved the membrane potential further from the contraction threshold, and decreased synaptic integration, thus protecting against overexcitability. However, high-potassium-induced contractures revealed that the contractile machinery remained functional at high temperature, but the nerve-evoked depolarizations were apparently not large enough to cross the threshold for muscle contraction. Thus, a variety of temperature-dependent compensatory mechanisms overlap to extend the temperature range over which the neuromuscular system remains functional over a broad temperature range.

title: Enhancing simulations of disordered protein ensembles with chemical shift restraints in coarse-grained models
summary_zh: 本文提出使用化学位移约束来增强粗粒度模型中无序蛋白集合的模拟。
summary_en: This paper proposes using chemical shift restraints to enhance simulations of disordered protein ensembles in coarse-grained models.
insights: 创新点：引入化学位移约束改进粗粒度模型
方法亮点：提高模拟无序蛋白集合的准确性
关键发现：化学位移约束有助于模拟瞬态结构倾向
insights_en: Novelty: Introduce chemical shift restraints to improve coarse-grained models
Method highlight: Enhance accuracy in simulating disordered protein ensembles
Key finding: Chemical shift restraints aid in simulating transient structural propensities
abstract: With more than one third of the human proteome being structurally disordered, intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) are key contributors to complex cellular functions, despite their highly dynamic conformational ensembles remaining elusive to conventional techniques in structural biology. Coarse-grained (CG) simulation methods thus serve as a gold standard to refine IDP ensembles. These methods, when relying on elastic network models or rigid body to sample secondary structure, are however inherently limited in their capability to model and sample transient secondary structure at a residue-level resolution as informed by experimental data. This fundamental limitation persists despite experimental evidence suggesting that transient structural propensities are a fundamental hallmark of IDP function. Through an artificial neural network capable of predicting backbone chemical shifts from C α -only protein conformations, we present a generalized framework which does not rely on dihedral parameterization to equip one bead-per-aminoacid CG force fields with the ability to sample functional elements of secondary structure. When applied on a large set of IDPs in isolation or condensates, our approach correctly recapitulates both local and global arrangements, yielding experimentally informed ensembles that can inform structure-mediated function and resolve force field limitations. This can yield a fruitful exploration of ensemble-to-function relationships in IDPs, allowing to explore phenomena such as secondary structure propensity and nucleation in condensates, conformationally selected binding motifs across disordered ensembles or conformational preferences of sequence-specific short-linear motifs.

title: Microplastic size matters—Report every particle
Gene conversion is a key driver of diversity hotspots in Mycobacterium tuberculosis antigens and virulence-associated loci
summary_zh: 本研究发现，基因转换是结核分枝杆菌抗原和毒力相关位点多样性热点的主要驱动因素。
summary_en: This study finds that gene conversion is a key driver of diversity hotspots in Mycobacterium tuberculosis antigens and virulence-associated loci.
insights: 创新点：揭示基因转换在结核分枝杆菌多样性热点中的作用
方法亮点：使用长读长测序分析基因组
关键发现：基因转换导致高度遗传多样性
insights_en: Novelty: Uncover the role of gene conversion in diversity hotspots of Mycobacterium tuberculosis
Method highlight: Use long-read sequencing to analyze genomes
Key finding: Gene conversion leads to high genetic diversity
abstract: Despite the long-held view of Mycobacterium tuberculosis ( Mtb ) as a genetically conserved pathogen, many genomic regions remain poorly resolved due to high sequence homology and repetitive content. Using complete genome assemblies generated from long-read sequencing of 151 globally representative clinical isolates, we comprehensively analyzed genome-wide patterns of genetic diversity and evolution across the Mtb genome. Our analysis uncovers pronounced diversity hotspots within paralogous regions (PRs) generated by recurrent gene conversion between homologous genes. In many cases, these hotspots exhibit more than an order of magnitude greater genetic diversity than the rest of the Mtb genome, which is otherwise characterized by remarkably low variation. Mutations within these regions display clustered substitution patterns, excess paralog-matching variants, and distinct mutational spectra consistent with ongoing gene conversion. Our analysis identifies over 300 individual gene conversion events (GCEs) distributed throughout the Mtb phylogeny. These GCEs occur predominantly within gene families associated with virulence and host–pathogen interactions, including the PE, PPE, and ESX families. Several of the most pronounced diversity hotspots occur in antigens encoded within PRs. Among these, the vaccine candidate PPE18 harbors mutations in validated epitope sequences and predicted alterations in HLA-II binding. Together, these findings demonstrate that gene conversion actively shapes antigenic and virulence-associated diversity in Mtb .

title: MSCquartets 3.3: Fast Inference of Species Networks and Trees of Blobs under the Multispecies Coalescent
summary_zh: MSCquartets 3.3通过实现TINNiK和ECToBlob算法，快速推断物种网络和Blob树。
summary_en: MSCquartets 3.3 implements TINNiK and ECToBlob algorithms for fast inference of species networks and trees of blobs under the multispecies coalescent model.
insights: 创新点：实现快速推断物种网络和Blob树

insights_en: Novelty: Implement fast inference of species networks and trees of blobs
Method highlight: Use C++ to improve computational speed
Key finding: New algorithms simplify basic analyses
abstract: Abstract The R package MSCquartets offers a suite of methods for testing and inferring species relationships from gene trees under coalescent models. MSCquartets 3.3 significantly extends the functionality of version 1.0 by implementing the TINNiK and ECToBlob algorithms for inference of the tree of blobs under the network multispecies coalescent model (NMSC). Additionally, it implements the NANUQ+ algorithm, a fast method for inference of level-1 networks. Computational speed of all functionalities is greatly improved through use of C ++ routines, and a Shiny App is introduced for easier exploration of basic analyses. Availability and implementation: MSCquartets 3.3 is available on the Comprehensive R Archive Network, at https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=MSCquartets. The MSCquartets 3.3 Shiny App is available at https://mscquartets.shinyapps.io/MSCq-app/

title: Integrating complementary datasets for constructing microbiome-metabolome-disease pathways
summary_zh: 研究微生物组-代谢组-疾病通路。整合互补数据集。提出高维结构方程模型。
summary_en: Studying microbiome-metabolome-disease pathways. Integrating complementary datasets. Proposing a high-dimensional structural equation model.
insights: 创新点：提出互补数据集整合方法
方法亮点：高维结构方程模型应用
关键发现：模型有效连接微生物组、代谢组与疾病
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed method for integrating complementary datasets
Method highlight: Application of high-dimensional structural equation model
Key finding: Model effectively links microbiome, metabolome, and disease
abstract: Abstract Motivation Microbiome–metabolome–disease pathways play a central role in host health, but studying them is limited by the data available. Large clinical microbiome cohorts often lack metabolomic measurements, while multi-omics studies with paired profiles are typically small or incompletely phenotyped. Combining such complementary datasets is challenging: the metabolite is not measured in the clinical cohort, microbiome data are high-dimensional and compositional, and log-ratio analyses depend on an arbitrarily chosen reference taxon. Results We propose a framework that integrates a large target cohort that has microbiome and outcome data with a smaller external study that has paired microbiome–metabolome profiles. A high-dimensional structural equation model jointly links the microbiome, the metabolome and the disease outcome. It allows for unmeasured confounding and groups microbes into functional categories. We address compositionality with the additive log-ratio (ALR) transformation, estimate parameters by penalized two-stage least squares, and test metabolite–disease associations with a regularized permutation test. A novel multiple-reference procedure treats each microbe in turn as the ALR reference. It combines the resulting p-values with the Cauchy combination test and classifies microbes by stability selection, which makes inference robust to the choice of reference. In simulations, the method controls the type I error rate, and its power increases with both target and external sample sizes. An application to inflammatory bowel disease, integrating the FRAN and iHMP cohorts, reveals biologically interpretable microbiome–metabolome–disease links. Availability and Implementation The method is implemented in the R package MMDP, freely available at https://github.com/lei-fang-stat/MMDP. Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: pxGPT: A schema-constrained multimodal LLM framework for plant phenotyping
summary_zh: 开发pxGPT框架，将植物图像转化为结构化表型记录。结合自由文本描述和人工审核。
summary_en: Developing the pxGPT framework to convert plant images into structured phenotype records. Combining free-text description with human review.
insights: 创新点：pxGPT框架实现图像到表型的转换
方法亮点：结合自由文本描述和人工审核
关键发现：pxGPT在表型记录提取上优于人工标注
insights_en: Novelty: pxGPT framework achieves image-to-phenotype conversion
Method highlight: Combining free-text description with human review
Key finding: pxGPT outperforms human annotation in phenotype record extraction
abstract: Abstract Summary Deep learning can scale image-based plant phenotyping but typically targets predefined traits, whereas manual phenotypic description is more flexible but difficult to scale. We present Phenotype eXplorer Generative Plant Traits (pxGPT), a Python framework that converts multi-view plant images into structured phenotype records. The workflow combines free-text description, dataset-specific schema generation with human review, and schema-constrained information extraction. We evaluated the extraction stage on three Brassica datasets using 78,973 annotations from ten annotators who had no access to pxGPT predictions. For 38-45 qualitative traits per dataset, pxGPT-human agreement ranged from 0.572 to 0.712, compared with 0.620 to 0.739 agreement among human annotators. All 32,736 required trait fields were present; 93 values were empty, and no qualitative descriptor violations were recorded. For selected morphological structures, pooled false-positive rates were 0.5-8.0%, while sensitivity varied across structure types in one mature-plant dataset (37.5-100%). The curated schemas were applied unchanged with two commercial models and one locally hosted open-weight model, with differences in mean accuracy of 0.03 or less. In the evaluated Brassica datasets, these results support schema-guided extraction of visible plant traits without separate model training for each trait. Human-guided schema development offers a path to extend pxGPT to other crops and imaging conditions, with accuracy requiring validation in each new setting. Availability and Implementation The software is available at https://github.com/YaoChengLab/pxgpt and an archival version of the source code is available on Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22931745). Curated schemas used in this study, annotation guides, phenotype records and human annotations are available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22907554. Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: XenoMix: Estimating mouse content from DNA methylation data of Patient-Derived Xenograft models
summary_zh: 提出XenoMix工具，从PDX模型DNA甲基化数据中量化小鼠DNA污染。
summary_en: Proposing the XenoMix tool for quantifying mouse DNA contamination from PDX model DNA methylation data.
insights: 创新点：XenoMix工具量化PDX模型小鼠DNA污染
方法亮点：利用基因组同源性检测小鼠DNA信号
关键发现：XenoMix在PDX模型中有效
insights_en: Novelty: XenoMix tool quantifies mouse DNA contamination in PDX models
Method highlight: Utilizing genomic homology to detect mouse DNA signals
Key finding: XenoMix is effective in PDX models
abstract: Abstract Summary DNA methylation microarrays enable cost-effective, high-throughput profiling of human and mouse samples and are widely used to study epigenetic alterations in cancer. Patient-Derived Xenograft (PDX) models complement this approach by preserving primary tumor characteristics while enabling in vivo studies of drug response and therapy resistance. However, it remains difficult to quantify mouse DNA contamination in PDX DNA methylation data generated using microarrays. We present XenoMix, a light-weight computational tool for quantifying mouse DNA contamination directly from DNA methylation data in PDX models. XenoMix leverages the high sequence homology between human and mouse genomes to detect and quantify unexpected signal contributions originating from mouse DNA. Using ground truth mixtures, XenoMix achieved Pearson’s correlation coefficients higher than 0.99. When applied to PDX data, we identified varying levels of mouse contamination originating from biological and technological variability. XenoMix establishes a critical quality control step in DNA methylation analysis of PDX models, and we show that the estimated contamination can be incorporated as a confounding variable in downstream analyses. Availability and Implementation XenoMix is available as a standalone R package from https://git.dkfz.de/b370/scepigen/XenoMix and as a module in the RnBeads software package. Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

OpenDVP: an experimental and computational framework for community-empowered deep visual proteomics
summary_zh: 介绍openDVP框架，实现社区驱动的深度视觉蛋白质组学。
summary_en: Introducing the openDVP framework for community-empowered deep visual proteomics.
insights: 创新点：openDVP框架推动深度视觉蛋白质组学发展
方法亮点：结合开源图像分析工具与多组学数据
关键发现：提供快速和智能分析流程
insights_en: Novelty: openDVP framework promotes the development of deep visual proteomics
Method highlight: Combining open-source image analysis tools with multi-omics data
Key finding: Provides fast and intelligent analysis workflows
abstract: Abstract Deep visual proteomics (DVP) is an emerging approach for cell-type-specific and spatially resolved proteomics. However, its broad adoption has been constrained by the lack of an open-source end-to-end workflow within a community-driven ecosystem. Here we introduce openDVP, an experimental and computational framework for accessible and scalable DVP. OpenDVP combines open-source image analysis tools (MCMICRO, QuPath and napari) with scverse formats (AnnData and SpatialData) for multiomics integration. It provides two workflows: a fast-track pipeline requiring no image analysis expertise, and an artificial intelligence-powered pipeline incorporating state-of-the-art methods for image preprocessing, segmentation and spatial analysis. We apply openDVP across three archival tissue studies (human placenta, early stage lung cancer and locally relapsed breast cancer), integrating spatial single-cell phenotypes with exploratory proteomic measurements. Finally, we introduce deep proteomic profiling of cellular neighborhoods as a scalable approach for spatial discovery proteomics.

title: Obesity in Children Aged 2 to 12 Years
summary_zh: 研究2至12岁儿童肥胖问题，探讨肥胖与多种健康问题的关联。
summary_en: Studying obesity in children aged 2 to 12 years, exploring the association between obesity and various health issues.
insights: 创新点：分析儿童肥胖与多种健康问题的关联
方法亮点：使用BMI和生长图表识别肥胖儿童
关键发现：肥胖儿童生活质量较低
insights_en: Novelty: Analyzing the association between childhood obesity and various health issues
Method highlight: Using BMI and growth charts to identify obese children
Key finding: Obese children have lower quality of life
abstract: Importance Obesity affects 15% of children aged 2 to 5 years and 22% of children aged 6 to 11 years in the US. Obesity in children is associated with dyslipidemia, hypertension, metabolic dysfunction–associated steatotic liver disease, and obstructive sleep apnea. Compared with normal-weight peers, children with obesity have lower quality of life and are 5 times more likely to have obesity in adulthood. Observations Body mass index (BMI; calculated as weight in kilograms divided by height in meters squared) is used to identify children at risk for excess adiposity, and guidelines recommend that clinicians screen for obesity using BMI starting at age 2 years. Among children, obesity is defined using standardized age- and sex-specific growth charts, with obesity defined as BMI in the 95th or higher percentile and severe obesity as BMI of 120% or greater of the 95th percentile. Obesity treatment in children includes intensive health behavior and lifestyle treatment, consisting of at least 26 contact hours of face-to-face group or family-based activities that incorporate nutrition, physical activity, and behavior change education delivered to the child and caregivers over a 3- to 12-month period. Intensive health behavior and lifestyle treatment reduces BMI by 0.7 compared with children who do not participate in intensive health behavior and lifestyle treatment. The only obesity pharmacotherapy currently approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for children younger than 12 years is setmelanotide, a melanocortin-4 receptor agonist, which is indicated for 3 forms of rare monogenic obesity ( LEPR , POMC , and PCSK1 genetic variants), Bardet-Biedl syndrome, and acquired hypothalamic obesity. Liraglutide is currently only FDA approved for youth aged 12 years or older; however, a randomized clinical trial among children aged 6 to younger than 12 years demonstrated that, compared with placebo, liraglutide reduced BMI by 7.4%. Metabolic and bariatric surgery is rarely used in children younger than age 12 years and evidence supporting its use in children is limited. Early identification and treatment of obesity during childhood may reduce risk of type 2 diabetes, dyslipidemia, hypertension, and mortality in adulthood. Conclusions and Relevance Obesity in children is associated with chronic disease, such as hypertension, and with poor quality of life. Evidence-based treatment for obesity in children includes intensive health behavior and lifestyle treatment, and pharmacotherapy may provide additional benefit, although short- and long-term safety and efficacy data are limited. Early identification and treatment of obesity during childhood may reduce risk of type 2 diabetes, dyslipidemia, hypertension, and mortality in adulthood.

summary_zh: 研究辅助生殖技术与儿童癌症风险关联。
summary_en: This study examines the association between assisted reproductive technology and childhood cancer risk.
insights: 创新点：分析不同辅助生殖技术与癌症类型。

abstract: Importance Childhood cancer risk after assisted reproductive technology (ART) remains uncertain, particularly by procedure and cancer type. Objective To examine associations between ART and childhood cancer overall and by ART modality and cancer type. Design, Setting, and Population Nationwide Danish cohort of 1 086 136 live-born children from 1996 to 2012, of whom 37 228 (3.4%) were conceived using ART, with follow-up through 2023. Exposures Maternal ART, classified as in vitro fertilization (IVF), intracytoplasmic sperm injection, or frozen embryo transfer. Main Outcomes and Measures Incident childhood cancer. Cox proportional hazards models estimated hazard ratios (HRs); Poisson models estimated incidence rates. Non-ART births were the primary reference; secondary analyses used children of women with a history of infertility and children conceived using IVF as reference groups. Results During a median follow-up of 20 years, 3736 cancers occurred. Compared with non-ART births (incidence rate, 18.3 per 100 000 person-years), children conceived using ART had higher cancer incidence (incidence rate, 23.6 per 100 000; HR, 1.26 [95% CI, 1.07-1.48]). Rates were higher after frozen embryo transfer (incidence rate, 41.1 per 100 000; HR, 2.18 [95% CI, 1.45-3.29]) and intracytoplasmic sperm injection (incidence rate, 27.9 per 100 000; HR, 1.48 [95% CI, 1.16-1.89]) but not IVF (incidence rate, 18.5 per 100 000; HR, 1.01 [95% CI, 0.79-1.28]). Frozen embryo transfer was associated with leukemia (incidence rate, 11.1 per 100 000; HR, 2.36 [95% CI, 1.06-5.28]), lymphomas (HR, 3.03 [95% CI, 1.13-8.12]), and soft tissue sarcomas (HR, 7.63 [95% CI, 2.82-20.62]); intracytoplasmic sperm injection was associated with lymphomas (incidence rate, 4.6 per 100 000; HR, 1.94 [95% CI, 1.07-3.54]), soft tissue sarcomas (incidence rate, 3.3 per 100 000; HR, 3.28 [95% CI, 1.54-7.00]), and central nervous system neoplasms (incidence rate, 8.2 per 100 000; HR, 1.63 [95% CI, 1.04-2.57]); no associations were observed for IVF. Findings were similar in secondary analyses using children of women with a history of infertility and children conceived using IVF as reference groups. Conclusions and Relevance ART, particularly frozen embryo transfer and intracytoplasmic sperm injection, was associated with increased childhood cancer risk, but absolute risks were low. The consistent results in secondary analyses of children with maternal infertility history or conceived via IVF suggest that procedure-related, rather than infertility-related, factors warrant further investigation.

Rituximab vs Azathioprine for Eosinophilic Granulomatosis With Polyangiitis Maintenance Therapy
summary_zh: 比较利妥昔单抗与硫唑嘌呤在EGPA维持治疗中的效果，随机临床试验评估缓解持续时间。

Method highlight: Double-blind, double-dummy, randomized clinical trial
Key finding: Assessing remission duration
abstract: Importance For patients with eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis (EGPA), guidelines recommend considering maintenance therapy after achieving remission. Data comparing maintenance therapeutic options are limited. Objective To compare the effects of rituximab and azathioprine maintenance therapies on remission duration for patients with EGPA who recently achieved remission of vasculitis after standard therapy, including prednisone tapering or withdrawal. Design, Setting, and Participants From March 7, 2018, to June 2, 2022, this double-blind, double-dummy, investigator-initiated, superiority, randomized clinical trial enrolled 98 participants with EGPA from 36 hospitals in France. Inclusion eligibility required a new EGPA diagnosis or relapsing EGPA within 30 to 360 days of achieving vasculitis remission (Birmingham Vasculitis Activity Score of 0 [range, 0-63, with higher scores indicating more severe disease activity]) after a standard induction regimen. Data were analyzed from April 1, 2025, to September 17, 2025. Additional analyses ended June 22, 2026. Interventions Participants were randomized to receive a predefined standardized tapering of oral prednisone and either 500 mg of intravenous rituximab every 6 months for 18 months and daily oral azathioprine placebo for 24 months (n = 49) or rituximab placebo every 6 months for 18 months and daily oral azathioprine for 24 months (n = 49). Main Outcomes and Measures The primary efficacy end point was the duration of total remission during the 28-month study period while taking 7.5 mg/d or less of prednisone. The 14 secondary end points included proportion of participants remaining in remission, rate of vasculitis relapse, and rate of asthma or rhinosinusitis exacerbations. Results All 98 randomized participants (mean age, 59.0 years [SD, 14.4]; 50 women [51%]) received at least 1 dose of the trial regimen and 92 (94%) completed the trial. The mean time in remission with prednisone at 7.5 mg/d or less was 91.1 weeks (95% CI, 80.9-101.2) vs 96.0 weeks (95% CI, 85.6-106.5) in the rituximab and azathioprine groups, respectively ( P = .38). The proportion of participants who remained in remission during the 28-month study period with prednisone at 7.5 mg/d or less was 17 of 49 (34.7%) vs 11 of 49 (22.4%; relative risk, 1.51; 95% CI, 0.83-2.73; P = .18) in the rituximab and azathioprine groups, respectively. The proportion of participants with at least 1 vasculitis relapse was 7 (14.3%) vs 9 (18.4%) in the rituximab vs azathioprine groups, respectively, and for those with at least 1 clinically significant asthma exacerbation, rhinosinusitis exacerbation, or both, it was 16 (32.7%) vs 19 (38.8%). One participant in the azathioprine group died of SARS-CoV-2 infection before vaccine development. Rituximab recipients experienced a higher incidence of severe infections (23 [46.9%] vs 12 [24.5%], respectively), primarily due to severe SARS-CoV-2 infections. Conclusions and Relevance For participants with newly diagnosed or relapsing EGPA, rituximab was not superior to azathioprine for improving the duration of total remission during 28 months while taking prednisone at 7.5 mg/d or less. summary_zh: 研究活体肾脏捐赠后怀孕的妊娠结果。比较捐赠者和非捐赠者的妊娠结果。

abstract: Importance People who become pregnant after living kidney donation may be at increased risk of pregnancy-related adverse outcomes, although the evidence is unclear. Objective To determine whether pregnancies after living kidney donation are associated with a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes than matched pregnancies among nondonors. Design, Setting, and Participants This matched cohort study used provincial administrative health care databases from Ontario, British Columbia, and Alberta, Canada, and included living female kidney donors aged 18 to 42 years who donated a kidney between July 1992 and August 2021 and subsequently had singleton pregnancies of at least 20 weeks’ gestation. These pregnancies were matched 1:4 with singleton pregnancies of at least 20 weeks’ gestation among female nondonors. Pregnancies in donors and nondonors were matched on delivery date, age at delivery, years between cohort entry and delivery, number of prior pregnancies, and income. Final follow-up occurred until March 2023. Outcome analysis occurred from August 2024 to September 2026. Main Outcomes and Measures The primary outcome was a composite of hospitalization with a diagnosis of gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, or eclampsia. Secondary outcomes included 12 maternal, fetal and neonatal adverse outcomes, including the individual components of the primary outcome, the composite of low birth weight or preterm birth, and small for gestational age at birth. Results The sample included 385 pregnancies in 252 living kidney donors (mean [SD] age, 27.8 [5.0] years) matched to 1540 pregnancies in 1535 nondonors (mean [SD] age, 27.0 [4.8] years). The primary composite outcome of gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, or eclampsia occurred in 46 donor pregnancies (11.9%) and 128 nondonor pregnancies (8.3%; risk ratio, 1.51; 95% CI, 1.10-2.08). Among the 12 secondary outcomes, the 95% CI for the risk ratio excluded 1.00 for the outcome of small for gestational age, which occurred in 53 donor pregnancies (13.8%) and 121 nondonor pregnancies (7.9%) (risk ratio, 1.86; 95% CI, 1.37-2.52). CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE In this study, pregnancy after living kidney donation was associated with a higher risk of the composite outcome of hospitalization with a diagnosis of gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, or eclampsia, when compared with matched pregnancies in nondonors. Most postdonation pregnancies were uncomplicated. These findings support counseling donor candidates who may become pregnant about this risk and informing the prenatal care of donors who become pregnant.

summary_zh: 研究利用扫描隧道显微镜观察广义维格纳晶体的量子熔化。方法上，通过电子掺杂的六角氮化硼双层石墨烯实现。实验表明，空穴掺杂的维格纳晶体产生相互作用驱动的无序状态。

The method involves electron-doped bilayer graphene with a triangular moiré superlattice. Experiments show that hole-doped Wigner crystals yield interaction-driven disordered states.

insights_en: Novelty: Scanning tunneling microscopy images quantum melting process
Method highlight: Electron doping enables Wigner crystal study
Key finding: Hole doping yields disordered states
abstract: Two-dimensional moiré materials provide a versatile platform to explore phase transitions in strongly correlated systems. Using scanning tunneling microscopy, we imaged the density-driven melting of generalized Wigner crystals (GWCs) and Mott insulators (MIs) in electron-doped, near-60°–twisted molybdenum diselenide bilayers featuring a triangular moiré superlattice. We observed notable electron-hole asymmetry in GWC melting: Hole-doped GWCs yielded interaction-driven disordered states, whereas electron-doped GWCs melted into delocalized liquid-like states. This asymmetry arose from the broken particle-hole symmetry of the moiré superlattice, which produced electron and hole Fermi pockets with different momentum geometries upon GWC condensation. MI states melted without such asymmetry, consistent with the absence of a symmetry-breaking density modulation. This work provides direct visualization of the emergent phases that appear as GWCs undergo quantum melting transitions.

title: Electronic bound states in the continuum in a two-dimensional metal
summary_zh: 研究利用扫描隧道显微镜在二维金属Pd5AlI2中识别缺陷诱导的电子束缚态。方法上，通过计算分析电子跳跃干涉。实验表明，缺陷导致的空间局域态与扩展态正交。
summary_en: This study identifies defect-induced electronic bound states in the metallic continuum of Pd5AlI2 using scanning tunneling microscopy. The method involves computational analysis of electron hopping interference. Experiments show that defect-induced spatially localized states are orthogonal to the extended states.
insights: 创新点：二维金属中发现电子束缚态
方法亮点：扫描隧道显微镜揭示缺陷态

insights_en: Novelty: Electronic bound states found in two-dimensional metal
Method highlight: Scanning tunneling microscopy reveals defect states

abstract: Bound states in the continuum (BICs) are quantum states that remain localized despite lying within a continuum of extended, delocalized states. Whereas optical BICs have been realized in photonic systems, achieving electronic bound states embedded in a metallic background remains an ongoing challenge. In this study, we used scanning tunneling microscopy to identify two defect-induced electronic states that remain localized within the metallic continuum of Pd 5 AlI 2 , a two-dimensional van der Waals metal. Our calculations suggest that electron-hopping interference on the decorated checkerboard lattice of Pd 5 AlI 2 gives rise to a (quasi) flat band built from spatially localized eigenstates that are orthogonal to the dispersive continuum. Atomic defects within this frustrated lattice shift the associated flat-band localized states into the metallic continuum, forming robust, symmetry-protected BICs.

title: Visualizing symmetry-broken Chern insulators and their quantum melting
summary_zh: 研究利用扫描隧道显微镜研究双层石墨烯中的霍夫斯塔特态。方法上，通过磁场调控观察对称破缺的色绝缘体。实验表明，霍夫斯塔特带分数填充时形成多倍单元格相。
summary_en: This study investigates Hofstadter states in bilayer graphene using scanning tunneling microscopy. The method involves magnetic field tuning to observe symmetry-broken Chern insulators. Experiments show that phases with multiple unit cells form at fractional filling of the Hofstadter bands.
insights: 创新点：扫描隧道显微镜可视化霍夫斯塔特态
方法亮点：磁场调控研究对称破缺

insights_en: Novelty: Scanning tunneling microscopy visualizes Hofstadter states
Method highlight: Magnetic field tuning studies symmetry breaking
Key finding: Multiple unit cell phases form at fractional band filling
abstract: In the presence of a magnetic field, electronic states of moiré quantum materials develop a Hofstadter spectrum that provides a distinctive setting for studying the interplay between band topology and strong electron-electron interaction. Using scanning tunneling microscopy, we studied Hofstadter’s states in bilayer graphene aligned with hexagonal boron nitride and directly visualized the formation of interaction-driven symmetry breaking Chern insulators. Our measurements revealed the formation of phases that double, triple, or quadruple the moiré unit cell at fractional filling of the Hofstadter bands as well as states with complex intra–unit cell wave functions. We visualized two distinct quantum phenomena in different Chern states, including quantum melting driven by the appearance and proliferation of topological defects and a quantum transition co-occurring with phase competition and separation.

abstract: Guanidine exists almost exclusively as a resonance-stabilized cation, making its direct enzymatic functionalization challenging. We identified the cyanobacterial enzyme NosH, which catalyzes direct prenyl transfer to free guanidine. Structural and mechanistic analyses revealed guanidine activation by a two-aspartate clamp coupled to prenyl-donor binding through a distinct catalytic architecture. Guided by these features, we identified a large family of guanidine prenyltransferases across bacteria and plants. Plant enzymes produced guanidine alkaloids such as galegine in vitro and heterologous expression of a plant ortholog in Nicotiana benthamiana produced galegine in planta, providing a direct enzymatic link to plant-specialized metabolism.

insights_en: Nanochannel dynamics improve efficiency
Experiments show dynamics improve performance
Impact of dynamics on separation performance
abstract: Nanochannels capable of fast and selective mass transport are central to applications in energy, resources, biomedicine, and the environment. However, extreme nanoscale confinement, often coupled with rigid channel environments, imposes substantial frictional and adhesive barriers, causing sluggish transport and constrained selectivity. We identified nanochannel dynamics as a key to addressing these challenges by harnessing the intrinsic mobility (e.g., self-rotation) of confined functionalities to enhance molecular transport. Through a combination of experiments and simulations, we demonstrated that such dynamics reshape transport by promoting kinetic energy transfer and enabling more efficient molecular relays, thereby improving separation performance beyond current benchmarks. Our findings highlight the role of nanochannel dynamics in regulating mass transport under confinement and provide a framework for designing advanced nanochannel systems.

abstract: The underlying mechanism of the thermal Hall effect generated by phonons in a variety of insulators is yet to be identified. In this work, we report on a sizable thermal Hall conductivity in nickel phosphorus trisulfide (NiPS 3 ), a van der Waals stack of honeycomb layers with a zigzag antiferromagnetic order. The longitudinal (κ aa ) and the transverse (κ ab ) thermal conductivities peak at the same temperature, and the thermal Hall angle, at this peak, respects a previously identified bound. The amplitude of κ ab is extremely sensitive to the amplitude of magnetization along the b axis but is not correlated with the phonon mean free path, which points to an intrinsic origin.

abstract: The power conversion efficiency (PCE) and stability of flexible perovskite solar modules (PSMs) are less than those of their rigid devices because surface hydroxyls desorption on flexible substrates, which disrupts self-assembled monolayer (SAM) anchoring and perovskite crystallization. We developed a decoupled SAM-perovskite codeposition strategy that accelerates SAM anchoring by reducing the SAM-perovskite interaction and ameliorates perovskite crystallization. The certified PCE with phenethylammonium iodide as the passivation molecule was 20.2% on PSMs with device areas of 750 cm 2 . With 1,3-diaminopropane dihydroiodide as the passivator, the PCE of 22.0% for a device area of 14.55 cm 2 decreased by 8% after 1044 hours under maximum power point tracking at 85°C and 65% relative humidity. The devices pass all sequences of an international commercialization assessment standard for flexible portable PSMs.

Method highlight: Uses long-read RNA sequencing technology

abstract: Immunotherapy with checkpoint inhibitors has revolutionized cancer therapy and enabled considerable therapeutic advances for treating various diseases, including lung cancer. However, the molecular determinants of variable patient outcomes remain unclear. Using long-read RNA sequencing, we mapped the landscape of alternative RNA splicing in human primary lung adenocarcinomas. We identified more than 149,000 full-length messenger RNA (mRNA) isoforms, more than half of which were unannotated and many that occurred in immune-related genes, particularly within the type I interferon response pathway. We functionally characterized retained introns in the STAT2 gene that produced altered protein isoforms that regulated immune signaling and interferon responses and correlated with patient survival after anti–programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) immunotherapy. These findings position alternative splicing as a regulator of tumor immune responses and reveal intron retention in STAT2 as an interferon regulatory axis that correlates with PD-L1 checkpoint inhibitor response.

title: Neuropharmacology of language: ERP evidence for catecholaminergic modulation of syntactic processing
summary_zh: 研究显示，多巴胺类药物可增强句法处理过程中的认知资源调用。
summary_en: The study shows that dopamine类药物 can enhance the recruitment of cognitive resources in syntactic processing.

insights_en: Novelty: Study on the impact of dopamine类药物 on syntactic processing
Method highlight: Combines electroencephalography and psychopharmacology methods
Key finding: Dopamine类药物 enhance the recruitment of cognitive resources in syntactic processing
abstract: A few studies have shown that brain catecholamines are implicated in language comprehension. However, the specific cognitive processes they modulate remain underexplored. We hypothesized that catecholamines enhance the unification of syntactic roles and word meanings into coherent multiword structures. This study combined electroencephalography and psychopharmacology to examine the effects of a catecholaminergic stimulant (methylphenidate) on processing sentences containing local syntactic ambiguities. Methylphenidate amplified the P600 event-related potential effect, which has been linked to the recruitment of cognitive resources for processing sentences with increased syntactic load. The drug’s impact on semantic processing was subtler, showing a suggestive attenuation of the N400 effect to ambiguous sentences. Furthermore, the increase in the P600 effect under methylphenidate was most pronounced in participants with lower working memory capacity. This study provides evidence for linking catecholamine activity to syntactic unification in healthy individuals. Elevated catecholamine levels appear to increase the cognitive effort invested in syntactic unification, and to support the dynamic prioritization of syntactic information when contextual demands require it.

title: From authenticity ecosystems to human–AI hybrid societies
The survival paradox of close-in planets orbiting red-clump giants
summary_zh: 研究发现，靠近红团星的红矮星行星存在悖论。
summary_en: The study finds a paradox of close-in planets orbiting red-clump giants.
insights: 创新点：红团星红矮星行星生存悖论的研究
方法亮点：通过 asteroseismology 确认红团星
关键发现：存在与理论预测不符的行星
insights_en: Novelty: Study on the survival paradox of close-in planets orbiting red-clump giants
Method highlight: Confirms red-clump giants through asteroseismology
Key finding: Planets exist that do not conform to theoretical predictions
abstract: Close-in planets orbiting core-helium-burning red-clump giants directly challenge tidal-engulfment theory, which predicts that planets within about 1 au of Sun-like stars should be engulfed during red-giant-branch (RGB) expansion. The existence of such survivors would imply missing physical processes in the late stages of stellar and planetary evolution. Yet only one such “forbidden” planet had been identified to date. Here we report three systems—24 Boo b, HD 12648 b, and TYC 4282-605-1 b—whose host stars are confirmed red-clump giants through asteroseismology, showing that each has already undergone dramatic expansion and contraction following helium ignition. Their planets now reside at orbital separations smaller than the maximum stellar radii attained during the RGB phase, implying that they should not have survived. Among them, 24 Boo b orbits at only 0.183 au with a 30-d period, making it the closest planet known around a red-clump giant. These findings demonstrate that this paradox is not an isolated anomaly but signals the emergence of a class of evolved planetary systems. Their survival defies current models of stellar–planetary coevolution and points to unexplored physics shaping planetary architectures around post-RGB stars.

title: Molecular drivers of cotranslational protein assembly in bacteria
summary_zh: 研究揭示了细菌共翻译蛋白质组装的分子机制。
summary_en: The study reveals the molecular mechanisms of cotranslational protein assembly in bacteria.
insights: 创新点：细菌共翻译蛋白质组装机制的研究
方法亮点：结合 ribosome profiling 和单分子光镊技术
关键发现：异源四聚体通过层次化组装途径形成
insights_en: Novelty: Study on the molecular mechanisms of cotranslational protein assembly in bacteria
Method highlight: Combines ribosome profiling and single-molecule optical tweezers technology
Key finding: Heterotetramers form via hierarchical assembly pathways
abstract: Protein complexes are pivotal to all major cellular processes. Translation-coupled complex assembly is ubiquitous in eukaryotes, but its molecular basis and prevalence in bacteria remain poorly understood. Here, we combine ribosome profiling and single-molecule optical tweezers to establish principles governing cotranslational assembly of four structurally diverse complexes in Escherichia coli . We reveal how heterotetramers form cotranslationally via hierarchical assembly pathways, with initial heterodimer formation priming the assembly of higher-order oligomers through a topology-dependent organization of homomeric and heteromeric interfaces. Co-post assembly, defined as interaction between nascent and fully synthesized subunits, initiates when dimerization domains are completely exposed at the ribosome. The assembly order is predominantly unidirectional and matches the operon gene order, with upstream-encoded subunits being synthesized first, and then engaging downstream nascent partner subunits. The co-post assembly efficiency depends both on the native operon structure and the ribosome-associated chaperone trigger factor, which binds emerging oligomerization domains and whose dissociation marks the onset of partner subunit engagement. The handover from chaperone engagement to cotranslational assembly is mediated by nascent chain folding. Finally, we show that co-post assembly provides a fitness advantage. Together, these findings reveal how genome organization and chaperone-assisted folding coordinate cotranslational assembly to promote efficient complex biogenesis and cellular fitness in bacteria.

title: System-level reorganization of gene networks underlies the nurse-to-forager transition in honeybees
summary_zh: 研究揭示蜜蜂从护理到采集的转变与基因网络系统重组有关。
summary_en: The study reveals that the transition from nursing to foraging in honeybees is related to the system-level reorganization of gene networks.
insights: 创新点：蜜蜂行为转变的基因网络研究
方法亮点：分析蜜蜂发育过程中的基因表达数据
关键发现：基因网络重组与行为转变相关
insights_en: Novelty: Study on the gene network of honeybee behavioral transition
Method highlight: Analyzes gene expression data across developmental time points
Key finding: Gene network reorganization is related to behavioral transition
abstract: Division of labor in social insects is enabled by coordinated changes in physiology, neural signaling, and gene regulation, yet it remains unclear to what extent behavioral maturation reflects incremental changes in individual genes and/or a reorganization of transcriptomic regulation at the system level. Here, we analyze the nurse-to-forager transition in worker honeybees ( Apis mellifera ) from a network perspective, treating the transcriptome as a gene–gene correlation system whose global organization reflects collective regulatory states. Using fat body gene expression data across five developmental time points that span an interval of behavioral transition, we construct signed gene–gene correlation networks and quantify their macro- and mesostate properties. We then descend to the level of the gene and construct microstate gene lists of interacting genes. Behavioral maturation of worker honeybees is accompanied by coordinated, nonmonotonic changes in global network structure rather than simple global shifts in interaction strength across the network. Early stages exhibit broadly positive, globally synchronized correlations, whereas later stages show increased modular segregation and the emergence of antagonistic gene–gene relationships. Despite this differentiation, networks remain fully connected with high global efficiency, consistent with a flexible small-world–like organization. Positive correlations primarily support global integration, while negative correlations act as localized, boundary-enforcing constraints. Negative correlations form a structured pattern of antagonism that is sparse and module-specific, occurring primarily between functional gene modules rather than within them. Network layouts and module analyses reveal two polarized, attractor-like regulatory states, a structure recapitulated in a vitellogenin-centered subnetwork and consistent with prior experimental perturbation studies.

title: Mechanistic insight into conflicting valence fluctuation of Cu(I) photocorrosion pathways: The role of charge behaviors
summary_zh: 研究Cu2O光电腐蚀路径中的电荷行为。制备不同电荷传输特性的Cu2O光电阴极。发现电荷积累与腐蚀行为相关。
summary_en: Investigates charge behaviors in Cu2O photocorrosion pathways. Fabricates Cu2O photocathodes with distinct charge transport properties. Finds correlation between charge accumulation and corrosion behavior.
insights: 电荷积累与腐蚀行为相关
制备了具有不同电荷传输特性的Cu2O光电阴极
发现电荷积累与腐蚀行为相关
insights_en: Charge accumulation correlates with corrosion behavior
Fabricated Cu2O photocathodes with distinct charge transport properties
Charge accumulation correlates with corrosion behavior
abstract: Photocorrosion remains a major challenge that hinders the development of photoelectrochemical (PEC) solar fuel production. Although Cu 2 O is a promising photocathode material due to its suitable band structure and visible light absorption, both oxidative and reductive photocorrosion pathways have been reported, with no consensus established in the research community in the PEC system. In this work, we fabricate three Cu 2 O photocathodes with distinct charge transport properties to investigate the correlation between charge accumulation and photocorrosion behavior. Both oxidative and reductive photocorrosion were observed depending on the type and location of charge accumulation. Notably, we propose a refined oxidative photocorrosion mechanism in which photogenerated holes induce surface Cu 2 O dissolution to Cu 2+ , followed by coordination with adsorbed *OH to form Cu(OH) 2 /CuO under illumination, which is contrary to the widely assumed direct oxidation from Cu 2 O to CuO. This work not only provides a unified understanding of the dual photocorrosion pathways in Cu 2 O, but also offers a generalizable framework for understanding photo-induced degradation in metal oxide photocathodes and for guiding the design of more robust PEC systems through charge transport engineering.

title: Blinks are strategically coupled with head movements in unconstrained natural gaze behavior
summary_zh: 眨眼与头部运动策略性结合。眨眼概率随头部速度增加。眨眼与头部运动时间相关。
summary_en: Blinks are strategically coupled with head movements. Blink probability increases with head velocity. Blinks are temporally modulated relative to head movement onset.
insights: 眨眼与头部运动策略性结合
眨眼概率随头部速度增加
眨眼与头部运动时间相关
insights_en: Blinks are strategically coupled with head movements
Blink probability increases with head velocity
Blinks are temporally modulated relative to head movement onset
abstract: Blinks are a ubiquitous yet largely unnoticed aspect of human vision, despite causing frequent interruptions of visual input that can amount to up to 10% of waking time. By leveraging a large dataset of unconstrained gaze behavior during two natural tasks, we found a behavioral strategy to limit the impact of blinks: blinks were strategically coupled with head movements, which minimizes information loss due to unreliable visual input during head movements. Specifically, blink probability increased with higher head velocities and showed strong temporal modulation relative to head movement onset: Blink probability was reduced before head movement initiation and then peaked during the head movement. The strength of this coupling was tailored to the individual needs of participants, with participants with higher baseline blink rates showing stronger synchronization. This indicates that blinks are a part of an individually coordinated strategy when orchestrating eye and head movements during unconstrained natural behavior.

title: Reduction of aflatoxin contamination in maize kernels mediated by host-induced gene silencing
summary_zh: 利用宿主诱导的基因沉默降低玉米中的黄曲霉毒素。设计RNAi构建体靶向真菌和黄曲霉毒素基因。确认RNAi转基因在转基因玉米中的存在。
summary_en: Reduces aflatoxin contamination in maize kernels via host-induced gene silencing. Designs RNAi constructs targeting fungal and aflatoxin biosynthesis genes. Confirms presence of RNAi transgenes in transgenic maize.
insights: 利用宿主诱导的基因沉默降低黄曲霉毒素
设计RNAi构建体靶向真菌和黄曲霉毒素基因
确认RNAi转基因在转基因玉米中的存在
insights_en: Reduces aflatoxin contamination via host-induced gene silencing
Designs RNAi constructs targeting fungal and aflatoxin biosynthesis genes
Confirms presence of RNAi transgenes in transgenic maize
abstract: Aflatoxins produced by some species of Aspergillus pose a significant threat to global food safety, because they contaminate a variety of crops including maize. In this study, we used host-induced gene silencing (HIGS) to reduce aflatoxin accumulation in maize upon infection with Aspergillus flavus and Aspergillus parasiticus . Two RNAi constructs were designed and introduced into maize, one targeting two essential fungal genes involved in ergosterol biosynthesis ( CYP51A and CYP51B ) and the other targeting three aflatoxin biosynthesis genes ( AflC , AflD , and AflR ). The presence of RNAi transgenes was confirmed in 17 and 14 independent lines possessing the CYP51A/CYP51B RNAi construct and the AflC/AflD/AflR RNAi construct, respectively. Most transgenic lines had single-locus integrations and one or two copies of the transgene. Transgene expression varied considerably among the lines. Small RNA sequencing confirmed the production of siRNAs from the HIGS trigger sequences. Levels of CYP51A , AflC , AflD, and AflR transcripts in Aspergillus spp. were successfully decreased upon infection of transgenic maize. However, significant reduction in the level of CYP51B transcripts was not achieved and the CYP51A/CYP51B RNAi transgene had no discernible effect on fungal growth in infected maize. In contrast, we observed significant reductions in aflatoxin accumulation in four AflC/AflD/AflR RNAi transgenic lines infected with A. flavus and in two transgenic lines infected with A. parasiticus . Notably, one AflC/AflD/AflR transgenic line exhibited minimal aflatoxin contamination upon kernel infection with A. parasiticus . These results demonstrate the potential of HIGS to reduce aflatoxin production in mature corn kernels.

title: Correction for Wolfe et al., Adapting the MasSpec Pen for noninvasive detection of oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma
Superlubricity by glycerosome boundary layers
summary_zh: 甘油脂质体作为边界润滑剂。甘油脂质体摩擦系数低至10^-5。甘油脂质体润滑效果优于传统脂质体。
summary_en: Glycerosomes as boundary lubricants. Glycerosomes achieve a friction coefficient as low as 10^-5. Glycerosomes exhibit superior lubrication compared to conventional liposomes.
insights: 甘油脂质体作为边界润滑剂
甘油脂质体摩擦系数低至10^-5
甘油脂质体润滑效果优于传统脂质体
insights_en: Glycerosomes as boundary lubricants
Glycerosomes achieve a friction coefficient as low as 10^-5
Glycerosomes exhibit superior lubrication compared to conventional liposomes
abstract: The search for high-performance lubricants is of broad relevance to biomedical applications, including artificial joints, regenerative scaffolds, and osteoarthritis therapies. Here we introduce glycerosomes—phosphatidylcholine (PC)-based vesicles containing glycerol—as a promising boundary lubricant. Using a surface force balance, we show that glycerosomes achieve a friction coefficient as low as 10 − 5 under a high compression pressure of 15.6 MPa, representing a 20-fold reduction compared to conventional PC liposomes. This level of lubrication surpasses any previously reported boundary lubricant system at such pressures in aqueous media. Mechanistically, glycerosomes exhibit substantially lower adhesion energy than PC liposomes, and theoretical simulations reveal enhanced vesicle stability and flexibility. Our findings establish glycerosomes as a superior hydration lubrication platform, with promising implications for both biomedical implants and industrial applications requiring robust lubricity.

title: Virus transmission required for maintenance and host adaptation mirrors neurophysiological differences in rabies-derived peptides
summary_zh: 病毒传播与宿主适应需要特定神经生理差异。使用模型和数据分析狂犬病毒传播。狂犬病毒需要不同传播动态以维持。
summary_en: Virus transmission required for maintenance and host adaptation reflects neurophysiological differences in rabies-derived peptides. Uses models and analyses to study rabies virus transmission. Rabies virus requires distinct transmission dynamics for maintenance.
insights: 病毒传播与宿主适应需要特定神经生理差异
使用模型和数据分析狂犬病毒传播
狂犬病毒需要不同传播动态以维持
insights_en: Virus transmission and host adaptation require specific neurophysiological differences
Uses models and analyses to study rabies virus transmission
Rabies virus requires distinct transmission dynamics for maintenance
abstract: Pathogen adaptations to new hosts are central to the disease ecology of cross-species transmission and host switching of viruses. The rabies virus is a model for adaptations to different hosts as it induces behavioral changes that facilitate transmission, while being maintained in distinct species-specific cycles of infection. Here, we demonstrate that the rabies virus requires distinct transmission dynamics in two hosts with different ecologies to establish maintenance, using agent-based modeling, analyses of virus glycoprotein-mediated manipulation of neuroreceptor function, and phylogenetic analysis. Epidemiological models suggest that rabies virus variants adapted to arctic foxes, which sustain rabies virus at very low host densities, require a higher probability of transmission than viruses adapted to raccoons. Using in vitro electrophysiology, we demonstrate that the rabies glycoprotein-derived peptides from arctic fox rabies variants are more potent antagonists of alpha7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptors. These findings suggest a possible functional basis for the behavioral modifications that drive enzootic rabies transmission in the context of host ecology. In addition, a large proportion of residues that may drive rabies virus adaptation to raccoons and arctic foxes are found within this neurotoxin-like region. Furthermore, a residue in the neurotoxin-like region of the mature rabies virus glycoprotein (residue 183) has been associated with pathogenicity, host switching, and disease ecology in previous studies. We propose the hypothesis that rabies virus transmission dynamics adapt to the ecology and physiology of novel hosts through the selection of glycoproteins that elicit specific degrees of behavioral modification and transmission probability.

title: m 7 G modification in mRNA cooperates with QKI to promote homologous recombination repair
summary_zh: m7G修饰的mRNA与QKI合作促进同源重组修复。m7G修饰的RNA在DSB位点积累。QKI5直接与MRE11相互作用。
summary_en: m7G modification in mRNA cooperates with QKI to promote homologous recombination repair. m7G-modified RNA accumulates at DSB sites. QKI5 directly interacts with MRE11.
insights: m7G修饰的mRNA与QKI合作促进同源重组修复
m7G修饰的RNA在DSB位点积累
QKI5直接与MRE11相互作用
insights_en: m7G modification in mRNA cooperates with QKI to promote homologous recombination repair
m7G-modified RNA accumulates at DSB sites
QKI5 directly interacts with MRE11
abstract: DNA double strand breaks (DSBs) are repaired through distinct pathways, with homologous recombination (HR) favored when DNA ends undergo extensive resection. Although cytoplasmic N7-methylguanosine (m7G)-modified RNA increases after UV-induced single-strand breaks, its role in DSB repair (including HR) remains unclear. Here, we show that m7G-modified RNA accumulates at DSB sites, where it recruits the m7G reader protein Quaking (QKI)5, to selectively promote HR. Mechanistically, QKI5 directly interacts with MRE11 and enhances its DNA binding affinity, thereby facilitating DNA end resection. Depletion of QKI5 impairs recruitment of the MRE11–RAD50–NBS1 complex to DSBs and reduces HR repair efficiency. Moreover, elevated QKI5 expression is associated with resistance to radiotherapy in both mouse models and clinical cohorts. Together, these findings identify the m7G RNA–QKI5–MRE11 axis as a regulator of HR pathway choice and suggest QKI5 as a promising therapeutic target in cancer treatment.

title: HAP40 functions as a proteostasis regulator by controlling huntingtin interactions and its release into the extracellular space
summary_zh: HAP40通过控制亨廷顿蛋白相互作用和释放调节蛋白质稳态。HAP40是HTT的必需相互作用伙伴。HAP40缺失影响mHTT表达。
summary_en: HAP40 functions as a proteostasis regulator by controlling huntingtin interactions and its release into the extracellular space. HAP40 is an obligate interaction partner of HTT. HAP40 loss impairs mHTT expression.
insights: HAP40通过控制亨廷顿蛋白相互作用和释放调节蛋白质稳态
HAP40是HTT的必需相互作用伙伴
HAP40缺失影响mHTT表达
insights_en: HAP40 functions as a proteostasis regulator by controlling huntingtin interactions and its release into the extracellular space
HAP40 is an obligate interaction partner of HTT
HAP40 loss impairs mHTT expression
abstract: Huntingtin-associated protein 40 (HAP40) forms a stable protein complex with huntingtin (HTT). Its cellular function and how HAP40 loss influences mutant HTT (mHTT) abundance and pathobiology are currently unclear. Here, using diverse cellular models and omics methods, we demonstrate that HAP40 is an obligate interaction partner of HTT and through its binding controls HTT interactions and the abundance of HTT-associated proteins, indicating that it functions as a HTT interaction regulatory unit. Also, loss of HAP40 in mHTT-expressing striatal cells impairs autophagic protein degradation and triggers transcriptional activation of the CLEAR network, demonstrating that it functions as a proteostasis regulator that acts on quality control pathways. Finally, mHTT-expressing cells lacking HAP40 showed increased secretion of a ~205 kDa mHTT fragment through an endoplasmic reticulum (ER)/Golgi-associated route, indicating that striatal cells reduce intracellular mHTT-induced proteotoxicity through activation of secretory pathways. Together, these results establish HAP40 as a critical proteostasis regulator that through controlling HTT interactions maintains cellular homeostasis.

title: c-FLIP loss links arrest of gene expression to TNFα-dependent antiviral guard immunity
summary_zh: c-FLIP缺失将基因表达停滞与TNFα依赖性抗病毒防御联系起来。感染抑制宿主基因表达。c-FLIP缺失不激活防御除非TNFα存在。
summary_en: c-FLIP loss links arrest of gene expression to TNFα-dependent antiviral guard immunity. Infection suppresses host gene expression. c-FLIP loss does not activate defense unless TNFα is present.
insights: c-FLIP缺失将基因表达停滞与TNFα依赖性抗病毒防御联系起来
感染抑制宿主基因表达
c-FLIP缺失不激活防御除非TNFα存在
insights_en: c-FLIP loss links arrest of gene expression to TNFα-dependent antiviral guard immunity
Infection suppresses host gene expression
c-FLIP loss does not activate defense unless TNFα is present
abstract: Cells sense infection through dedicated receptors, yet these surveillance pathways are often subverted by pathogen-encoded virulence factors. Guard immunity provides complementary defense by rapidly killing infected cells in response to infection induced stress. However, the symptoms of infection frequently resemble noninfectious stress, raising the question of how they are distinguished. Using quantitative transcriptomics, proteomics, and global translation measurements during viral infections in vitro and in vivo, we show that infection globally suppresses host gene expression and prevents direct antiviral responses. However, the resulting proteostatic stress does not activate guard immunity unless tumor necrosis factor-α (TNFα) is present. We identify the anti-apoptotic protein c-FLIP as a guard for gene expression integrity: its loss sensitizes cells to TNFα, triggering cell death and limiting viral spread. Modeling demonstrates that TNFα and c-FLIP loss function as a biological AND-gate, providing specificity and speed. These findings show how cells integrate internal stress signals with external inflammatory cues to improve the fidelity of death decisions, and how this circuitry may misfire during noninfectious inflammation.

title: No Reflow at Perfusion Imaging: Thresholds for Outcome Groups | Radiology in a Minute
